articleTitle: Development and Application of Down-hole Tool Virtual Laboratory of Petroleum Engineering Specialty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, the importance of down-hole tool virtual laboratory in the petroleum engineering experimental teaching is discussed; the whole process to realize the virtual lab by means of multimedia courseware is introduced; the key technologies to develop the down-hole tool virtual lab are described in details in five aspects, i.e. the selection of experimental contents, the design of multimedia courseware, the preparation of materials, the system integration and the software debugging and packaging. Practice has proved that the virtual lab plays an important role in the experimental teaching, and good effect is achieved.

articleTitle: Determinants of Chinese Exhibitor Satisfaction and Re-attend Intention
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This research used factor analysis to explore the underlying factors that might affect the satisfaction level and re-attend intention of Chinese exhibitors to an exhibition, and then utilized regression equation to verify the reliability of factor analysis and disclosed the relative importance of these factors to the satisfaction level and re-attend intention of Chinese exhibitors. This research is helpful to provide a better way to understand the Chinese exhibition industry, the various needs of Chinese exhibitors and the determinants that affect the satisfaction level and re-attend intention of Chinese exhibitors, and also helpful to give supports to Chinese exhibition organizers and accelerate the growth of Chinese exhibition industry.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Earnings Management of China's Comercial Banks in New Accounting Standards
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Effective Techniques to Improve Teaching Quality in IT Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Quality Control begins with education and ends with education. Training is very important in IT enterprises and all kinds of industry. While the approaches to give training courses is different from those traditional lecture formats. Several models of project-oriented courses are introduced herein. Effective techniques such as the course objectives and format, course management and project, the role of the course coordinator, a necessary condition for success: upper management involvement, curriculum for the lecture sessions, project monitoring, final projects day, and internal use of the project course format are expatiated. After several years of experiense, these kinds of project format courses can convey to the students the investigative approach to problem solving.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Bottleneck of Mobile E-commerce in ChongQing Based on PEST Analytical Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This is significant of great efforts to develop mobile e-commerce, promoting the building of mobile e-commerce bases and model area in Chongqing, gradually creating national mobile e-commerce industry gathered center and e-commerce applications innovation center and the construction of information technology experimental zone of co-ordinating urban and rural areas. In this paper, PEST analysis from politics, economy, society and technology analyzes the bottleneck affecting the development of mobile e-commerce in Chongqing, which promotes innovative ideas of the development of mobile e-commerce in Chongqing and gain experience.

articleTitle: Study of the Optimum Extraction of Coal Resources Based on the Rate of Comprehensive Extraction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Low efficiency and waste are the main problems in the process of coal resources extraction in China. Taking the utilization and recovery rate into account, the article has analyzed the factors influencing the utilization and recovery rate and given some suggestions to improve it by setting up a dynamic optimal model. The analysis result indicates that: (i)the policy based on reserves to impose the taxes is more reasonable to improve the utilization and recovery rate,(ii) through the differential tax which is low imposed on the low-grade resources, the waste due to the drop of low-grade resources can be effectively reduced.

articleTitle: New Accounting Standards Influence on Earnings Conservatism of Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The earnings conservatism is an important prerequisite for rational investors who make decisions. China's new accounting standards clearly spelled out the conservatism as one of quality requirements of accounting information for the first time. This paper examines the influence of china's new accounting standards on the earnings conservatism of listed companies, results shows that: 1)The earnings of listed companies in china have kept conservative from 2006 to 2008???2)After the implementation of the new accounting standards, china's listed companies earnings conservatism has decreased. Though the public company conservatism has improved in 2008 compared with 2007, it is not significant.

articleTitle: The Optimization Implementation of High Performance Video Decoder Based on C6416 DSP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of the multimedia and network technology, video applications such as VOD, video-phone etc. are used more and more widely in our life. Consider by the high performance and easy implementation, we select TMS320 c6416 DSP platform and implement the MPEG-4 decoder. Based on the architecture and instruction characteristic of DSP, structure-level, program-level, code-level optimization was conducted respectively. Experimental data show that the decoder implemented can decode video in real time efficiently.

articleTitle: Research of the Adaptiveness of Telecommunication Networks Based on Modularity Concept
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Telecommunications network is one of the most important parts of urban infrastructure, ensuring the normal operation of the urban. As modern urban functions are continuously being optimized, how can we make telecom network construction more responsive to the changes of urban functions become the focus of recent studies. Modularization has been used mostly in order for the management of complex systems to be simplified. In this present paper, an adaptive model of telecommunication network modules will be established and the adaptive behavior of telecommunication network modules will be analyzed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study of the Employability-Based Talent Cultivating Pattern
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Discussion for CI-CM Model Application in the Culture Creative Industry of Binhai New District, Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With beginning of analysis in the relation and difference between Creative Industry and Culture Creative from the tow point of views of Creative Industry birth history and its inbeing, this paper gives the feasibility of Culture Creative Industry. And, this paper studies circumstances around Culture Industry in the Binhai New District so as to give birth to CI-CM model, which based on 'fast path' model for the development of the Binhai New District Culture Creative Industry. At the end of this paper, we analysis the conditions and superiority for application CI-CM model in development of the Binhai New District Culture Creative Industry from the point of the market, cost, investment, protection for the knowledge property right etc of views. So we get the conclusion: the Binhai New District should develop its Culture Creative Industry using the CI-CM model to advance and light the Tianjin's culture status.

articleTitle: Research on E-Payment Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of the Internet, particularly the further development of online shopping, electronic payment types are continual being discovered and there are additional methods that exist or are being developed continuously. This paper analyses various E-payment types and presents the advice to develop the third-party payment.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Avoiding Human Resources Outsourcing Risk
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, although Human Resources Outsourcing becomes popular in china, risks contained in the process of Human Resources Outsourcing restrict its further development and prospect. This situation not only goes against the development of Human Resources Outsourcing service, but also makes it difficult for the outsourcing enterprises to develop core competitive strength through Human Resources Outsourcing. For the above reasons, Outsourcing Risks become an important research subject in the field of Human Resources Outsourcing. Currently, most of the researches are concentrated on the demanding party of Human Resources Outsourcing service market, without considering the risks caused by supplies. This paper analyzes Human Resources Outsourcing Risks from the perspective of service providers and raised the measures to reduce risks.

articleTitle: How to Value the Brand Valuation of an E-Commerce Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Along with the new rapid economic development which is characterized by web-based, knowledge management and globalization, e-commerce enterprises have become the main model of enterprise development. High-quality brand value is the central part of the brand management elements and decisive force in the survival and development of e-commerce enterprises. The e-commerce companies brand value assessment model has been studied and discussed according to the classic brand valuation model.

articleTitle: The Development and Application of Petroleum Engineering Network Course Learning System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Knowledge of petroleum engineering specialty is applied throughout the entire process of oilfield production, the petroleum engineering course is very important in petroleum engineering specialty. In the context that the professionals who engage in the oil production are currently asked to enhance the learning of the special knowledge of petroleum engineering, it is necessary for petroleum colleges to develop a network course which makes the non-petroleum professional students and people engaged in the oil production learn by themselves. E-learning is a digital learning method on the condition of network. The range of its application is extending gradually. E-learning method is introduced and the "petroleum engineering" online course is set up based on the WebCT course platform in campus network. Students can learn all aspects of special knowledge of the Petroleum Engineering curriculum systematically and completely through the network by themselves and good learning effect is achieved.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Classification of Typical Family in Beijing from the Perspective of Investment Portfolio
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Design Consideration and Implementation of Portscan Detection Module on NP-Based IDS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper we describe the design consideration and implementation of portscan detection module regarding to TCP analyzing of SCUT NIDS. The aim of the portscan module is to take immediate action in response to alerts generated by SCUT NIDS to protect the system from portscan attacks. Portscan module is required to maintain TCP connection records, the design of such a connection table is not trivial for a high speed IDS with large number of active connections and high packet arrival rate,especially in a resource constrains Intel IXP2400 network processor. After comparing various design options, we adapted from hash table data structure, employing the special hardware unit assist to calculate a hash over our unique ascending order quadruple which worked in a quite simple but efficient way that is totally different from the Snort scheme, our design not only differentiates both directions of a TCP connection and thus eliminates unwanted additional search operation, but also avoids data corruption and greatly reduces the probability of hash collisions. In order to improve the allocation/deallocation procedure for TCP connection nodes in our IDS systems, we further devised a large management stack caching with a local memory buffer, which is fully exploiting the specialized network processor architectures and optimizing the use of various types of memories with different speeds and size. The theoretical analysis and experiments confirmed that the combination of a large conventional hash table-based search and an array-based stack with caching improves the performance significantly.

articleTitle: China's Energy Development Strategy Coping with Climate Change
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Energy is an important material basis in economic growth and social development. China's industrialization will consume inevitably lots of energy and resources. Energy supply and energy security have become major Constraints of China's industrialization. At the same time, the issue of China's energy security is more serious from the climate pressure of the international society. This paper studies the changes and features of the energy structure since China's reform and opening up, and analyses the problems of energy development process in the context of continuously increasing the gap between energy supply and demand. It puts forward countermeasures and suggestions to China's future energy development. There is important practical significance about the results to China's energy security and the sustained, healthy development of national economy.

articleTitle: Research on the Wiki & HIS-Based Application Mode of Hospital Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Through the requirement analysis of hospital management, the paper elaborates the necessity and feasibility of hospital informatization from the traditional information management to knowledge management based on the hospital information system (HIS hereafter). With the discussion of knowledge management mechanisms and characteristics of Wiki, a Wiki & HIS-based application mode of hospital knowledge management is put forward with a case of the clinician combined with his practical application. This solution can organically match the e-commerce service mode and the techniques of Web2.0 to the requirement of hospital knowledge management, and is helpful to construct the new dynamic, open, distributed and service-oriented hospital information system.

articleTitle: A Framework for Management of Information Resources in E-government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Increasing information in electronic government have challenged traditional management policies and practices. And with these challenges, the need for a scientific management pattern for the quality and quantity of available information in e-government is urgent. Adaptive management will be required to maximize the utilization of any option for management of information resource in e-government and to achieve long-term objectives through implementation of information ecosystem management. This paper proposes a framework that can be used to scope management of information resources in e-government and investigates its relation with objectives of information resources management. The structural elements of the framework include analyzing the complexity and uncertainty of information resources in e-government, mode of adaptive management, environment of adaptive management, and platform of adaptive management. A reference framework for better management of information resources in e-government is provided.

articleTitle: Design and Establishment of Website of Bilingual Demonstration Course
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: “Introduction to Food Science and Technology” from Tianjin University of Science and Technology has been selected as National Bilingual Demonstration Course in July 2009. In combination with the practice of building up the site, this paper discusses how to construct the course website, improve its quality, and exert its influence.

articleTitle: Design of Double-power Controller in Mesh Node with Harmonic Analysis Function
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper issues the design of three-phase AC power supply, which is used by control equipment of multi-radio mesh node in CR network. The design frame including hardware structure and software flow chart is explained, and the arithmetic for ascertaining zero of AC voltage during frequency component calculation is emphasized.

articleTitle: A New Adaptive Cumulative Layered Multicast Scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we introduced an adaptive cumulative layered multicast scheme, ACLM, to address multicast receivers' heterogeneity in available bandwidth. ACLM uses an optimal layer rate allocation algorithm which can maximally satisfy each receiver's available bandwidth. Through a novel feedback aggregate algorithm, ACLM dynamically determines the number of layers and the rate of each layer. Simulation results show that ACLM is adaptive and TCP-friendly. Meanwhile it can optimize overall throughput.

articleTitle: A Research on Pricing Strategy of E-commerce Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The global financial crisis make the world's economic uncomfortable generally, Transmission of influenza viruses affect the traditional retail and other business. E-commerce is growing strongly buck the trend. The pricing of logistics which service for e-commerce, becoming a more important part of enterprise management to reduce costs, improve competitive advantage. This paper analyzes the structure of e-commerce logistics services price and pricing motivation, explores the pricing index system of e-commerce logistics services, put forward a series of reasonable pricing strategies and methods of e-commerce logistics service.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Coordination of the Cooperation Risk in Supply Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article distinguishes and analyses the various supply risk, and discusses intensively a kind of important basic risk-cooperation risk from both quality and quantity sides. After discusses of corporate risk's different respects, the article estimates the supply network's cooperation risk by two different methods. One method makes use of the financial risk and loss evaluation thought, other is the “chi-square” for obtaining a priority vector from multiplicative and fuzzy preference relations.

articleTitle: Information Hiding Technology in Electronic Notes System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper starts from security needs of electronic notes in the present situation of e-commerce and discusses the application of information hiding technology and relative concepts. Then it presents a algorithm of information hiding technology that applies in the electronic notes system, including embedded hidden information algorithm and hidden information extraction algorithm, and describes the idea of the algorithm. Finally, the paper discusses realization of the e-ticketing system based on information hiding technology, and points out the security that information hiding technology brings to the system, so that the e-ticketing system gets with the security needs of e-commerce in authentication, notes anti-counterfeiting, tamper-resistant features.

articleTitle: Study on Emergency Management Evaluation for Super-long Tunnel on the Basis of GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The number of super-long road constructing tunnels are increased sharply. How to improve service manage and damage prevention. It is a hot problem that the department of expressway road tunnel and service are concerned. Damage prevention of super-long road tunnel is a comprehensive system that it is technology and control. This paper achieves the function that the data is preserved, statistically analyzed and comprehensively evaluated in view of artificial neural networks on the basis of GIS. Puts forward damage prevention evaluation index system. It includes management organization system, traffic control system, hazardous goods and safe checking system, rescue organization and fire control system, mechanical and electrical system, monitor system, civil structure maintenance control system, fire emergency system and safe control system. Divides into damage prevention grade in view of different weight value and damage prevention grade of different index. It suggests a basis for damage prevention evaluation of super-long road tunnel.

articleTitle: The Design of Wireless Students Management System Based on Fingerprint Sensor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Attendance check is important in the work of students management. In this paper a students attendance check and personal identification system design based on fingerprint Sensor FPS200 and wireless communication module nRF903 is proposed. It is included fingerprint identification terminal equipment, floor relay station, building relay station and control center. We design a mix star network topologic and tree network topologic structure to translation the data. Delphi5.0 is used to developing the management software to realize students' fingerprint database management. Applications show this system can complete the personal identification and attendance check of students immediately, thus it can offer useful information for the student management department.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Estimation of Economic Value of Recyclables Collected by Waste Pickers and Collectors and Suggestions for Their Mangement in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Cooperation Strategies Selection about R&D Investment in Enterprise Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the enterprises cluster in the two stages of R&D and market under a variety of strategies, comparing the R & D investment and profit under each strategy. Then proposing to build innovation and services platform systems and creating regional brand are the optimal choices to the enterprise cluster.

articleTitle: The Centralized or Decentralized Security Analysis of E-Government Intercommunication
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Information security has externality because of the infection of information system security. The e-Government intercommunication improved information share and work efficiency while the emergence of new security problems was produced. This paper analyzed the security of E-Government intercommunication similar security ability by mathematics mode considering the important factor that the infection of information security can be controlled through intercommunication infrastructure for the first time. It argues that consolidation intercommunication infrastructure, uniform standard, centralization management can bring right benefit. In additional, from security cost control parameter q of several technology intercommunication infrastructures comparison, the technology with smallest security cost control parameter q should be choose first depend on the model analysis when the development intercommunication infrastructure.

articleTitle: Research on E-Business Ecosystem and Its Internal Coordination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper proposed the role and composition of an e-business ecosystem, and analyzed some problems likely to occur among members of an e-business ecosystem such as trust, interest scrambling, information asymmetry, and coordination. Finally, it proposed four coordinating mechanisms-relation coordinating, interest coordinating, information coordinating, and operation coordinating.

articleTitle: Study on Multi-levels Incentive Mechanism Model for Tacit Knowledge Sharing in Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Tacit knowledge exists in knowledge main-bodies of different hierarchy in enterprise. To enable full sharing and improve core competitiveness, incentive models of knowledge sharing for knowledge main-bodies of different hierarchy should be established; According to principal- agency theory, and taking into account incomplete information of knowledge sharing, multi-stages incentive model of knowledge sharing for knowledge worker, incentive model of knowledge sharing for knowledge team based on team sharing interests, and incentive model of knowledge sharing for supplier, are proposed. The results indicate that, in order to acquire maximum rewards in enterprise, special incentive contracts are to be made for different knowledge main-bodies, optimal incentive decisions to meet enterprise own objective are to be made, and knowledge body's knowledge sharing effort is to be improved.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on E-Commerce Influences to Competitive Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The development of E-commerce brings new topics to enterprise competitive intelligence research. It is important to study the E-commerce influences to competitive intelligence in E-commerce environment for better supporting the planning and implementing of enterprise competitive strategy. The article puts forward an E-commerce influence model to competitive intelligence work and a revised model by empirical research. The result can benefit further research on competitive intelligence in E-commerce environment.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Coordination by Revenue Sharing Based on Continuous Quantity Discount Function
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper investigates the mechanism of revenue sharing (RS) among the actors in a two-stage supply chain (SC) with a decentralized decision process. The SC consists of a manufacturer, and a distributor, and in the chain, profit is shared proportional to the actors' investment amount or effort level, and sharing profit equally means sharing risk. Whether they cooperate depends on sensitivity coefficients of market demand function and quantity discount function. In a numerical example, the actors' common preference interval about profit fraction is exploited and a new RS contract is proposed, and the total SC profit and the consumer surplus (CS) with the new method are proved higher than that in the competitive market scenario. This paper also implies that direct marketing is of a higher profit level compared with distribution, however, transformation of sales mode from distribution into direct marketing needs gradual transition with the new contract, and sales mode analyses of Lenovo Company, Dell Company and Compad Company are provided to illustrate this point.

articleTitle: Incentive Mechanism Study Based on Game Analysis for New Housing Security System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper makes two phase Game models which are under the background of central government carries out the incentive mechanism, based on the different choices on profit between central government and local government in the construction of safeguard housing and the characteristics of official achievement competition in local governments. Through the models, we can get the result that the only efficient way to advance the construction of safeguard housing is that central government must carry out necessary incentive mechanism. While the central government is making this mechanism, they need to hold the intension of encourage and add on the matched restricted system. Then there will be satisfied construction of safeguard housing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Operation Mode of Chinese Storage Logistics Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on the Paths of Low-carbon Urban Construction Driven by Low-carbon Consumption
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Low-carbon urban construction relies on impelling both low-carbon production and low-carbon consumption simultaneously. Under the condition of socialist market economy, low-carbon consumption is more important than low-carbon production because of its guiding role of the latter. Therefore, on the basis of analysis on the status quo of both low-carbon productive consumption and low-carbon individual consumption in Shanghai, we put forward several paths of low-carbon urban construction driven by low-carbon consumption. Overall, low-carbon productive consumption can be promoted by industry restructuring and energy saving and emission reduction reconstructing. Meanwhile, low-carbon individual consumption will realize by means of enhancing public consciousness of low-carbon and accelerating the transformation from consciousness to action.

articleTitle: How Does the Tax Collection Efficiency in China?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the technique of stochastic frontier analysis and China’s provincial panel data from 1997 to 2005, this paper studies tax collection efficiency and the factors affecting it. The empirical analysis shows that: From 1997 to 2005, the efficiency of tax collection increased in different regions, the average efficiency of sample regions increased from 0.482 to 0.672, and the aggregate level of efficiency was still not high, which showed that there was great potential room to improve tax collection efficiency in China. Although there was large gap among different regions, the statistics showed that the efficiency of tax collection and management underwent narrowing tendency. The increase of the proportion of female staff can improve the efficiency of tax collection and management; the person whose age is between 36 and 45 years old had a higher efficiency; the level of economic development gave positive effects on tax collection efficiency. However, its effect was relatively weak; appropriately reducing the number of tax staff can improve the efficiency of tax collection and management.

articleTitle: Research on County Community Health Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Community Health Service (CHS for short) has played a more and more important role in people's life as a new type of health service. However, it had many obstacles to get further development, especially for county CHS. As a social service, the people living in counties need the CHS more than the ones living in big cities. In this paper, it made an in-depth analysis on the problems exist in the development of county CHS, and then put forward its suggestions with the stress of governmental responsibility being laid.

articleTitle: HR Recruitment Websites Evaluation Based on AHP-FSE
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, human resource recruitment websites have been more and more popular in the talent market. The HR recruitment website is an important part in the E-business world. Several HR recruitment websites in China have been in a leading position in this field. In the mean time job hunters find it difficult to assess those websites for their choice decision. This paper utilizes Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Fuzzy Synthetic Evaluation (FSE) to establish a set of methods to evaluate and rank the leading HR recruitment websites in China, helping leaders and managers making decisions in concerning fields as well as helping web surfers and job hunters selecting their preferred channels.

articleTitle: A Study on the Reciprocal Relationship between Strategic Resource, Diversification Strategy and Capital Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the panel data of 762 listed companies in China from 2003-2006, this paper analyzed the relationship between a firm's strategic resource, diversification strategies and its capital structure by establishing a simultaneous equation model. Our empirical results show that strategic resource and diversification strategies significantly affect capital structure. In turn, capital structure affects the investment on strategic resource and the choice of diversification strategies. Capital structure and strategic resource, diversification strategies are reciprocally interrelated.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Brand-Assemblage Strategy: A Comparative Analysis on Two Typical Industrial Clusters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Nature and Experience of Eco-friendly Operation of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The concept of eco-friendly operation of enterprises has been put forward for a long time but up to now we cannot find a clear definition for eco-friendly operation. Most of existing research and paper define eco-friendly operation from the viewpoint of environmental protection. Existing environmental concept, to some extent, hampers business getting profit. So clarifying the nature of eco-friendly operation of business is very important for business sustainable development. In order to provide a theoretical basis of business eco-friendly operation this paper explores the internal mechanism and core content of business eco-friendly operation and makes some extend analysis by historical methodology. In this paper we theorize the mechanisms of the experience of eco-friendly operation during the pursuit of both environmental performance and financial performance.

articleTitle: The Application of Network Marketing Tools
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The exploitation and utilization of Internet marketing tools is mainly to make the network marketing function come true. This paper mainly dissertate in detail the function of network marketing from the respect of online survey, online information issue, website popularize, web brand establish, online promotion, distribution channel, after sale services. Those aspects reflect the whole process activities of marketing on internet.

articleTitle: Application of Organizational Project Management Maturity Model Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The objective of this paper is to present an approach to apply the Organizational Project Management Maturity Model (OPM3) to effectively assess organizational project management capability. Assessment index system is put forward based on OPM3, and BP neural network assessment model is constructed. Model is trained and validated through computer simulation by Matlab software. The result shows that the proposed approach can obtain objective and accurate assessment.

articleTitle: On Shortest Path Interval Games
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, a kind of shortest path interval game is studied. The following two theorems are obtained. (1) When the coalition S owns the path, and the condition W(S)=[W<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub>(S),W<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub>(S)+c] is true for some fixed c≥0, then there exists no-empty interval core; (2) When the coalition S owns the path, and the condition W(S)=[W<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub>(S), (1+θ)W<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub>(S)] is true for some fixed θ≥0, then there exists no-empty interval core. By using the concept of the point core of the game introduced by S. Zeynep Alparslan Gök, the lower point game and upper point game are defined. Using the concept of compositive defined in this paper, the interval game is translated to two point games. By introducing the concept of critical value, it bound the range of incomes of the game. Finally, the distribution of the interval core simplified by defining the minimal supporting set.

articleTitle: Constructing of the Foreign Exchange Management Information System of the Transnational Corporation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As China drives domestic enterprises to implement the development strategy of "going global", foreign activities of transnational corporations are increasing every year, and issues of their foreign exchange management are quite highlighted. This paper analyzed the significance of constructing a foreign exchange management information system in the process of China transnational corporations' foreign business, and explored the content of constructing the foreign exchange management information system of the transnational corporation, such as the basic framework, the information constitution, network requirements and information transmission requirements etc.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical Study on the Elements of Employment Ability of College Students Based on Employing Unit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Investigation of High-efficiency Abrasive Finishing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: High efficiency abrasive finishing technologies are newest developed advanced machining processes to satisfy super-hardness and difficult-to-machining materials machined. In the present paper, development status and latest progresses on high efficiency abrasive finishing technologies relate to high speed and super-high speed grinding, quick point-grinding, high efficiency deep-cut grinding, creep feed deep grinding, heavy-duty snagging and abrasive belt grinding were summarized. The efficiency and parameters range of these abrasive finishing processes were compared. The key technologies of high efficiency abrasive finishing, including grinding wheel, spindle and bearing, grinder, coolant supplying, installation and orientation of wheel and workpiece and safety defended, as well as intelligent monitor and NC grinding were investigated. It is concluded that high efficiency abrasive finishing is a promising technology in the future.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Countermeasures of Payment Risk in Construction Contract
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Knowledge Management Capability to Intellectual Property Risk in Enterprise Independent Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: During the process of enterprises implementing independent innovation, intellectual property risk will be induced by a variety of uncertain events. So this paper analyzes the influence of Knowledge management capability to intellectual property risk through 218 questionnaires with SEM, the main contributions can be summarized as follows: the capability of knowledge conversion, knowledge application and knowledge protection can effectively reduce the intellectual property risk which independent innovation enterprise faced. To the enterprise, design of organization mechanism, application of information technology can promote knowledge management, in order to avoid facing the intellectual property risk which is caused by all kinds of omissions on the knowledge management at the greatest degree. The orientation of further research are proposed at last.

articleTitle: ODR in E-Government and Obstacles to Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Many developed countries consider e-government to be an essential strategy to modernizing government. Undoubtedly it is imperative that ODR be incorporated into e-government strategies because not only will ODR free up court resources but ODR is generally cheaper, quicker and less adversarial. However, there is a `digital divide' existing between developed and developing counties in utilizing ODR, although some developing counties have already begun to recognize the potential that ODR offer and made some achievement. But the ability to realize the potential gains from e-government and ODR is dependent on a number of variables such as political support, the existence of an adequate legal framework, available funds and infrastructure, technical and security factors and cultural changes. Only when the necessary steps have been taken by governments in developing countries to provide their citizens with access to ODR, we will be a lot closer to overcoming the digital divide.

articleTitle: A Study on the Evaluation of the e-Commerce Maturity Degree for Construction Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Embarking from the content of the architecture industry e-commerce, the paper first build up a systematic index of the e-commerce maturity degree for construction enterprises from the view points of the management environment, technical support, the applying procedures, security and the benefits of e-commerce; And then use the method combined grey relational analysis and the TOPSIS method to build up an evaluation model; At last give out the sorting of the e-commerce maturity degree of construction enterprises according to the relative proximity. On the purpose of helping the construction enterprise evaluate its e-commerce application level, this model provides the important reference for the enterprise decision-making.

articleTitle: E-Participation in Network Political Era: Background, Features and Functions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Citizen political participation in future will inevitably show a lot of revolutionary features of digit and network. The rise of e-participation is closely related to the rapid development of social economy and network technology. The political background of e-participation is mainly composed of the crisis of representative democracy and the trend of direct democracy. Moreover, the new ideas of service-oriented government based on civil society will further promote the development of e-participation. There are a range of new characteristics in e-participation, such as reducing the cost of political participation, broadening its channels, and making direct democracy possible. E-participation has a positive impact on the democratic development. First, it may reduce the sense of people's political apathy and increase their enthusiasm for political participation. Second, it may cultivate citizens' democratic consciousness and political responsibility. Third, network consensus supervision might become the most extensive and representative one in the whole society. Fourth, the e-participation also contributes to the reforms of governments’ management, which is mainly reflected as follows: the power structure changes from the centralization model to the decentralized one; decision-making structure changes from the vertical model to the interactive model; networks will weaken the functions of governments' regulations, enhance the communication and contact between governments and the public, and highlight the governments' service functions.

articleTitle: Argumentation-Based Negotiation Support
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Argumentation theory can be used to model legal reasoning, non-monotonic reasoning and many other problems. In this paper a framework of argumentation-based negotiation support is provided. Based on argumentation theory approaches supporting negotiators’ decision processes and their negotiation dialogues are redesigned. Integrating decision support with communication support in the same framework aims to facilitate information sharing between negotiators, improve acceptability of negotiation proposals by providing sound arguments, and realize flexible, robust and explainable negotiation support.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Analysis of Food Safety Prevention from Economic and Ethics Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of the Telecommunications Business Navigation System Based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The telecommunication e-Business Navigation System is a typical Information Management System. In this paper a design of the Telecommunication Business Navigation System based on the J2EE has been proposed, which mainly implements the management of the telecommunication company's daily business, such as product information, goods information, AP information, SP information and etc. It uses Structs framework, Hibernate framework and spring framework technology, and also uses Tomacat as the web container to construct the WEB management system based on B/S. It behaves as a milestone of the telecommunications industry.

articleTitle: Virtual Organization Project Management Capability for Large Scale Engineering Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Virtual organization is the normality of the organization of large scale engineering project. The concept of virtual organization project management capability (VOPMC) is proposed. The dimension of VOPMC includes process, organization and content. Project management should cope with standard problems, systematic problems and complex problems. The VOPMC has three stratums: standard management capability, systematic management capability and complex management capability. VOPMC is integrated, hierarchical, dynamic and harmonious capability. VOPMC perfects the theory of organization project management capability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Management Research on Agreement System Dynamic Automobile Supply Chain Alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Characteristics and Optimal Usage Amount of Environmental Capacity Production Factor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Intelligent Ant System's Applied Researches into Asymmetric Network Storage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The asymmetric network storage system has improved greatly in single point's inefficiency and time delay reduction. Data were transmitted through channels differring from those controlling information. In a shorter period of time acquiring the best path can enhance the performance and reliability of network storage and data transmission. The experiment results demonstrate that the intelligent ant system is able to obtain the best path from among several different storage modes.

articleTitle: The Moral Hazard and Club Model of Internet Presence Provider
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The relationship between consumer and internet trading platform in e-commerce market is seen as a principal-agent relationship under incomplete information, which the moral hazard risk might exist. In order to control the moral hazard risk effectively, the club model for internet trading platform is put forward in this paper. The club model is a virtual organization composed of various Internet presence providers and can be controlled effectively through reputation constraints and championship incentives.

articleTitle: The Design and Exploitation of Tendering Management System Based on Workflow
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes and discusses the concept of workflow, and researches technologies and methods of the workflow modeling and workflow engine. Based on the Workflow model of Management System and using J2EE architecture with a flexible MVC (Model View Control) design pattern, this paper discusses a design process of workflow management system model, and introduces the specific applications of workflow management system model combining with Qixin tendering information management system platform.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Effects of Fiscal Shocks in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the dynamic effects of fiscal shocks in China between 1990 and 2008. We adopt a Bayesian vector auto-regression framework. The main findings are as follows. First, government expenditure expansionary shocks are found to have positive effects on output. These effects become substantially weaker in the last 10 years. Second, the crowding out effects of government expenditure on consumption are found in the long-term other than in the short-term. Although the effects of government spending on prices are usually small and not always significant, they are positive. Third, tax revenues have negative effects on output, consumption, export and prices. The application of these results to the analysis of fiscal policy points to the conclusion that automatic stabilizers should play a more important role in China because the effect of an increase in spending or a cut in taxes would be multiplied by stimulating additional demand for consumption goods.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Elder Tourism Market in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Sustainable Development of Industrial Clusters Based on the Theories of Life Circle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article studied the theories of industry colony life cycle's correlation, analyzed the industrial colony's life cycle which had been divided into four stages: seed time, growth period, mature period and winter. This article introduced the theory of industrial colony sustainable development, elaborated sustainable development's risk of the industrial colony for each stage, and analyzed each stage's sustainable development condition, obtained the sustainable development's factor of the industrial colony for each stage. It also gave feasible suggestions for the industrial colony's sustainable development.

articleTitle: The Application Research on the Heat Shrink Film Packing Machine Based on Hybrid Petri Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The industrial production line is a complex hybrid dynamic system including time discrete and continuous. In order to master the control policy of the production line, the mathematical model and simulation of the heat shrink film packing production line based on the hybrid Petri network technology is put forward in the paper. The result of mathematical simulation model is of quick and high precision, as well as good validity, when the hybrid Petri network theory is applied in the working process of heat shrink film packing system. The mathematical model and simulation has been great helpful for the design and experiment of heat shrink film packing machine.

articleTitle: Process Training for Student in School
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Process training is very important for the student without work experience to gain the process abilities. The process abilities can help students to get an ideal position in the software organizations. But how the process training is hold for students in school? This paper report our effort on process training with our HK student process designed for students.

articleTitle: Marketing Efforts and Dual Channels Coordination under E-Business Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Considering the impact of marketing efforts on channel demand, this paper studies the impact of consumers' perceived risk on competition equilibrium of dual channels, and then studies the problem of dual channels coordination. The research shows that when consumer's perceived risk in Internet shopping increases, the profit of the manufacture and the total channel system will decrease. Comparing with the dual channels without coordination, if manufacture carries out the dual channels coordination tactics, the performance of total channel system will be improved.

articleTitle: Progress in Geographic Information Standardization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper reviews and compares progress in geographic information standardization. The result shows that both international and national standardization organizations are all focusing more and more on standardization of geographic information services, instead of geographic data. Based on the comparison analysis, this paper considers and suggests countermeasures on working mechanism and theoretical content deployment of national geographic information standardization.

articleTitle: Dynamic Comprehensive Evaluation of Property Insurance Companies' Business Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Under the framework of a comprehensive evaluation of business performance, the paper builds comprehensive evaluation index system from aspects of profitability, solvency, operating capability and growth capability, and determines the weight of the evaluation indicators by using ANP. Then it gives a dynamic comprehensive assessment method for property insurance companies’ business performance based on gain level in spiriting and applies it. The empirical study shows that the method is effective, and can objectively assess the comprehensive business performance. It provides a basis for comparison of property insurance companies.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the E-Government Performance of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Performance evaluation of e-government is system engineering, the paper use the econometrics based on systems engineering and how econometrics is used to solve economic problems in e-government of China. This paper adopt the input-output system research method from engineering system technology, work together with econometrics to solve the headache problems which e-government faced today. The content of this paper includes three parts: Research review and hypothesis, data and the quantitative model, the mainly problems of e-government economics. In order to research a number of evaluation modeling factors, the paper tackle the original data of related investigation and study, summarizes the facts from a questionnaire, compares the actual situation of different e-government departments, and finally makes quantitative analysis.

articleTitle: Study on Multi-objective Decision Making Method of Enterprise Project Investment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To multi-objective decision-making problems of Enterprise project investment, this paper analyzed the issues in project decision, considered the factors of qualitative and quantitative in the project decision, and combined with the various constraints of the project selection process, then established the objective planning model of enterprise project investment and discussed the application of the model. The paper proposes applying the 80/20 principle to choice evaluation objectives, and using simplified scoring method to dealing with those qualitative goals.

articleTitle: Research on Market Operating Mechanism of China's Digital Information Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Nowadays, the digital and networked information environment has brought great convenience to people's lives. It is the extensive use of information technology and the rapid development of Internet that has accelerated the global informatization. Thus, the digital information service has become a hot issue. As the market is the key to maintain and function the economic relations, the study of market operating mechanism of digital information would be of great significance. This article is trying to describe the composition of digital information service market with positive analysis, and also analyze its operating mechanism from three aspects: price, supply and demand, as well as competition. At the same time, we also expound the existing problem to present situation of digital information service.

articleTitle: The Optimal Threshold Price for the Name-Your-Own-Price Retailer with Stochastic Demand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Name-Your-Own-Price (NYOP), a new sales mode, has emerged in recent years and is different from traditional pricing mode. Most previous papers study the NYOP channel from the auction perspective or predicting the retailers' inventory is unlimited. However, the NYOP channel differs substantially from the environment studied in the auction. The typical NYOP retailer such as priceline.com sells airline tickets, hotels et al that faces a supply constraint. The online retailers' stochastic revenue model are put forward and numerically analyzed when customers' stochastic demand and the probability distribution of pricing are known. The relationship between the optimal threshold price and limited inventory and the selling time are discussed.

articleTitle: On the Current Situation of Local E-governments-Based on Sample Survey of 6 Provinces in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Adopting absolute and relative value methods in the making of evaluation standard, the thesis contains a sample survey of 6 provincial government portals. And it has been discovered that 100% of the provincial, local and county governments have their own portals established, while units under country level have rarely done so. Those government websites are mostly user-friendly, but not helpful enough, and in need of more interactivity. Generally speaking, those websites were built on low levels. This thesis will provide relevant measures to deal with those deficiencies.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Separable Convertible Pricing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper mainly choose three issued separate stock options and bond trading of convertible bonds which issued in 2008 in China: samples as follows, State Power CWB1, COSCOL and Baosteel CWB1,and from a empirical point of view to analysis the price of these bonds and warrants. Obtained the conclusions that the bond portion has the investment value, analysis the reason of some theoretical warrant price and actual price’s deviation.

articleTitle: A Survey Analysis on Current Situation of Enterprise's MIS in Xiamen
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, a survey on enterprise's MIS is processed in Xiamen, China, which purpose is to understand the current situation of enterprise's MIS. The survey results are analyzed by the use of SPSS, EXCEL and other statistical software. It is pointed out some current problems in Xiamen enterprise's MIS. In the end, some suggestions and programs are presented, which is contributing to the application development on enterprise's MIS in Xiamen.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Chinese and American Travel E-Business Models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Mode of operation of tourism enterprises by the local development level of e-commerce, enterprise's own characteristics, and so on. Tourism e-commerce in China-US business model is far greater than the differences that exist in the service function of the existing differences. In this paper, from a tourist site and a comprehensive Web site navigation, and strategic collaboration between the co-operation and profit model on three aspects of Sino-US travel site within a comparative analysis of business model,And on this basis that the further development of China's tourism e-commerce direction.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Effects of a Firm's Innovative and Risk Taking Propensities on its Innovation Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Mixed Cigarette Storage Mode and Its Warehousing Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper discusses the three cigarette storage modes which are automatic warehousing, big-space one-story warehousing, traditional one-story warehousing as well as their advantages and disadvantages. And on this basis, it focuses on studying combinations of the three modes. The successful use of the mixed mode lies in storage scheduling and goods dispatching or circulation. This paper presents the design principles of scheduling and goods dispatching, puts forth the mode involved. In addition, it carries out a case study, taking Zhengzhou cigarette distribution center as an example. The results demonstrated the superiority of the hybrid storage mode.

articleTitle: Study of Data Agent Memory Thought-Based on P2P Network Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In peer-to-peer networks, The availability of data reduces severely by the node frequent offline, a lot of data transmission service can not carry out because the bandwidth resources extremely limited, there is no a administrator to manage transmission about virus document. To solve these problems, this paper puts forward a method with studying of P2P network model based on data agent memory thought. this model based on data content and evaluation within the scope of the neighborhood and subsequent node to agent memory, the local node visit and search information according to the memory optimization strategy, for a low service evaluation memory regularly updated and deleted. The model use the agent memory and data updated means, the effective method of update reduced bandwidth consumption, improve the searching efficiency, increase the system's security.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis and Prevention of Network Accounting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of computer and network technology, the network environment provide a full range of information support for accounting information system to, network Accounting become new area of accounting development. But network accounting is facing much risk, and would take great danger to the accuracy and security of accounting information. SO, risk analysis of network accounting and proposing suitable measure to it is a new topic that theorists should research at present.

articleTitle: E-learning in Universities: A Social Psychology Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Starting from a CNNIC report and a survey investigation, the article shows the importance of promoting e-learning for college students and its potentiality. As E-learning has developed with new ideas such as equal Learning, the article further analyzes the psychological characteristics of college students and their influence on the current e-learning promotion. The argument has put forward s social psychological perspective on the study of e-learning development in universities.

articleTitle: On Analysis of the Nature and the Effectiveness of the Management Based on the Cobweb-Style Management Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Characteristics and nature of the management are always hot topics studied by people. If we do not make what are characteristics and nature of the management clear, we will not manage well. Therefore, only if we deeply analyze what is the management, we know how to do. The article believes that the management is the activity that the manager makes assumption for the management and imposes the management behaviors on the management objects in order to realize the purpose of the management from the view of the management elements. Through the division of the management elements, the article designs a kind of cobweb-type management structure, in which the management elements play an important role in the management activities, and then determine and show characteristics and nature of the management, that is, the management appropriateness or suitability, as well which also determines the management effectiveness. Accordingly, the article considers we must enhance the management effectiveness mainly based on the nature of the management, the concerned ways as followed: To clear the management purposes and establish the appropriate goals; To analyze the management assumptions and identify the appropriate premises; To impose the manage behavior and accurately gain control of degree; To analyze the management objects with targets; To make the management elements collaborative and emphasize the structural optimization.

articleTitle: Improved Efficient Forward Secure Signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: B. Alomair, K. Sampigethaya and R. Poovendran proposed a generic method to construct forward secure signature schemes from standard signature schemes in EuroPKI 2008 workshop. They propose a forward secure signature scheme (ASP scheme) based on Schnorr signature scheme which is used as a black box. In this paper, we analyze the security of ASP scheme and show an attack to point out that this scheme doesn't satisfy the forward security. Then we modify and improve ASP scheme to overcome the shortcoming. Our scheme can resist to the attack and satisfies the forward security. The most prominent performance of our scheme is that it has the most efficient key update of all known schemes, only running just a hash function once. The security of the modified forward secure signature scheme can be proved to be equivalent to the discrete logarithm problem.

articleTitle: Legal Regulation of Information Asymmetry in E-Business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-business is developing rapidly around the world with the modern electronic information technology. Compared with other countries, however, E-business in China is still on the underway stage. One of the main reasons lies in lack of a good legal system in regulating the information asymmetry, which impairs the credit heavily in the market. Therefore, it is very necessary to embark on the research on the reasons cause the information asymmetry. This paper tries to find the reasons and provide some effective suggestions in resolving the problem.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Operational Risk of Chinese Personal E-Banking
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-banking has become an important innovation to bank industry. Although it has some peculiar advantages, its risk seems more complexity and aggressiveness for its inherent nature. For Chinese e-banking, the most important risk is operational risk, which hinders the development and expansion of Chinese E-banking. Among the Chinese E-banking businesses, the losses of personal e-banking happen more frequently and badly affect the development of e-banking, so we study the operational risk of personal e-banking. We analyze the situation of operational risk of Chinese personal e-banking, and with the small loss data sample, use the peak-over-threshold method to evaluate the severity of the losses, the frequency of the excesses losses and expected shortfall under different confidence, simulate the annual operational loss of Chinese personal e-banking. The results seem credibility and reasonability with the tail test on excesses. The method gives a reference to answer the question that how much the operational risk of Chinese personal e-banking is.

articleTitle: A Research of PBL Platform for E-education Based on Embedded Recording and Broadcasting System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Aiming at the requirement of colleges and universities for the PBL teaching mode, the research designs a foundational training platform for E-education which is based on embedded recording and broadcasting system. The platform adopts VGA card for collecting and encoding signals with the DSP technology, meanwhile, the terminal management program is used to achieve remote control for the hardware.

articleTitle: A Value for Weighted Two-level Coalition Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper generalizes the Shapley Value to a non-symmetric value for transferable utility games with two level coalition structure. Non-symmetry exists in players and in both two-level coalition structures. We present seven axioms to characterize this value and provide a property which show that our result consistent with Levy and McLean's weighted coalition structure value and E. Kalai and D. Sament's weighted Shapley value.

articleTitle: Research on Participant's Behavior of C2C's Credit Evaluation System Based on the Evolutionary Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Existing C2C's credit evaluation system is an important tool to help buyers and sellers who make transactions online to regulate their credit. Since sellers'credit, which imposes profound reference for buyers to decide whether to purchase or not, to safeguard their own interests, some sellers use a variety of ways to undermine the credit evaluation system after they received a bad evaluation from the buyer. By applying evolutionary game theory, this paper simulates the online trading mutual credit evaluation process. An evolutionary game model between buyers and sellers is built to study and analyze the evolving process of participant's behavior and key factors affecting evolutionary stability. It promotes government and the Third-party platform to make effective decisions maintaining the authenticity of the credit evaluation system.

articleTitle: The Tax Issue and Counterplan within Process of the Electronic Commerce Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Electronic commerce development quickly become a part of the national economy, how to construction the fair and orderly environment of e-commerce development, have already become a importance topic of e-commerce. Appeared many new tax problem in the e-commerce environment, these problem influence tax system, tax collection and international tax, etc, according to tax in all countries development and research status, aim the characteristics of our country e-commerce, revise related laws.

articleTitle: Flow Cache Design for Improving Traffic Collection in NP-Based Network Monitor System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper we describe the design consideration and implementation of flow cache architecture based on IXP2400 network processor in SCUT. Network traffic collection provides real world data for further performance analysis and that therefore make it very important for network management and monitoring. However, the design of such a high performance system with efficient flow cache data structure is not trivial in today's high speed and large volume network environment, especially in a resource constrains Intel IXP2400 network processor platform. After comparing various design options, we adapted from hash table combining binary search tree data structure, employing the special hardware unit assist to calculate hash value. Inspired by unix block buffer approach, we further refined our proposed flow cache scheme that not only caches the result from flow collection but also speed up the flow update procedure. By theoretical analysis and careful engineering design, we finally concluded that a combination of a hash table with binary search tree and a group linked free buffer list with caching provides us a remarkable performance gain.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Monitoring of Financial Prosperity Based on Entropy Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The same as macro-economy, enterprise's financial status also exists a prosperity cycle which displays from contraction to expansion and form boom to depression. According to the principle of macro-economic prosperity monitoring, based on the entropy model in informational theory, the paper constructs the financial prosperity index and designs a dynamic monitoring method which includes trend graph of financial prosperity and signal graph of financial prosperity. The method supplies a new means to depict the features and process of the periodic fluctuations in enterprise's financial status intuitively. It uses financial data of listed companies in common manufacturing industry in the application research based on this principle and method.

Author Keywords: Signal Graph of Financial Prosperity formatting

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Game between Owner and Contractor in the Bidding Process of the Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, firstly we establish the dynamic game model between owner and contractor in the bidding process of the construction project. Then we make analysis of the 24 situations when owner and contractor take different behaviors and demonstrate their payment function separately under different situation. Finally we make suggestions on what kind of strategy should the owner take in order to avoid the contractor submitting a low price malignantly and make sure the contractor performance better after the acceptance of the bid.

articleTitle: Research on the Copy Detection Algorithm for Source Code Based on Program Organizational Structure Tree Matching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Code plagiarism is an ubiquitous phenomenon in the teaching of Programming Language. A large number of source code can be automatically detected and uses the similarity value to determine whether the copy is present. It can greatly improve the efficiency of teachers and promote teaching quality. A algorithm is provided that firstly match program organizational structure tree and then process the methods of program to calculate the similarity value. It not only applies to process-oriented programming languages but also applies to object-oriented programming language.

articleTitle: The Application and Research of Software Testing on Agile Software Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Software testing is the key for software quality. Agile software development method that is new methodology in recent years embraces change and fixes attention on the delivery of high quality software. Extreme Programming, the most popular one of agile, emphasizes the testing, and confirms to the principle that is test-driven development. After analyzing the relative knowledge of agile software method and software testing, this paper did systemic research about test process on agile???unit test, functional test and integration test, and management of bug appearing in the test process, and draw a conclusion through comparing agile with the traditional method in testing.

articleTitle: Research on E-Government System Network Security Based on Immune Agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper creates a new E-Government security framework based on Immune Agent, and it describes a new deployment policy of E-Government network system based on Immune Agent. On the theoretical basis, this thesis elaborates the detailed design and implementation of a particular E-Government network system. To meet the needs of practical security and provide strong protection, the system is developed by adopting the new model and algorithm. It is already been in use.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Dynamic Index System for Corporation Independent Innovation and Its Application Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Insufficient innovation power has become the core issue that restricts corporation independent innovation. Firstly, this paper summarized the study of the dynamic of corporation independent innovation, and proposed dynamic model of independent innovation in this foundation.
