Finally the paper constructed the dynamic index system of corporation independent innovation and made empirical analysis for 37 industries in Anhui province.

articleTitle: Portfolio Model Based on CVaR Under Friction Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Taking into more account practical situation of Chinese securities market with non-convex non-concave typical transaction cost and revenue and measuring the risk of the securities by the conditional value at risk, we establish a portfolio model in which the expected income of portfolio is taken as objective function and Conditional Value-at-Risk is taken as a constraint. The model is solved by a particle swarm optimization algorithm based on punished function. It is shown by the numerical results of six stocks in Hu and Shen market that the proposed model is rational.

articleTitle: Applications of SystemView Software in the Experiment Teachings of Electronic Major Courses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: There are many abstract concepts and mathematic theory in electronic major courses which are difficult to understand, thus killing students’ interests in learning. Experimentation is the necessary part of teaching process. This paper discusses the applications of SystemView in experiment teaching of electronic major courses. The practice shows that the emulation by using SystemView not only visualizes the abstract theories but also improves students’ comprehensive ability and quality, enhances experiment teaching effect.

articleTitle: The Application of Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation in Physical Science and Technology Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Human resources is to develop the productive forces of the core resources during the new era. With the development of Chinese sports career, scientific research plays an important role in the development of sports. The level of the value of human resources has become an important criterion of to judge the competitiveness of sports career. In this paper, we give comprehensive evaluation model of sports science and technology human resources management by building a multi-factor multi-level fuzzy evaluation model, on a basis of pointing out the defect of the traditional econometric model of human resource value, and finally table a instructional proposal on it.

articleTitle: Discussion of Integrated Three-dimensional Teaching Model Based on E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Integrated three-dimensional teaching philosophy and model based on E-Learning have been proposed and discussed for the current problems of higher education in this paper. From constructivism and other educational theory, research content and effective way of integrated three-dimensional teaching model based on E-Learning have been achieved clearly. An integrated three-dimensional teaching framework that combined the traditional classroom with E-Learning teaching methods has been constructed in this paper. These fully embodied the advantages of all-round teaching methods and achieved the purpose of raising the quality of teaching.

articleTitle: Toward a Framework for Assessing Internet Channels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The emergence of the Internet has forced a large number of firms to introduce Internet-based channels of distribution into existing distribution systems to market their products. In multiple channels context, there has been a call for better performance measures to assess whether channel management is productive. Unfortunately, little academic research has addressed key criteria to apply in determining the marketing channel performance. In order to fill in the literature gap, this research attempts to adopt Analytic Network Process (ANP) to identify and compare the key performance criteria of Internet channels on the basis of Strategic Profit Model (SPM). This study found that Return on Equity and Return on Total Assets are two most important criteria. This research helps managers to know the key criteria of Internet channels performance evaluation, which is much helpful for them to configure their improvement plans as they may not have sufficient resources to deal with all the dimensions at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on Business Model of Mobile TV in China - The Case of CMMB
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper first summarizes the theory of business model and mobile TV, then It adopts a generic research framework for business model of mobile TV, including organization, technology, service and finance. Finally, based on the example of CMMB (China mobile multimedia broadcasting), the business model of mobile TV in China is analyzed.

articleTitle: China-ASEAN Free Trade Area and Service Trade
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper empirically estimates the Service trade structure effects of China-ASEAN Free Trade Area based on endogenous treatment and differences-in-differences methods, The results prove that the likelihood of an new RTA membership is enhanced by similarity of endowment structure and compensation of expenditure pattern, and also RTA accelerates the inter-industry trade of service departments between partners. Overall, this indicates the potential advantage of integration in East Asia is huge, and higher risk of asymmetry demand shocks will come along with the process of integration in service departments, which means regional public goods are important.

articleTitle: Research on Calculating Methods of the Reimbursement Ratio, The Threshold and the Top for Compensation of China's New Rural Cooperative Medical System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Since the implement of China's New Rural Cooperative Medical System in 2003, problems of too low reimbursement ratio and the top for compensation, over high the threshold for compensation exist universally, whose existence are highly related to the absence of feasible statistical calculating methods. This paper gives two practicable calculating methods. One is based on the original data. And the other one is based on the general density curve. In comparison, the second method is more practical and accurate, which can be used to determine the appropriate reimbursement ratio, the proper threshold and the top for compensation conveniently avoiding the problem of the excessive precipitation funds at the same time.

articleTitle: Anatomize the Function of American Federal Administrative Monitoring System by Control Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: On the basis of cybernetics, it reveals the structural features and functions of the United States' administrative monitoring system, by using system analysis method to construct systematic model and introduce transfer functions. The result shows that United States' systematic design of its administrative monitoring system enhances the safety function of state administrative monitoring system, both scientifically and effectively. While there also exists the defect of accuracy deviation. Besides, theoretical analysis and political phenomena are basically consistent.

articleTitle: An Impact of the U.S. and the U.K. Return Volatility for the Hong Kong and the Japan's Stock Market Returns: A DCC and Bivariate AGARCH Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The empirical results show that the dynamic conditional correlation (DCC) and the bivariate AGARCH (1, 2) model is appropriate in evaluating the relationship of the Hong Kong and the Japan's stock markets. The empirical result also indicates that the Hong Kong and the Japan's stock markets is a positive relation. The average estimation value of correlation coefficient equals to 0.477, which implies that the two stock markets is synchronized influence. Besides, the empirical result also shows that the Hong Kong stock market has an asymmetrical effect and the Japan's stock market has not the asymmetrical effect. The return volatility of the Hong Kong stock market receives the influence of the positive and negative values of the U.S. and the U.K. return volatility rates, and the return volatility of the Japan's stock market also receives the influence of the U.S. and the U.K. return volatility rates.

articleTitle: Research of Reverse Logistics Information Management System Based on B/S+C/S
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of economic society, people pay more attention to the requirements of environment protection, reverse logistics gradually attract the interest of people. So the effect of MIS toward reverse logistics becomes much obvious. The traditional development model B/S or C/S structure can not satisfy the reverse logistics system information sharing and security requirements. This article describes the system function model design, and logic structure design and safety design is investigated. The design and realization method of reverse logistics management information system was also put forward.

articleTitle: Designing a Multi-view Commodity Ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we develop the viewpoint that there exists commodity multi-view knowledge in the circulation of commodities. We analyze attribute domain under the multi-view circumstances and build a multi-view oriented cognition model of commodity knowledge. Based on this cognition model, this paper proposes the meta-model of multi-view commodity ontology by using competency questions, which is a standard technique in ontology engineering methodologies. This new commodity ontology is more suitable for the physical demand of e-commerce.

articleTitle: The Complexity of the Information Release Activities on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper discusses complexity properties of information release activities on the Internet. It analyzes massive data from the real websites, where some phenomena that the theories of the power law, the self-similarity and the 1/f noise existing are found. It means that either network forums or news websites are one of the SOC (self organization critical) systems. The results showed in this paper present new proof to explain how the paroxysmal events happened and how the web opinions are formed.

articleTitle: Resource Management for Manufacturing Grid Based on Comprehensive Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper proposes a new method: PCA- Optimal SVM model which is composed of PCA and Optimal SVM to optimize the allocation of manufacturing grid resources through resources allocation data. The model is fit for company in the small sample space. It uses PCA to predigest the input vector and uses Optimal SVM to judge the statement of the company resources. With the model, one or more enterprises could be selected in every process in full lifecycle of product, and the defects in resolving optimal configuration with traditional algorithm model could be omitted. The application case proved that the proposed method can improve the feasibility of the program in optimal configuration, and it is suitable for on-line resource optimal configuration control for manufacturing grid.

articleTitle: Study on the Operational Risk Assessment Model of Untapped Low-grade Reservoirs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: First of all, by defining low-grade reservoir in this paper, we evaluate and quantitatively analyze operational risks of the untapped low-grade reservoir and classify the operational risks. Then, through introducing the probability analysis method and combining with the low-grade reservoir operation, we establish the operational risk assessment model of the untapped low-grade reservoir. Finally, by using the mathematical software MATLAB to calculate all kinds of relevant graphics and tables, we evaluate and quantitatively analyze the operational risks of the low-grade reservoir.

articleTitle: A Trapezoid Model for Credit Evaluation of Construction Agent based on Risk Management Benefit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the summaries in the research achievements related to agent construction system, aims at the lack of credit resources in the current agent construction market, the credit risk problem of agent project is divided and analyzed as in-credit and credit of construction agent, the balance analysis of risk management benefit and decision-making of risk management of construction agent are discussed. On this basis, the two difficult choices of construction agent on credit problem are analyzed by value curve. Finally, a trapezoid model for credit evaluation of construction agent is put forward, including evaluating basis module, quantitative analysis module and optimizing evaluation module, which will reverse the value inversion between in-credit risk and credit risk of construction agent.

articleTitle: Research on the Definition and Classification of Web Market-Based Virtual Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: From the present situation of virtual enterprise research, a general description of web market in the Internet environment is made, moreover the concept of web market-based virtual enterprise is proposed. Four types of characteristics of virtual enterprises is analyzed and summarized as well. Feasible ideas are put forward for commercial organizations to carry out operating better in the web markets.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Developing the Green Government Procurement in China: Problems and Suggestions for Protecting Environmenet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Chinese E-government systems Adoption: from Institutional theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The e-governmental adoption means that the information systems become the necessary part of the public organization during a period and by the special channel step by step finally. The research is based on the fruit of information systems adoption in business firms, and analyzes the different essence between firm and administration organization, and explores the mechanism of information systems and public organization institution. The research constructs the e-government adoption model based on the new institutional theory, and the final results are: the factors of organization commitment, group culture and superior coercive pressure are most important factors to influence the information systems adoption decision.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Road to Labor Service Problems of China Construction Industry: Chinese-featured Vocational Education and Training System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Mechanism Designing and Decision Making of Tacit Knowledge Conversion within Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Tacit knowledge is the main source of forming enterprise competitiveness, but its implicit and uncoded characters cause that its applicable scope is limited. It should be explicit that it can be put into good use. Conversion of tacit knowledge involves two questions within enterprise: one is that the attitude of enterprise and knowledge worker colony is different; second is that the attitude of high knowledge worker colony and low knowledge worker colony is different. In order to solve the questions of knowledge conversion, the replicated dynamic equations of two-echelon evolution game theory is adopted to make inspiring mechanism, and in this way to spur the high knowledge worker colony and low knowledge worker colony to adopt the decision which will maximize the benefit of enterprise.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Applying the VE to Diagnosis the Elements for Enterprise Knowledge Gap
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Classification for Different Mental Tasks Based on EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Electroencephalogram(EEG) signal is an important information source of underlying brain processes. The communication based on EEG between human brain and computer is a new modality of human-computer interaction. Through time-domain regression method for EEG denoising pretreatment, AR model coefficient is extracted as feature vector, classifies the mental tasks based on BP network and PNN network.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Evaluation of Venture Capital for SMEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Trust Games between China and America Experimental Research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Most subjects in trust game experiments have been made up of American college students so far. This paper examines the degree of trust and being worth trusting in an experimental trust game with 128 participants of Tongji University in China. The results reveal that Chinese students' behaviors systematically diverge from that predicted by the economic man hypothesis. Moreover, through the comparative study on subjects' behaviors between China and America, we find that Chinese students are more prone to trust others and also more worth trusting. In other words, Chinese students' behaviors deviate more significantly from the economic man hypothesis prediction. This may be explained by the difference between Chinese and American cultures.

articleTitle: The Study on the Influences of Enterprise Managers' Communication Competency on the Employees' Turnover Intention
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The managers' communication competency is a very important factor that influences the enterprise management performance. This study, applying self-constructed “Questionnaire of Manager's Communication Competency” and “Questionnaire of Employees' Organizational Behavior”, measured 429 enterprise managers and employees from the following cities, Shanghai, Shenyang, Guangzhou, Beijing, and Ningxia. The Spss11.0 was used in the statistic. The results of multiple stepwise linear regression analysis at communication competency toward turnover intention revealed that it is communication competency that contains a higher predictive ability towards turnover intention, in which management communication competency has a strong say in explaining turnover intention. Thus we conclude that group cohesion can be viewed as an important performance standard of testing communication competency, and language-expressing competency takes the largest part in the regression equation of turnover intention.

articleTitle: Research on the Eco-Socio-Economy Synergetic Development of Urban Forestry under E-government Affairs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The urban forestry plays a leading role in improving the urban ecological environment. At present, the slow arboreal growth, the heavy municipal pollution, and the relatively high maintenance cost, coupled with the limited local revenue lead to the tardy development of urban forestry in the north part of China. Along with development of economy and living standards, the demand of residents on the good ecological environment will also increase. Under the circumstance of inadequate investment in urban forestry, the survey shows that residents have strong willingness to pay for the improvement of urban ecological environment. Therefore, corresponding countermeasures are proposed on the participation of the residents in community-based organizations, urban forest ecological compensation and returning farmland to forest according to the analysis of the issues existed in the boreal urban forests, to promote the coordinative development in the ecological function, the social function and the economical function of urban forestry.

articleTitle: Evolution of Network Relationships of Focal Firms in Cluster from a Perspective of Knowledge Transfer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Cluster is a favorable location of knowledge diffusing and creating. The focal firm's strategy can both influence and be affected by the inter-firm relationships and knowledge transfer which take place within the cluster. By an analysis framework for knowledge transfer, the text explains the role of a focal firm in the evolution of a cluster and analyses how a focal firm in cluster can modify the knowledge nature and adopt different types of supply relationship to control the range of knowledge diffuse and increase the effectiveness of knowledge transfer. Then, the text constructs an interpretative model. According to the model, the text analyses the evolution of the relationships between the focal firm and its suppliers.

articleTitle: A Parameter-Adjustable Estimating Method for Change Frequency of Web Pages
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Refreshing on-line information in time is a main task of incremental crawling, so it is very important to predict the change frequency of web pages. We model the change of page as a Poisson process in this paper. And based on it, we propose a parameter-adjustable algorithm after considering the unbiasedness, efficiency and consistency comprehensively. This algorithm can adjust the parameters in order to estimate the change frequency more effective.

articleTitle: Collaborative Business Informatization Service Pattern of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The industry cluster is the main development pattern of the current equipment manufacturing industry. This thesis analyzes the information requirements of small and Medium-sized enterprises in the cluster for collaborative business and innovative service, and conducts the research on cooperation and innovation pattern by making use of public service platform. In the thesis, the basic framework of the pattern is put forward. An information-supporting platform based on grid technology is established through analysis of system structure, key technology and main functions. The platform can efficiently improve the cooperation between small and Medium-sized enterprises which have collaborative business relations, reduce production and overhead costs, and sharpen the overall competitive edge of manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: A Review of Electronic Commerce Research in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A literature review of electronic commerce research in China is presented in this paper. The articles are searched with the keyword “electronic commerce” separately from the core journals and the Engineering Index (EI) journals of the China Academic Journals Full-text Database at www.cnki.net. The distributions of articles published by the core and the EI journals by year and topics are analyzed. The top 10 EI journals for publication of EC articles are recognized. The main findings include: 1) both distributions by year from the core and EI journals in China show growth in general but with waves, which are different from the steady growth distribution of international journals; 2) the most heavily published EC research area is in the technological issues followed by the market topics in China journals; and 3) the most of top 10 EI journals for publication of EC articles are in the computer area followed by electronics, mechanical engineering, and system engineering.

articleTitle: Study on the Effects of the Negative WOM on Brand Switching in the Net Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to research the influences of the negative WOM on the consumer brand switching behavior from the strength of negative WOM, the disseminator's expertise and the strength of relationship, with the mobile phone as the study object and make a comparative analysis between the traditional WOM and the online WOM through empirical research.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A New Frame for Manager Incentive: Experimental Economics Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Impact of Competitors on Service Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the modern service, companies need to continuously innovate in services and thus enhance their competitive advantage. The process of innovation in service firms will be affected by many factors, competitors also an important source of innovation. In this paper, the author started with the drive of service innovation, focusing on the impact of competitors on service innovation, and consider that the competition, imitation, learning and collaboration between competitors will have a positive role in promoting service innovation.

articleTitle: Research of Collaborative Commerce Platform for Steel Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The steel industry is an important industry to the people's livelihood. In the collaborative commerce environment, study of collaborative commerce platform for steel supply chain has an important practical significance. In this paper, collaborative commerce and supply chain management theory is studied, and supply chain management of present stage of China's steel industry is analyzed. Based on the above-mentioned, architecture of collaborative commerce platform for steel supply chain is built, and the procurement commence platform and sales commence platform are focused on. Currently the system thought has been verified in the enterprise, and the results are very good.

articleTitle: The Integration Strategy of E-commerce Platform and ERP Based on Cooperative Application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To integrate the internal and external information resources of an enterprise, the integration of e-commerce platform and ERP system has been widely concerned. This paper discusses the system integration strategy with following levels: application integration, business integration and data integration. Also it describes how to integrate e-commerce and ERP with the SSH framework to realize the cooperative application of them finally.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: From Dynamic to Super Dynamic: Enlightenment for the Enterprises in the Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on Early-warning Management for Crisis of Human Resource: Knowledge Frame and Evaluation Index System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Crisis of human resource has become the most frequently crisis on which the enterprises faced and early-warning, pre-control and proposed program for the enterprises to prevent the crisis in human resources are of great theoretical and practical significance. This paper use qualitative and quantitative methods to study on early-warning management for human resource crisis systematic. We build a scientific and rational human resource crisis warning index system and evaluation model so as to reduce losses to the minimum and promote the sustainable development of enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Centralized Government Examination and Approval System Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: SOA is known as the most advanced and rational software architecture currently. We can effectively improve the flexibility of systems, and adapt to a variety of possible business restructuring and change by integrating SOA into the software design. First, the structure and composition of the centralized examination and approval software developed with SOA ideas and technology is introduced. Then, the design ideas and methods of examination and approval workflow management system based on SOA and the centralized examination and approval components based on SOA are given. Finally, application effects of the system are introduced. Application in practice shows that the system has good adaptability and flexibility, can well meet the needs of the centralized government examination and approval.

articleTitle: A New Customer Care Information System Architecture Model Integrated EA with SOA in Power Supply Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article gives two architecture models which respectively based on EA (Enterprise-Architecture) and SOA (service oriented architecture) at first, and then makes a contrast of those two models, analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of those two architectures. Finally a conclusion that those two architectures should integrate and propose a new Customer Care Information System architecture model based on the integration of EA and SOA in Power Supply Enterprise. This model can basically achieve the goal of establishing a sustainable development framework for Customer Care Information System in Power Supply Enterprise.

articleTitle: Privacy Preservation in E-government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The hot demand for e-government makes it vitally important to provide a solution to privacy preservation. This paper discusses in depth the key concerns and implementation techniques related to privacy preservation in e-government, before providing a solution which best tradeoffs the demand for information disclosure and the concerns about privacy preservation.

articleTitle: Support Newcomer's Learning in Community of Practice: In Terms of Legitimate Peripheral Participation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Community of practice is critical to organization learning. This paper takes the newcomer as subject. It analyzes the factors affected newcomer's legitimate participation and peripheral participation, then it suggests how to support newcomer's learning in community of practice.

articleTitle: Digital Economy and Amusement Consumers Quality of Life
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Coupled with consumers' psychological distortion, the urge to obtain attentions of netzens from ICPs has caused Internet recreation consumption immoderacy, say, IAD. At first the authors discuss the nature of Internet recreation consumption and verify the relationship between consumption of vulgar digital amusement products and the life quality of the consumers, then propose some countermeasures against Internet consuming irrationalities.

articleTitle: Study on the Tuition Standard in China Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the fairness and benefits of the opportunity to accept higher education, tuition should be paid. The average cost of higher education and the ability of tuition paid which are determined by the average income are two fundamental basics for making the standard of tuition. In order to research the standard of tuition, the paper focuses on two issues: What is the acceptable range of tuition for higher education in China? How much is the reasonable tuition for higher education in China? Then we establish a multiple linear regression model on the basis of the reasonable assumption. Using the Eviews Software, we get that the range of average tuition is [4674.4, 7516.1]. Then we make a sensitivity analysis on the state funding and got the conclusions. Tuition all over our country colleges and universities are reasonable, and that the average tuition is negatively correlated to the state funding to some extent. Through the conclusions, we obtain that the state funding accounted for 25% in training costs of students. If the state funding rises by 250 yuan, the average tuition will decrease by 238 yuan.

articleTitle: The Application of Secondary Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation in Enterprise Order Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the defects of the present method of company order assessment, a superior membership function is brought forward to establish the element values in the fuzzy evaluation matrix, the rationality of the membership function is proved and an example with the fuzzy evaluation matrix built by this membership function is given. The company order evaluation index system using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation measures can improve the rationality of the assessment of the order with enterprise scheduling system.

articleTitle: Civil Aviation Information System Based on Semantic Web
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we present our definition of a particular ontology of the Civil Aviation Information System. Therefore we have a fundamental information framework for the whole system. We also show the mapping of models between OWL and XML, which are both quite useful. And with OWL-S, we describe and extend definition of web services in the system. All these not only unifies the information in the system, but also, very importantly, makes the system more intelligent and automatic, realizing the auto-discovery, auto-matching, and auto-composition of services there.

articleTitle: Countermeasures Based on the Development of E-government Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, China's e-government has made great achievements in government affairs and public administration, but it still faces various problems like contac but don't intercommunicate, bottlenecks of resource sharing, incomplete standards and policies, weak convenient service function, and horizontal uneven development. We should give fully play the unity and coordination role of the central government in innovation management system, operational mechanism and developing and improving e-government policies and standards. It is also necessary to integrate requirements, establish a "public-centered," "one-stop" concept of government services, integrate resources, establish a unified central database, and then encourage government to accelerates the promotion of e-government development integration by adopting a professional outsourcing service and market oriented approach.

articleTitle: Management Decision-Making Based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, it proposes fuzzy neural network(NN) system which is used for management decision-making and composed of three separate networks. The system's input can be both figures and vector language. The system's output exceeds the standard neural network - two-valued logic state. Based on the ambiguity function, NN's back-propagation algorithm and the monotonic function NN model the paper proposes the learning algorithm which is suitable for the fuzzy neural network. The system can well adapt to the management problems which are complex and ambiguous.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Networked Manufacturing Customer Relationship Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Empirical Study for the Efficiency of Listed Companies in the Internal Capital Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper introduces the following five concepts about equity: the holding shares by the group, the holding shares by the state, institutional investors, the holding shares by the executives and the concentration of ownership. By grouped comparison studying about the internal capital market's direction, manner and purpose, the writer tries to give a general analysis of the efficiency of listed companies in the internal capital market. Moreover, according to statistic and econometric regression analysis, a multilevel econometric model is illustrated to verify the efficiency of listed companies in the internal capital market and the reason behind the result. In the conclusion, the study in this paper shows that the efficiency of the listed companies market is somewhat low in the internal capital market.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Existence Value Measurement of Natural Resources and Environment: Holistic View Based on Common Goods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on Design of a New E-Business System Based on .NET
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-business is rapidly changing the traditional business model. In order to establish the e-business which is consistent with the characteristics of business and to establish the position of enterprises in the new competition pattern, a new e-business system based on .NET is designed and implemented. The system takes .NET as a development platform. It mainly includes the four functions: search, registration, information release and background management. In the system a new idea of e-business is put forward which is that computers are used to automatically complete information search and information release of other websites. It has a very good practical promotion and application value.

articleTitle: From Private Information to Common Knowledge: A Discussion on the Informational Function of Institution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper gave an informational consideration on the foundation of institution. Through codification any information was turned into knowledge, which could be learned and thus decoded. Institution could be seen as a codification system, which codified numerous information into limited classifications. After an institution was turned into common knowledge, the informational asymmetry among actors could be greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Multi-credit Evaluation of Construction-agency Based on Gray Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the summary achievements in the research related to credit evaluation, in this paper, an evaluation on construction-agency on behalf of government is being put into practice, by taking into account the extensive application of construction-agent system and credit crisis problem in domestic market. In order to enable government evaluate construction-agencies' credit, a credit evaluation index system is proposed, then built a gray multi-credit evaluation model, which offering government a quantitative analysis method to evaluate. Finally, take a representative case for example to illuminate the application of credit index system and gray evaluation model, result of which verifies the practicability and feasibility of the system and model in this paper.

articleTitle: Internal Control Analysis Based on the Relationship of Internal Controls, Risk Management, Strategic Objectives
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The core objective of enterprise management activities is to achieve corporate strategic objectives, Ieaving the core objective to talk about any activity is meaningless. This paper analyzes the delicate relationship of the internal control???the risk management and strategic objectives from the perspective of internal control which is one important way to achieve the core objective of enterprise, The establishment and improvement of internal control for the sustainable development of enterprises hold an very important role. Theorists and practitioners always exist controversy on the relationship of between risk management and internal control. Author not only tries to analyze their relationship from both of the historical development, both of the fundamental aim is to achieve corporate strategic goals, also analyze the enterprises of our county exist the main problems in the implementation of our internal control and put forward constructive suggestions to address these issues.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comprehensive Evaluation of the Overall Quality of Urban Public Open Space
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Interactive Development between Professional Market and E-Business: A Case Study of Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The emergence of e-business is not only a challenge to the traditional professional market, but a strong support of the updating and optimization of the traditional professional market. The key to the further development of professional market of Zhejiang province is to actively make use of modern information technology and network technology to transform and upgrade traditional professional market, and to integrate the trading pattern with e-business. The interactive development of e-business and professional market is the way to the management innovation of professional market. But the development of e-business still exist many problems in technology and supervision. So the government should make more efforts on policy-making, creation of credit environment, integration of network resources and improvement of supporting system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Knowledge Management System of Post Technology M&A Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: On Integrated Governance of e-Government: Technology, Institution, Market, and Government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Integrated governance stresses the integrated operation of government organizations and departments. It is the systematic result of vertical hierarchical axis and horizontal action axis which includes various market subjects. The two dimensions of technology-institution and market-government are the components of the integrated governance of e-government. Based on Computer Supported Cooperative Work of top-level Governance Enterprise Architecture, this article designs a framework which integrates society, administration, policies and their interaction, with social demand as the input and public service as the output. It also designs a cross-department e-government system with Computer Supported Cooperative Work as its basis. The article discusses the function of integrated governance at the governance institution level exemplified by government regulation and legal adjustment and concludes that we need to promote China’s e-government construction by technological and institutional means.

articleTitle: Quality Control over E-government Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper intended to develop a quality control model of e-government outsourcing. E-government has become an explicit component of public sector reform and e-government outsourcing becomes a crucial choice for government to support its sustainable development. The success of e-government largely depends on whether the service offered will be used by the citizen. Under the circumstance of outsourcing, it is determined by the operation quality of e-government outsourcing. Based on the review of quality management theory, this paper applied total quality management to analyzing the e-government outsourcing management. After inspecting the process of e-government outsourcing, a quality control model is proposed according to the outsourcing process. It will help to improve the operation quality of e-government outsourcing by paying more attention to the process quality control.

articleTitle: Realized Information Systems Strategy: A Multiple-Case Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: After the multiple-case study of seven enterprises, this paper identifies the dimensional construct of information systems (IS) strategy of Chinese enterprises. The study shows: the four-dimensional construct of IS strategy proposed by Chan, Huff and Copeland is partly applicable to the enterprises in China. In fact, the IS strategy of our country encompasses three dimensions: business action support dimension, business decision support dimension and network embeddedness support dimension. Meanwhile, it finds that for different enterprises, the three dimensions of IS strategy can coexist in a enterprise but vary from one another and the supporting function of the same IS to business strategy can also be different.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Ownership Structure, Executive Compensation and Earnings Management - An Empirical Research on China's Listed Firms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Incentives Analysis of Network Group Incidents Actualization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The highly interactive network makes the trend that the network group incidents are moving toward reality gradually, this paper analyses in depth the incentives of network group incidents making tracks for actualization from the network which is based on the re-division of their types and generation models,which include the Government's negative and hysteretic responses,the relative deprivation of the rights of network information,the block of the appealing of network interests and expressive channels,the elaborate planning by the lawless persons and hostile forces,with a view to cope up with the network group incidents for the government, and to warn early and provide guidance related to promote the network group incidents tending to reality, only in this way can we build a harmonious socialist society.

articleTitle: A DEA Study on R&D Efficiency: Compare with Most Famous Transnational Corporations in PRC, USA and South Korea
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: There are great differences between DG TNCs and the transnational corporations of developed country (DC TNCs) in technological innovation field. This study analyze the situation of China's Haier Group, Korea's Samsung Electronics Co. and US General Electric GE by using Data Envelope Analysis methods, compared to the research and development input-output efficiency of these three enterprises. Both transnational corporations of developing countries and transnational corporations of developed countries take research and development as the main source of technological innovation. Comparatively speaking, fund investments of research and development take great impact on the sales of initial phase of the enterprise internationalization, with the deepening of the internationalization of transnational corporations; the impact of scale economies of enterprises will be increasing.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Shipbuilding Supply Chain Supernetwork
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we develop a model of shipbuilding supply chain network, including three tiers: raw materials and accessory products suppliers, shipbuilding centers (i.e. shipyard), the shipowner. In the normal course of shipbuilding, production is mainly carried out by meeting the needs of the end-user (i.e. the ship-owner). Under these conditions, decision-makers are analyzed in target, at last the optimization of the model by using the theory of variational inequalities and the numerical example are given.

articleTitle: Study on the Government Investment Projects Evaluation Based on Evidence Theory and Unascertained Measure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A new method based on the integration of evidence theory and unascertained measure is put forward for the government investment projects evaluation. The dimensions of index system are reduced by evidence theory. Then, the data of the indexes reduced is input into unascertained measure. Empirical study has shown that the method used in the government investment projects evaluation is feasible and reliable.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Management for SMEs in Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The main objective of this paper to enhance the entire supply chain of Small and Medium sized Enterprises (SMEs) in Pakistan, and to examine the SMEs in Pakistan and how the SMEs adopt their way of undertaking business from traditional practice to e-business? Implementation of supply chain management will lower costs and increase efficiency and thus lead to the significant gain for SMEs. The Supply Chain Management can be implement in the SMEs of Pakistan in the form of Cloud computing Model developed and maintain by government Ministries and development bodies.

articleTitle: Network Self-healing Algorithm Based on Mobile Agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As the network faults happen, a mass of the unprocessed data from the distributed network based on the traditional self-healing mode will be transmitted in the whole network, which will aggravate the network transmission burden. In this paper, a new network fault healing mode based on the mobile agent is proposed. On the basis of it, the self-healing algorithm which named the pre-deploying available path set algorithm is proposed. At last, the algorithm is tested by experiments and the results are analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Multasking Principal-agent Model in the Housing Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: There exist three main tasks in housing management including housing and basic equipment maintenance management, environment management and safety management, which form the multitasking principal-agent relation between the owner and the property service enterprise. Based on the overall utility of property service, when the owner delegate property service enterprise with those tasks respectively, the optimal incentive of each task is independent with each other. However, when there is only one enterprise in charge of those tasks, the incentive would change with task costs varying interdependently. The establishment of the model will help the owner to take different incentive measures for different tasks, and realize the “win-win” between the owner and property service enterprise.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Services Policy Reform: A Case Study of Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Competitiveness Evaluation of e-Commerce Website Based on AHP-Entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to reduce the influence of the subjectivity and evaluate the competitiveness of the e-commerce website effectively, this paper applies entropy method to establish model to determine the objective weight of each index, and calculates the distance and close-degree between the e-commerce website and the ideal point, and then sorts the competitiveness of the e-commerce websites according to the close-degree. The results show that the method can provide strong support to evaluate the competitiveness of e-commerce websites.

articleTitle: The Choice of Enterprise Logistics Outsourcing Strategies Based on Improved TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The improvement of enterprise's competitiveness depends upon the choice of the logistics outsourcing strategy. This paper uses the entropy method to determine the function's weight of the enterprise needed logistics service relatively, uses Value Engineering Theory to analyze the function and cost of logistics services, then takes ratio of sub-function evaluating value and the corresponding cost value as the functional cost value coefficient. Enterprises can select the optimal scheme according to the TOPSIS value sorting. The method provides a basis for the selection and evaluation of enterprises' logistics outsourcing strategy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Industrial Policy Analysis on Low-carbon Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on the venture capital exit of grey ideal solution and fuzzy multiple attribute decision-making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The combination of entropy weight with ideal solution and TOPSIS for selection of the appropriate exit way for venture capital. The weights and the preference order of various criteria were provided by entropy, TOPSIS and distance approach degree were combined with similar approach degree. The compositor of similar approach degree to select the venture capital exit.

articleTitle: Research on the Information Service System of Forestry Carbon Sequestration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Setting up the information service system of forestry carbon sequestration(ISSFCS) is the inevitable choice for implementing e-government, it is also the essential information exchange interface for internet carbon trade among the related enterprises. Based on analyses of the role and services users of ISSFCS, the design ideology and principles of the information service system were elaborated, and the integral interface establishment design for the ISSFCS was proposed that included the overall flow chart, functional modules, logical design of the system database, system server, the development environment of customer terminals, software and hardware disposition for the information service system.

articleTitle: Study on the Reasons and Mechanism of Human Resources Spillover in Family Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The difference between the need & expectation and reality in family enterprises is the fundamental cause for the spillover of human resources, while the physiological needs, safety needs, social needs and development needs play an important role in the spillover. According to the establishment and analysis of the mechanism of human resources spillover, the inner mechanism for human resources spillover is determined by the attractive force of family enterprises and centrifugal force of the employee himself and it is dynamically developing. Meanwhile, the mass of family enterprise entrepreneur, the mass of enterprise organization, the mass of the employee, the family bonds distance and the employer's desire are main factors which influence the spillover of human resources.

articleTitle: Discussion to Practice of E-Business Principle Course in Non-E-Business Professional
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to the author set up the practical experience of E-Business course in the computer, economic administered, international trade and other non-E-Business professional, analysis of the background and current situation of course. Proposing to bring together situation of professional training courses targeting the focus of, from the combination of training objectives to guide their interest in learning to start. Emphasis on interactive teaching, Stress for different professions students to develop targeted educational programs and teaching contents. Teachers should make thematic content, groups of students, problem-solving. Shows examples of papers using a wide range of interactive teaching.

articleTitle: Research on B/S-Based Autonomic Stereoscopic Comprehensive Experimentation Teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper has construed the most optimal learning environment with network resources base on the multi-learning theories and constructivism learning theory of modern educational theory. Students can make the most use of the resource of laboratory and network, with the help of teachers, students can study dependent to cultivate the inaugurate spirit. The theoretical knowledge of pedagogy, psychology and teaching methodology as background, following the principle of practicability and general applicability, a B/S-based autonomic stereoscopic comprehensive experimentation teaching platform is designed. The characteristic is using more convenient and more interactive. The mainly purpose is to help students to construe knowledge, and the application of teaching target and teaching tactics are also be considered.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Contribution of Foreign Trade on the Economic Growth of Guangxi Province, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In open economy, development of foreign trade greatly impacts on GDP growth. Adapting simple regression for researching the relationship between foreign trade including total export and total import and GDP growth of Guangxi province, with the collected 30-year statistical data from 1978 to 2008. The result indicates that foreign trade has contributed a lot to the GDP growth of foreign trade and still has great potential to be tapped. There is a positive correlation between the foreign trade and GDP. And import has more and more influenced the economic growth of Guangxi province, China. What the most important is the growth has little interdependency on the net export. Finally, the paper points out that in order to maintain the economic growth, Guangxi must unswervingly implement the opening-up policy and be aware of trade protectionism.

articleTitle: The Application of Data Mining in Predicting Power Industry Financial Risks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper applies DEA model to a sample of 58 power plate listed companies in the securities market in China in 2008, with a view to identifying the financial risk companies and non-financial risk companies, instead of using ST in the past. Then, after comparing logit regression model and neural network LVQ in predicting the company financial risks, the conclusion was drawn that neural network LVQ is better in predicting.

articleTitle: Research on Modified Optimization Model for Vehicle Routing Problem in E-commerce Logistics Distribution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This study improves the original model of vehicle routing problem by adding some strains such as time windows, volume, weight, as parameters into the model. The model is adjusted to an mutilate-goals vehicle scheduling problem based on the mutilate-goals programming, and study on how the time-windows and time-distinction affects the delivering planning. We use GAMS to simulate and solve this problem.

articleTitle: Content Analysis on Articles on Customer Relationship Management in E-Business in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Customer relationship management, which is abbreviated as CRM, is a key part during and after E-business activities. In this paper, we analyze 116 articles that are related to CRM in E-Business and collected in CJFD(Chinese Journal Full-text Database) from 1997 to 2006. The articles' published time and journals on which articles were published are analyzed. And the authors of these articles are also discussed. Moreover, the content of these articles is analyzed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the Incentive of Engineering Contractor under Information Asymmetry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Measurement of Real Estate Bubble in China: An Overview of Direct Test Models Since 2003
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A decade-long recession happened in Japan caused by 1990s' real estate bubble, the global financial crisis triggered by the recent U.S. subprime mortgage bubble, even the economic crisis later make the public understand that the real estate bubble hurts the overall economy comprehensively and decisively, a serious real estate bubble in China in recent years adds a new footnote on the overall hurting to its national economy. The effective control on the real estate bubble depends on the scientific measurement of the bubble existence and its expansion. This paper describes the direct test models of the real estate bubble measurement in china, discusses its basic mechanism and comes to several conclusions.

articleTitle: The Optimizing Implementation of Fast Loop Filter Based on C6455 DSP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: H.264 is the newest high performance video encoding standard that is attributed to applying several new efficient compress methods such as loop filter. The computational time consumed of H.264 increased by 2 or more times compared with previous standard and it hard to implement in many read time or resource-limited application. To speedup the critical time-consuming module, a fast loop filter algorithm is proposed by optimizing the two main processes that are the boundary strength decision and real pixel-level filter. Based on instruction structure of C6455 DSP, we implement a fast loop filter and the experimental data show that the proposed optimizing methods are so efficient that the loop filter not only has fast enough speed but also has high quality restore image.

articleTitle: Improving E-government Performance in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: China is undergoing rapid economic and political change, accompanied by developments in e-government, with radical implications for citizens. This paper analyses what is e-government and the significance of it first. Progression of Chinese e-government is introduced in the second part. Then the paper lays out the factors that determine the performance of e-government. Suggestions as to how to improve e-government performance in China is given in the last part.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Educational Technology Capacity for University Teachers in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Enhancing the educational technology capacity for teachers is an important part of the education informatizaton. It is demanded by the professional development of teachers and instruction reform. This paper provided some strategies of enhancing the educational technology capacity for teachers according to the present educational situations of universities. The strategies provided five aspects such as policy supports, environment, pre-service training, post training and virtual collaboration. It is of great significance for the changes in educational thinking and concepts and to promote the reform of instructional model, system, content and methods, and also to accelerate the educational and management modernization. So it is important to enhance the educational technology capacity for university teachers.

articleTitle: Interoperability of Digitizing Systems Based on Semantic Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the growth of the complex multi-disciplinary collaborative design product demand, the collaborative environment and functionality interoperability of the product design put forward higher requirements. To solve the issues of information-sharing among heterogeneous digitizing systems, this paper introduces semantic grid combined by semantic Web and grid technology, and proposes the semantic grid hierarchy model supporting interoperability, and establishes digital system interoperability integration framework based on semantic grid, and achieves a prototype system on this basis.

articleTitle: A Survey of Current CRM Practices in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper uses a convenient MBA sample to study the current CRM practices in China. Fifty-two questionnaires were collected and eight cases among them were studied further. We find that there is a great demand of CRM, especially for service providers. Also the more complicated a company structure, the greater need for CRM. The major reason to use CRM is `to manage and integrate customer info for the purpose of customer retention and service personalization.' Even if most companies are satisfied with their CRM practices, the greatest challenge of CRM practices is data issue, including data collection, credibility, etc. The CRM of B-B companies is simpler and focuses more on sales and financial affairs. Those personalized and humanistic CRM practices are characterized as nepotism and operated outside their IT system. Chinese B-B companies still don't wake up to the importance of understanding their customers' customers. The CRM of B-C companies focuses more on personal information, which is kept well in their IT system. Most B-C personalized services are mediated via mail, email, or phone. In China, CRM is better practiced among those industries who are able to collect credible personal info, like telecommunication and bank.

articleTitle: Research on User Groups Features of Mobile Payment: An Empirical Analysis Based on Association Rules of Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For quickly locating the specific user groups in the mobile payment market, this paper investigates and analyzes the Mobile Ticketing in mobile payment service from five main aspects, the users awareness, demand, usage, using willingness and users evaluation. We use data mining methods of association rules to do analysis to 1615 valid questionnaires and locate the user groups who are most likely to use Mobile Ticketing, so as to help the Communication Carriers to lock the target customers market precisely and quickly at the beginning of promotional period of Mobile Payment. The results show that mobile payment market, especially mobile ticketing, is still in the early stage, the users are with low awareness, the potential user groups are very big, the users who are willing to use mobile payment services are mostly concentrate in young user groups with high spending monthly and high education.

articleTitle: A Repair Strategy Based on Minimal and Imperfect Repairs for Two-dimensional Warranty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The costs from the servicing of warranty depend on the reliability of the product, the maintenance actions, and the servicing strategy. In this paper, we focus on a repair strategy based on minimal and imperfect repairs for two-dimensional warranty. We consider a rectangular warranty region with two measures (age and usage) and divide it into three disjoint sub-regions. The failed item is rectified by imperfect repair when it fails for the first time in the second sub-region of the warranty while all the other failures are repaired minimally. We derive the optimal values for these to minimize the total expected warranty cost. At last, we give an illustrative numerical example and compare with other strategies studied in the earlier literature to find the best repair strategy for two-dimensional warranty.

articleTitle: Further Research on Cooperative Document Reviewing System Based on Mobile CSCW
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The appearance of Mobile CSCW made people have much more understanding on Computer Supported Cooperative Work. With the help of Mobile CSCW, the efficiency of cooperative work has been improved,even some work has become viable what could not before. In this paper, we analyzed the characters and system model of Mobile CSCW, discussed the related developing technology and information security. Simultaneity, a mobile cooperative document reviewing system based on our analysis and discussion is also introduced to finish official document reviewing in some occasions.

articleTitle: Research on the Multi-source Heterogeneous and Isomerism Resource Mashup and Display Technology: In the Development of Village Folk-custom Tourism E-commerce System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Village folk-custom tourism businesses, whose units are single families, are often smaller scale. This scattered distributed characteristic requires a suitable e-commerce platform to display tourism resources and promote the information exchange between tourists and businesses. However, current multimedia technologies in the development of folkcustom tourism e-commerce system do not directly integrate the heterogeneous and isomerism resource such as geospatial information. It impedes the exhibition of primitive folk custom culture. Towards the goal of exhibition of primitive folk custom culture, an implementation method of integrating folk-custom tourism e-commerce multi-source heterogeneous and isomerism resources for displaying, which is called the Resource Mashup and Display technology (RMD), is presented as a key technology for the proposed scheme. This technology integrates WebGIS, multimedia, Web-3D and virtual reality panorama technologies, and achieves the integrated display for the multi-source heterogeneous and isomerism resources. First of all, using the geospatial information as an integrating link of resources, RMD add geospatial attribute to URI (Universal Resource Identifier) of resources. It realizes spatialization processing for non-geospatial resources. Secondly, by calling the resources via Web API, RMD achieves the 2D/3D Web e-map as the carrier, which combines the graphics, video, audio, virtual reality panoramas and other multi-source heterogeneous and isomerism resources with electronic map on WWW. It provides users a multi-display-mode. Thirdly, for different users' requirements, RMD offers multi-terminal access mode (such as PC, mobile phone, PDA and so on) for users to access via WWW. This paper describes the implementation of RMD and explores the development of village folk-custom tourism e-commerce. This technology enriches the display means of folk-custom tourism ecommerce, and satisfies the information exchange requirement among the folk-custom tourism enthusiasts, villages and towns folk-custom tourism business and tourism management department.

Author Keywords: the Resource Mashup and Display technology (RMD)

articleTitle: An Adaptive Immune Genetic Algorithm Based on Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The adaptive Immune genetic algorithm's evolution speed is quick and the optimizing ability is unyielding, it's a effective improvement of the standard genetic algorithm. But it still has the problem of easily falling into local optimum solution. The chaotic algorithm can carry out the ergodic character making a perturbation motion in a certain range of the value, so that the algorithm can jump out of local optimum solution, find the global parameter optimization. In this paper we lead chaos factor into the adaptive Immune algorithm to make the algorithm easier to find the global optimum solution.

articleTitle: Coordination in Retailer-Dominant Two-Stage Supply Chain Based on Lead-Time Reduction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper seeks to optimize the cost for retailer and supplier in a retailer dominant two-stage supply chain. For this study, the market demand is deterministic and the lead time is controllable, while shortage is allowed with partial backorder and partial sales loss considered. The model analyzes the way to maintain a high degree of customer satisfaction, and to reduce the total cost of the supply chain. The simulation by Maple software illustrates the relationship among the decision variables and how to optimize the cost of the retailer and supplier under different lead-time, backorder ratio and compensation coefficient.

articleTitle: A Newly Products Exhibition Mode of Digital Musical Instruments Marketing in Network Enivoment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the marketing characteristics of digital musical instruments, a newly products exhibition mode is designed to make the advantages of network. In the paper we present the principle and key designs of the proposed method. Also we discuss the deployment problems on how to apply it in real world, and the merit and prospects are summarized in the conclusion.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Innovation of Project Financing for Real Estate Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of China Sovereign Wealth Fund Risk Based on the Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to solve risk management problem of China Sovereign Wealth Fund, the fuzzy comprehensive assessment model is used in this paper. By evaluating the risk of fuzzy comprehensive, this paper establishes the corresponding fuzzy comprehensive assessment model based on different risk factors. According to the model established in this paper we can see the risk degree has its distribution of various evaluation membership. According to the model, this article carries out simulation analysis on the risk assessment of China sovereignty wealth fund. In accordance with the principle of maximum membership degree that the simulation analysis is proved to be high-risk projects with high investment, high risk, high yield and so on.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical Study about Applied Relation between Human Resource Development and Advanced Manufacturing Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research of Steganography for Multi-cover
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper presents a model of multi-cover based on static Markov chain. Researched on incomplete steganography system, analyzed the working principle and its implementation steps for shortage of single cover of capacity, embedded security and poor restorative, and given safety analysis of model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Priority Order Selection of the Effective Supply of Rural Public Goods in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Expansion of Digital Reading Function in Library Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article briefly expounds the conception of “Digital reading”,illustrates the development trends of “Digital reading”and how to achieve it. “Digital reading” is changing the trachtional model of library services. In the light of how to deal with “digital reading”and expand the service functions for the reader. This article discuss from digital information service, online bibliographic query, online information transvrission, online education, development of virtual resources and so on.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Relationship among the Structural Dimensions of Service Fairness in the Banking Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, banking services, as the research object to explore the relationship among distributive fairness, procedural fairness, interactive fairness and informational fairness. The study found: informational fairness significant impact on the procedural fairness and interactive fairness, while the procedural fairness, interactive fairness significantly affect the distributive fairness, in addition, the procedural fairness also have a certain impact on the interactive fairness.

articleTitle: Study on Pro-Poor Tourism Based on Supply Chain Management Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The purpose of this paper is systematically studying the problems of pro-poor tourism (PPT) in China based on supply chain management theory. By constructing the PPT supply chain, theoretically prescribed the general development direction and special role of PPT object in the chain, and advanced two strategies, adding assistant nodes and establishing e-business flat of PPT supply chain to improve PPT development.

articleTitle: Study on the Public Information Service Systems of Railway Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As we enter the 21st century, we experience one of the most important changes in our lives-information technology has been the important resource in the modern scientific and technology competition. So the tide of Railway Informatization is increasingly rising. Railway information service system is the strategic resource element in the course of informatization. But railway information service in our country is not perfect yet, especially the information Service for the public.
