This paper first focus on the current situation of public information service in China, then proposed an information service system for railway industry to enhance the efficiency and transparency of information transmission. and then give some advices on how to operate the information service system to facilitate the information transmission in railway industry.

articleTitle: Study on the Comprehensive Network-Based Service System in the Tourism Destinations for Independent Tourists
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Tourists have been the principal parts in the value chain in tourism industry at all times. In e-tourism era, on purpose of information integration and resource optimization, which one can be the appropriate candidate to serve the ascending population of independent tourists? This paper identifies the important role of the comprehensive network-based service system in the tourism destination, sheds lights on its development model and framework from the review of relevant research and practice. Results in this study reveal that the travel service provider should dominate the e-tourism development. The service system should aim to the independent tourists' need in the aspects of information acquirement, deal conclusion, travel experiencing and its sharing, be built on the complementary ground of the Internet and mobile networks, and bring the visitors into the publication of spatio-temporal information of fine granularity. Findings of the study are expected to assist travel service providers to understand current e-tourism in China and to support their planning for future e-commerce development in China.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment Model of Information Security Based on Knowledge Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The comprehensive assessment of information security is the foundation for risk management of information system. The information risks of organization are analyzed and identified by the application of knowledge value chain. The information resources and the information circulation process are explored in the management system. This paper built a two layers index system for assessment and it is concerned with four elements which are information, information source, information receptor and information environment. And then the model of fuzzy comprehensive assessment of information security is structured by the application of fuzzy methods. This theory research will give more props for the risk management study.

articleTitle: Substitution Effect Evaluation of Tourism Products Based on Multi-level Grey Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Substitution effect of tourism product is the phenomenon that some tourism products substitute each others because of their similar value and utility. With the goal to appraise the substitution effect of tourism product quantitatively, the author utilizes the multi-level grey theory which is the synthesis of grey correlation theories and group-decision analytical hierarchy process (AHP). The author also carries out the demonstration study of Wuling and Red Stone Forest, which indicates: there is certain substitution effect between the geological tourism resources groups of Wuling and Red Stone Forest, but Wuling silicarenite resources group has no sufficiently strong substitution effect for Red Stone Forest, so the Wuling Geological tourism resources group has the shielding effect on the Red Stone Forest. Through demonstration study, it is confirmed that application of multi-level grey theory in appraising quantitatively the substitution effect of tourism product is objective and credible, avoiding the disadvantages of analytic hierarchy process. This method provides a feasible quantitative analysis tool for the substitution effect appraisal with small sample and poor information.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Impact of the Olympic Games on Hotel Operations - Case of Star-Rated Hotels in Daxing District
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Manufacturing Information Implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Manufacturing industry is the most important pillar industry in national economy, however, china is not a power in world Manufacturing industry. Many factors, such as low productivity, low level of management, and poor quality of products and so on, restrict the development of Manufacturing in China. So, an urgent need to enhance the competitiveness of China's manufacturing is the manufacturing information. The risk analysis of the implementation of information process provides a theoretical basis for the successful implementation of information technology.

articleTitle: Context-Based Modularization of Large Ontologies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Ontology has a very wide range of applications, however the large-scale ontologies are not easy to manage and produce redundancy during deduction. In this paper, we first analyzed how to map the OWL into Graph and summarized six relations in Modular Modeling; an extended-BFS algorithm is introduced to partition large ontology into sub-ontology according to different combination of context information. Then we use multi-media conference ontology as an example to prove the effect of algorithm and compare the modularized results of upper ontologies by different thresholds.

articleTitle: An Analysis on R&D Staff of Enterprises High-tech Salary Incentives
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, a random sample surveys are made on the overall awareness level of incentive pay element of some R & D staff in the Beijing-Tianjin high-tech enterprises with a questionnaire survey method. In order to analyze and statistic the survey results, SPSS statistical software is used to summarize the constituent elements of a comprehensive salary, which is divided into inherent pay and external pay. The top three elements are the year-end bonuses, work achievements and sense of honor, career development planning. Individual factors have a significant effect on the awareness level of incentives.

articleTitle: Research on E-Government System Evaluation Based on Hierarchical Grey Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Evaluation of e-government is the basis for improving e-government performance. An evaluation indexes system is established from interior and exterior dimensionality based on service and application. And the evaluation arithmetic is built by analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method and grey evaluation method. AHP was used to calculate the weight of indicators, grey evaluation method is used to evaluate the synthetically evaluation. Taking one e-government system as an example, the experimental results indicate that the hierarchy grey evaluation method is effective.

articleTitle: On Intangible Learning Resources in E-learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Problems on Learners’ poor accomplishment in learning have existed for a long time. By analyzing and comparing the differences between the traditional teaching resources and learning resources in e-learning, it is concluded that there is a severe lack of intangible learning resources, which is the main reason for learners’ poor accomplishment in e-learning. Besides, some suggestions on how to strengthen the construction of intangible learning resources are provided in this paper.

articleTitle: Real Estate Early Warning Information Release Platform Based on ArcGIS Server
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Real estate early warning system must be established rightly in the condition of rapid expanding for real estate market. This paper introduces how to construct real estate real estate information release platform, which is based on system architecture of ArcGIS server, a distributed WebGIS application development kit. Mechanism of geospatial data sharing is focused on web services, which is based on protocol of SOAP. Methods of geospatial data modeling and concept model of real estate real estate information release platform are put forward. Through experimental verification, advantages and disadvantages of ArcGIS server platform are presented. In conclusion, advices for actual engineering application for WebGIS are suggested.

articleTitle: Rational Analysis of Brass Paradox Based on Network Reliability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Brass paradox reveals that the total cost of travel of the residents will increase rather than reduce and the level of service drop anomaly after the addition of new sections. In this paper, we analyze the reliability of road network in-depth based on Brass paradox. At first, we calculate the travel time reliability, unblocked reliability and invulnerability while increasing one section. Then, we compare it with the previous results not increasing the path. This indicates that the reliability would not be reduced, but increased. So the efficiency of its services will be greatly enhanced with the increasing of a section of the road. The calculated results have practical value.

articleTitle: An Identity-Based Rational Secret Sharing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Rational player's behavior in secret sharing schemes always determined by their expect payoff. Under this scenario, rational players will simply not broadcast their shares so that traditional secret sharing schemes could not complete in a bounded running time. In this paper, we propose a new rational secret sharing scheme based on IBE decryption. In this scheme, shares are distributed by dealer encoded by a bilinear pairing in finite field. Rational players exchange their shares in finite repeat games. The mechanism of the scheme makes all the rational players have incentive to broadcast his or her share of the secret. The security analysis and complexity analysis are addressed in the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Research on Customer After-sale Service Intelligent Decision-making Based on Component Reasoning Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the paper, intelligent decision making technologies are adopted to improve the rationality and effect of customer after-sale service. For the low efficiency of single reasoning and insufficiency of service knowledge, a novel component knowledge reasoning mechanism for multi-solution decision problems is proposed, in which decision knowledge is represented as rule, model and case. The mechanism integrated several reasoning methods according to their characteristic. By three kinds of methods, single reasoning, integrated reasoning and concurrent reasoning, the mechanism can provide more feasible solutions and the best solution or satisfying solution can be obtained more easily.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of Supply Chain Model's Changes in High-tech Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Analyze and Recommend News Comments in E-Government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of Internet, more and more public users prefer to present their viewpoints of government policies. They often comment on some emergencies through news, blogs and so on. Their opinions influence decision makers of government to make right decisions. However, large numbers of news and related comments are produced when an emergency occurs and officers are very difficult to read and analyze all of them in seconds. Specially, comments usually are short texts and common clustering technologies are not suited to analyze them. In this paper, we firstly propose a framework based on semantic web technologies to recommend news and related comments in order to aid different officers to get their interesting news rapidly. Then, a new short text clustering method is discussed to analyze related comments. Finally, a news recommender system based on above approaches is introduced.

articleTitle: Planning and Design of Regional Logistics Transaction Information Platform Based on Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The regional logistics transaction information platform can effectively reduce logistics costs to drive the rapid development of the regional economy. In this paper, the textile industry cluster in SX region as background, the logistics information platform for the development of trading domestic and international significance and the development of regional logistics information platform for the status quo are analyzed; the SX regional logistics transaction information platform for target market positioning is introduced, and the mode of operation is selected; the design principles of the platform, front and back with the main function modules, as well as with the development of tools and key technologies are described. Finally, both from a safety and maintenance are recommended. As a regional textile industry for the SX cluster logistics transaction information platform, practical will have a huge boost for the development of the local textile industry.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Construction of Individual Credit Evaluation System Based on Third-party e-Commerce Transaction Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: China's Individual credit for e-commerce research has focused on the surface of the system, and the research content is very scattered, theoretical and systematic index system is not yet formed. In this case, from the long-term perspective of the system construction, an establishment of personal credit evaluation index system suitable for China's e-commerce conditions has important theoretical and practical significance. this paper first discusses the personal and e-commerce credit and other basic theory, and for the first time to create a personal credit evaluation index system for the seller based on third-party e-commerce transaction platform, drawing lessons from domestic and foreign banks in the credit assessment of individual indicators and methods about consumer credit, and from Taobao's credit evaluation mode. This system puts forward practical improved methods in respect of authentication, transaction security deposit, the auction amount, auction moral, services and weighted scoring, and use AHP to solve out the index weights of evaluation at all levels, making it more perfect in practical applications. It includes not only management issues, but also to a large extent rely on technical support. The evaluation method has a high value of promotion and application, and the accumulated data in network transactions can be applied to other areas, which being an important reference for Personal Credit Assessment has a very considerable commercial value and also has a high reference value for China's personal credit index evaluation system.

articleTitle: Operational Efficiency Cost Reduction Studies Based on Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The operational efficiency cost has a direct impact on the manufacturing cost of final product. From the perspective of supply chain management, the operational efficiency cost of an enterprise is the organization operating cost that takes place in the process of providing products or services by the enterprise. These expenditures are a must, though they do not increase the value of the product. The occurrence of these expenditures is a direct affect the formation of the product cost. Through the analysis of the internal subsystems and the associated efficiency cost, using the thinking of supply chain management, highly efficient operation can be achieved. Thereby the efficiency cost can be effectively reduced.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Comparison and Integration of Quality Improvement Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Commercial Bank Risk Comprehensive Based on Entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: From the broking out of U.S. substandard loan crisis and the closing down of commercial banks ,we can see the important reason of suffering heavy losses is that commercial banks did not properly assess a series of facing risks. At present, China's commercial banks risk analysis is still in the traditional objective qualitative analysis phase, as for risk quantification, especially comprehensive evaluation is not enough. The paper is from the perspective of commercial bank supervision to building a commercial bank risk evaluation index system, to establish an uncertain evaluation model based on entropy to determine the weights, and through giving the example of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and Huaxia Bank, it assessed the risks of commercial banks quantitatively and comprehensively.

articleTitle: The Discussion of Web-Based Multi-factor System for Land Auction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Currently, there are three mainly ways (auction, bidding and listing) to pay for the using of state-owned land which differ in their characteristics and the scope of application as well as some inevitable drawbacks. Under such circumstances, government's ability to regulate and control the land market is relatively weak. In view of the above shortcomings, we introduce a new land auction in this paper, named multi-factor auction which based on the internet. Through the introduction of a wide range of evaluation factors, with the modernization of the network technology and using of science and integrated scoring system, land auction would be more equitable under the guidance of the government.

articleTitle: Development of an Interactive Multimedia E-learning Environment Based on Wireless PDA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Using the Internet to enhance E-learning has become a trend in modern higher education institutes. This paper presents an interactive multimedia E-learning environment Based on Wireless PDA. System is mainly used for medical students through distance to study the knowledge about skin diseases. Students can use handheld PDA devices through the network to identify the specific skin diseases. System is composed of four part, such as online studying the module, long-range communicate managing the module, image recognition module, image database administration module. The student gains the medicine scene actual case to study picture and the related knowledge about specific skin diseases. The database system adopts advanced registration administration mechanism. Using artificial intelligence technology, the system can complete the original medical images for classification, feature extraction and embedded tags. Using image-recognition technology, the system can dynamically identify and match pictures. With the application of Wireless PDA technology, the system will be more efficient for college students in higher education.

articleTitle: Study on Data Quality Evaluation of Coal and Gas Outburst
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Data quality evaluation is an important part of the process of data mining. This article has build the information quality evaluation index system and evaluation model, determines the quantitative index for each quality dimension, and also demonstrates the formulas to calculate them. The article takes the completeness as an example: Evaluate the information quality completeness dimension of key factors about coal and gas outburst, and, accordingly, finish the completeness evaluations of other dimensions, which can provide effective approaches and basis for DM data acquisition and pre-processing in predicting coal and gas outburst.

articleTitle: Research on Relations between Chain Store Logistics Capability and Logistics Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Logistics service quality of chain store is vital to the chain store’s operation. Through researching the domestic and overseas literature, the paper puts forward the concept and components of chain store logistics capability. It also develops a model to study the relationship between chain store logistics capability and logistics service quality. The model is developed based on the current situation and problems in Chinese chain store logistics, which not only clearly shows the directions to promote logistics service quality in chain store, but also lays the foundation for future empirical research on the model in China.

articleTitle: The Analysis on Performance Evaluational System of eGBCP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As the applying of public philosophy and methods in governance, the informatizational evaluation of the main part, object, indicators, institution etc. in public affairs tend to diversify. According to this, the thesis reconstructs the performance evaluational system from the angle of eGBCP. And it hopes to carry out the political orientation for citizens in main part, organization system, index design etc. of performance evaluation.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of University Library Service Level Based on AGA-FAHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the discussion on the evaluation index of University Libraries Service Level, the essay proposed AGA-FAHP comprehensive evaluation method, expounded its advantages and method principle, analyzed the example and concluded that this method can efficiently and quickly evaluate the service level of University Library.

articleTitle: Engineering Geological Problems Caused by City Planning and its Management Countermeasure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Geological environment condition is the basic factor for city existence and stability and the foundation for city construction. In city construction belts with comparably stable earth crust and good geological environment is preferable. Hence, engineering geological condition must be taken into consideration during urban construction. And city is a place where the geological environment is much influenced by human activities whose forming type, function, land used and development have a close relationship with geological environment. To survive and get maximum benefit, human make the best of environment to construct in many ways. Nowadays city planning and construction is developed from simplex plane style to the dimensional style. Increase of high-rising, unceasing construction of substructure work, development of higher, deeper, longer, larger, heavier, clustered urban construction arouse engineering geological problems brought by city construction. Characteristic of city construction is that it comes along with city and its harmfulness increases with city development. Yet an effective management way is to keep to the conception that human and geological environment should be in harmony among planning, construction and geological environment.

articleTitle: The Research of Teaching Mode of Network Experiment System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper presents a method how to design the networking experimental system based on browser server model. The design overcomes the relative shortage and the inconvenient meets the needs of experimental resources. The networking experimental system consists of active server page using JavaScript, server-side applications, and the external experimental equipments, the user logs on the experimental system through the web browser, sets up the experiment parameters and commands, experimental results will be presented to the user by the browser.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Inquiry into the Relationship between Cluster Supply Chain and Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Design and Implement of Personal Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Nowadays the information on the Internet is increasing rapidly and being updated in real time. How to acquire the information you need quickly and accurately is a primary research topic. According to the defect of current search engines, this paper presents a model of personal information, to improve examining allowing rate of information search and to perfect mutual function between users. This paper gives a working principle of the model and discuss abstract technology of the model.

articleTitle: Design Perspectives of Mechanisms of Public Service Delivery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the origin, characteristics and limits of the current design perspectives, provider-oriented perspective and consumer-oriented perspective, of public service delivery mechanism. Based on the analysis, it introduces the theory of service marking into the discussion of mechanism design of public service delivery. It points out that public service delivery mechanism should be designed from the perspective of interaction because of the existence of lots of public services which are provided and consumed simultaneously.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Regulation and Supervision on the Rent-Seeking in Government Procurement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: During the period of e-government innovation, the occurrence of surplus of objects and asymmetry of information, along with the imperfection of market result in the corrupt activities of rent-seeking. The behavior of rent-seeking always yields such bad results that society resources wasted, procurement quality reduced and society atmosphere ruined. This paper starts with a review on the related work of rent-seeking, explains the relationship between the monitoring and supervision probability and the rent-seeking strategies in different situations, and proposes game analysis of regulation and supervision on the rent-seeking in government procurement. Finally, according to the model of the regulation and supervision rent-seeking, we summarize the best strategy of the model, and illustrate how to apply it by the government supervisor department.

articleTitle: Accounting Confirmation of Executive Stock Option
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Executive Stock Option is a long-term incentives for employees and generally respected by the business community and widely used. In the main accounting treatment there is a cost concept and the concept of profit distribution. This paper demonstrated the cost concept of executive stock options is more suitable than profit distribution concept, from the economic substance of stock options, the definition of cost element, the neutrality of accounting standards, etc.

articleTitle: Efficient Strong Fair Concurrent Signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: We propose a fair novel concurrent signature scheme. It resolves the existing problems in traditional concurrent signature schemes, that is initial signer (A) has some advantages over matching signer (B), such as A could show B's ambiguous signature and the keystone to a third party in private to demonstrate B's binding signature but B can not, or A could keep the keystone secret and B do not have power to force A to release it. In our scheme, the keystones were produced by both A and B, that is to say, the two participants in our scheme have equal positions, no one has any priority than the other, so our scheme can achieve the fairness of both sides.

articleTitle: A Study of Knowledge Evolution in Supply Chain Based on SECI Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper is based on Nonaka's knowledge evolution and innovation SECI model, combining with other scholars' knowledge evolution model in supply chain. The authors think the knowledge evolution has three dimensions. Moreover, different from the one-way logistic and financial flow in traditional supply chain enterprises, knowledge flow is bi-directional. And according it, the bi-directional knowledge evolution and innovation model in supply chain model is established in this paper.

articleTitle: Strategic Research on Xi'an's Ability to Undertake Industrial Transfer of Software and IT Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the grads transfer of global software and IT service outsourcing industry to China, Xi'an is becoming the ideal undertaking district for global software and IT service industry. Based on factor analysis, this empirical study on software and IT service industry selects nine cities including Xi'an as target cities to analysis their abilities to undertake industrial transfer of software and IT service by constructing industrial undertaking capacity index system from the perspective of industrial transfer drivers in the roll-out regions. The results show that Xi'an's industrial undertaking capacity is comparatively strong. It has strong comparative advantages in human resource endowments and corporate operational costs, yet, there is still much room for growth in market size and industrial scale. Finally, feasible suggestions to solve the industrial development bottlenecks that Xi'an confronted are given.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism and Applicable Framework of E-Business Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In E-business environment, organizations are facing the challenges which are forcing them to ensure that they know what is going on in their business on a daily basis to react quickly to rapidly changing conditions. Evolution of BI is imperative to successful E-business, but more researches just stress more on techniques and lack of business application mechanism exploration. So exploring the direction , methods and basic mechanism of BI evolution is the inevitable problem. Based on analyse the challenges of traditional BI in the context of E-business,, this paper studies the evolutional objectives of BI system in E-business, explores the application way of BI and the working mechanism of BI system in E-business ,and more expounds the its operational framework of E-business intelligence system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Study on Setting Method of Project Buffers in a Critical Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Research of Equipment Support Dissipative Structure System Cobweb Organization Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Equipment support system has a tendency for chaos and disorderly condition. Its mutually effect makes it continuously exchange for human resource, energy, material and information with outside world, minus entropy emerges continuously. Equipment support system will be orderly dissipative structure, when minus entropy surpasses entropy. This process embodies that equipment support system is evolving forever. Finally this paper puts forward the concept of equipment support dissipative structure system and cobweb organization structure mode of equipment efficient support system. Some conclusion and suggestion on the organization structure are valuable for equipment efficient support system.

articleTitle: The Analysis about the Dissipative Structure on Innovation Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It is not an isolation, the self-seal system, for all the organization, particularly for the rapid change and the development social environment. The enterprise must make the corresponding adjustment and the transformation enhances the management potency, unceasingly based on the environment change. The enterprise may through the innovation and carries on the management to the innovation, breaks the limitation of the traditional organization. The reorganization and the conformity, establishes a benign reasonable diffusion structure, thus changes own malpractice, causes during impetus social development for its own input “the energy”, promotes its benign revolution. This theses mainly through the analysis about the theory of innovation management and the diffusion structural, IT get the result that the proof innovation management is also a actually diffusion structure. In fully from diffusion structure essential factor non-linearity, open system, far away equilibrium state three angle analysis after innovation system request, It also make the discussion about how to enhances the innovation management using the diffusion structural theory!

articleTitle: Electronic Business Technology and its Security Problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper discusses two main ideas, Electronic Business Technology and its Security Problems. E-Business relies upon a wide range of technologies. Here we examine the more vital technologies for electronic Business. Included Networks, E-mail, The Word Wide Web etc. On the Internet many electronic Business applications can be used today, but most of them provide only weak security or even none whatsoever. A major cause of this problem is the variety of technologies used to create such applications. Most existing security architectures are not designed to work in different environments. We discuss existing security systems; Sesame, CORBA, GSS-API, the Java family including.

articleTitle: A Research on Information Disclosure Quality of Listed Companies in China Based on the Evidence from Shenzhen Stock Exchange
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Information disclosure quality is directly related to the effective level of capital market and investors' protection. Enhancing information disclosure quality is an essential urgent demand of listed companies all over the world. In this paper, based on the data of Shenzhen Stock Exchange, general analysis and volatility analysis are made to assess the current situation and prospect of information disclosure quality of listed companies in China. Finally, we bring forward some improvement recommendations.

articleTitle: Research of Customer Perceived Value on eStores
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Customer perceived value is the crucial basis for customers to choose which eStore to purchase goods. To enhance customer perceived value is an important approach for eStores to construct their competitive advantages. The factors influencing customer perceived value are often not quantified, however they can be prioritized by AHP Method so that eStores can use these factors to enhance customer perceived value and advance competitive advantages, and eventually promote customers' purchases.

articleTitle: The Impact of Communicating Media on Group Decision-making Process and Outcome: An Experimental Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper reviewed literatures on group conflict and GDSS and put forward 3 hypotheses. The result of experiment shows that under computer-mediated condition, more task conflict will be generated and perceived decision performance is higher than in face-to-face condition.

articleTitle: New Method for Suppliers Selection under Uncertain Environment of the Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Existing suppliers selection methods are mostly for certain environment. However, this environment is usually uncertain in practice. Therefore, the study of the suppliers selection under the uncertain environment has an important theoretical and practical application value. Based on Gray Theory, AHP and Fuzzy Opinion Centralized Sequence, this paper construct a new fuzzy ranking method to select suppliers. First, a correlation matrix model is established under the Gray Theory, the weight of every evaluation index is determined by AHP. Then the best supplier is judged and chose under the Fuzzy opinion centralized sequence.

articleTitle: Study on Corporate Hereditary Central Dogma
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on analyzing the central dogma of biology, this paper raises hypothesis, using the analogism method to set up the corporate hereditary central dogma. It analyzes the differences between the Corporate hereditary central dogma and the central dogma of biology, which explains the significance of research on Corporate hereditary central dogma; it discusses the meanings of all factors of Corporate hereditary central dogma, and believes that the corporate DNA includes the corporate system, the corporate culture, the adaptive mechanism of the corporation to the environment, and the internalization form of the corporate related theory, rule and legislation. The corporate RNA refers to technology, and the corporate protein refers to product. The way of information transfer among corporate DNA, corporate RNA and product is a process of complete circulation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Application of TQC in JinJie Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on DSS Based on the Consistent Result of Different Evaluation Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: DSS is a core function module of a e-government system, but the inconsistent result of different evaluation methods makes the decision maker confused. This paper introduces the conception of granular consistency of the results of different evaluation methods firstly, and then it is given the formula to compute the granularity of different evaluation methods. Finally a numeral example is used to illuminate the approach.

articleTitle: Research About the Efficiency of Rural Credit Cooperative Fund Allocation in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, studies of rural credit cooperatives in Zhejiang Province, according to date from 1979 to 2005 annual data, using econometric models, the output value of township enterprises in Zhejiang province during the sample added value of township enterprises and rural credit cooperatives for the loan balance, as well as agriculture in Zhejiang Province value-added output value of agriculture and rural credit cooperatives for the loan balance two sets of data on rural credit cooperatives in Zhejiang efficiency of allocation of funds to conduct quantitative analysis, and on this based on the allocation of funds for improving the efficiency of countermeasures and proposals.

articleTitle: Modeling Software Park Knowledge Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Building Software Park to develop software industry is widely used around the world. Software park knowledge network plays an important role in Software Park's technology innovation. This paper gives a definition of software park knowledge network. Based on the analysis of knowledge nodes such as government agencies, Software Park management agencies, software enterprises, academies, service organizations, software platform providers in software park knowledge network and relationships among them, a software knowledge network model is proposed.

articleTitle: Study on the Science and Technology Transfer Mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Along with the advent of economic globalization, the science and technology transfer becomes a key power to push economic growth. The different science and technology transfer mode has different effects. Research on the effective mode of science and technology transfer may enhance the result. By adopting detailed analyze of national science and technology transfer mode to establish an evaluation model. Finally, the paper also puts forward some strategies on science and technology transfer.

Author Keywords: Approach and Mode of Science and Technology Transfer

articleTitle: Integrating Information and Multimedia Technology with Experimental Teaching of Heat Transfer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Information and multimedia technologies are playing a more and more important role in modern engineering education. The significances were analyzed for integration of information and multimedia technologies with experimental teaching of Heat Transfer. The application methods were summarized as simulations, DISLab and resource sharing. In order to optimize experiment teaching, it is necessary to harmonize teachers' leading role and students' main initiative, and simulations, DISLab and real experiments should supplement and bring out the best in each other.

articleTitle: 3G Technology is Integrating Network Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The 3G technology's commercialization is the great event of communications industry. Fusion of interoperability in the network, how to conduct effective network convergence has been plagued with many people. The development of multi-service convergence is the effective way to meet the modern consumer demand personalized and to fully tap the value of converged network services. The converged Network consumer market can be fractionized by commercialization of 3G technology based on the needs of the different characteristics of various types of consumers. That also can create more cost-effective and further promote the comprehensive development of network convergence.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Superfluous Mud and Brick Rubbish Transport Management System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper analyzed the characteristics of superfluous mud and brick rubbish transport management, presented the structure and key technologies of building the superfluous Mud and brick rubbish transport management system. It integrated GIS, Video Surveillance and network technology, implemented the goals of the automatic and dynamic management for superfluous mud and brick rubbish transport.

articleTitle: Development of Educational Game Software Based on Multi-touch Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Since the multi-touch technology comes, it is widely used in many fields. This paper introduces the conceptions of the multi-touch technology and analyzes its present development status. Then the development platform, TUIO protocol and the system framework of the educational game software based on the multi-touch technology are proposed. Finally, an educational game software is developed and presented. It demonstrates the proposed technique route is feasible.

articleTitle: An Influence of the High Oil Price Periods for Two Stock Market Returns: Empirical Study of the Thailand and the Philippine's Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The empirical results show that the dynamic conditional correlation (DCC) and the bivariate IGARCH (1, 1) model is appropriate in evaluating the relationship of the Thailand and the Philippine's stock markets under the oil price returns of the high oil price periods. The empirical result also indicates that the Thailand and the Philippine's stock markets is a positive relation. The average estimation value of correlation coefficient equals to 0.334, which implies that the two stock markets is synchronized influence. Besides, the empirical result also shows that the Thailand's and the Philippine's stock markets do not have asymmetrical effects. The return volatility of the Thailand's and Philippine's stock markets do not receive the influence of the high oil price periods. The variation risks of the Thailand's and the Philippine's stock market returns do not receive the impact of the oil price return volatility rates' square item. But the two stock markets do have the higher variation risks under the high oil price periods.

articleTitle: E-Commerce and Aided Decision Support System of Logistics Based on Spatial Web Services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Significance of e-commerce and aided decision support system of logistics for economic development was analyzed. Spatial information analysis and visualization performance is very poor in traditional e-commerce system of logistics, so e-commerce and aided decision support system of logistics establishing method based on spatial web services was researched by using GIS technology. Logistics business database and geodatabase were built. On that base, SOA of the system were set up with ArcSDE, ArcGIS Server and VS.NET softwares. Some characteristic functions including data publishing dynamically, business sheets processing, optimized route analyzing, distribution center aided siting and statistic analyzing were implemented in the system. And these function modules were encapsulated as web services.

articleTitle: Strategy of Speeding up the Modernization Process of China's Coal Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this thesis, the China's Industry will be fractionized through the industry categories and that will be according to the level of modernization evaluating index system which is common used in Developed Countries, and then, we will admeasure the level of the coal industry modernization which benefiting from the researching results from the predecessors. In that way, the factors which can influence the modernization construction of coal industry in China will be thoroughly discussed, and at last, the exercisable advice for how to change the management mode of coal industry to follow the intensive style, how to strengthen the awareness for modernization construction, and how to promote social responsibility of the entrepreneur will be given.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on Collaborative Protection of Commercial Secrets among Supply Chain Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of the economic, the collaborative protection of the commercial secrets in the supply chain enterprises is increasingly important. In this paper, we analyze the necessity of the collaborative protection of the commercial secrets. The game modal is employed to analyze the actions and the benefit-based relationships between the core corporation and the supplier. Results indicated that the distribution of the net surplus between the core corporation and the supplier determines their payoffs and actions.

articleTitle: The Principal Component Analysis about Three-dimensional Time Series Data of Chinese Information Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Using the method of the principal component analysis of the three-dimensional data of time sequence, we analyze the process of informationization of 31 provinces and cities in China in the year 2005 and 2008, further we calculate the score on the base of the first main composition to the areas, and give the tables of their sequence, analyze the dynamic change in these different areas. Some constructive suggestions are proposed to the informationization of Chinese area finally.

Author Keywords: the Princompsition analysis of the three-dimensional data of time sequence

articleTitle: Extraction of Greatest Impact Factor in Nonlinear Diagnosis Models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For diagnosis models with one response variable influenced by multiple factors, the paper proposes a method that finds the greatest impact factor, referred to as main factor. The method is based on statistical analysis and uses the principal component transformation to optimize statistics. It includes several steps: sampling, calculating and constructing the correlation matrix between response variables and factors, obtaining the most relevant matrix by principal component transformation, determining main factor by comparing the correlation degree of correlation matrices and the most relevant matrix. The algorithm can meet the need of many engineering problems that hunt for the greatest impact factor in non-linear diagnosis models with multiple factors.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Factors of Channel Conflict in Customer Relationship Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Analysis on E-interview
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper defines the concept of E-interview, analyze the advantage of E-interview and elaborate the reason of the application scope of the E-interview in the current personnel selection. This paper not only points out the important position and the applicable scope of the E-interview in the current personnel select, but also does the basic estimate to the application foreground of the E-interview. For making good use of E-interview in the business and government, it also gives some suggestions about the preparation of the hardware and applicants.

articleTitle: Product Market Competition and Capital Structure: Evidence from Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper gives a panel-model study on the data of 547 listed companies in China from 2005 to 2007 and draws a conclusion that in China capital market, the capital structure of listed companies in different industries which have dissimilar competition of product market reveals significant diversity. Moreover, the relation between product market competition and capital structure presents positive, which means that listed companies who face drastic competition will select high debt ratio, while those whose competition is weak will select low debt ratio. At last, this paper also points that the decision of capital structure is not only a financial problem. It must be consistent with the company's competition strategy of product market.

articleTitle: The Intelligent Control of Temperature for Packaging Production Systems of Heat Shrink Film
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The shrink temperature is a key technology parameter in the heat shrink packaging production system; it will directly effect the quality of packing production. The intelligent control of the heat shrink temperature has an advantage of the heat shrink temperature control. The fuzzy control is applied in the heat shrink production system. And the four functions of the lead feedback compensation, performance measurement, control parameter modification, control rule modifications are added and the fuzzy control is adapted in the new system. The high precision of the new system is gotten. The steady-state errors of the heat shrink temperature are decreased and the contraction quality of the heat shrink film is increasing.

articleTitle: Heuristic Teaching and Practice on Assembly Language Programmng
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A new teaching method-“realization of goal” is proposed considering the characteristics of the assembly language course with being hard to understand and needing hardware theory. According to the method, classroom teaching is combined with autonomic learning, and some reforms in education such as “learning transfer” theory have been applied in order to grasp old knowledge and understand new knowledge. In the meantime, the influence of student number and teaching material to quality of teaching is also proposed. Practice in the course show that the proposed method can arouse students learning interest, and their programming powers are also improved.

articleTitle: A Utility Function Analysis on DTN Services of Resource Pre- and Post-Fetching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Quality of Services optimal models often based on the utility function maximization. However the services in Delay and Disruption Tolerant Networking (DTN) have different characters on delay and disruption. So a novel utility function was made to analyze resource pre-fetching and post-fetching in DTN and to prove the relational Pareto improvement and substitutability. Then users' competitions were analyzed under accounting policies by utility function and game matrixes, which show accounting by traffic improves more network efficiency than by monthly unlimited. And a pricing formula was draw. Finally some data from Internet bar is proposed as a sample. The utility function analysis on game theory make a role in network services behaviors, and it can conduct a distributed network traffic regulation to ensure quality of service in DTN.

articleTitle: Observation, Exploration & Analysis on Broad Space-Time Spheres of New Media
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper discusses the intrinsic connotation of new media; it expresses the view that traditional media provides a foundation for the emergence and development of new media, while new media is an ascent & expansion form on the basis of traditional media; the paper points out that new media possesses technology-oriented, intensive, boundless, widespread, updated & upgraded characteristic as well as the salient features of digitization, networking pattern, interlinking dissemination, quick penetration, environmental protection & energy saving, and so on; it also envisages the increasingly broad space-time spheres of new media. From the perspective of development trends, the good nurturing environment of new media will greatly promote its growth and development in China, which will help to realize resources complementation and construct a new pattern of innovation & development.

articleTitle: China's Bilateral Trade Intensity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we use an intensity approach incorporated with gravity model to measure and compare China's bilateral trade with the world average level. Our gravity model adjusted trade intensity index indicates that: 1. The trade between China and South-East countries are not more intensively than the world average when the effects of economic size and distance (both geographical and cultural) have been considered. 2. China has increasing interests in Africa Market during the period of 1985 and 2005. 3. China has intensively imported from Middle East oil suppliers. But the intensity of Japan's import from this region is much higher than that of China's.

articleTitle: Case Analysis of the Enterprise Reform Based on the Logistics and Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Currently the competition between enterprises is of logistics and supply chain. The enterprise with a more responsive supply chain will be the winner. Amongst the elements of supply chain logistics is the most prominent element hence its response time will determine that of the whole supply chain. And if an enterprise wants to realize modern logistics it has to reform the management. This paper mainly emphasizes the relationship between modern logistics and enterprise reformation by analyzing the case of Xinfei Electric which has realized modern logistics and reengineered the process of the enterprise successfully.

articleTitle: Channel Competition in “One-to-Two” Supply Chain Based on Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As implementation degree of electronic commerce increasing, this paper analyses the channel competition among large retailer, small retailer and the manufacturer in “One-to-Two” supply chain with different customer service level by game theory. It concludes that, when the manufacturer builds Internet direct channel, as implementation degree of electronic commerce increasing, the Internet direct channel' price of manufacturer becomes cheaper, so does small retailer's price. Besides, the Internet direct channel' price of manufacturer has nothing to do with the small retailer's customer service level.

articleTitle: Research on Evolution Mechanism of Innovative Industrial Clusters and Policy Suggestions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Innovative industrial cluster (IIC) is a high-end model of traditional industrial cluster (TIC), and it is a brand-new model of economic organization with innovation as a driving force. This study first defines the basic concept of IIC, and then discusses its evolution mechanism by analyzing the growth period, evolution path and stages, and finally gives relevant policy suggestions on stimulating the development of IIC.

articleTitle: Self-consciousness, Self-efficiency and Peer Learning from SDT Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Peer learning is a topic in the education psychology field. From the career development and human resource development perspectives, peer learning plays an important roles in human resource manage and learning organization building. This paper focused on the relationship among self-consciousness(SC), academic self-efficiency(ASE) and peer learning(PL). By the methods of SEM and sample from college students, authors found that those cognitive psychology variables have positive influence on peer learning.

articleTitle: C2C E-Business Customer Loyalty Evaluation: A New DEA Approach with Information Entropy Constraints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper introduces an improved data envelope analysis (DEA) approach to evaluate the customer loyalty of C2C E-business. Information entropy theory is used to constrain the weight assignment in DEA model, which helps improve the traditional DEA model and acquire a more objective and reasonable evaluation result. An empirical case is given to illustrate the improved model.

articleTitle: Work Support and Technical Professional Creativity: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Using a sample of 403 technical professionals from 129 Chinese companies in 28 cities, we found that (1) comparing with supervisors, work support from coworkers may have potentially long-lasting effects on creativity, (2) intrinsic motivation partially mediated the contribution of work support from coworkers to technical professional creative ability. We discuss implications of these results for research and practice.

articleTitle: An Analytic Model of the Factors Affecting Knowledge Transfer in the E-commerce Alliances Based on Overlapping Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Recently, knowledge alliance has been the crucial method for enterprise to get competitive advantage. Based on overlapping knowledge under the E-commerce environment, this article has analyzed the factors of knowledge transfer in Knowledge Alliance. It has put forward the four -factor model and analyzed four major factors such as the nature of knowledge, the inner factors within enterprise, the outer factors among alliance partners and the E-commerce alliance environment. Three kinds of relationships between factors and knowledge transfer are explained: positive effect, negative effect and an inverted U-shape effect.

articleTitle: A Study on Valuation Methods of E-business Enterprise Based on Real Options
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the emergence and development of Internet technology, e-business enterprises sprang up like bamboo shoots after a spring rain. E-business enterprise valuation has become the focus of attention because of the flexibility of e-business enterprises' business and profit model. In the systematic analysis of characteristics of e-business enterprises, Black-Scholes option pricing model are introduced to establish e-business enterprises valuation system based on the real option. In addition, the study also takes e-business enterprises M&A as an example to verify the operability of the above system, which provides a new perspective and way of thinking for the e-business enterprises valuation.

articleTitle: Study on Basic Problems of Building Chinese Construction Market Credit Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper discussed some basic problems in the building of Chinese construction market credit information platform, and analyzed the significance of building construction market credit information platform. Then the paper discussed fundamental functions of construction market credit information platform and how to choose a construction market credit information platform pattern.

articleTitle: ESM: An Extended Schema Matching Method between Database Schemas
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Schema matching is a basic problem in many application fields as fundamental operation of schema. This paper analyses the advantages and limitations of iMAP and CM, and proposes an extended schema matching system architecture between Database Schemas (ESM). First, ESM filters unreasonable matches by preprocess and clustering process. Then it employs a set of special-purpose searchers to explore a specialized portion of the search space and discover 1:1 and complex matches. Then it estimates candidate matches and selects optimal candidate matches by using similarity estimator and match selector respectively.

articleTitle: Hospital Process Modelling and Tool Designing for Healthcare Services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper presents an investigation into the use of process modeling to decibels complex processes in the healthcare sector, with reference to the process of Surgery and Registration in China. We argue that process models are generally useful as a means for understanding, analyzing and improving complex health processes. Also, we show that using these models it is possible to discover process bottlenecks and low-quality information, to identify cross-functional boundary problems, and to focus assessment of information quality in the various processes of the hospital.

articleTitle: Future Framework of Mobile-Center Digital Home
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Digital home has not the imagination not only for consumer but also for industry. Booming products have made it possible for every one, which brings many huge commercial chances and a compelling commercial battle. Maybe nobody knows indeed what the digital home like in the future. But, no doubt, the winner must be the one who can predict the model of digital home. In this paper, a new model of next generation digital home is discussed. The core content is that the digital home will have more mobile character in the model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A New Topic in Disaster Economics - Marine Disaster Economics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on Cost-Sensitive Communication Models on Large-scale Monitor Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Large-scale distributed monitor networks are in face of the challenge of tremendous data communication costs due to the resource restriction. Prediction models can be used to reduce communication cost over the networks. A framework is proposed which provides a mechanism to maintain adaptive prediction models that significantly reduce communication cost over the distributed environment while still guaranteeing sufficient precision of demand results. Prediction models are also proposed to process prediction queries over future data streams in this paper. Three particular models, static model, linear model and acceleration model, and the corresponding tuning schemas are given. Experimentations are performed based on the simulated data and ocean air temperature data measured by TAO (tropical atmosphere ocean). Analytical and experimental evidence show that the proposed approach significantly reduces overall communication cost and performs well over prediction queries.

articleTitle: The Study of Decomposed Model for Production Planning in Supply Chain System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Since supply chain management usually breaks the boundary of a single enterprise to take the advantages of integration and time efficiency, modern productions systems are featured with multi-location, automation and openness. Traditional production planning methodologies need to be updated to support supply chain, a relatively new pattern of organization. Based on analysis on systematic features of supply chain enterprises, the paper establishes a tri-level coordination mechanism, which is further illustrated through a functionally decomposed module.

articleTitle: The Application of Industrial Chain Cobweb Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Industrial chain is an integrated functional chain structure that formed among inter-related industries under specific economic relationship. As a functional chain structure, industrial chain emphasizes the inter-relationship among joints. Through an analysis on the definition of industrial chain, this essay shows the industrial chain cobweb model and the interrelationship among joints within the chain that serves as a basis for improving profitability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Statistical Analysis on financial maturity in Guangdong Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Classification of E-Government Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-government affected by many factors, which contain highly complexity and uncertainty. While people definitely produce uncertain cognition from incomplete information, it is hard to use quantitative analysis for evaluating E-government performance. Therefore, this article attempts to use unascertained means cluster method to study the classification of E-government performance. Based on the analysis of influence factors of E-government performance, this paper constructs a E-government performance evaluation system which contains 19 secondary indicators based on public information, online business, public participation, network security, system cost and network design. Moreover, in the case of 10 government departments with the function of social service and management in one province, the unascertained means cluster method is applied to evaluate the E-government performance of the 10 departments. The empirical research indicates that this methodology not only provides a precise classification, but also clarifies the degree of affiliation of different samples. It is believed that this methodology is more advanced and has practical value and application prospects.

articleTitle: Study on the Supply Chain Inventory under Electronic Commerce Base on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Base on system dynamics, this paper use the software I think to build two molds, they are traditional two-lever supply chain and electronic commerce two-lever supply chain. In the two molds, we use arrays to simulate a single inventory center ships out to multiple retailers. And some traditional constraints on Dispatch Centers are loosened, such as unlimited capacity. After the simulation, We compared the two molds from multi-angle and confirmed that electronic commerce two-lever supply chain outperforms the traditional two-lever supply chain such as low inventory, bullwhip weakened.

articleTitle: Study of University Informatization Using Gray Relation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: University informatization is an important aspect of modern universities. University informatization is affected by many factors. We analyze influence factors of university informatization, and provide effective decision-making reference for improving informatization. This paper establishes the university informatization index system, introduces the grey relation analysis method, and chooses four universities to compute their informatization index scores. In addition, we use grey relation analysis method to analyze the university informatization with these influence factors. Finally, we give an overall evaluation.

articleTitle: Tacit Knowledge Transformation Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Knowledge is playing an increasingly important role in the era of knowledge-based society. The practice proves that tacit knowledge is the more important resources. How to transform and share tacit knowledge, to serve the society, the enterprise and individual is a hotspot of today. In this paper, from the tacit knowledge and ontology of the concepts and features, the tacit knowledge sharing transformation model is putted forward.

articleTitle: The Business Model Comparative Advantage and Industry Analysis of Industrial Products Supermarket Chains
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper compares industrial products supermarket chains with the traditional industrial circulation channels, mainly in the information processing mode, channel character and customer service levels, analyses the Internal and external environment of Industrial products supermarket chains, points out the problem we should concern for further development of Industrial products supermarket chains in the future.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Effectiveness of New Campus Construction of Colleges and Universities in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the existing literatures, this paper defines and classifies the effectiveness of new campus construction of colleges and universities. Then, we discuss the relationship between different kinds of effectiveness, and analyze the generation mechanism of the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Subjective Game Model of Supply Chain Emergency Decision-making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper builds the subjective game model of emergency in supply chain system, and then analyzes the emergency decision-making when supplier and retailer are facing with the emergency attack. If retailer increases the wholesale and retail price differentials, it's belonging to the high-technological product with higher price and lower quantity available, or supplier possesses the abundant additional product ability, the supplier couldn't decrease the quantity available. Once the supplier has to reduce the quantity available, the retailer should rapidly start up the emergency decision-making, where it seeks for the potential supplier to reinforce the quantity available. If the quantity available coming from potential supplier is greater than the reigning supplier in the crisis state, the potential supplier and retailer will get the more marketing profit.

articleTitle: Research on Auditing Rent-seeking Activities in Capital Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: From the Perspective of rent-seeking theory, this thesis studies the auditing fraud that needed to be resolved. The thesis analyses the necessity and the theory logic beginning of the auditing rent seeking, and briefly reviews the development and current situation of the relate researches. Through proposing the audit rent seeking activities' implication, the main body, the manifestation and the future research direction, this thesis provide the foundation and the reference thoroughly for the further research.

articleTitle: Research on Selection of Regional Leading Industry Based on Sustainable
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: How to choose the leading industry based on different conditions in different regions, which include environment, resources, human resource etc Industry Advantages. The basic approach and tasks includes: speed up to adjust economic Strategy and change of the pattern of economic growth and to strengthen resource conservation and environmental protection. Most of researches focus on the economic structure. Nature resources flow is an emerging concept in resources science. Research on Selection of regional Leading Industry Based on Sustainable, an economic mode of selection of leading Industry was studied which was suitable and competitive advantage for regional development. Some proper strategies are provided for economic policy of industry adjustment. Resources flow research can promote the development of regional economy and the improvement of industrial structure, the formation and development of regional sustained competitiveness is very important to resources flow and improvement of industrial structure.

articleTitle: Dynamic Monitoring and Intelligent Network System Design and Implementation for Mandatory Inspection Measurement Instruments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article analyzes the existing process problem on archiving the measuring instruments which have gone through compulsory examination in China. The system archives data online intelligently, shares data with the Measurement and Technology Agency, updates automatically at pre-determined intervals, dynamic and real-time monitoring by the Quality Supervisory Bureau (at district or county level), controls and supervises via the Internet by the Government Measurement Administration Team and issues warnings at critical levels which were preset. With this 5-in-1 system, it dynamically manages all the processes and the data is then submitted and achieved once only. So duplicate effort and data redundancy could be avoided.

articleTitle: A Networked Chemical Test System Based on Web Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Nowadays, it is very important and necessary to share calculation model and results in chemical tests system for testers who work in different place and lack of certain expensive but key test devices. This paper proposes a novel software architecture for those people to share their resources and to work collaboratively. To begin with, it brings forward the system architecture based on web service. Then, the system is designed and implemented by using C# language. Finally, we take an example as explosive performance test software to demonstrate our proposed system. The results show that the proposed system can enable interoperability and sharing in the networked chemical test environment.

articleTitle: Human Resource Development and Management in Government from the Perspective of Knowledge Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the advent of knowledge economy, there is showing a series of new features in the HR Development and Management in Government such as capitalization, strategic-orientation, people-orientation and virtualization etc, in the aspects of concept, ideas, systems and supporting measures, which highlights the weak points of the HR Development and Management in Government including the lag of concept, the deficiency in system, the weakness of operation mechanism, the insufficient training and development and a lack of incentive mechanism, on the other hand demands new changes including from “people” to “human resources” in ideas, from “simplification” to “diversification” in functions, from “rule of man” to “rule of law” in method and from “political content” to “comprehensive training” in practice. In order to adapt for this trend, the HR Development and Management in Government must advance itself towards scientific, information-based, people-oriented, marketing and legalizing process.

articleTitle: Design Quality Evaluation of Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to probe into the content and the method of Design Quality Evaluation in China's construction industry. The design quality was divided into technology quality, economic quality and service quality. Each kind of quality was been separated finely and a four layer of evaluation index system was set up. An FCA method was introduced in this article to appraise the quality of design.

articleTitle: Government's New Roles in Network Era: Emergence and Development of the “Network Spokesman” System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of economic reform, it is necessary to speed up the process of government reform so as to build a service-oriented government.
