articleTitle: An E-learning System Based on Subsumption Architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The loss of feeling is one of the biggest shortcomings in the traditional E-learning system. In order to compensate for this shortfall, we describe a face recognition-based Intelligent E-learning system based on Brooks' subsumption architecture. In this architecture, we implement the subsumption of lower layers by high layers using nonmonotonic reasoning principles. However, unlike systems that followed Brooks' work, it allows the layers to work in synergy to produce the compound behavior. Study shows that, based on the above structure, the system could track learners' emotional changes in real time, and dynamically adjust the learning strategies to make learners' study more efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Constructing Emergency Event Bayesian Networks Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Emergency events have brought lost to the human society. To improve the effectiveness of emergency management, a universal emergency event Bayesian Networks model for predicting dynamics of the event is proposed in this paper. Based on system theory, emergency event is first viewed as a system, and the basic elements of the system are proposed. Then the Bayesian networks model of emergency events is proposed to deal with the uncertainty of the events, and the method of building the Bayesian Networks is introduced. Finally typhoon event is incorporated as an example to demonstrate its effectiveness in practice. The model proposed in this paper can help predict various emergency events using expert's knowledge and historic data.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Nowadays, the competition among enterprises has transformed into the competition within supply chains under the circumstance of rapidly developing E-commerce age, the reduction of logistics cost has already become the core element of the enterprises competition. This paper aims to establish SCOR-based enterprises ABM model, which includes logistics cost calculation, performance evaluating determination and process improvement and so on. By the study of ABM model and the analysis of the activities costing, we can improve the process and then enhance the competitiveness of the enterprises.

articleTitle: Estimating Operational Risk of China's Commercial Bank Based on LDA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Loss Distribution Approach (LDA) is one of Advanced Measurement Approaches (AMA) for estimating operational risk. The approach first estimated the distribution of operational risk loss frequency and the distribution of loss size. Then we got the distribution of annual operational risk loss by using Monte Carlo simulation. At last we calculated the operational risk capital via the annual loss distribution. Lack of operational risk loss data for single Chinese commercial bank, this article viewed all the commercial banks of our country as a whole, and estimated operational risk of China’s commercial banks by using LDA, then calculated the operational risk capital.

Furthermore, it puts forward some detailed solutions, including role-level-based authorization management, recruitment program management, system data management and maintenance.

articleTitle: How Employee Turnover Affects Career Success and Firm Performance in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: I discuss how employee turnover affects career success and firm performance in China. Based on the literatures the model about employee turnover, career success and firm performance is built. From the model it is found that employee turnover brings to employee input diminishing that could produce employee pay loss and cut down firm profit because of immature labor market in China. To verify the view, I give a demonstration based on data in which the result is consistent with the above theory. From the conclusion, the proposals are as follows: an employee should reduce turnover to avoid market risk, and a firm build the cohesion culture to attract its employees, and the government should establish the perfect labor market for employees.

articleTitle: A Practical Approach for Risk Assessment of Data Leakage Prevention in Telecommunication Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Recently more incidents caused by improper data leakage prevention have occurred in many organizations which have been suffering a huge loss. The study of data leakage prevention is receiving considerable attention for reasons of privacy protection of personally identifiable information, preservation of an organization's brand and reputation, retention of intellectual capital. It is very challenging for senior management in telecommunication industry to identify, analyze and properly treat the data leakage risks due to the complexity and diversities of business process and supportive information systems. In this paper a practical method of risk assessment aimed to analyze and evaluate the risks of data leakage protection related to customer information in telecommunication company is presented, and the distribution view and transition view have been defined to describe and analyze the customer information which provides the basis for the risk assessment. A group of technical tests are proposed to find and verify the risky vulnerabilities which have been identified based on the method.

abstract: Wireless network is the trend in the future, but the signals of wireless are often covered each other in the transmission, so the hiding channel is the unavoidable. This paper studies the execution mechanism in transmission especially and lets the program counter to follow the change of information flow in the execution progress. The type of program counter (pc) makes dynamic changes with the type of program variability to tag the information flow. This paper also illuminates the transformation process from the hiding information flow to visible information flow, at the same time the thought of chain queue is also available.

Also the model could better reflect the relationship among the whole index, which based on the independence of the index.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government

This paper discusses the impact of introducing e-commerce on e-book collecting-editing work, and then describes the channels and forms of using e-commerce in library collecting-editing work. Finally, this article points out that application of e-commerce in digital library literature collecting-editing is the inevitable trend of development in future.

And this passage mainly focuses on problems that exist in the construction of e-government affairs in China, including symbiotical mode of China's e-government affairs being low level stage, legislation mechanism lagging behind and application of e-government affairs being barely satisfactory. Last but not the least, this passage raises up a few improving suggestions for construction of the e-government affairs in China.

Furthermore, this passage illustrated function and relevant technologies of different units and modes. Design of structural function for the ELPVRC's units (including resource database unit, operational experiment environment unit, record and analysis unit of data) and key technologies applied in the ELPVRC (including database application, realization of 3D effects of virtual-reality commodities and database connection) were discussed. In addition, promising future of the ELPVRC applied in remote e-business was prospected.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Electronic gift certificate system is the digital simulation of the physical gift certificate system on the Internet. Transferable and Untraceable is the main characters. Electronic gift certificate be proposed and glowed up with the development of the Internet. In this paper, I propose a blue print of implement the electronic gift certificate system. Through the study on the field of the electronic payment, I get the method of achieve Transferable and Untraceable characters in the Electronic gift certificate system, which based on 3G mobile communication technology and RSA encryption; Propose the blue print of the Electronic gift certificate system, include the function design, system framework design, safety design, database design and protocol design. We propose in the study, the method to archive the transferable???untraceable characters carry out the breakthrough of the technique of electronic payment. The blue print of the electronic gift certificate system can be the reference of the relational study.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Today, the network teaching has become an important part of the education system of universities. A Web-based network teaching platform is introduced in this paper. The platform is designed aiming at the teaching of the correlative courses of dsp (digital signal processing) chip technology. Firstly, the main exploitation tools and platform running scheme are presented. Secondly, the total design of the teaching platform is introduced which is exploited based on B/S structure by the use of PHP and MySQL. Through the network teaching platform, students can study by themselves some DSP knowledge, make online communications with their teachers and complete their assignments by the internet, and teachers can achieve primary paperless teaching mission and manage the students' information such as operating results, submitting tasks, scores of daily exercise and experiments. Some advanced exploitation technology and thinking are also used in this platform.

This paper uses the game theory to illustrate the importance of credit evaluation system in our country based on the analysis of C2C e-commerce sites of credit evaluation system, and puts forward some suggestions on the problems of credit evaluation system.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government

But our small and medium firms get in a significant unfavorable seat even if they have gained great progress. The irrationality of decision-making, especially in sales, makes a firmly causation to the situation. Through this paper we want to import Decision Supporting Systems to increase scientific index of decision-making in the sales procedures, meanwhile use UML activity diagram to describe the workflow. Finally the Agents are analyzed from the perspective of rules.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Talent is the source of the development of the high-tech enterprises, and it is also the base of the business’ development. Therefore, to retain talent and play the role of talent is the important works for the enterprises. Using the software SPSS’ factor analysis method to determine the impact key elements of the brain drain of the high-tech enterprise, thus we can propose the related measures about the brain drain, and hope to reduce the brain drain and help high-tech enterprises.

articleTitle: An Extended Automata to Efficiently Match Counting Constraints Patterns
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Regular expression matching is an important application in the area of network security. In this paper, we analyse the limitation of the existing methods and show the classification of counting constraints patterns. We then present a new representation for deterministic finite automata, called Bitmap Shift Finite Automata (Bs-FA), which introduces condition function and bitmap structure. Bs-FA handles counting constraints patterns effectively and considerably reduces memory space requirement of states by evaluating this method on signature sets used in Snort. Overall, for all signature sets and compression methods evaluated of counting constraints patterns, Bs-FA offers the best memory reduction.

articleTitle: The Impact of Venture Capital on Firms' Accounting Performance - Taking Chinese Listed Companies in SME Board as Examples
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the impact of venture capital on accounting performance of the firms, taking 66 Chinese listed companies in SME Board of Shenzhen Stock Exchange as examples. Although ANOVA and cross-section regression analysis show no significant differences of performance between venture capital backed firms and non venture capital backed firms, in a long term venture capital does show a positive impact in increasing firms' accounting performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of a Learning Resource Service Eco-System Universe of Discourse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The dissertation analyzes the theoretical basis of LRSES and proposes the theoretical model of LRSES. The author constructs a Learning Resource Service Eco-System Universe of Discourse (LRSEUoD), and analyzes its five subspaces, that is Role Space ∑R, Content Resource Space ∑CR, Media Tools Space ∑MT, Coordinating Space ∑C, Work Information Space ∑W, with formal modeling. The progress of learning resources’ interactive evolution is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Economical Benefit of Low Permeability Oil Reservoir Development under Different Well Patterns
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Development of low permeability oil reservoir is a very important in the petroleum engineering, especially for China. Adopting different well pattern, the economic benefit is different. What is the relationship between well pattern and development result? In this paper, the author described the characteristic of low permeability reservoir development, given the economic benefit calculation method. Through a sample study, the relationship between well pattern and development economical benefit was studied, and given the optimization scheme. The results can provide theoretical guidance to low permeability development design.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics Optimization Based on Parallel Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper is concerned with the efficient design of a reverse logistics network. The mixed integer linear models is formulated and determine how to optimize collection cost, transportation cost, fixed cost, variable cost, disposal cost, the sale revenue of reclaimed materials and revenue of selling two-hands products. GI/G/m queuing model presents uncertainty inherent to reverse logistics. In order to search for the optimal solution of this model, the paper proposes an algorithm based on the technique of Parallel Genetic Algorithm (PGA). To speed up the processing of generations of populations, parallel genetic algorithm splits the population into several sub-populations and run them in the parallel way. An example is solved by PGA and the result shows the algorithm has a rapid convergence rate.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Research on Development Level of Urban Agriculture in PRD Based on Entropy-Fuzzy Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to the development status, this paper analyzes the Space-Function Distribution of Urban Agriculture(UA) in Pearl River Delta(PRD), then constructs a set of quantitative evaluation index system of Urban Agriculture in PRD Based on it. In determining the index weights, introduced the concept of entropy, avoiding subjective factors caused by some commonly used methods such as analytic hierarchy process (AHP) etc, To evaluate the overall development level using Fuzzy-Synthesis. At last, comparatively analysing the Urban Agriculture development level on the nine cities in Pearl River Delta.

articleTitle: On the Problem and Countermeasure of Network Financial Service Development of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, network financial services in china have developed very quickly. However, through empirical analysis, this paper argues that there are still many problems in the development of network financial services of china, such as laws and regulations problem, security problem, network infrastructure problem, etc. To solve these problems, this paper considers that we should formulate and improve relevant laws and regulations, strengthen the network security, speed up the network infrastructure, enhance the innovation of network financial services, and reinforce the supervision.

articleTitle: The Incentive of Government Chief Officials at Grass-roots Level: An Analysis of the Political Tournament Model in Interagency Information Sharing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The lack of incentive mechanism for government chief officials is the key obstacle to improving interagency government information sharing. This paper considers the political tournament model as suitable to stimulate local governmental “top leaders” at district-level and county-level, and then puts forward some measures for the application of the model.

articleTitle: The Study and Exploration on German Dual System for Counselor's Long Distance Training Mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to the contents and situation of Chinese counselors' training, this study explores German dual system for counselor's long distance training mode combined with German dual system of vocational education mode. After that we set up the teaching platform, counseling platform and supervision platform for counselors. We also establish the courseware of expertise and skills, as well as other resources which match the requirements of counselors' growth system. The kind of training mode has achieved good results and found a new method for training counselors.

articleTitle: Explore Tax Issues Related to E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Along with the electronic commerce recent year's swift development, this kind of emerging commercial shape has formed the huge impact on the traditional tax revenue system and the collection pattern. In terms of tax equity, fiscal revenue mobilization, or the healthy development of e-commerce industry, we should all be included as soon as possible tax jurisdiction. The building of a long-term tax consideration, we propose that e-commerce sales of goods by the material form of taxable value-added tax and business tax, respectively.

Author Keywords: E- Commerce Business Tax Value-Added Tax

articleTitle: Spatial Integration of Urban Agglomeration Based on DEA Dynamic Clustering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper employs dynamic clustering of DEA model to analyze the efficiency of the urban economic of the 11-prefecture cities in Jiangxi. The calculated results show that the spatial connections among cities are being strengthened and the entire urban system being optimized, but there are significant spatial differences for urban agglomerations to link, and the radiating and agglomerating effects of the deputy central cities are weak and technical efficiency is low. Therefore, the four suggestions have been put forward, priorities of temporal development, key areas of spatial construction, paths of industrial development, and goals of infrastructure construction.

articleTitle: An Experiential Analysis of the Influence of Critical Marketing Environment on Consumer Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Critical marketing environment is the restraint condition of enterprise business activities, which has extremely important influence on the existence and development of enterprises. Meanwhile, critical marketing environment is one of the important factors influencing consumer decision making, too. On the basis of studying the factors influencing consumer decision making and the macro marketing environment of enterprises, this paper explored how the critical marketing environment influences the consumer decision making. In addition, taking Chinese automobile purchase decision making as an example, it studied how the macro marketing environment influences the Chinese automobile consumer decision making.

articleTitle: On Tactics of Improving the Quality of IT Outsourcing Relationship for Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It is the key for an enterprise to improve the quality of IT outsourcing relationship to achieve success. This paper firstly makes analysis on the evaluation indexes of the quality of IT outsourcing relationship and its effecting factors, then puts forwards four tactics to improve the quality of IT outsourcing relationship, which are strengthening the convergence and integration during the outsourcing transition, enhancing the controlling mechanisms of outsourcing, promoting the building of trust mechanisms, and reinforcing the quality management of complex outsourcing relationship.

articleTitle: Financial Asset Price Forecasting Based on Intertransaction Association Rules Mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It has been widely accepted that association rules mining, the task of searching for correlations between items in a database, can discover useful rules in stock analysis. Previous studies mainly emphasize on mining intratransaction associations. In this paper, we introduce the concept of intertransaction and the FITI algorithm so that we can effectively forecast the price changes in Chinese capital markets, then we compare FITI with EH-Apriori, and demonstrate the advantages of FITI over EH-Apriori. At the end of this paper, we apply the algorithm to a dataset of Chinese asset indices and the results indicate the usefulness of intertransaction association rules in price prediction.

articleTitle: Opinions about the Development of Agricultural e-Commerce in the New Socialism Countryside Construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper introduces the basic concepts of e-commerce and the problems among agricultural e-commerce of China. It briefly describes the remarkable significance of the e-commerce in agriculture, the current situations and features of the applications in China's e-business. Combined with the constraint factors that exist in the current development of, the article mainly presents the strategies of how to develop agricultural e-commerce in china, making e-commerce play its due role in the promotion of agricultural production, thus, serving for the construction in a new socialism countryside.

articleTitle: Research on Automotive Part Production Strategy Concerning Piracy Rate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A two-stage game between genuine part maker and counterfeiter in automotive part market is analyzed based on manufacturing cost and part quality. At the first stage, the genuine manufacturer determine the total demand in the market by choosing the supply quantity of whole automobiles; At the second stage, genuine part maker and counterfeiter choose their respective optimum prices given a known total market demand. Research shows that: because of a correlation between manufacturing quality, cost and quantity, genuine and fake manufacturers will yield different product prices and market shares in different total market demands. Only when the total market demand beyond a certain threshold, can counterfeit products emerge. Furthermore, there exists an optimum market demand at which the genuine manufacturers can achieve maximum profits. The total market demand is controllable by the supply quantity of whole automobiles for genuine manufactures, thus properly controlling automobiles' supply quantity is effective to protect genuine manufacturers' profits.

articleTitle: The Application of the E-learning in the EOR Teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Along with the development of computer technology and network technology, E-learning way of learning in petroleum college teaching is applied widely. With using of internet public information resources by both teachers and students, the combination of multimedia teaching techniques and network technology may also play advantage both traditional classroom teaching methods and students' autonomous learning. This paper summarizes the practical teaching experience of Daqing petroleum institute for many years, introduces the application exploration achievements of CAI courseware in teaching reform in petroleum engineering specialty backbone course Enhance Oil Recovery (for short EOR).

articleTitle: Research on Fault Identification in the Internet Inter-Domain Routing System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we explicitly propose the problem of fault identification in the Internet inter-domain routing system, and develop a systematic and sophisticate algorithm to identify the BGP faults in the Internet inter-domain routing system. The algorithm fully utilizes the hidden temporal and topological correlations among the BGP routing updates to identify the common BGP faults that might trigger the routing updates.

articleTitle: Construction Safety Assurance System of Key Water-control Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Safety of key water-control project construction is of great significance to people's lives and national economic development. Science and technology and economic develop rapidly at present, there will be more large-scale and more complex key water-control project, and the safety assurance work will be much more difficult. So this paper tries to form a perfect construction safety assurance system of key water-control project. It mainly contains personnel assurance system, institution assurance system, method assurance system and safety measure system.

articleTitle: Research on e-Commerce Environment in Decision-making Model of Consumer Purchase
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: What factors will affect the consumer's purchase decision-making is a very complex issue, it has also become a consumer behavior research focus. In this paper, the consumer online shopping from the reality of the technology acceptance model based on online consumer purchase decision-making model designed to enrich the content of this field of theoretical and practical development of e-commerce market to provide reference.

articleTitle: The C2C Web Site Cost Analysis Basing on the Role as a Credit Watchdog
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Most of the investigations about the structure of E-commerce website cost are start from financial point of view at present. The paper introduces enterprise psychology cost to cost structure and analyses the relationship between enterprise psychology cost of the C2C E-commerce website, who performs as a credit watchdog, and the trade dispute interposition of personnel, basing on characteristics of C2C E-commerce web site.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Competitive Strategy Based on Value-net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The value-net is the product of the rapid development of information economy. It is a new business design that uses digital supply chain concepts to achieve both superior customer satisfaction and company profitability, and coordinates member firms within the value-net, and extracts the core capabilities of the value creation. This paper introduces the concept and model of value-net, and constructs a enterprise competitive strategy based on value-net by analyzing Porter's traditional competitive strategy, and also presents the implementation of enterprise competitive strategy based on value-net. Furthermore, the author attempts to shed light on application methods for practitioners on their business initiatives.

articleTitle: Research on H.264 Standard Stream Media Files over 3G Wireless Networks Based on DaVinci Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For transmission of multimedia over 3G wireless networks, H.264/AVC represents a major step forward in the development of video coding standards. In this paper, firstly, the authors briefly introduce a overview of H.264/AVC standard and propose the related coding tools, usingDM6446. Then, the paper gives the hardware and software design of a simulation system, this system can acquire the multimedia information and send the information by 3G interface. At the last section, the authors compare the H.264/AVC standard with other prior coding standards. The results show that H.264/AVC standard will enable new applications and business opportunities to be developed.

articleTitle: A Conversation Protocol Design between Heterogeneous Agents Using KQML
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In a MAS (Multi-Agent System) agents may be heterogeneous. Two disparate agents require a common understanding of messages and message content in order to interact with each other. So a conversation protocol is needed for the communication of agents. Several conversation protocols have been proposed, but these don't work well in an environment of heterogeneity where an agent wishing to interact with a large number of other disparate agents cannot be expected to have knowledge of how to initiate or maintain a conversation with all other agents it may encounter. This paper proposes an application independent conversation protocol is defined at first in which a sequence of activities an agent has to perform to solve the problems in the communication using KQML with the notation of FSM.

articleTitle: The Relationship of Stock Returns and Inflation in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to study the relationship of stock returns and inflation in China, VAR model is used in this paper. Use China's stock market data and inflation data from 1991 to 2008 to establish VAR model, then research on the relationship between the stock returns and the inflation rate by econometric methods. Empirical results show that there is a faint correlation between the stock returns and the inflation, which is a negative correlation in the long-term.

articleTitle: Analysis of the added value model of regional traffic and transport based on Spatial Econometrics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The added value of transportation between provinces and cities has a strong spatial correlation, thus it uses space econometric method to study the economic behavior in the paper. According to space-dependent diagnostic tests, it establishes space lag model of the added value of the transportation. Through simulation analysis, we find that the external transport functions are not fully out in He' Nan province and others, so how to play the role of these transport hub has become a very important issue.

Author Keywords: the added value of transportation between provinces and cities

articleTitle: Knowledge Management Strategy Under the Condition of E-Business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As development of the knowledge economy and e-business, knowledge management (KM) is becoming increasingly important. By the rapid development of information technology, especially network technology and e-business, channels to get information continue to expand, means of access to get information gradually fast, corporate information rapidly expanded. In the e-business environment, except acquiring supply and demand information through the Internet and modern information technology, integrating of enterprise value chain enterprises the more important question is how to deeply manage all information, then knowledge management have emerged so. However, many enterprises still do not realize to use the knowledge management a business management strategy which can promote enterprise development and competitiveness in the long-term. This paper would like to do a little useful discussions on this.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Internal Service Quality of E-Government Based on Structural Equation Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This research explores the relationship among various factors of internal service quality of e-government. We hypothesized that the soft environment, the hard environment and job satisfaction have positive influences on internal service quality of e-government. We tested these hypotheses by SEM with investigation on civil servants and MPA students who participated in and were familiar with e-government program. Results show that both the soft and hard environment play direct roles in improving the internal service quality of e-government. Moreover, special attention should be paid to the support of the leadership in the soft environment. There is also evidence that the improvement of job satisfaction mediates problem solving significantly.

articleTitle: International Coordination of E-Business and China's Strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-business is playing a key role in individual country's economy as well as in global economy. Its global nature brings some problems to it, which can not be solved interiorly. But digital divide between the two country groups is expanding. Official and non-official organizations undertake the due obligations to e-business coordination in many aspects, and have gained remarkable achievements. What China should do in this e-business wave is discussed finally.

articleTitle: Some Improvements on Recoverable E-cash
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: When the E-cash file being destroyed for some unexpected error, we cannot expect waiting for the recovery of the file, but improve the design of E-cash system such that the bank can compute the amount of E-cash the user really lost. Recoverability and untraceability (anonymous) are two obviously conflicting properties. If we give up untraceability, we can compute the lost E-cash by computing the difference of the withdrawn and deposit amount of the user by recording all the transaction activities in a large database, then the bank can recover the lost E-cash for the user. It is obviously unfeasible for the complexity of storage. Shoemakers proposed an E-cash system which contains recovery but it's an on-line system. Joseph proposed an off-line E-cash system which possesses both properties of recovery and Untraceability, but it has many problems also, we analyze the problems and propose a few points of view of designing Recoverable E-cash.

articleTitle: Study on Computer Technology Utilized in Engineering Cost Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to the need of engineering cost management reform and with the development of computer technology application in Internet, the paper introduced application status of computer technology in engineering cost management, some problems existed in engineering cost management at present, and the future of its application were analyzed. Point out it is an inevitable trend for using computer information technology in engineering cost management.

articleTitle: Application of TPM In Site Continuous Improvement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to the theoretical analysis, this paper considers that site management is the first line-integrated management. Continuous improvement of site management is requirement that enterprises adapt to the environment change and obtain competitive advantage. This article analyzes 8s management, visual management, standardization management, lean production (LP), TPM, 6σ management. A framework of the site management based on continuous improvement is set up. Methods of site continuous improvement and their relationship are explored. Then the method of TPM is applied to the site management in Jiangsu Tianming Machine Group Co., Ltd so as to validate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: A New Concept in Protection of Historical Buildings: Industry Cluster and Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Many industrial buildings will be abandoned and demolished in cities due to the structural transformation of the economy. Some of them, in terms of their physical lives, can be well used continuously, and have a symbolic value in their local communities. This paper aims to explore how to protect and reuse the old industrial buildings. The previous urban planning approach emphasized on the physical form of a city, rather than on the analysis of urban economy. As a result, some protected buildings were destroyed, considering development of local economy. By analyzing successful and unsuccessful cases on protecting historical buildings as viewed from industry development and value chain, this paper finds a new pathway satisfying both promotion of urban economy and protection of urban heritage. As far as abandoned industrial buildings is concerned, developing cultural and creative industries enable local government to gain a win-win between development and protection.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Organizational Change Mode and Approaches Implemented Based on the Authority and Rights System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In general, the business's organizational change is a comprehensive change for the business, and mainly focuses on the organizational structural change (including the the corporate governance structure's change) and the operating mechanism's change. The article analyzes principles of the organizational change mode to build the constituent elements of organizational change, and then considers that the organizational change mode concentrates on the formation of the action plan and the management of organizational change, also, the best platform of the business's organizational change should be a system of the authority and rights. Accordingly, the article designs a new model of organizational change mainly focused on the authority rent-seeking and rights to appeal of the business's stakeholders and suggests the concerned approaches implemented.

Author Keywords: the system of the authority and rights

articleTitle: The New Darling of Electric Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The background of eB2B(business to business electric commerce) will be introduced as a point of departure to explore the relationship between eB2B and eB2C(business to customer ecommerce); contrasts of cost-efficiency, ESM(electric supply chain management) and global development scale demonstrate that eB2B will lead the trend of ecommerce but not eB2C; the Case 3 market is emphasized to be the main force of eB2B market; the introduction of Alibaba is expounded for its contribution to both global and Chinese eB2B markets.

articleTitle: Study on Revenue Sharing and Coordination Mechanism of the Closed Loop Supply Chain Based on Nash Negotiation Model and Buyback Contract
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper discusses revenue sharing and coordination mechanism of the reverse logistics including a manufacturer and a retailer who experiences stochastic demand. On the base of optimization models designed, the optimal order quantity and the optimal price at which the producer buybacks the retailer's surplus commodities are acquired. As a result of the revenue sharing and coordination mechanism based on Nash negotiation model and buyback contract, profit of the close loop supply chains can be maximized and coordination of its members can be realized. Finally, a mathematics model is given to verify the conclusions.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Relationship between LMIEs' Technological Innovation and Energy Consumption Intensity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: China's rapid growth of energy consumption can be attributed to many factors, among which Low energy efficiency is dominant. Energy efficiency is determined by the level of production technology, so technological innovation should be the effective way to improve energy efficiency. In economic society, enterprises are the core players of technological innovation. In China, the large and medium-sized industrial enterprises (LMIEs) form the backbone of industrial sector, so the technological innovation of LMIEs is the decisive influence on energy efficiency. In this paper, we firstly use factor analysis method to do evaluation on the technological innovation capacity of LMIEs in 30 regions of China according to the data of 2007, and then apply regression analysis to research the relationship between the regional technological innovation capacity of LMIEs and regional energy consumption intensity. The study results show there is significant negative correlation between them, which suggests the energy efficiency can be boosted by promoting technological innovation capacities of LMIEs.

articleTitle: RFID in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Supply chain management (SCM) is essential for a company. Effective SCM can always enable the company maintain a stable and lasting competitive advantage, thereby can increase its overall competitiveness. But there are two main problems in the traditional SCM, which are known as “Ripple Effect” mainly due to the delay of a particular activity which results in the delay of the whole SCM and “Bullwhip Effect” caused by the demand uncertainty in the supply chain, respectively. As markets become more global and competition intensifies, the old mode of the traditional SCM is not feasible any more. Companies must find a new way out. RFID technology is a good choice, which can greatly overcome the shortcomings of the traditional SCM and improve its efficiency. However, on the other hand, there are also some challenges. This paper mainly studies the application of RFID technology in supply chain management, the strengths and weaknesses of it are all analyzed.

articleTitle: Web-Based INC Collaborative Learning Based on LAMS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the popularity of the network and Web technologies, as well as the advantages of collaborative learning; web-based collaborative learning in the application of teaching activities has been more and more recognized and valued. On the other hand, the unique features of LAMS make it as the most suitable platform for building collaborative learning activities. In consequence, this paper innovatively proposes a Web-based INC collaborative learning model combining incentive mechanisms in the collaborative process. Furthermore, the specific implementation is carried out in the LAMS platform.

articleTitle: An AHP and BSC Approach for Evaluating Performance of Universities Based on KM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper is to construct a balanced scorecard (BSC) for universities based on knowledge management (KM) and the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) for evaluating it. The BSC concept is applied to define the hierarchy with four major perspectives (i.e. financial, customer, internal process, and learning and growth), and performance indicators are selected for each perspective. An AHP approach is then proposed in order to determine weight. The results provide guidance to universities regarding strategies for improving department performance.

articleTitle: Financial Needs of Shanghai's Culture Undertakings and Diversity Policy Input Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As an important component of the building of a harmonious society, the development of cultural undertakings play a pivotal role in the protection of cultural rights and interests of citizens and realize a fair and open culture and enhance the cultural vitality and competitiveness. And the study by comparing the features and representative in London, New York, Singapore and other international cities taken by the cultural methods and intensity of cultural inputs, as well as the merits of cultural management in order to offer advice and suggestions on China's cultural development.

articleTitle: A Process Mode of Space Weapons Systems Innovation Based on the Knowledge Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Space confrontations have become the main assault force of wars in a new form and produced an increasingly important influence on the war process and outcome. Therefore, national military industries and academic community focus on the innovation of space weapons systems. However there is not a recognized innovation mode and the current innovation modes have attracted a lot of controversy. Based on a detailed research in some space weapons systems, the paper offers to a new idea which is with “knowledge” as the main line and adopts knowledge supply chain to study innovation mode of space weapons systems. In light of the thought, we developed a process mode and process flow diagram for space weapon systems innovation. The process is divided into eight parts: innovation task, analysis of stakeholders, knowledge module division, and construction of knowledge supply chain, outsourcing selection, module development, system integration, delivery and promotion.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Distribution of Company Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, the author defines the company's structure as a series parallel connection system. Considering the various importance degree of each department in the actual operation and combining the computation of reliability of unit in the company management system, the author builds the optimization mathematical model of company distribution based on reliability distribution theory.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of the Internet Tourism Information of Local Governments' Official Tourism Websites
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The tourism website has become a pivotal tool for tourism destination marketing. The purpose of this study was to evaluate the internet tourism information of 30 local governments' official tourism websites in China. Analysis was concentrated on eight items such as foreign language, site counter, menu item, sitemap, search engine, e-map, information update and contact point, link site. This study suggested that gratifying results were achieved in the development of the local governments' official websites in China whilst problems still remain. Implications of this study could be used to improve the tourism information provision for local government.

articleTitle: Infrastructure Securitization in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Infrastructure in China is generally financed by government debt and bank loans, which endangers the financial system of the nation. This paper proposed asset-backed securitization as an instrument to solve the problem of financing infrastructure. This paper analyzed the principle of infrastructure securitization and studied the implementation details of the infrastructure securitization through the case study of securitization of Guangzhou Metro. It is concluded that the infrastructure securitization can be an effective instrument to finance infrastructure project in China.

articleTitle: The Research on the Financial Early Warning System Based on Cash Flow
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Now the listed companies in China are facing a severe problem about the financial situation because of the financial tsunami. Certainly, the stakeholders of the enterprises will experience different levels of loss. Therefore, the build of effective early-warning index system of financial crisis make a significance to corporate investors, creditors, operators, etc. This article indicates the financial data limitation of China's listed companies, considers the cash flow as a vital factor in financial early-warning system and establishes three financial early-warning indexes based on cash flow, and then predicts three thresholds related with the three indexes respectively. The paper have a conclusion that the model on three financial early-warning indexes is applicable by calculation and empirical verification in listed companies in China.

articleTitle: On the 3G-Based E-Government Technology and Its Legal Risk Prevention
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As the Chinese informationization has marched into the 3G (Third Generation Mobile Telephony) era, 3G-Based mobile government information system will guide the way of the development of E-government. Based on the analysis of the existing technology of China, this paper aims at providing more technological appliance and development channel for the government information disclosure. Besides, corresponding technological and legal risk countermeasures for the solutions of the existing and potential issues rising from the development of 3G-based e-government are also included in the paper.

articleTitle: Exerting Theory and Technology of Wavelet to Repair and Treat with Ancient Patterns and Symbols in Stone Steles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Theory and technology have important significance and worthiness in stone stele researching especially in ancient stone chisel researching, there are cicatrices and stone blooms, erode, denudation, under the guidance of wavelet theory, band wavelet instruments and infrared instruments together, we can look upon obscure imprint correlate to literalness well and truly, revert its formerly picture and image, it has particularly important meanings for the reparation or partly reparation of ancient steles.

articleTitle: Obtaining Enterprise's Sustainable Competitive Advantage from eCRM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In e-commerce era, successful strategic CRM is the basis for a sustainable and hard-to-imitate competitive advantage, however, how does electronic customer relation management (eCRM) help enterprises to obtain the competitive advantages? This paper just gives an answer to this question. This paper sets out from analyzing the source of enterprise's sustained competitive advantage, studies the function and tactics of customer relation in the obtainment of enterprise competitive advantage. Meanwhile, through typical case analysis of network enterprise Alibaba, it expounded the fact that enterprises can obtain the competitive advantage through implementing electronic customer relation management in information technology era.

articleTitle: The Research on Contribution of Human Capital in Listed Company's Net Profit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Human capital has became the most important resource of enterprise,which should participate enterprise retained profits,distribution along with material resources capital according to its contribution rate. Due to the particularity and complexity of human capital,although there have been plenty mode of inquiry about human capital contribution rate and human capital,much insufficiency still in,demanding improvement and perfection. The study use the theory of C-D production function calculating the human capital contribution rate of quoted company for the first time,and give comparative analysis of 10 vocations′human capital contribution rate,which are Gas and Electric and Water Production,Realty,Construction,Transportation and Storage,Agriculture and Forestry and Fishing and Animal Husbandry,Wholesale and Retail Trade,Social Work,Information Technology,Manufacturing, and Multiple′s Trade,and put for ward the proposals of improving human capital contribution rate and participating enterprise income apportionment. Those submitted each vocation’s human capital contribution rate,can use for reference to real work.

articleTitle: Construction of Star-Shape Enterprise Value Network Center As Industry EC Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The existing Industry e-commerce platform has the problems as: the operation mode is not innovative, the information and display methods are not diversity, the service is not comprehensive, the function of transaction is not complete and the resource integrated is not efficient. This paper tries to construct a star-shape value network for SME. The network use every enterprise in the industry as nodes, and use the universal interface provide by e-commerce platform as axes, that will link all enterprise websites which having their own style with e-commerce platform, forming an interconnected business network which is interrelated, reciprocal, win-win and collaborative development.

articleTitle: Incidence Relation Modeling of Administrative Permit with Multi-Business Based on Role Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to establish the optimized model of administrative permit, the paper analysed the incidence relation of administrative permit with multi-business. The modeling method of multi-business incidence relation was proposed by using role network theory and relationship function matrix. An instance was showed to introduce the application of the method in multi-business administrative permit system. Then it gave the corresponding petri network model, describing not only the serial and parallel process relationship of the business objects but also key permit departments intuitively.

articleTitle: Study on the Career Competency of Commercial Bank
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The employee's career competency is critical for an enterprise to survive and develop. This paper took the employees' career competency of commercial banks as study object. By analyzing the components of employee's career competency of commercial banks, this paper put forward a suitable development system model of career competency for commercial banks, and also explained its operating mechanism based on human resources disposition and information flow separately. This paper figured out that employees' career competency of commercial banks include professional ability, leading ability and endogenous quality, and the main contents of the development system should involve professional and leading ability. Constructing career competency development system with four basic modules as “pre-career development subsystem”, “enterprise development subsystem”, “individual self-development subsystem” and “transformation & integration subsystem” can achieve the intercourse of employee and information between interior and interior, interior and exterior, so as to efficiently promote the employee's career competency during the dynamic process of internal operation and external competition, and eventually maximizing the effectiveness of human resources development.

articleTitle: Study on the Development of E-commerce and SMEs' Supply Chain Financing in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of the E-commerce (or E-business) nowadays, the commercial banks are keeping continuous innovation and development of financing transaction. Chinese practice shows that E-commerce begun in 1998 promotes the development of supply chain financing, and has alleviated the problem of SMEs financing to some extent. However, SMEs are still facing the problems about excessive dependence on indirect financing for banks, and uncoordinated development between E-commerce and the supply chain financing and so on. The research has shown that based on the existing supply chain financing models, our country should actively promote the integrating process of E-commerce and SMEs' supply chain financing, to make it truly become an effective financing channels for SMEs, it will be an inevitable trend in the development of the electronic supply chain financing in China.

articleTitle: The Calibrating Method of Frame-transfer Type CCD Image Smearing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The Structure and imaging process of frame-transfer CCD is analyzed, Finding the image smearing is because of photosensitive unit is still exposure when image transferred line-by-line, The image subsequent lines will influent by previous lines inevitable, once there is a highlight area in image, which will generate serious image smearing. In this paper, a Calibrate image smearing method is proposed, which uses subsequent line's gray subtract previous line's affluence, and use this method to test several frame-transfer type CCD, experimental result shows the method simple and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Marketalized Operation Model in the Field of Urban Infrastructure Construction in Western Cities of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the practical situation of the westward of china, the author bring forward seven operation models of marketalized in the field of urban infrastructure construction, and analyses the different features of operation models and their applicable field. Hoping to give the guidance and reference of improving the quality and service level of western urban infrastructure construction of our country.

articleTitle: Research on E-government Date Encryption Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Data encryption is important to E-government information safety. This paper introduces the general model of date encryption, points out using different arithmetic according to the degree of cryptograph. After analyzing the disadvantage of the model, it adds the identity validation part to revise the model. Then it explains the procedure of data encryption in Egovernment, such as how to do identity validation, and how to manage the secret keys.

articleTitle: Study on Harmonizing Land-use and Ecological Environment Based on Ecological Footpint: A Case Study of Gu'an County, Hebei in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Ecological footprint is a viable approach to measure the ecological economic system of a region, as an important method in harmonizing land-use and ecological environment. According to the concept and calculation method of ecological footprint and ecological harmonious degree, the ecological footprint and ecological harmonious degree of Gu'an County in 2008 were analyzed with related statistical data. The results indicate that Gu'an's per capita ecological footprint was 2.1907 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, while the per capita biocapacity is only 0.5398 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>; the per capita ecological deficit reached 1.6509 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The ecological harmonious degree was 0.4025, implying that Gu'an was not in the state of sustainable development status. Meanwhile, the ecological footprint and ecological harmonious degree of each town of Gu'an County were apparent. Based on these, some suggestions were put forward to alleviate Gu'an County's ecological deficit and make Gu'an County transfer to sustainable development model between land use and ecological environment.

articleTitle: Network Based Approach for Discovering Academic Researchers with Shared Interests
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Interest or expertise of researchers is a kind of knowledge in organization, like university, research institute and research community. Effectively management of this kind of knowledge can facilitate communication of members in organization and improve their performance. Researchers' cognitive limit and large amount of relevant information available present great challenge to discover researchers with similar interests. Previous research addresses this problem by investigating their research related relationships. The social network based approached do not satisfy researchers' needs due to their failure to take into consideration the semantic information related to research interests. To solve this problem, in this research, we propose an integrated model based on ontology and social network analysis to mine researchers with similar interests.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Electronic Commerce Logistics Distribution Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, the problem that e-commerce puzzles businessmen is safety and logistics distribution. This paper introduces GIS into the system of e-commerce logistics distribution, displays electronic map through the integration of MapInfo and Visual Basic, and presents an intelligent algorithm for state space searching for the shortest path with the aid of the thoughts of state space searching and dynamic cut branch in artificial intelligence. Realize the firewall using a packet filtering, and complete foreground goods transportation over the internet, and backstage logistics management and firewall. The experiment results show that the management software can meet the requirement of the high-speed and low-cost distribution in e-commerce, and provide the security of e-commerce logistics management software, so it can help decision makers to make sensible decisions.

articleTitle: Application of Multimedia and Network Technology in Improving Teaching Quality of Petroleum Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper expatiates on the application of multimedia and network technology in improving teaching Quality of petroleum engineering, summarizes its characteristic and application predominance and brings forward the changes of teaching mode of petroleum engineering in multimedia network technology environment. At last, the recommendations of improving the teaching quality and enhance the technology popularize and application was proposed.

articleTitle: Coal Requirement Prediction Using BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Coal is one of the most important main energy-consuming resources in our society. It is important to forecast the coal requirement with high accuracy. BP neural network forecasting model has the typical of self-learning and self-adaptation. It is often used in these systems that are difficult to create accurate mathematical model. The factors such as the trend of the industrial coal, the rate of increased GDP, rice index and the proportion in the energy-consuming of coal are considered in this paper. We use improved BP model to predict and simulate in MATLAB. It proves that this prediction has better application.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Continuous Innovative Capability - An Empirical Study from Technology Parks in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In global competition, there is a need to measure the capability of continuous innovation for industrial clusters. Innovation capability for industrial cluster is measured by the Innovation Organization Sub-System (IOSS), Innovation Support Sub-System (ISSS) and Innovation Environmental Sub-Systems (IESS). In this paper, an evaluation system composed of 22 indicators is developed. An empirical study based on the Qingdao Technology Park has examined the changes of its innovation capabilities. Discussions and recommendations to improve the capabilities of continuous innovation are also given.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of Listed Company Market Competition's Influential Factors - Based on the Empirical Research of Steel Industry in Our Country
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive HRM Based on e-HR under the Economic Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This document is about comprehensive HRM based on e-HR, which has realized HRM's strategic value, reflected modern management ideas such as BPR, CRM, as a result, e-HR will be representing the future new pattern of HRM. Under this economic crisis caused by USA Financial Crisis in 2008, executives, HR professionals, line managers and employees can all get various services and specific HR solutions based on e-HR, for example, labor cost accounting, reducing staff and compensation's decision-making, flexible payment design, business-manpower index model setting, performance process management, knowledge-sharing platform, on-line EAP counseling etc.

articleTitle: The Theory and Empirical Study of the Services' Benefits Based on Product Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Due to the unique nature of services, some service industries not only the characteristics of the service itself, but also has the attributes of goods, services, and differences in the interests of value into their products to provide an important foundation. In this paper, hotel and catering industry as the object of study, from the functional benefits, emotional, and economic interests of three-pronged analysis differentiated, post-purchase satisfaction, to achieve product value, building structural equation modeling to verify dimensions of interest and the value of the product impact is possible.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Supply Program Designs of a Three-layer Supply Chain in Autombile Businesses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Empirical Research for the Effects of Dynamic Capabilities on Business Performance in E-Business Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Dynamic Capabilities are the capabilities that an enterprise responds to the environmental changes. These capabilities are especially important to E-Business enterprises for sustainable development. Through theoretical analysis this paper probes into the hierarchies of Dynamic Capabilities. By using survey questionnaire in E-Business enterprises, empirical study is carried on applying structural equation modeling (SEM) to analyze the effects of Dynamic Capabilities on business performance. The results show that Dynamic Capabilities have significant and positive impacts on business performance. Among the Dynamic Capabilities' contribution to business performance, the effects of different capabilities are different.

articleTitle: P2P-Based Real-time Interactive Net-classroom Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Modern distance education requires the high-capacity, large throughput of video network. A good video education platform is the foundation of the remote network on-demand and live teaching. However, there is the large gap between the reality of network environment and the real-time interactive requirements of modern network teaching mode, which desires real-time and continuous transmission of a large number of audio & video streaming, in order to achieve real-time playback of course teaching, online courses in video on demand (VOD), interactive discussions in online classroom. This paper carried out the modern cognitive science research and the analysis of characteristics of online teaching, and proposes a new model of real-time interactive and network-oriented teaching architecture based on the P2P streaming media technology. Thereafter, the Real-time Interactive Net-classroom (RTINC) infrastructure is advanced. The preliminary instance based on the above-mentioned model has dynamic load-balancing features, good adaptation and expansion performance, the smaller building and maintenance costs and other potential advantages.

articleTitle: The Application of Six Sigma Method in F Bank
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The aim of this passage is to analyze the factors that influence the customer satisfaction by combining with the method of Six Sigma and to give out advices on improving. The analysis of the paper is based on the phenomena that customer waiting time is too long and customer is unsatisfied with the counter service, the phenomena often image in the courses of daily operations in the bank. In the phase of improvement, we use the idea of queuing system to analyze the Issue and make a queuing system optimization program.

articleTitle: The Quality of Listed Banks' Internal Control Information Disclosure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the 12 listed banks' 2007 annual reports of Shanghai Stock Exchange, this paper analyses the listed banks' internal control information disclosure quality from the internal control information disclosure medium, internal control self-evaluation reports and the assurance reports of accounting firms, etc. This paper presents an evaluation model of listed banks' internal control information disclosure quality. Using the model, this paper has evaluated and compared the 12 listed banks' internal control information disclosure quality. Finally, this paper puts forwards some advices about internal control information disclosure.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Dynamic Inventory Management with Selling the Substitute as Stockout Occurs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Reform of Examination & Approval System for Chinese Government-Invested Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Process Integration Evaluation and Providers Selection of the Fourth Party Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The present study puts forward a new method for supply chain integration of the Fourth Party Logistics (4PL), based on value chain analysis method and modern optimal control theory. The proposed method can be described as follows. First, the supply chain of 4PL was defined and transformed into process design requirements based on the benchmarking and quality function deployment (QFD) method. Second, the optimal model of 4PL is given using multipurpose optimal theory in order that the whole maximum value of partners within 4PL is achieved under time, quality, cost, and service constraints. Third, appraisal system of process integration solution is set up and estimate standard of supply chain of 4PL reference model is given. In the end, we proposed the evaluation method of 4PL integration solution based on fuzzy theory and the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method. The proposed method laid the theoretical foundation and tangible measures for process integration of supply chain of 4PL for difficult to achieve synergy from supplier with dynamic behaviors, organization autonomy and distribution.

articleTitle: On Certain Problems and Countermeasures of Listed Corporation in China's Financial IT Project Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the development process of our modern financial listed companies, IT projects which are based on digital technology-driven play an important role and have a profound impact on aspects of promoting financial listed companies' large-scale development and institutional innovation. Today, no matters in state-owned commercial banks or joint-stock banks of our country, various financial businesses rely much on computer networks and information systems. However, problems existing in implementation and operation of IT project have seriously affected security of internal control and economic benefits of China's financial listed companies. Therefore, to strengthen IT project management as soon as possible has become a significant step to accelerate the pace of building China's operational safety of China's financial listed companies. The management team of financial listed companies should pay highly attention to and strengthen the IT project management. Improving emergency response of IT project, capability of handling and recovering breakdown, is to ensure the safety and stable operation of IT systems in financial enterprises.

articleTitle: Knowledge Sharing Effectiveness of Enterprise Nonstandard Employing Knowledge Workers: A Research Based on Contract and Embeddedness Theoretical Views
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Entering knowledge economic age, the amount of enterprise holding knowledge and the ability to develop and utilize knowledge have been the sharp weapon to deal with market competition and the ever source to develop continuously, and knowledge sharing is the most important part of knowledge management. With nonstandard employing knowledge workers more and more common, the knowledge sharing between nonstandard employing and standard employing workers has been coming important for enterprise to accumulate and create knowledge. Firstly this paper divides nonstandard employment into four models based on labor contract and social embeddedness theoretic views, and then tests the knowledge sharing effectiveness difference among models by empirical research. The research show the knowledge sharing effectiveness of nonstandard employing knowledge workers are various, and the embeddedness into working organizational network is more vital impacting view comparing with the labor contract maturity.

articleTitle: Structure of the Network for TAOBAO
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the advent of Electronic Commerce and its rapid development we witness more and more people pay attention to online shopping. TAOBAO provides the largest online shopping platform in Asia, gains more than 70% on-line shopping market share in china and C2C (consumer to consumer) market obtains 83% global share of TAOBAO. The analysis of network topology between online shops in TAOBAO in this paper is observed in perspective of complex network, and we also adapt a notion of credibility - a measurement TAOBAO evaluates the on-line shops, as weight to make deeper of it. It is observed that the distribution between the degree of the shops network and shop credibility follows power-law and so it offers an underlying application (mercantile) value for new shops development on TAOBAO. The outcomes of this paper not only renders managers of TAOBAO some references on about plan and management, but also in some sense help consumers to understand TAOBAO better.

articleTitle: Research on Unified interface of Heterogeneous database
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, different technologies were used to handle heterogeneous database in system development. It's easy for the application developers to access single database, however, the technology and code complexity make a big challenge to handle data of systems which obtain multiple data sources, no matter what the application patterns base on C/S B/S or the mixture of both. This paper offers a perspective on the framework and its realization of handling multiple data sources under a unified way based on the years of application system development experience. To achieve purpose of accessing multiple data sources with unified messages, some specific types of messages for operating heterogeneous database were defined by XML language, and other relevant technologies were introduced to implement this framework.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method for Toll Policy in Transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Tolling is generally considered to be a method for balancing the supply and demand of social resources. This paper explores the emergence and development of the transportation toll policy. It examines the influence of tolls on travelers' route choices, and even the departure time choices. The modern toll policy is mainly designed to reduce traffic congestion. We list potential motivations for applying the toll policy to balance traffic supply and demand, and then uncover how it works. We discuss the approaches that evaluate the transportation toll pricing policy. Finally, by introducing the study case, California State Route 91, we apply the proposed method to compute the value of time and the value of reliability to evaluate the toll pricing policy on this study site. We also verify the actions and reactions of the toll policy in the practical transportation network.

articleTitle: Flexible Strategy of E-learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to improve quality of teaching and method of teaching and learning process, flexible strategy is introduced into e-learning - flexible teaching model is created. This model includes flexible teaching and learning idea, teaching strategy, flexible management and flexible organization. The model provides new learning method such as peer exchange for learners to change their learning strategy.
