At the same time, the model provides design aid of teaching method and teaching means for teachers. Flexible evaluation methodology is adopted to ensure the quality of e-learning. In this way, teaching ideas are changed and teaching effect is upgraded.

articleTitle: The Agile Team Learning in Unconventional Emergency Decision-making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper discusses the agile learning of decision-making team in the situation of unconventional emergency. The paper proposes a research thinking of agile team learning based on the scenario analysis & rough set mode (R-S mode), in order to find an efficient analysis method to the team learning in unconventional emergency decision-making. The paper analyzes the characteristics of agile team learning in unconventional emergency decision-making, establishes the frame of agile team learning, and puts forward the scenario analysis & rough set mode (R-S mode). At last the paper takes the snow disaster in South China in 2008 for example and discusses the agile learning process of the snow disaster.

articleTitle: Design of Risk Management System on Overseas Oil Development and Utilization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With its ever growing industrialization and urbanization, China's oil demand has been increasing rapidly. In order to alleviate the conflict of domestic demand and resources shortage, nowadays China has to develop and utilize the oil resources overseas. This paper presents the design of risk management system on overseas oil development and utilization based on MapXtreme & C# tools, including system architecture, basic functions and key technologies.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Mobile SVG for Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) is one of the key technologies for Commerce At Light Speed (CALS). The use of Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) in the PDA-based IETM is wide promising. This paper firstly analyzes the advantages and characteristic of Mobile SVG application for the PDA devices, and then presents the process of creating Mobile SVG illustration complying with IETM Standards. End of this paper, a prototype system for PDA-based IETM is constructed, and the implementation technique of SVG applying to the specialized IETM browsing system is also studied and provided.

articleTitle: Choice of Strategies for Establishing Incentive Mechanism of China's Public Servants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Incentive mechanism of public servants a way of action and value by which government leads public servants in order to achieve administrative goals, which has vital influence on motivating and encouraging public servants’ enthusiastic and dynamic energy, and increasing efficiency of governmental administration. At present, in incentive mechanism of public servants of China, there exist lots of problems, such as singular means of substance incentive, formalized spirit incentive, unsound administrative culture, ignoring inner incentive roles, indistinctive competition and encouragement, weak ethnic incentive, nonstandard negative motivating operation, incomplete monitoring and restricting systems, improper and dilatory incentive, rigid and formalized incentive ways, and so on. If these problems are solved, the people-oriented idea must be paid attention to, administrative culture built up, scientific salary system established, rewards and punishment of system and management improved, system for position and rank raising and achievements testing system perfected.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Comprehensive Assessment of Goverment Websites
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The aim of this paper is to develop comprehensive evaluation criteria for government websites and to apply it to a sample. Considering the difficulty of fuzzy synthetic evaluation method in calculation of the multiple factors and ignorance of the relationship among evaluating objects, a new weight evaluation process using an analytic hierarchy process (AHP) approach was introduced. This improved method for determination of weight of the evaluating indicators was applied in three websites assessment of China government entities. Results showed that it is important for websites to provide orientation information, and that website style be properly adapted to the government web environment and facilities be made available to users, and that website security and privacy concerns be addressed. Compared with the original evaluation method, the method was favorable for fuzzy synthetic evaluation when there were more than one evaluating objects and the evaluation results were more reasonable. The findings provide useful information to website assessment for improving e-government.

articleTitle: An Approximate Proximal-Extragradient Type Method for System of Monotone Variational Inequalities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper extends the approximate proximal-extra gradient type algorithm (for short, APEA) presented by He, Yang and Yuan to solve the system of monotone variational inequalities (for short, SMVI). We give the inexact proximal point algorithm for SMVI and prove the convergence of the algorithm under certain assumptions.

articleTitle: A New Multi-class Classification Algorithm of Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A kind of method of SVM for multi-class problems was given in this paper. This method is based on PCA Support Vector Machine coding method. After experimenting, it is better than one-against-one Method and one-against-the -rest Method. This SVM for multi-class method saves time and enhances precision of forecast. In based on principal component analysis SVM method, coding multi-class method classes' seismic facies, the precision of forecast is very high.

articleTitle: The Research of CIM Modeling for Transformer Protection and Input Loop of the Power Secondary Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In view of existing situation of the inconsistent power system model, a method of CIM modeling for power secondary system is given, based on better understanding and the analysis of the primary system CIM modeling. Combined with the particular characters of the secondary system, it establishes CIM model for the transformer protection and the input loop of the secondary networks. Then it shows the method is proper and feasible. Some important issue about further research is put forward as well.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: System Dynamics Modeling for Telecom Operation Enterprises' Service Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study of the Seismic System E-government Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The traditional IT industry and the mode of E-Government are currently experiencing great changes, Cloud Computing becomes a trend. This paper explains the definition and understanding of the Cloud Computing. Combined with the demands of the seismic system E-government, such as high performance computing, resource sharing service, building the green network, this paper analyzed the key technology of deployment the Cloud Computing in the seismic system and promoted the application mode.

articleTitle: Indigenous Characteristics of Chinese IT Corporate Organizational Culture Conceptual Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The purpose of this study is to identify China's indigenous conceptual dimensions of IT corporate organizational culture and to increase the knowledge and comprehension about organizational culture in specific context, and to promote the theory development and model structure. The first study employed an inductive approach to identify IT corporate organizational culture dimensions. Based on a practical investigation on IT corporate culture of China, and additionally a conclusive analysis, we've collected 1039 organizational culture sample scenarios from the open-ended investigations on 253 IT CEOs (or E-business vice president). After examining the quantitative data, 12 dimensions are identified for China's IT corporate organizational culture, out of which 7 are similar to their western counterparts, and the other 5 are totally unmentioned in the western literatures. In the second study, we conducted a content analysis of IT corporate organizational culture document, and found the outcome of the first study creditable and steady. Through the comparative study, some peculiar dimensions in China and the absent western equivalents in the west are unfolded.

articleTitle: The Government's Behavior Analysis of MICE Industry Development in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The MICE industry, tourism and real estate are called the three pillar industries of urban development. The MICE industry is the first choice for urban development around the world. In China, the MICE industry is still at the initial stage, so it can't develop orderly and healthily without Government's guidance and support. While facing the main problems of the current government's behaviors, it must transform the Government's function and regulate Government's behavior in order to promote the MICE industry to develop rapidly, healthily and sustainability in Chongqing.

articleTitle: Nerve Network Role in the Teaching of Video Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of IT technology, the volume of video data has been presenting the geometric series growth. How to rapidly capture the wanted teaching video data at the sea video database is the currently hot research topic. This discourse advances such a video retrieval method based on the artificial nerve network. The method would perform the content-based analysis and retrieval to the video data.

articleTitle: The Industrial Pollution Management Based on Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Clustering techniques has been applied to the classification of industrial pollution source. Use the features of industrial waste water pollution sources and waste gas pollution sources to build the data model, and cluster about 30000 records of pollution sources, then assess and explain the clustering results. Build a two-dimensional classification based on waste water and waste gas according to clustering results and make customized industrial pollution management policies to improve environmental management.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of the Virtual United Organization in the Prophase of the Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Currently, the keystone of cost control has been moving from the Construction Phase to the prophase of construction project. However as there are still a lot of uncertain factors and the information obtained in the prophase is limited, there are yet no good methods for cost control in the prophase of the construction project. Virtual Organization, as one control method, has been applied in the cost control practice and it has made an impact on cost control. However, Virtual Organization is still not able to fully solve the problems in the prophase of the construction project. Based on the present researches, this paper tries to further improve the cost control level in the prophase of the construction project through establishing the Virtual United Organization and analyzing its applications. In the Virtual United Organization, the Work Package is creatively used to check each scheme and control the project cost.

articleTitle: Mechanism Research on the Influence of Intellectual Capital on the Core Competence of Corporation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes formation mechanism of the core competence of corporation, which is the direct acting factor for corporation performance. First, the interrelationship among intellectual capital, corporation capability and core competence of corporation is analyzed; then resource pool and capability pool are constructed and intellectual capital's factors' interactions with each other are also analyzed; finally, the mapping mechanism between intellectual capital pool and capability pool is proposed and the influence mechanism of intellectual capital on core competence is clear.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Life Cycle Project Management in Government Invested Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Electronic Commerce Systems Based on SCA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to solve the problems of electronic commerce’s discreteness, heterogeneous, decentralized and incompleteness, proposes a framework for electronic commerce system based on the SCA, through the design of logical structure of the system, the different modules of electronic commerce systems are uniform packaged through the service component, so the system has feature of scalability and flexibility. Practice shows that the program can effectively respond to the existing electronic commerce system for information integration, information exchange and data sharing.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Impact between Service Quality, Customer Satisfaction and Loyalty of E-business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper we provide a model based on current theories about the interplay between E-business customers' satisfaction and loyalty. In turn, we choose an approach of methodologies, structure equation model, (SEM), which has been widely used in the management science research, to prove our model. With some first-hand information through a questionnaire survey about one existing E-business enterprise we verify and adjust the model. Finally, some recommendations on the management for E-business retailer have been proposed.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Project Duration Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: There are many factors affect the accuracy of project duration forecasting, the lack of relative information and the complexity of the project are two major aspects. To overcome these constraints and establish a feasible forecasting model, this paper presents an improved method to forecast the project duration, which combines the earned schedule and artificial neural network. We adopt the artificial neural network because of its ability to model complex nonlinear relationship without a priori assumption of the nature of the relationship. The performance of the developed models was evaluated. The results show that the artificial neural network can improve the accuracy of the project duration forecasting significantly in terms of the error evaluation measurements.

articleTitle: Human Capital, Fertility Rate and Labor Productivity of Agricultural Scale of Operation: Evidence from China 1980-2007
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To the fact that the labor productivity of large scale operation is too low in our country this paper expands Solow's model and use cross section, pool, (fixed effect) panel data model to carry on empirical analysis. All the results indicate fertility rate and human capital have important influence on labor productivity of the agricultural large scale operation. Through reducing rural fertility rate and improving the level of rural human capital, we reduce too many agricultural workforces from two respects of flow and stock promote the popularization of modern agricultural technology and effective disposition of agricultural factor of production, which make agricultural total output increase. Therefore, the labor productivity of large scale operation improves.

articleTitle: Research on Antecedents of Adoption Intentions of Collaborative Commerce Based on TOE and TAM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The theoretical model of collaborative commerce adoption intentions is proposed based on TOE and TAM, with the perceived risk variable added to the model. Empirical analysis shows that environmental permission, organizational support and technical support affect adoption intentions through perceived risk, perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use.

articleTitle: The Construction of Diversified Learning Platform Based on Bilingual Education - The Teaching Practice of E-commerce Course in SIFT
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Bilingual education is an important manifestation of internationalized school running mode in the current domestic colleges and universities. Combined with the bilingual teaching experience of e-commerce course in SIFT, this paper starts with the construction of diversified learning platform to give a detailed analysis on the reasonable arrangement of bilingual teaching course content, the effective organization of teaching methods, the build-up of teaching resources network, etc. Furthermore, it is proposed that the bilingual education program should pay more attention to teachers' training and improving the index system of course evaluation from a developing perspective.

articleTitle: Research on the Security of an Improved E-commerce Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, security issues are arising from people's attention. The lack of security will cause the malicious agent to spread without restriction on Internet or cause it to be invaded by the malicious host, so that business activities shall be involved into chaos. So it has become a crucial step for e-commerce to construct a safe and effective transaction environment. In this paper, we summarize the security requirements and propose a credit model (host credibility assessing the credit relation) to resolve the security issue of mobile agent based electronic transactions. With a security analysis, we show that the proposed scheme satisfies all security requirements.

articleTitle: Research of JIT Distribution Center Location for Regional E-Supermarket in Ring-like Area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Location selection of distribution center is one of the most complicated problems in modern business operations; hence many mathematical algorithms were developed. The subject investigated is the regional E-supermarket with JIT distribution pattern in ring-like area, this paper proposes a two-stage model to solve its location selection problem while minimizing the number of distribution centers and total operation costs. The Set Covering Problem (SCP) model and the integer programming algorithm are utilized in the first and second stage separately. Numerical example of Beijing is given to verify validity of this model.

articleTitle: Course Construction Based-on Interactive E-learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The design method of interactive e-Learning course based on Blackboard platform was probed in The paper. Taking it for example of course network of quality inspection of electric appliance, the paper built the interactive design platform for e-Learning course and analyzed the learning condition of students, which largely enhanced students' capability of learning and mastery of course knowledge.

articleTitle: The Study on Clickstream-Based E-Commerce Personalized Service Mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article introduced E-Commerce personalization service, put forward the meaning of clickstream data, analyzed the use of the process of clickstream data, finally proposed a clickstream-based intelligent shopping guide system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Research on Supplier Assessment Indices System of Green Purchasing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Web-Based Links and Authoritative Content Pagerank Improvement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: By studying the traditional analysis algorithm of PageRank found some deficiencies. Combination of link analysis and web pages relevant to the content analysis of an improved PageRank algorithm for EPR (Extended PageRank),starting from the web content and using existing web content VSM models to solve related problems. Starting from a web page links (including the links in and links out of) the authority to resolve the problem. Experiments show that through improved PageRank algorithm is much higher than the traditional sort.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Enterprise Core Competence Based on the Entropy and Triangular Fuzzy Number
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to the evaluation problem of enterprise core competence, this paper proposes a new size comparison method of the triangular fuzzy number and establishes an evaluation model with the combination of the entropy and triangular fuzzy number. Then, it provides a new evaluation method with the combination of qualitative and quantitative researches. The empirical studies has shown that the evaluation model based on the entropy and triangular fuzzy number can carry out an comprehensive evaluation for enterprise core competence objectively and reasonably.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Fixed-Charged Transportation Optimization in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For coping with the multi-objective fixed-charged transportation optimization problem (mfcTP) in SCM a new fuzzy rules-based particle swarm optimization algorithm called Fuzzy-PSO is proposed in the paper. In terms of this new algorithm base on the fitness vector function, we firstly construct the fuzzy rule base which is convenient to express the explicit knowledge, and then apply the fuzzy rulers to control the process of traffic distribution with the fixed-charged. The experimental results show that it can find better Pareto front and Pareto optimal solutions in the real-world problems even if nonlinear and discontinuous. So it is more effective than st-GA and m-GA.

articleTitle: Research on the Measuring Structure, Pattern and Methods of Management Information Cost
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the era of knowledge economy, the companies usually collect large amounts information to make decisions. Management information cost is a kind of new cost form, which happens in process of decision-making. In this paper, the author discusses the measuring structure, pattern and methods of management information cost.

articleTitle: Quantitative Risk Analysis Approach on Construction Project Feasibility Research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The traditional methodology on risk analysis in construction project feasibility research has remained for a long time in the atmosphere of qualitative analysis. A thorough quantitative analysis approach in the same field has been carried out in this paper based on the properties and mechanisms of value mining. Taking advantages of value mining theory, the practical evaluation on potential revenue and predictable risk of construction project has been put forward, and the optimization among various schemes for construction project feasibility research is proposed, under the principles of multi-target fuzzy decision making and satisfaction degree of value mining.

articleTitle: Quarterly Earnings Distribution and Earnings Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Earnings management of the listed company is a hidden rule in the capital market. Previous researches usually based on annual earnings are difficult to find when and how firms manage their earning during a fiscal year. Given that the fourth quarter affords the last opportunity of earnings management, the abnormal change in earnings of the fourth quarter is open to doubt. Based on the evidence from Chinese listed firms, we use the distribution approach and logistic regressions, and find that the discontinuities at zero in the earnings distribution may be induced by earnings management. Our findings help to forecast in what conditions firms are likely to manage their earnings.

articleTitle: The Game Analysis of Eco-efficiency Driven Restructuring of China's Coal Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the analysis of affecting factors of the coal industry structure, the method for taking eco-efficiency as the standard evaluation criterion of coal enterprises is proposed. The eco-efficiency supervise game model is established to analyze local governments' action and coal enterprises' action in the process of policy implementation. In the end, some strategy is given based on the analysis for the game's mixed strategy equilibrium.

articleTitle: A Pattern Based Anti-Fraud Method in C2C Ecommerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Although reputation models are available to encourage good services of sellers as well as punish their bad ones in the C2C ecommerce environment, their anti-fraud ability appears to be weak in general. Based on our TRUST model and the method of combing fraud pattern recognition with Time Window, we propose a Fraud Identification Method which has certain anti-fraud capabilities. Simulation experiments show that the introduction of TRUST model of the method in this paper has more advantages.

articleTitle: Multi-rounds of Price Automated Negotiation Model about Supplier Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For automated negotiation scenario's characteristics on supplier Relationship Management, according to the scenes' information of the negotiating parties, such as the negotiating goals, the extent of the relationship, the concept of the goal - relationship (G-R) factors was put forward, and a calculating method of the first proposal in negotiations was built by the concept; At the same time, a forecasting method of the nearest 4 steps trend about the other side' proposals was presented, and a counter-offer model of buyers was given. These methods can provide real-time support information for the negotiators in automated negotiation, improve the efficiency of the negotiations, and guide the negotiations to the benefit of the buyer, achieve better negotiating benefits.

articleTitle: Building E-Learning Platform in Vocational and Higher Training College with Claroline
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, the students in vocational and higher training colleges have a universal problem that they are not good at autonomous learning. Innovating traditional models of instruction and creating IT-based autonomous learning environment are imperative. It seems that establishing an e-Learning platform is an effective method. Claroline is regarded as one of the most popular open source learning management systems (LMS). It is very fit for vocational and higher training colleges to build an e-Learning platform, at the same time the teacher should match e-Learning model in teaching. Only in this way is it possible to foster students' capability of autonomous learning. To better illustrate this architecture, in this paper, we introduce the Claroline into class. And then, we design an instructional framework and model with which the teacher can build E-Learning Platform in Vocational and Higher Training College easily. Finally, some shortcomings about using this E-Learning platform in instruction are outlined.

articleTitle: Analysis and 3D Visualization of Flood Inundation Based on WebGIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the fast development of information technologies, GIS is used for spatial analysis and visualization of large-volume data through Internet, i.e. complicated algorithms, vector data, high resolution images and digital elevation model. This thesis implemented WebGIS in accordance with OGC standards, on the basis of the open source of World Wind with Java version. OGC specifications were analyzed and WebGIS framework was implemented, e.g. Xi'an spatial data of five layers. Based on WebGIS framework, flood inundation architecture was designed, procedure of flood inundation and algorithm for flood area were described. 3D visualization of flood inundation at different flood levels based on WebGIS was displayed, providing convenient human-computer interaction to decision-makers and scientific researches.

articleTitle: Dynamic Fuzzy Evaluation for E-Commerce Service Quality Based on the SERVPERF
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper reports on a study which evaluates electronic commerce service quality based on the dynamic fuzzy sets by improving the SERVPERF model. At first, this paper reviews literature on SERVQUAL, SERVPERF and some other electronic service quality evaluation model, then puts up with a dynamic multi-layer fuzzy evaluation method, and uses this method to improve the traditional SERVPERF framework. At last this paper conducts a case analysis, and the results show the convenience and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Special Market-Orientated Integrated E-Business Portal System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The technology of integrated information portal is one of the solutions to the information silo. The portal based on special markets is received more attention. This paper introduces the portal, the features and the development of information portal. A functional structure of the portal information systems for E-business is given by using the technology of society and the concept and methodology of comprehensive integrated system. An example of system module based on Google App Engine also be shown. At last, the importance of system model for integrated information portal based on cloud platform had been discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Impact of the Third-Party on the Bullwhip Effect in the Closed-loop Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: By establishing the mathematical model, and comparing the Bullwhip Effect between the Forward Logistics and the Closed-loop Logistics, this paper proves the existence of Reverse Logistics will intensify the Bullwhip Effect, and makes quantitative analysis about this increment. Then it analyzes the contribution of The-Third-Party Reverse Logistics enterprises in cutting down the uncertainty of the inventory with the help of "Filter Principle".

articleTitle: Value Management of Supply Chain and Data Mining System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To establish the value management system of supply chain is to integrate the subsystems of the value chain through the effective value-management method and the guidance of the system of the supply chain value strategy, is to maximize the supply chain value, is to establish the right decision-making matrix of supply chain value and choose the appropriate value strategy of supply chain. The scientific and practical data mining system of supply chain is an important basis of the value system of supply chain to achieve the best efficiency. Through the information transmission in data mining system of supply chain, the value management system and the process management system of supply chain can achieve an organic integration, which to realize the best efficiency of the whole operations of supply chain system.

articleTitle: The Study of SCM Strategy and Business Model of Fast Fashion Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Fast Fashion chain store such as H&M???ZARA and UNI QLO are becoming the invader of the fashion world. They are concentrated on the promotion of the new style--“Fast Fashion”. Attach great importance to the strategy of Supply Chain Management is one of the success reasons for the largest Fast Fashion Retailers. China is a big and strong country in the field of the fashion but she has not any famous brand. She has been called “The factory of the world” and she is just a base of OEM. Through the study and comparison to the homepage of H&M???ZARA???UNI QLO, We try to analysis the business model and the SCM strategy of them and give some advises to the fashion enterprises in China.

articleTitle: Construction of Emergency Disposal Decision System Based on PDA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to enhance the effectiveness and pertinence of chemical accident emergency disposal, the emergency disposal decision system based on the PDA was designed, which can solve the scene decision-making difficult problem effectively and standard emergency handling procedure. Emergency handling plan is formed by the system according to the analysis of accident situations, accident happening spots and accident mediums, to instruct the scene personnel to do the initial accident emergency work promptly. Meanwhile, the functions of the PDA such as positioning, wireless transmittal of information and the ability of communication are applied to timely transmit spot images of accidents and status messages which furnish the first-hand data for the emergency assessment, decision-making and resource dispatching of back-end platform. The application of system will promote the emergency decision-making of scene pertinently and scientifically.

articleTitle: Financial Input-output Efficiency Analysis of Water-transporting Logistics Enterprises in China Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The financial input-output efficiency of eleven water-transporting logistics enterprises in China were evaluated by applying CCR model and BCC model of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA). The results showed that only four enterprises achieved DEA efficiency in CCR model, ten enterprises were technologically efficient in BCC model. Results not only identified the existing problems in the water-transporting logistics enterprises and pointed out the adjustment direction, but also helped them to improve their own management level and enhance their own competitiveness.

articleTitle: Purchase Strategy of Multivariate Combinatorial Auction for Multimodal Transportation Service Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For the purpose of solving the problems of unbalanced international goods flow and high transaction cost in the container shipping service supply chain, an approach of combinatorial auction was proposed in this article for the purchase strategy of multimodal transportation service. According to the various factors of freight rate, service quality, reputation, and network of transportation, the criteria of the winner (or winner mix) in the combinatorial auction of multimodal transportation service was established, as well as the single objective programming model. The simulation process was carried out via a case, which proved that the establishing model is rather feasible for the purchase strategy of multimodal transportation service.

articleTitle: Electronic Commerce Undergraduate Talented Person Ability System Construction - Based on Network Human Resources Pool Investigation and Study Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Through to carries on the sample observation from the human resources pool collection's 826 electronic commerce undergraduate course talented person employment advertise information, summarized a series of need ability, and further classified them, carried on through certain method ability the quantification, then carried on the statistical analysis using the SPSS software, obtained each kind of ability to request the situation - is the market demand situation, obtained each kind of ability in the employment influence coefficient, constructed a scientific electronic commerce undergraduate course talented person ability system according to this for the basis.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Types of C2C Sellers' Perceived Risk in the Entire Transaction Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The perceived risk of sellers has been rarely considered in the past research. In order to clarify the types of sellers' perceived risk and match them with the transaction stages, this paper analyzed a number of posts on e-bay(answer center)forum by employing the method of Netnograhy. The conclusions are as follows:(1)There are five types of C2C sellers' perceived risk, including economic risk, evaluation risk, time risk, eligibility risk and image risk, of which the first three are the core types. (2)The types of C2C sellers' perceived risk exist in each transaction stage. The salient periods are the second stage-items for sale, the fourth stage -settlement-collection, the sixth stage-returning-evaluation and the eighth stage-the phase indirectly related to the deals. These conclusions provide theoretical support for the C2C platform operators to develop relevant policies to reduce the sellers' perceived risk.

articleTitle: The Selection of Navy Vessel's Support Alternatives in Operation Cycle by Cost-Effectiveness Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The structure of navy vessel's Life Cycle and Operation Cycle are presented. The self-support and harbor-support are analyzed when navy vessel is docked. The effectiveness and cost model of the two types of support are established with WSEIAC model. The calculation means is given. The effectiveness and cost example of support of two types is presented to a conventional submarine under the modified WSEIAC model. The results display that the harbor-support is of superiority over self-support of navy vessel.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical Research on Effecting Factors of CSR Report of Commercial Banks in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: User Behaviour Based Access Control Decision
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A user's behaviour for using a specific web service on Internet, like her/his biometric information, can be used to identify the use. In many cases, the user behaviour represented as a set of attributes can be classified as either normal or anomalous. This value or in conjunction with other attributes of the user can be used to authorise the user of having access to the web service. To a certain extent, it can protect against identity theft since it may be very difficult to impersonate on behaviours of using Internet. This article presents how a user's behaviour for using a particular web service is observed and classified; how this behaviour attribute is securely transported across network; and how it used for access authorisation decision.

articleTitle: Authenticated Multiple Keys Exchange Protocol Based on Bilinear Pairings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Harn and Lin proposed an authenticated key agreement without using one-way hash functions. It enables two communicating parties to establish four common session keys by sending two Diffie-Hellman public keys in a single round of message exchange. However, to resist the known key attack, only three common session keys can be used. Over the past years, all researches study to establish four common session keys and all four common session keys can be used. In this paper, we shall extend these protocols to establish 36 common session keys in each round of key agreement protocol. The proposed protocol is based on bilinear pairings. Moreover, the security and efficiency of our proposed protocol are presented.

articleTitle: The AHP-FM Assement of Audit Risk in E-Commerce Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The AHP-FM assessment model opens the window for the quantification of audit risk in e-commerce enterprises. In this paper, we introduced the application of AHP-FM model in audit risk assessment for e-commerce enterprises in detail, and designed the AHP-FM assessment supporting system.

articleTitle: Using Participatory Design Methods to Study Users' Emotional Experiences
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Motional experience design is an important evolving design trend. In the field of Human-Computer Interaction, experience is a very different term with usability which is easier to define and measure. Therefore knowing the experience and capturing the experience are two key points to experience design. Traditional user research methods might not be applicable enough in terms of studying users' emotional experiences in complicated HCI processes. This paper discussed about a design research and presented a simple and economical way by using participatory design method to research users' online shopping experience. The research results indicated that through this research method, designer can effectively collect users' emotional information and learning their mental models which can be applied in future design practices.

articleTitle: Retaining Customers by Data Mining: A Telecomunication Carrier's Case Study in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Data mining is used in this paper to retain high value customers for a telecommunication carrier in China. First the customers are segmented by data mining, and then different strategies are proposed to retain the high value customers. Finally, further applications of data mining for customer relationship management in telecom are discussed.

articleTitle: Game Model Analysis of Government Incentive Measures to Enterprises Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Technological innovation is very important to enhance enterprises' core competency and competition advantage, but enterprises' enthusiasm is not high for it, facing many risks. So it is necesssary for the government to draw up incentive measures to encourage enterprises' technological innovation. This paper tries to set up the game model of enterprises' motive power for technological innovation and deduces the conditions of self- innovation. The conclusion is helpful for the government to draw up incentive measures for enterprises' technological innovation.

articleTitle: New Method of Object Tracking under Complex Circumstance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The original MeanShift algorithm uses color histogram as the target feature and does not take the objectives of spatial information into account. Therefore, there are some stability problems under the complex background. It leads to target losing easily. A new tracking algorithm named weighted mean of the centroids is proposed in the paper. In order to improve the robust of tracking process, the weighted mean of centroids corresponding to the color bins and the model update strategy is added. The problem of spatial information on color distribution is solved, and the situation of deviation from the real target caused by using single fixed target model is also avoided by using this algorithm. Furthermore, experimental results show that the improved tracking algorithm is better than the original meanshift algorithm.

articleTitle: The Method of Grey Related Analysis to Multiple Attribute Decision Making Problems with Intuitionistic Fuzzy Sets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Recently, intuitionistic fuzzy sets have been used to build multiple attribute decision making models that can accommodate imprecise information. In this paper, the method of grey related analysis for handling multiple attribute fuzzy decision making problems based on intuitionistic fuzzy sets is presented. The proposed method allows the degrees of membership and non-membership of every alternative with respect to all attributes and the normalized interval weight of each attribute, instead of the constant weights. The method could provide a useful way to help the decision maker to make his decision efficiently. Finally, an example is shown to highlight the procedure of the algorithm at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: A Risk Assessment Model Based-Business-Circle of E-Government Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of computer network and information technology rapidly, they are serving every walk of life in China. Chinese government is using widely the information and network technology for improving its work. So, Chinese E-Government information system is developing feetly. However, in fact, E-Government information system has some its characters and some potential hazards in China, which affects E-Government information system's healthy and favorable development. It is insufficient that some secure products and tools are only used for the security system architecture of E-Government information system. To build secure and authentic system architecture of E-Government information system, the risk assessment and management is necessary for secure and reliable E-Government information system. A risk assessment model based-business-circle of E-Government information system is proposed in the article according to the characters of E-Government information system. In the model, some business circles are given according to the importance and features of E-Government information system. Moreover, the risk assessment is done in every business circle. The model introduces the idea of risk assessment, scheme of risk assessment, process of risk assessment and the computational method of risk.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Dynamic Simultaneous Optimization of Production and Pricing under Reference Effect in Perishable Products Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Segmentation Based on Profitability, Profit Growth Rate and Relationship Reliability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Any effective CRM will be based on solid customer segmentation. This paper puts forward a new segmentation measure involving profitability, profit growth rate and relationship reliability. This paper also describes in detail how to calculate these dimensions.

articleTitle: Commentary on the Supervision of Foreign Banking IT Risks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Financial business of banking greatly relied on information technology, thus IT risks become an important issue in banking operation risks. Towards the supervision of IT risks, this thesis analyzes the principal systems of America, Britain, Basel Committee, HongKong, Singapore, etc. It comments on their achievement, aiming at monitoring and upgrading our banking IT risk supervision.

articleTitle: The Exploitation and Utilization of Customer Database in CRM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper, through the construction of customer database of the customer relationship management, has probed into the customer- database relational model and the development of the customer database procedure with emphasis. Then, it also has drawn the structural chart of the customer database system and has described the application mechanism of the customer database. Finally, combining with the business management practices, it has discussed about how the customer database can help business decisions.

articleTitle: The Management about the Secondary Market of Mineral Rights Based on E-Government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article aims to integrate the operation and management of mining rights market with E-government building, and exploring a better mode of mining rights of the secondary market, which will help us to rationalize the allocation of mineral resources and provide some ideas to enhance the efficiency of public administration.

Author Keywords: E-government the Secondary Market Mining rights Management

articleTitle: Research on Network Security System Based on Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper introduces network security System based on intrusion detection technique. Describe the definition and the classification of intrusion detection introduce the gengric intrusion detection model, Then we design a network security system based on intrusion deception.

articleTitle: Roles of Teachers with the Advent of E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The "e" stands for electronic and it is associated with the use of the Internet to undertake the wide range of activities. Like the Internet itself, there is no way of controlling the advent of e-learning. What we can hope to do is begin to understand the complexities of the new environment and how we teachers can work effectively as e-teachers. Though there is a large shoe to fill, one thing is definite. That is the conventional roles of teachers are no longer appropriate in the new environment. The authors of this paper analyze the necessity of e-learning and its impact on teachers, and put forward some suggestions for e-teachers.

articleTitle: Computerization, An Important Way for China's International Freight Forwarders to Improve Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: China should make great efforts to develop the freight forwarder industry, not only for the requirement of the division of international trade, but also for the needs of the further development of China's foreign trade, especially for the development of the service trade. However, there is a large development gap between China's international freight forwarders and the world's leading international freight forwarders. The former's service is in a poor level and not efficient. In order to narrow these gaps and to adapt to third- party logistics transformation trend, China's international freight forwarders should pay attention to the computerization construction.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Residential Hedonic Prices in Nanjing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we briefly analyze the theoretical foundation of residential hedonic price model- Lancaster theory of consumer preferences and Rosen's supply and demand equilibrium model about hedonic market. The residential hedonic price model in this research is set up on the nonlinear relationships between prices and hedonic variables in Rosen's theory, in which the residential prices were chosen as dependent variables and fourteen independent hedonic variables were chosen from real estate experts' opinions. Five hundred groups of residential prices and hedonic variables in September, 2009 from Nanjing were collected and input into the model. Ten hedonic variables entered the model and four were refused. The refuse reason is explained and the sign, price elasticity and marginal price of ten entering hedonic variables are discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the Recommendation Trust Model Based on Encouragement and Punishment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the open distributed environment, the knowledge of belief is absent for the entity with which we will contact, so the recommendation trust is very important for the distributed system. In this paper a recommendation trust model is proposed based on encouragement and punishment. In the model, the trust value of any entity consists of trading reputation value and recommendation reputation value, the recommendation factor is affected by multi parameters and can adjust dynamically with the recommend result. When the recommender supports the real information then the value of the recommendation trust will increase otherwise decrease the value.

articleTitle: Effect of IT on Supply Chain Outcome: From an Inter-organizational Relationship-specific View
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: IT business value remains a burning topic in IS field, yet limited investigation has been undertaken in supply chain context. From an interorganizational relationship-specific view, a path model of IT business value realization in supply chain context is developed and tested, with three kinds of relational assets involving interorganizational IT infrastructure integration, process coupling and knowledge sharing being put up with. By using data from 121 firms in China, we find evidences that IT and other relational assets do create value for supply chain, which in turn lead to organization performance. The study contributes to enhance and enrich our understanding on IT business value in supply chain context and the strategic significance of interorganization relational assets.

articleTitle: Study and Application on Ontology Based Unstructured Text Query Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper proposed an approach to process unstructured text query. The approach applies domain ontology in converting unstructured text to structured one. Then it uses ontology mapping technology in the knowledge searching process. It builds relationship between the structured text and cases in the knowledge base. In this way, the cases that match the condition expressed by the query text can be found efficiently and precisely.

articleTitle: Cryptanalysis on Polynomial-Based E-Voting Schemes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Recently, CAO et al. proposed an efficient electronic voting scheme based on the polynomial function. They claimed to satisfy the fairness, uniqueness, eligibility, anonymous, accuracy and robustness. In this paper, we show that the electronic voting can guarantee neither robustness nor anonymity. Some candidate can add the ballot number by altering data, and any candidate can know the accurate content of each vote after the tallying stage.

articleTitle: Logistics Supply Chain Management Based on Heuristic Multi-Constrained Combinatorial Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Fierce competition in global markets and the heightened expectations of consumers have forced business enterprises to invest in and focus attention on the relationships with their customers and suppliers and businesses increasingly realize that they no longer compete as solely autonomous entities. Logistics supply chain management has become more and more important for the major retailing corporations. Logistics supply chain optimized design and operating management mechanisms are modeled for the major retailing corporation logistics supply chain management through the multi-constrained combinatorial optimization expression in this paper. Novel scheme based on heuristic soft computing technique is proposed to efficiently solve the multi-constrained combinatorial optimization major retailing corporation logistics supply chain management problems.

articleTitle: The Influence of Service Design on Public-perceived Administrative Service Quality: The Moderating Effect of Social Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper, by taking a disaggregated approach, is intended to explore the influence of service design on public-perceived administrative service quality and examine the moderating effect of social monitoring on the relationship between service design and public-perceived administrative service quality, which consists of six dimensions. Results show that service design and social monitoring have positive and direct impacts on each dimension of public-perceived administrative service quality, while social monitoring plays significant moderating roles in the relationship between service design and responsiveness, and that of service design and transparency, and the moderating effects are both negative.

articleTitle: A Neural Network-Based On-line Monitoring Model of Process Mean and Variance Shifts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, a neural network-based identification model is proposed for both mean and variance shifts in correlated processes. The proposed model uses a selective network ensemble approach named DPSOEN to obtain the improved generalization performance. The model is capable of on-line monitoring mean and variance shifts, and classifying the types of shifts without considering the occurrence of both mean and variance shifts in one time.

articleTitle: Technology Adoption in Tourism Industry: A Case of Wireless Technology (WiMAX) for Tanzania
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Although much literature exists on how technology can promote tourism industry, little is known about this phenomenon in developing countries. The existing technologies have not been able to successfully tackle the infrastructural and connectivity problems. To tackle the challenges, the use of low cost and simple technologies is imperative. This paper therefore discusses the role of wireless broadband technologies in promoting tourism industry in Tanzania. It explains how WiMAX, a modern wireless technology, can add a competitive advantage to a tourism industry by giving tourist the ability to stay in-touch with the world whilst enjoying safaris in the most remote areas in the world. This paper is most useful to academician, researchers and stakeholders of tourism industry who looks into ways of promoting e-tourism and e-commerce in developing areas.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Path Selection of Characteristic Agriculture Cluster Development in Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Evaluation of Micro-loan Companies on Soft Set
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Characterized by operating regionally, “credit only, non deposit”, loans in small, scattered and short-term, micro-loan companies have became a major force of financial services in rural areas of China increasingly. Due to differences in the lending object and the basis of loan decision, credit risk evaluation of micro-loan and large amounts business loans are completely different, the current methods of credit risk evaluation can't be applicable to micro-loan companies absolutely. Bases on a review of credit risk evaluation methods of micro-loan in foreign countries and in-depth analysis of special reasons that induce the credit risk to micro-loan companies, we found that the existing credit scoring model couldn't evaluate the credit risk of loan applicants effectively and accurately in the operation of micro-loan companies. To address this problem, this paper proposes a suitable credit risk evaluation method on the soft set theory which deals with mixed uncertainty problem. We argue that integrate the operating characteristics with the credit risk evaluation method, loan officers can make loan decision more accurate on the soft information that collected at the present stage of micro-loan companies.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics Network Design with Consideration of Forward and Reverse Facility Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To take into consideration the forward and reverse facility integration in reverse logistics network design, this paper proposed a mixed integral linear programming(MILP) model to address the issues of site selection and flow allocation in a reusable bottle recycling system. The model mainly focuses on the decision about whether the distribution and recycling facilities should be integrated at one location. And this paper also gives numeric example to validate the model and make a quantitive analysis on the benefits brought by this facility integration.

articleTitle: A Study on the Dynamic Expert Evaluation Method on Enterprise Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article will from the perspective of valuator, based on the analysis of quantitative evaluation method of experts' evaluation level and abnormality, construct the dynamic time-vary evaluation on enterprise technological innovation. The research shows that, this method could overcome the negative influence of subjective weight towards evaluation result in the existing method; and it can evaluate the enterprise technological innovation more scientifically and objectively. The evaluation result can provide the scientific basis and decision-making reference to the related government department to grasp the real state of technological innovation accurately and timely.

articleTitle: The Project Research for Optimal Scheduling Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The project management optimization for an important aspect of the scheduling scheme is reasonable to reduce costs, improve quality and shorten the cycle. Traditional project scheduling and optimization methods have been unable to fully meet the rapid development of modern project management needs. The PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) is a simulation of birds the heuristic search algorithm mechanisms, which function optimization, constrained optimization, minimax problems, such as multi-objective optimization problem. It has become an important branch of the many related optimization fields. Although the project is to optimize the scheduling, many traditional methods can achieve good results, but the particle swarm algorithm can achieve a greater degree of optimization. In this paper, research on the particle swarm optimization of the basic principles of their algorithm for the initial exploration process, compared the effectiveness simulation of particle swarm optimization and traditional genetic algorithm in optimal scheduling of the project. Therefore, the original project plan with the optimal scheduling on the basis of introduction of particle swarm optimization algorithm can get better quality, shorter cycle and fewer costs, and ultimately get the entire optimal project cycle, project quality and project cost.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Development of Reservoir Tourism Resource Based on MADM; A Case Study on Dongping Reservior
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the frame of “the Classification, Investigation and Evaluation of Tourism Resource (GB/T18972-2003)”, the paper definite the tourism resource function attributes of Dongping reservoir. For transforming tourism resource to tourism product, the paper constructed plan sets of resource development based on market need and natural endowment. With the method of MADM (Multiple Attribute Decision Making), every development plan has been ranked. So, the development orientation plans of tourism resource in Dongping reservoir accurately. At last, the applying suggestions in similar reservoir tourism development have also been mentioned.

articleTitle: Personalized Knowledge Push Service Based on Semantic Web
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The traditional knowledge push service based on non-semantic is inefficient in the hit ratio and accuracy because of the lack of semantic description and modeling to user preferences and knowledge resources. Semantic Web has unique advantages such as the robotization of the meaning interpretation, the decentralization of knowledge expression and the information identification by ontology. It provides a perfect technology for knowledge push service in the manner and level of services. Inspired by the relevant technologies of semantic web and proceed from users' actual demands, a three layers structure intelligent knowledge push services framework model is proposed. The architecture of the model is discussed. The knowledge push service based on user preference optimizes the current knowledge service course and enhances the value of the knowledge services in the semantic web environment.

articleTitle: Strategic Selection of Sustainable Development of Mineral Resources in China's Mining Cities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Degree of sustainable development of mineral resources (DSDMR) is the basis and security of mining cities' sustainable development. Thus, how to promote the DSDMR of mining cities has been widespread concerned by people. This paper tries to search for the systematic evolution characteristics and rules of DSDMR by highlighting the science and technology function of intelligence system. Afterward, it proposes the improved strategic selection under the stable state and the critical strategic selection under the critical state for DSDMR system. Then it indicates that the basic way of improving DSDMR of mineral city is the integration of the improved strategy and critical strategy.

articleTitle: Study on Reverse Logistics Network Model for Household Electric Product Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A sound designing of reverse logistics network for household electric product may lead to benefits of both economic and political. On the basis of analyzing reverse logistics network model, a reverse logistics network model is given for the returning of household electric product in such locations as collection, storage, disassembly, burying, and sale. A genetic algorithm is constructed, and case computing is conducted. The result demonstrates that using the genetic algorithm in the optimization of reverse logistics network model may achieve the optimum solution or approximate optimum solution.

articleTitle: The Strengthening Effect of Project Generation to Consulting Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Concerning the description of strengthening effect of project generation to the management consulting process, according to MCS(Management Consulting System) model proposed by Liang Gefu(2004). the paper will discuss it from five parts. 1. The directional role of project generation can intensify consulting goal. 2. A reasonable human-to-machine division of labor make sure the efficiency of exploiting resources and the value created by human brain. 3. The logic of generated process function and module layout according to project will be strengthened. 4. Intensification caused by effective combination of consulting methods. 5. The rationality of multiple choices supported by project combination form. Uses the method of AHP on processing may realize the different levels' effects or factor importance. Then uses the method of MGDM can directly grading the difference factors.

articleTitle: A Panel Data Study of Energy Consumption and Economic Growth in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This study examines the relationship between energy consumption and economic growth for 29 provinces of China during the period of 1995-2007. Panel unit root, panel cointegration and Granger causality are employed to infer the causal relationship. The results show there is a panel cointegration relationship between energy consumption and economic growth. The Granger causality results indicate the presence of bi-directional causality running from energy consumption to economic growth with feedback effect. The policy implications are that Chinese government should ensure energy supply safety, improve energy efficiency, definitely put forward the strategy of low Carbon economy. China should build up the low-carbon innovation system, and carry out institution innovation of energy-saving and low-carbon economy. Firms are required to undertake social responsibility and encouraged to take measures to low energy consumption and carbon emission.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Mobility of Top 500 Chinese Firms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Design for General-purpose Interface of Community Informatization Basic Database Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To solve the "isolated island" problem of the community-based information data, the SOA technical architecture is introduced to the development of Community Informatization Basic Database in this paper. Firstly, the general architecture of the system is introduced. Secondly, some interfaces are defined, such as the system access interface, data manipulation interface. Thirdly, the specific design of the interface is made. The interconnection and resource sharing between community information system and various business systems can be efficiently achieved with the Community Informatization Basic Database based on the design.

articleTitle: RFID in the Livestock Supply Chain Management: Application and Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: RFID technology automatically identifies the target and obtains relevant information by radio frequency signal. Through RFID technology we can collect and exchange information efficiently. This quality of RFID technology can be specifically used in every segments of the livestock products supply-chain. But non-uniform technical standards and high costs hamper the application of RFID in the livestock supply-chain, the uniform technical standards and greater government support efforts can promote the application and development of RFID technology.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Organizational Commitment and Turnover of IT Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Organization commitment is an invisible contract between organization and employee. How to use this to inspire and keep employees in organization is vital to managers. This paper use three level organization commitment model and turning over model based on a sample from a certain IT company in Wuhan to discuss the relationship between organization commitment and intention of employees turning over. Through statistical methods, this paper found that employees at the overall organization commitment level shows lower emotional commitment, and organization commitment was an important predictors of turning over intention, which helps HR manager make more incentives policy to motivate their employees.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Network and Organizational Learning: The Effect of Structure and Tie Strength
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Analysis and Forecasting of Oil Demand in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the cointegration theory, oil consumption, national economic growth, population, oil price, industrial structure, energy structure and technical progress variables are discussed in this paper. By analyses, it is found that cointegration relationship exist among variables of oil consumption, industrial structure, energy structure and technical progress. The error correction model about oil consumption is established. In addition, the data generated process of our oil consumption series is tested. And an autoregressive model with the trend for forecasting oil consumption to 2025 is established.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Based on Purpose Pursuit Method Coordination Degree of Urban Population, Economy, and Environment of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Service-oriented Workflow Metamodel and System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For solving the problems appearing in the application of SOA to various types WFMS, such as WFMS which includes many human activities, a metamodel of Service-oriented workflow process, SOWF-MM, is proposed. In SOWF-MM, services are regarded as resource, a service is bound to a service role when an abstract workflow process model is instantiated, and services may be invoked by different way according to different activities types. Finally, a WFMS, SOWF-MS, is developed to supporting the execution of workflow process model which accords with the metamodel.

articleTitle: Study on the Typical Application of E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-Commerce has become the market trend of this Century, the online bookstore management system as a typical application on E-commerce has a bright future. Therefore, the research on how to construct a high efficient and reliable online bookstore management system has practical meaning. The online bookstore management system mainly includes customer operation of the system front and the managers' management of the system background. The system front realize registration and logon for users, browsing books information, remarking on the books, placing orders, revising user's individual information and so on. The system background's management mainly includes the maintenance of books and users' information stored in the database and the dealing of orders and users' feedback information. This paper mainly elaborates the realization of the above functions.

articleTitle: A Study of the Relationship between Pay Satisfaction and Job Performance for Employees
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper made use of questionnaire to collect the data and SPSS software to analyze the relationship between pay satisfaction and job performance for employees. Correlation analysis showed that only pay-structure satisfaction had a significantly positive relationship with job performance, while other sub-dimensions of pay satisfaction had no significant relationship with it. Regression analysis further validated the conclusions of correlation analysis. Furthermore, it showed that pay-structure satisfaction and task performance had a mutual causal relationship, and pay-structure satisfaction was the independent variable in the linear equation of contextual performance.

articleTitle: A Sensor Awaking Strategy for Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Concentrating on node scheduling in tracking target across special region with uniform speed, the authors put forward a strategy for target tracking in wireless multi-sensor networks. The corresponding algorithm working depends on the virtual potential method. To sense target dynamically by sense nodes, we structure virtual force between moving target and the current sense node, then select the next sense one with information gain function so that as few nodes as possible are used to get the maximum probability of motion trajectory sensing when target cross the specific areas. The proposed algorithm is verified from the simulations.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Entrepreneurial Orientation: An Innovative Construct in Stimulating Effective Corporate Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis of Operating Pattern of ESN by Evolutionary Game Theory Based on Stakeholders
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: From the perspective of stakeholders, the evolutionary game theories are employed to analyzes the operating pattern of eco-industrial symbiosis network (ESN) systematically in this paper, the results show that the operating pattern of ESN, within a certain period, depends on the bargaining power that stakeholders has to make an initial strategic decision, the initial strategy adopted and the initial state in the game, and the evolutionary process of the operating pattern of Lubei (in china) eco-industrial symbiosis network is present to illustrate the above results.

articleTitle: Literature Review on Enterprise Tacit Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Tacit knowledge management provides potential impetus for the sustainable development of knowledge-based economy. Despite the fact that many Chinese enterprises have realized the strategic value of tacit knowledge, relevant studies on tacit knowledge management are still in their infancy. The author of the paper reviewed the present researches both at home and abroad on the measurement and acquisition of tacit knowledge as well as its transfer model and the obstructive factors of the transfer process.
