The author also made analysis of the deficiencies of the current study and presented his own view on the future development in this field.

articleTitle: Evaluation on International Competitiveness of Coal Industry Based on Objective and Subjective Integrated Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The system of evaluation indicator system for coal industry competitiveness is put forward based on coal industry reality. The comprehensive model of integrating Interval Analytic Hierarch Process (IAHP) and Entropy weight is established in this paper based on the theories and methods of IAHP and Entropy. The entropy weight is adopted in this model; the subjectivity which lies in ascertaining factors' weight in lower hierarchy was avoided. Meanwhile, the IAHP is adopted in this model can put the experts' knowledge into consideration. The evaluation model is applied in the 11 main coal production countries in the world. The empirical study validates the model as scientific and feasible in practice.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Risk Forewarning and Empirical Research on Enterprise Knowledge Management Based on Intellectual Capital
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In knowledge management activities a variety of uncertain factors may lead to knowledge management risk. To construct risk forewarning mechanism which is composed of risk identifying, intelligence monitoring and management action acts a critical point of reducing the possibilities of loss. As the result of risk identifying and the basis of information monitoring the risk forewarning indexes form a connecting link between the preceding and the following in the mechanism. In order to evaluate knowledge management risk effectively the paper analyses the relationship between knowledge management and intellectual capital. Then based on the framework of human capital, structural capital and relational capital the paper puts forwards the evaluating indexes system of knowledge management risk forewarning for knowledge-intensive enterprises. Finally, the paper applies comprehensive fuzzy evaluation method to assess knowledge management risk of a large software development group in P.R. China.

articleTitle: An Approach to Anti-counterfeit of Identity Document Based on Digital Watermarking and Digital Signature
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The anti-counterfeiting methods and implementation for certificates based on digital watermarking and digital signature technique are described in the paper. The lower frequency components are extracted as main feature information. After facial image on the certificates being transformed using DWT and DCT. Then this information as well as the owner's identities data signed are combined in the original images at photos. The experiment result shows this proposed method is a more promising certificate anti-counterfeiting technology.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research of Securing from Attack for Java Card
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper describes the mechanism of the object sharing in Java Card and analysis of the existed security problems which lead to the attack, at same time it puts forward two methods to solve the attack. By comparing and analyzing the two methods, we will develop more protecting mechanism to protect the security of Java Card.

articleTitle: What's the Reason for Online Unplanned Purchase
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Although internet becomes a new shopping media, there is little research about unplanned purchase in online shopping. We develop the questionnaire of the reason for online unplanned purchase (OUP) by open and structured questionnaires. There are all about 406 participants took part in our survey, of which 114 participated in the open questionnaire and another 292 participated in the structured questionnaire. Based on the Attribution Theory, we found that the reason for OUP includes four factors: internal-stability, internal-instability and external-stability and external-instability. Internal consistency analyses and CFA (Confirmatory Factor Analysis) showed the questionnaire had high reliability and validity.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Development Technology System Evolvement Mechanism Based on Brusselator Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Collaborative development technology system is a new technology system which is formed by the continuous integration process of related technology during its development, so a reasonable interpretation of its evolution will provide a theoretical basis for the orderly development of this system. This document introduces the Bursselator model to the evolution mechanism research of Collaborative development technology system for the first time, it build the Brusselator models of Collaborative development technology system from two points of view to improve and reform, through the mathematical analysis of the models analyzed the characteristics of system evolution, and further it is given a specific process to achieve its orderly evolution, and provide the basis reference for follow-up researches.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Application of Safety Culture Model in the Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Content-Oriented E-Government Information Portal Architecture and Strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Government Information Portal (GIP) is the foundation of E-Government. GIP is also the core of E-Government and is important communication channel between the government and its citizens. This paper first presents a content-oriented e-government information portal solution. The solution uses content maps technology to link together government documents, consisting of web pages from different departments of the government, providing an intelligent navigation tool for the entire site. Content maps are fundamentally about linking related items together and hence they should have a pivotal role in the navigation structure of a site. Then, this paper analyzes the architecture of the content-oriented e-government information portal, consisting of front office architecture and back office architecture. In front office architecture, the content map provides the structure for the site navigation and for page content. The back office architecture is to use the content map to supplement site content. Lastly, this paper probes into the strategies of the content-oriented e-government information portal, including Content Duplication, Content Reflection, Content Reference, Content Aggregation, and Content Query.

articleTitle: Determinants and Effect of Internet Marketing in E-Commerce: An Empirical Investigation from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Drawing upon the RBV perspective, the authors develop a model to examine the association between firm's Internet marketing resources and performance. The proposed model hypothesizes that Internet marketing capability can contribute to superior market performance in the E-Commerce environment, and they also identify three significant factors-IT capability, Internet marketing involvement, and investment-as enablers of Internet marketing capability and competitive advantage of firms. They test the research model using survey data from 195 firms in China. The results support the model, however, the association between IT capability and Internet marketing capability is not very significant.

articleTitle: The Key Technology of the New Generation Business System Used in the Domestic Commercial Bank
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The process restructuring of commercial banks is a significant transform for China's financial enterprises operating mode, and the IT platform construction plays a key role. This paper proposes that we should from the normative standards of the commercial bank's core business systems for the starting as soon as possible, to organize and work out the Integrated Financial Enterprise (IFE) solution, and its corresponding demonstration project. A complete set of solutions, including the IFE general framework model, the general component library, application-layer communication protocol FL7 in financial industry, the JAVA implementation for IFE core component, system testing standards and the corresponding test asset library are designed and developed. Based on the IFE proposed draft, the commercial bank can accomplish the variance analysis to design core business systems and IT platforms suited to itself and avoid repeated introduction. It can also carry out evaluation and testing to business process and varieties of process reengineering programs, to avoid the risk in the bank's process changing.

articleTitle: The Application of Design Structure Matrix in Project Schedule Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the limitation of traditional method of Project Schedule Management, and put forward a method of using DSM to cluster the work, when there is a coupling of the information flow of the work. It can reduce the number of coupling, shorten the communication time, shorten the project cycle, and also provide a new way of thinking for project schedule management.

articleTitle: E-Learning Based on Web2.0 Technical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Web 2.0 is a human-oriented Internet characterized by interaction, individuation and decentralization, which takes every user to be both information receiver and provider. It makes more free, quality and instant information accessible to users. During the Internet-based study, every learner plays the roles of knowledge obtainer and knowledge inventor at the same time. They are connected through the net and consist of an E-learning community. The application of multiple Social Network Software (SNS) has just catered for the demand of E-learning. This paper discusses the influence of all the above-mentioned technical characteristics of Web2.0 on E-learning in terms of RSS, interaction and individuation.

articleTitle: Study on Hotel Marketing Strategy under Web 3.0
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Network has been a kind of necessary platform in information retrieve, decision-making, communication and feedback. Web 3.0 is an improving new information transmitting platform based on Web 2.0. It will suffice tourists' demand better than before it owns intelligence and individuation. In this paper we introduce explore the Web 3.0 effect in hotel marketing based on deeply analyzing Web 3.0's born background, connotation and characteristics. We think individuation and high efficient self-helping touring will be the mainstream in touring market in Web 3.0 circumstance. In Web 3.0 era hotel network marketing will be preciser than before and tourism will be tightly connected with one unit. On the other hand in this era we have the shortest hotel marketing channel.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Organizational Change Pattern Based on Business Process Reengineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on the Enterprise Strategic Budget Management Mode Based on Balance Scored Card
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the strategic management theory, BSC and the budget management theory, this paper attempts to design a mode of enterprise strategic budget management. Comprehensive analysis reveals that the substantial differences between the BSC-based mode strategic budget management and the traditional budget management mode lie in budgeting and implementation. With the help of BSC, strategies can be gradually converted into practicable enterprise budget; therefore, BSC-based mode of enterprise strategic budget management is of both theoretical and practical significance. In the implementation procedure, enterprises can employ BSC to depict corporate strategies, namely to covert strategies to strategic map, and clarify strategic stage objectives. Besides, enterprises can set flexible objective for each strategy, clarify strategic guiding plan and resource demand, authorize human and financial resources as well as incorporate these settings into the budget to form a detailed budget sheet".

articleTitle: The Impact of Message Sidedness on Online Ads Effectivenss: The Moderating Role of Involvement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This study considers the moderating effect of involvement on consumers' response to one-sided vs. two-sided online advertising. Results obtained from an experimental study confirm that involved consumers' responses to two-sided online ads are more favorable than that of one-sided online ad, but only for involved consumers. Two-sided ad is no more persuasive for uninvolved consumers except for those who recognize the two-sided nature of the communication. The routes to persuasion of two-sided ads are also different for involved and uninvolved consumers. These findings provide a new economical way for enterprises to improve their online advertising effectiveness in the absence of trust nowadays.

articleTitle: Design of the Opening Experimental Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To adapt the reform of talent-training model, the “student-oriental” attitude of self-regulated learning should be initiated greatly, with the aim of strengthening the knowledgeable practice and skill cultivation, and reforming the traditional experimental teaching as well as putting the opening experiment into practice. Based on these ideas, this paper tries to explore the experimental effect on developing students' innovation, together with their creativity and practical skills, so as to make them adapt the educational requirements of society.

articleTitle: Environmental Pollution and Control Countermeasures of Piggery Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This thesis analyses implications and relationship of circular economy and negative externality of piggery industry, summarizes the main cycle economy patterns of pig industry in China, points out the existing problems on developing circular economy, then puts forward chief countermeasures including on improving the development mechanism and service systems, paving multiple channels of investment and financing, strengthening scientific and technological Innovation, raising peasant quality and the organization degree.

articleTitle: Aspect-oriented Technology-Based Production System Simulation Modeling Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For the deficiencies of the more mature view of current object-oriented simulation modeling of production systems, in this article from the aspect-oriented modeling point of view, give the cell design method which is based on the AO, mainly solute the identification of cross-cutting concerns, the selection of connection point and aspects separation, extended UML design and modeling and so on. As an example of the typical maintenance cross-cutting concerns, the aspect-oriented modeling method of the production line simulation system is studied by using the expansion of UML. Aiming at the inadequacy of the existing simulation software, extension method of eM-Plant is proposed based on component-based structure.

articleTitle: A New Definition on Fractal Porous Rock Damage Variable and Study on Evolution Characteristics of Porosity-permeability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Considered the fractal characteristic of rock with porosity structure, a rock damage variable which describes rock damage of the reservoir of fractal structure with hydraulic fracturing is defined, and this damage variable that describes the state of rock mass is also the number of the relative reductions as the pore radius is greater than r during arbitrary loading stage. The rock mass constitutive model of fractal pore structure and the damage evolution model of porosity and permeability are established. Taking one block of Daqing oil field as an example, the branch of rock and the variation of fractal dimension coefficient under different loading are determined in experiments, the rock damage variable, the evolution of porosity and permeability during loading process are calculated, and the following conclusions can be made: During loading process, the porosity of rock decreases, the permeability declines and the fractal coefficient descends. The calculated results coincide with the actual site.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Model for Logistics System Performance Based on CAS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The study of complex adaptive systems (CAS) has been a research effort attempting to find common characteristics and/or formal distinctions among complex systems arising in diverse domains that might lead to a better understanding of how complexity occurs, whether it follows any general scientific laws of nature, and how it might be related to simplicity. Based on the complex adaptive system (CAS) theory, this paper demonstrates the complex adaptive nature of logistics system, and argues that logistics system should be treated as a CAS. With this recognition, this paper investigates the complex adaptive performance mechanism of logistics system and proposes a quantitative model of performances on how various factors affect the logistics system.

articleTitle: The Construction and Operation of the Informatization Platform of Shanghai Port
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Under the background of world economic integration, the market competition is intense day by day. The current competition is not only competing among the products or the enterprises, but also in the level of the Government's administrative efficiency and the soft environment of the market. As the cross-border and cross-regional flows of the capital, goods and the personnel become fast, the process of the informatization is brought up. The call for the trade facilitation is growing, which would set higher requirements on the Customs clearance efficiency and the service level of port. In this paper, for the necessity, the construction procedure, the core function as well as the operation of informatization platform were fully analyzed. A summary of its vital role and certain enlightenment on the development of Shanghai urban economy, e-commerce and e-government was presented.

articleTitle: The Loss-averse Newsvendor Problem with a Service Requirement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the loss-averse newsvendor problem. Firstly, we develop a basic model in which the service-level constraint is not considered. And we get the optimal order quantity and the optimal expected utility under the basic model. Then, we add a service-level constraint into the basic model. And we also get the unique optimal order quantity and the optimal expected utility. Furthermore, we discuss the effects of the service-level constraint on the optimal order quantity and the optimal expected utility. We find that when the service requirement is low, the extended model is equal to the basic model. However, when the service level is high, the optimal order quantity is increasing in the service level and the optimal expected utility is decreasing in the service level. Finally, we analyze the effects of changing parameter values on the optimal order quantity under a service-level constraint.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the Factors and Countermeasures of Private Car Development of Suzhou
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Survey and Analysis of CALIS Web Resources Navigation System for Major Subjects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Making a survey and analysis of the CALIS web resources navigation system for major subjects, from the aspects of resources quantities, resource updating, resources usage, resources organization and service function, then points out some suggestion, such as adjusting embody range, showing the specialty, authority and integrity of the resources, improving the propagandizing of the CALIS Navigation System.

articleTitle: Research on Human Resource Configuration Strategy in Software Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Software engineering processes are the steps which aim to produce software that meet the demand and achieve the goal of the project. It includes the development process, testing process, operation process, maintenance process. These processes cover the requirements, design, implementation, verification and maintenance and other activities. Effective software engineering is an organic combination of personnel, tools and methods combine, which can enhance productivity, improve software quality, cut down the costs and mitigate risk. This paper presents a practical human resource configuration strategy based on the most widely used software life cycle model. In this paper, person was distinguished with each other according to their ability, and a human resources configuration model was established in the process of software engineering. By solving the model, quantitative data was obtained to conduct the staff allocation. A specific software engineering was illustrated and human resources configuration strategy in this research was proved to be effective and practical.

articleTitle: Research on Heterogeneous System Integration of Supply Chain Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The supply chain collaboration ability between the upstream and downstream enterprises is an important indicator for the enterprise competitiveness. In order to establish an open and loosely-coupled system integration environment, the architecture of system integration based on Service-Oriented Architecture, which can provide information exchanging and sharing between heterogeneous systems. Further, the paper uses an example to prove that SOA is an effective method to build heterogeneous system integration.

articleTitle: The Analysis on Necessity for the Enterprises Carrying Out Environmental Accounting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, the requirement of carrying out environmental accounting for enterprises is become more and more hot, especially in theoretical circles. Academic experts have discussed it and formed many articles on environmental accounting. But the enterprises are not interested in that. They have not taken any methods to do a separate accounting to the environment except for the requirement of related laws. Therefore, we may as well take a different angle to identify the benefits of carrying out environmental accounting from the position of enterprises.

articleTitle: Short Certificateless Proxy Signature Scheme with Provable Security
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, a provably secure short certificateless proxy signature scheme is presented. It is an efficient proxy signature scheme with the shortest signature length compared with the other existing proxy signature schemes from pairings. It satisfies all the properties required for a proxy signature. We also provide complete security proofs for our new scheme. Our scheme is proved secure in the random oracle model with the assumption that the Computational Diffie-Hellman problem is infeasible.

articleTitle: Duopoly Game with Endogenous Move-timing and Endogenous Strategic Variables
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper studies the equilibrium outcomes of a duopoly game under double endogenous choices, i.e. both the strategic variables (price or quantity) and the move-timing (first-mover or second-mover) are chosen endogenously. It is showed that whether the strategic variables are chosen before or after endogenous timing the equilibrium outcomes are identical. The equilibrium outcomes are quantity competitions with three kinds of move-orders, i.e. one simultaneous-move game and two sequential-move games with both leader-follower configurations.

articleTitle: The Application of Multimedia in Teaching of Principles of EOR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Multimedia with its unique advantages is more and more used in the teaching, especially in the teaching of Principles of Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR). The course is the required course for the students of petroleum engineering specialty. Through the vivid and intuitive multimedia teaching methods, the students can be able to transcend time and space to understand and grasp of macro-and micro-oil displacement mechanisms of EOR methods, procedures of indoor experiments and situation of field tests. And thus lays a solid foundation for the students to engage in practical work and scientific researching of EOR in the future.

articleTitle: The Analysis of City Creative Industry Competitiveness Based on Analytic Network Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the analysis of relevant studies about creative index, the Analytic Network Process can be used to evaluate the competitiveness of city creative industry. This paper considers the mutual influence between various indexes comprehensively, constructs an evaluation index system on city creative industry competitiveness involving creative talent index, creative technology index, socio-cultural environment index and industry scale index. It also gives the hierarchy of the city creative industry competitiveness in accordance to the Analytic Network Process and discusses the rationality finally.

articleTitle: Improved AHP Model for Real Estate Investment Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to find a more effective and practical method for risk management of real estate investment, an improved The Analytic Hierarchy Process model was proposed. The model introduces the football game model to the AHP and set up the hierarchy model. Then, the method was employed to the risk analysis of real estate investment. Application results show that the method proposed here is more effective and practical. This study provides a new method for the risk management of real estate investment.

articleTitle: Earnings Quality and the Agency Costs of Managerial Discretion: The Corporate Governance Effect of Accounting Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the data of listed companies between 2002 and 2004, this paper analyses how the earnings quality, measured by accrual quality, affects the list companies' agency costs of managerial discretion. It reveals: earnings quality affects the list companies' agency costs of managerial discretion significantly, the agency costs decreases with the improvement of earnings quality. The results are robust while controlling the effect of endogeneity, omitted variable and cluster effect.

articleTitle: A Kind of Design and Implementation for the Monitoring System Based on MMS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper presents a new design and implementation of MMS-based monitoring system. The architecture, functions and key techniques are detailed. This system is real time and reliable with the advantage of low power consumption. It is very suitable for personal and property safety.

articleTitle: Research of Service-Oriented Integration and Sharing on Information Resources of Spaceflight Launch Site
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: How to realize the exchange???integration and sharing of information resources is one of the key problems during the informatization of spaceflight launch site. The technology of SOA, Web Services and XML were described based on the analysis of integration and sharing problems about information resources in spaceflight launch site. According to the loose coupling idea of service-oriented, one integration and sharing of information resources platform was designed. XML was used by the platform as the exchange form of information resources because of its platform-independent. Thus the interconnection, interworking and interoperability are carried out between heterogeneous information resources. The study can provide the unified and integrated developing services for different application commands in spaceflight launch site.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Expansion of Market Boundary of the Port Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Internal Resource, External Environment and Competitive Advantage of Enterprises - Empirical Study Based on Hubei Province Manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This text follows the study idea of Resource-Based View, believes that internal resource enterprises possesses will exert an influence on competitive advantage of enterprises. At the same time, this article adds consideration to external environment, then establishes the study mode. This article empirically tests the hypotheses using the structural equation model, based on surveyed data collected from Hubei province manufacturer. The result of study confirms the mechanism of action that internal resource, external environment have influential action on competitive advantage of enterprises. Ultimately, this text summarizes the research conclusion and elaborates the management significances.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on SME's Financing under Financial Crisis Based on the Perspective of China's Credit Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Integrated Marketing Communications in the Era of New Media-Blue Ocean for SMEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: New media are changing the entire environment of IMC. With its unique advantages, NM extends the concepts, theories and methods of IMC to a brand new stage. In the background of fast development of new media, SMEs and large enterprises are once again standing on the same starting line.

articleTitle: The One Transaction of the Honest Behavior of the Game Analysis Based on E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-Commerce development is very rapid in china now. The quantity of e-Commerce trade gets more and more attention; however, trustworthiness problem in trade is a very important factor that affects the trade quality of e-commerce. E-commerce is a kind of new business trade mode, which is anonymous, implying that the requirements toward the credibility are much more than general business trade. This paper use s game theory to analyze the one transaction of the honest behavior of the game based on e-commerce, and establish honest game model, know that the regulatory and credit rating system is very important in the outside world. The conclusion is that not only the effectiveness of supervision is relevant on-line goods, but also require to monitor the process to increase the penalties which equivalent to the intensity of efforts to intensify supervision.

articleTitle: A Cost Value Analysis on Information Sharing in Two-level Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Information sharing in the supply chain can effectively reduce uncertainty, information asymmetry, "bullwhip effect" and supply chain costs. It can also improve the reaction speed of the supply chain to realize end-user’s satisfaction. This paper, by drawing on relevant literature and taking two-level supply chain as the research object, does a comparative analysis between the supply chain with information sharing and traditional one, and builds a minimized value model for each of them. In addition, by taking the mobile phone industry as an example, it analyzes the value of information-sharing on a numerical approach. The result shows that: information sharing has certain effect on the value increment of a supply chain.

articleTitle: E-money: Application,
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-money is a combing product of modern electron technology and money development. It is also the necessary tool as well as way to E-business activities. The existence of E-money is made the function of money to be raised to transmit wares exchanges, the exchanging time and distance are shortened, the circulative speeds of goods are faster and the living qualities of people are better. There are two main styles of bank credit card and network exchange to use of E-money. E-money is in a rapid developing period in China. E-money has been substituting cash in some areas and becoming important tool as well as way. The chances and challenges are existent. They are the facing development duties of Chinese E-money to normalize the use of E-money, raise the technique level and security coefficient, strengthen the functional constructions of m-small cities and countries, expand the using space and provide powerful support of law. It is the developing tendency that P-money replaced by E-money as whole, network money is rapidly developed. finger veins money and international E-money are applied.

articleTitle: An ACO-Based Dynamic Alliance Partner Selection Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Dynamic Alliance Partner Selecting problem is generally modeled as a combination optimization problem, the popular solution of this problem is building math models and choosing proper optimization method. Researchers have already brought forward many useful models and algorithms, but till now no solution of Partner Selection Problem is public accepted due to the problem’s complexion, which means there is a need to search for better Partner Selection methods. ACO (Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm) is a useful method in solving combination optimization problems, however, it is seldom used to solve Dynamic Alliance Partner Selection problem, and so relative researches are needed to test whether ACO can be a new method in solving Partner Selection Problem. In this essay, an ACO-based Dynamic Alliance Partner Selection Model is brought forward, and simulation is done to prove the validity of the model, this means a lot to the research of both Dynamic Alliance Partner Selection Problem and ACO.

articleTitle: Job Satisfaction's Influencing Factors: A Comparative Research between Standard Employing and Nonstandard Employing Knowledge Workers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Recent years, nonstandard employment has been coming an important method for organization to increase its flexible ability. Especial the nonstandard employing knowledge workers (NSE KWs) have been the vital part of organization's core competition. NSE KWs have different natures and working context comparing with standard employing knowledge workers (SE KWs), so there are different factors to influence their job satisfaction (JS). However there is little research on this topic. This research investigates main influencing factors of JS of NSE KWs, and compare the influencing factors' difference between NSE and SE KWs.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Entrepreneurs in China: Base on Hurun Report in 2003-2008
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Hurun report has been widely considered as an important guide to keep track of changes in Chinese entrepreneurs since created in 1999. This paper describes the biographical characteristics focused on three aspects of age, gender and educational level, then analyzes entrepreneurial motivation, the industry distribution and wealth trends based on the data of Hurun in 2003~2008. It is the interpretation of outstanding Chinese entrepreneurs at different aspects that is aimed at highlighting and reflecting the development of entrepreneurial activities and private economic in the context of the transition economy.

articleTitle: Spatial cluster based on map algebra
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The analysis of spatial cluster is an important issue in the field of spatial data mining. After investigating the general approaches of spatial cluster, based on the distance transformation of map algebra, a clustering model is designed, and an approach of spatial cluster Based on Map algebra is proposed. Finally, the experiments has been executed with the geo-spatial statistical data about the Entertainment of Wuhan residents, the result represents reasonable Leisure Activities cluster for urban residential areas.

articleTitle: Overall Evaluation of Risk Investment Based on Unascertained Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Analyzing the factors of system risk and non-system risk, the paper establishes comprehensive index system of venture capital. Using Unascertained theory, risk assessment suited venture capital is presented and a new risk-control model based on risk assessment is built. Finally, feasibility of this evaluation method is proved by a practical example.

articleTitle: Model for Social Impact Post-evaluation of Highway Based on Factor Analysis and Success Evaluation Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In view of the complexity of social impact post-evaluation and relatively inefficient evaluation methods, this paper constructed an index system of social impact post-evaluation of the highway through a combination of inductive and deductive methods based on the analysis of literature surveys and expert surveys and made full use of the superiority of the factor analysis and the advantage of success evaluation in data processing to establish a model for social impact post-evaluation of highway, which was testified by a case study. The model finds out a feasible path to solving complexity and inaccuracy of existing index systems, which are always involved with unavailability of useable data in the social impact post-evaluation of highway.

articleTitle: Internet Acceptance, Service Competition and Channel Profit in Dual-channel Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A price and service competition model for dual-channel supply chain was established, then the optimal solutions including service level and channel profit were compared between single channel and dual-channel supply chain The results revealed that the competition between dual-channel supply chain leaded to zero demand segment of Internet direct channel and more profits for whole supply chain system when traditional retailer adopted service differentiation strategy. Through dual-channel strategy the manufacturer effectively motivated traditional retailer to improve its channel service for more profits. Furthermore, the customer acceptance of Internet direct channel made a significant impact on the profit of manufacturer and retailer in the dual-channel supply chain system.

articleTitle: Challenges and Countermeasures of E-Political Communication
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Along with the rapid development of information communications and the internet technology, mankind has entered the internet era. As for civil society, network media means the new carriers and new channels of citizen participation; it also means a new kind of democratic manner. While for governments, such network media means innovation of their governance model. However, the communication between e-government and civil society in network era is faced with a formidable array of challenges, mainly as follows: First, the network advocates liberalism, while it denies any authority beyond the constraints of time, with anonymity and virtual characteristics. Under current circumstance, in which the network legislation is comparatively lagging behind and on-line identity authentication technology is inadequate and imperfect, it can easily lead to the spread of the disorder in citizen network participation. Second, the e-government may conduct covert network political control over civil society through the "information bombardment", "false information", "information supervision" and other ways; the powers of the internet era are clearly shifted to the hands of technocrats, thus this may lead to the so-called "technocrats serving the citizens" so that the substantive democracy of civil society might be impaired. Third, blind repeated construction of the government website, enforcement of "Government Online Project", and imperfect public information infrastructure, all set up many obstacles for the communication. Fourth, the "digital divide" has led to the fact that political communication cannot represent the interests of the public; the governments can hardly make an appropriate decision in line with public opinion. Fifth, government sectors, civil servants, and citizens are lack of awareness and ability in terms of network information. In response to these problems, the government should actively build up open government and the legal protection system; establish the protection mechanism ensuring network political and orderly participation among civil citizen, conduct "network real-name system", protect the lawful rights and interests of citizen participation (including the network participation) through the establishment of "Citizen Participation Law"; in addition, the government should take measures towards the elimination of the "digital divide", foster "e-citizens" and promote the awareness and ability of network information among government sectors, civil servants, and citizens.

articleTitle: Research on Senior Manager's Personality Traits and Corporate Lifecycles in Different Stages
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Enterprise in its growing, maturation and revival or decline stage needs senior managers with different traits. Enterprise should select the senior manager with traits correspond with the need of corporate lifecycles so as to improve work efficiency and enable enterprises to exist and grow better.

articleTitle: A Novel Intra-frame Encoding Method Based on Spatial Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For years, several intra-frame encoding methods such as AC/DC prediction used in MPEG-4 and multiple modes intra predication used in H.264 were proposed and the above methods made more efficient compress performance. But compared with inter-frame, the performance still need improved. So, referring to the experience of inter frame compress technique, a novel intra-frame encoding method based on spatial decomposition is proposed in this paper. From experimental data, it can be seen that the proposed algorithm improves subjective nature and increases 0.5-2dB while with similar bitrates compared with the previous methods.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Earnings Quality and the Agency Costs of Controlling Shareholder
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Planning and Design of Distributed Multilayer EP-ERP System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper illustrates the necessity and development prospect of EP-ERP system application in electricity generating enterprises by analyzing significance of information-based construction. The conception of establishing EP-ERP system model in management of electricity generating enterprises, aiming at the current situation of information-based construction in electricity generating enterprises, is combined with the electricity generating enterprises' own characteristic. Building the management model of EP-ERP system of State Power. S. electricity generating company, finished a set of programming design project of EP-ERP system application in electricity generating enterprises.

articleTitle: Building Default Predicting Model on Firm's Short-term Loan Data with Artificial Neural Network - Considering Qualitative Indexes and Misclassification Costs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To date, using model to predict whether firm's default is still a problem. It presents: a. most model using pairwise pattern; b. lack of qualitative indexes that affect firm's default; c. asymmetric between normal firm's misclassification costs and default firm's. So, introducing qualitative indexes, using all samples and considering misclassification costs, this paper builds an artificial neural network model on short-term-loan data. Though training, validating and testing, it's performance is good.

articleTitle: Research on the Knowledge Management Solution for Learning Organizations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper carried on an analysis to the knowledge management requirements of learning organizations. Based on the requirements and the knowledge management methods, a new knowledge management solution on the learning organizations has been proposed, and the functions of the new solution have been pointed out concretely.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy AHP in Bid Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Nowdays, the bidding competition is more and more fierce, and the bid evaluation is influenced by many factors, but there are so many subjective factors in the traditional methods that they can not make quantitative analysis objective. So this paper try's to use the Fuzzy AHP in bid evaluation, and establishes the index system of the bid evaluation, then the weight of index has been set up by the Fuzzy AHP. According to the results we get, by using Fuzzy AHP, it can void the subjective influence in the bid evaluation process and is scientific and feasibility.

articleTitle: Legislation of E-commerce: Current Situation, Issues and Improvements
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This thesis analyzes the development situation and a lot of issues in E-commerce at present, including trade safety issue, trade information acquiring issue, the forms and clauses issue and succor to the rights of consumers. Besides, this paper proposes suggestions to improve the legislation of E-commerce, investigate the protection of the rights of privacy, the rights of acquiring information and the rights of forcible explanation in E-commerce.

articleTitle: Dynamic Model of Leaders' Performance Based on Optimal Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Leaders' performance is decided by action performance and cost performance and organizational performance in organizational system. In former researches there are primarily theoretical studies and qualitative analyses on leaders' effectiveness or performance, and there are a few studies on quantitative analyses, which mostly rely on the method of comparing differences and ratio of divergence to measure leaders' performance by stage statistics. This paper designs the dynamic model of leaders' performance according to the order of time, quantitatively analyzes vary degrees of which main crucial factors in organizational system affect leaders' performance, depends on changes of cost utilization and organizational performance with keeping the stable state of action performance, regards optimum leaders' performance as the developing goal, adopts the method of marginal analysis and the technology of optimal control. In organizational system, the best way of improving and perfecting leaders' performance should be sought continuously.

articleTitle: The Key Issues to Develop M-Business System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Wireless access to the Internet is widely available in the world when terminal device roaming. Besides of buying merchandises, it also provides immediate access to up-to-date movie listings and news; anywhere-anytime access to e-mail; or the ability to check out a Web site while traveling. So concept of mobile e-commerce (m-commerce) should be replaced by mobile e-business (m-business), which will be centered on financial services, travel and retailing, and so on. So the basic concept and architecture of m-business system were be introduced at first, then the key issues to develop system were analyzed in details, which is scalable, secure, reliable and could support many different devices and network bearers, with the decreased time and reduction of risk to market.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Bernanke-Blinder Model in an Open Economy: Credit Channel, Money Transmission and Output Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Effect of Educational Technology on Learning Burnout of Music Majors in Music Theory Course
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to explore the effect of Educational technology on learning burnout, this study conducts a survey among 125 music majors by using questionnaire and experimental method. The result shows that the scores of 3 dimensions of learning burnout in Educational technology group are significant lower than in Non-educational technology group; the girls' scores of dejection and behavior improper dimension are significant lower than the boys' in Educational technology group. It is concluded that Educational technology can help music majors reduce learning burnout; in Educational technology group, the girls' scores of dejection and behavior improper dimension are significant lower than the boys'.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Relationship between Top Management Team Pay Gap and Corporate Technology Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Improved Irregular Parts Nesting with Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A novel solution for two dimension irregular parts nesting which combines with particle swarm optimization (PSO) was presented. Firstly, the proposed method covert the problem of irregular parts nesting into rectangular parts nesting problem by calculating the surrounding boxes of irregular parts and combining and filling congeneric parts. Secondly, presenting swapping sequence and variation of angle as velocity of particles to reconstruct PSO for the optimal solution of layout, then using dynamic remaining rectangle matching for decoding the permutation of nesting pattern and orthogonal accessing algorithm to realize automatic nesting. Its effectiveness has been fairly proved in practice.

articleTitle: M&A by Chinese State-owned Firms: An Environment-strategy Relationship Perspective - A Case from Baosteel Group Ltd.
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Starting from the environment-strategy relationship perspective, the paper explains the industry and institution influence on M&A, and two propositions are given. With Baosteel Group Ltd. as target firm, the empirical analysis indicates that M&A by Chinese state-owned firms is response to environment.

articleTitle: The Discussion about Consolidated Statements of Assets Impairment of Internal Contacts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the growing size of enterprise development, more and more companies need to prepare consolidated statements to reflect the Group's financial position and operating results. When the parent company and its subsidiaries or affiliates and subsidiaries increasingly complex business when the preparation of consolidated statements to the parent company has also brought more difficulties and problems. In particular, impairment of assets consolidated statements of issues will be on the authenticity of the whole enterprise group's assets and profits of the real significant impact, if the improper accounting treatment may lead to distortion of accounting information, the disclosure of accounting data will seriously affect the interests of minority shareholders. This paper suggests the assets of the consolidated statements of impairment of re-accounting, but also a true reflection of the financial position and better protection of minority shareholders rights and interests.

articleTitle: Information Technology, Supply Chain Integration and the Nature of Retail Firm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The retail firm adopts advanced information technology continuously, so that it can transmit business information timely, can share information with related agents of the supply chain, can simplify logistics process without cease, can select and purchase within a bigger range. As a result, its capability to integrate supply chain is enhanced. Information technology promotes the supply chain integration of the retailer, and affects the behavior guiding, function, scale, industrial attribute of the retail firm.

articleTitle: The Utility Optimization of Science & Technology Information in the Context of Knowledge Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: On the basis of the characteristics of knowledge supply chain (KSC) operation, this paper analyzed the circulation process of knowledge connoted, and constructed a description structural model of KSC on the basis of knowledge value realization. from the aspects of knowledge diffusion, information increment and knowledge innovation, explored the optimization process of the flow, transmission, diffusion, and utility optimization of science & technology (S&T) information in the context of KSC.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Farmers Land Cooperatives Mechanism of Land Compensation in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Economic Efficiency of Industrial Enterprises Using Connection Number and Stochastic Simulation of Triangular Fuzzy Numbers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The evaluation of economic efficiency of industrial enterprises is a comprehensive uncertainty system problem. Based on the theory of set pair analysis, stochastic simulation of triangular fuzzy numbers, a novel evaluation method for the economic efficiency of industrial enterprises was investigated in this paper. A concept of multi-element connection number of the set pair, which was consisted of evaluation index sets and classification standard sets of the economic efficiency of industrial enterprises, was introduced to express the hierarchy and fuzziness of membership between the evaluation sample and classification standard. Moreover, the triangular fuzzy number simulated by Monte-Carlo method was presented to depict the changing process and fuzziness of component coefficients of discrepancy degree. Combined with the weight of evaluation index, the integrated connection number was calculated to assess the grade of economic efficiency of industrial enterprises of the sample. The evaluation in form of a confidence interval corresponding to a confidence level was also given. Finally, a practical example was described to confirm and to compare with the extension method. The results show that the proposed model is more feasible and easy to operate, and the result is good. It can make full use of the uncertainty information of evaluation index and grade classification standard for the economic efficiency of industrial enterprises, and resolve the difficulties of traditional operations of triangular fuzzy numbers and their functions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: R&D Project Budget Management of Enterprises and Technology Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Change of Electricity Use Efficiency in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: By using the panel data of China provinces in 2000-2007, this paper calculates and decomposes the electricity use efficiency of China based on DEA-Malmlquist method, and then tests the convergence of China’s regional electricity use efficiency. The study shows the electricity use technical efficiency of China takes on upward tendency, but the overall level remains low; The technical efficiency and pure technical efficiency levels of electricity use decrease gradually from east to west as trapezoid; The pure technical efficiency of electricity use shows the shape of arc, firstly ascending and then descending; The rate of technological progress is the main reason restraining the rapid growth of electricity efficiency. The scale efficiency has a larger contribution to the progress of electricity use technical efficiency, and that the pure technical efficiency promotes the progress of technology efficiency in the east and middle, while restrains that of in the west.

articleTitle: Testing Modern Option Pricing Theory on the Early-warning of Financial Distress
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper introduce the modern option pricing theory as the theory frame, and use the classical BSM option pricing model to measure the financial distress degree with listed companies' data of China.

articleTitle: A Genetic Algorithm of Poly-condensation Solution Space for Resources Optimization in Civil Engineering Arrow Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A genetic algorithm of poly-condensation solution space is proposed for resources-balance optimization in civil engineering construction with arrow network techniques. Based on the method, a software is developed. Through a practical network planning, the method is demonstrated reasonable and effective, and the software is showed more powerful and more accurate than MS-Project.

articleTitle: The Energy Reforms under the Climate Change: The Development of Low-carbon Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Since 2007, the United Nations Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) released its fourth Climate Change Assessment Report, and climate change attracts unprecedented attention. According to scientific research, we all know energy use is a key resource to produce greenhouse gas which gives rise to the climate change. We need adjust the energy strategy to cope with the climate change. In this way, in this paper we will take china as example and explore the way to make the new balance between energy use and climate change.

articleTitle: Talent Model of Petroleum Enterprises and Its Empirical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Confronted with economic crisis and fierce competition nowadays, world oil companies pay more attention to the managements and redundancy of human resources. Hence it is of vital importance to study further about the optimization of personnel and determine the most rational number of staff in oil companies in order to lessen the overheads and meet the demand for talents. A regression model for employees in oil companies is constructed to study the relationship between the number of employees and other operational indices. Then relevant comparisons between Chinese and foreign oil companies are made to find out the existing problems, which can provide a theoretical foundation for the petroleum companies in China.

articleTitle: The Development of Comprehensive Training Platform about Informational Core-degree Capability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper puts forward to a solution of comprehensive training platform about informational core-degree capability of information security major in order to solve the problem that senior students' practical ability cannot meet the specific needs of enterprises. The training platform is guided with real enterprise cases and supported by real environment of software and hardware. It can make the teaching more purposeful and effective and finally makes experiments matched along with curriculums.

articleTitle: Trust-Based Robust Mechanism in Peer-to-peer Computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) computing may trigger a revolution in the near future because of its ease of use, huge choice and low price. Its chief features are anonymous, independent, dynamic, and absent of centralized server. Due to these features, on the other hand, P2P networks are often insecure and easily suffer from the malicious attacks. Besides, the peers in the system should cooperate in order for P2P services to be effective, but self-interested peers will exist inevitably and they may attempt to maximize their consumption of system resources while minimizing the use of their own. To provide a security and reliable measure in P2P computing, this paper presents a trust-based robust mechanism. This paper shows that the reliable trust score derives from self-experiences and recommendation information. The countermeasures by trust model to some attacks such as bad mouthing attack, on-off attack, conflicting behavior attack are also studied.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Marketing Opportunity Theory and Empirical Research Based on Product Benefit Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Simulation of Double Bargaining Mechanism with External Subsidy by Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The equilibrium and efficiency of double sealed-bid bargaining mechanism were studied under the external subsidy of full-bonus, half-bonus and none-bonus. The buyer and seller of bounded rationality was hard to choose the equilibrium solution in one trade. To investigate the learning behaviours of the agents, a trading simulating system in which two populations of buyers and sellers were randomly matched to deal repeatedly was constructed, and the evolutionary learning process of the agents were modelled by particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. The simulated results show that final bidding strategies of all agents in both populations are very close to the theoretical equilibrium solutions through an adaptive learning process, and external bonus markedly improve trading efficiency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Competitiveness of Agriculture in JiLin Province Based on the Diamond Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Study on Supermarket Chains of Multi-category Inventory Management Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Nowadays, the supermarket chains face the multi-category goods of which gross profit rate and sales volume are different. In this paper we study on supermarket chains of multi-category inventory management strategy. Firstly, we carry out classification on the goods by the method of retailer-oriented category roles. Then, we set different service level for different category goods. At last, we discuss the different categories of the optimal reorder point and the optimal order quantity.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Innovation Incentives Based on Double Characteristics: Economic and Social
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Entrepreneurial innovation is a very important driving force of economic development and a decisive factor for optimizing of social interests. Starting from the competitive exclusive and externality characteristics of entrepreneurial innovation, using the individual entrepreneurs' maximizing investment decision-making theory, the paper analyzes the relationship of entrepreneurial innovation inputs and economic benefits. Then with the model of Baumol's optimal spillover rate determination, we explore the incentive directions and means of entrepreneurial innovation.

articleTitle: A Study on Evolution Model and Promote Strategy for the Employability of Knowledge Workers in the Context of Boundaryless Career
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Though analysis of the intension and key-factors of employability in the context of boundaryless career, the difference on the importance of each employability factors contributing to career development during different employability evolution stages of the knowledge workers was explored. Moreover, in order to resolve the entrance crisis, embedding crisis and transfer crisis which were caused by deficiency of key-factors of employability in each developing stage, the contingency strategies based on multi-staged key-factors for developing and promoting employability of the knowledge workers were proposed.

articleTitle: Study on Genetic Algorithms Approach Applied to the Capacitated Disassembly Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the capacitated disassembly scheduling problem, in which the limitations of multiple resources, overtime considerations and corresponding resources required for setup are taken into account explicitly. A genetic algorithm is proposed by making use of the problem-specific knowledge in which only the binary variables for the setup patterns of root items are encoded and a two-stage procedure is presented as the decoding scheme. Results of computational experiments on randomly generated test problems indicate that the heuristic genetic algorithm gives the optimal solutions to all test problems in a very short amount of computation time.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Power Supply Enterprise Project Management Organization-oriented System Design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: E-Service Quality Research Based on Content Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the review of the e-service quality research in web 2.0 environment. This paper explored current customer's quality evaluation by utilizing the content analysis. The authors found that customers took much concern on the personal interaction and true information available when they evaluated the service quality of the web-site. Therefore, the paper pointed that the core task of the web-site is to keep on the information control and strengthen the function of personal interaction.

articleTitle: Research on the Land and Resources E-government System at City Level Based on Building Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, the land and resources e-government system are difficult to adapt to changes in requirement, and have too much duplication of similar projects and limited range of application. Based on the thorough study of the building technology, configuration and plugin technology, this paper puts forward a solution to develop a building platform of e-government system, which can reduce the programming requirements for developer, and achieve building e-government system quickly. By analyzing the development model of building platform, the overall framework of building platform is analyzed in depth, at the same time; the researcher illuminates how to build e-government system. Finally, the land registration flow is used as an example to show the use of building platform.

articleTitle: A Game on Supervision of False Activities in C2C Electronic Marketplace
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes a differential game model describing the interactions between the government agency and the seller in C2C electronic marketplace and solves it by using Pontryagin maximum principle. We show that the open-loop equilibrium is subgame perfect. The optimum steady-state control strategies of both sides are derived under symmetric and asymmetric information, and results are compared in order to provide guidance for the government to supervise sellers with false behaviors.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Human Nature and Incentive Mechanism Design for Knowledge Workers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Planning and Building a Website for Private Car Sharing in Zhengzhou
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Zhengzhou, located in central China, is the provincial capital of Henan Province where there is few main roads, more vehicles, big population density which lead to heavy city traffic. Private car sharing can ease the increasing traffic pressure over time, and can improve the utilization rate and economical benefit of private cars, lift the burden on the environment. The pioneering work is to create a website for planning private car sharing. This article argues that the website setting-up necessity and feasibility and puts forth the site's profitability model, stresses the importance of the external environment that should be given to support and discusses how to build it from the culture orientation, the early promotion, the initial operating and capital budgets.

articleTitle: The Normative Study of Cronyism on Chinese Family Business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, the family business becomes a hot issue, the family business is playing an important role in the modern economy, but its management question has also become increasingly outstanding, the most prominent question is cronyism in the family business. This article has analyzed the reasons of nepotism from four aspects: the traditional Chinese family culture; trust resources lacking; financing channel's sole; professional manager's lacking. And set forth their pros and cons of relationship, and then put forward several measures to regulate family business cronyism.

articleTitle: Research on the Core Specialty Ability of Undergraduate: Based on the Public Finance Specialty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The Financial Crisis has effectted the undergraduates employment, which reveals the weakness in the ability building of our general higher education system. Starting from the research of high education, the thesis analysises the training objectives, training programs and curriculum examination system of the Public Finance Specialty. Researches show that there is the uncoordinates among the training objectives, training programs and curriculum examination system, which leads the undergraduate students lacking the employability and competitiveness. Then the thesis advises that the special ability of undergraduate should have been the core, which can make the training system better and improve employability.

articleTitle: A Study on the Path Dependence of NIS Influenced by Transnational Corporations Integrated Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, transnational corporations is becoming one of the factors that influence on China's NIS gradually. They also affect the technological developing direction of China through integrated innovation activities, which makes path dependence more and more seriously. In this situation, we must insist on the developing way based on independent innovation, and get rid of the dependence on the technology of international corporations. Through executing national innovation strategy, establishing independent innovation platform, promoting innovation bodies' collaboration and strengthening international technology cooperation, set up the NIS that makes the independent innovation as core.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Impacts of PSC Elements on Contract Economics under Oil Price Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Economic Analysis on the Causes of Resources Exhaustian
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: E-learning as a Flexible Way in Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Learning and development is an important part in employees' personal and career development. Traditional learning programme have lots limits, but e-learning provides a more flexible way of training for both employees and organizations. This paper is focus on discussion the benefits of e-learning can be provided for organization and individuals.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Blog for University Students' Information Literacy Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As a kind of rapid and simple knowledge management system, blog has been gradually introduced into education field recently. This paper summarizes composition of university students' information literacy and researches the application of blog for university students' information literacy education.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Satisfaction Evaluation Index System of Manpower Dispatch Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Human dispatch is a kind of employing labor way beneficial to employee, enterprises and society. However, human dispatch industry has not formed quality specifications as a newly arisen service industry, which restricted the development of human dispatch service. This paper argues that an important way of establishing service specifications for human dispatch industry is continuous improvement of service products based on customer satisfaction. According to characteristics of the human dispatch service industry in China, this article puts forwards significant driving factors effected on customer satisfaction (including enterprise image, perceived quality, perceived value) and constructs the model of customer satisfaction in human dispatch industry based on known theoretical results and methods. On this basis, it also establishes the evaluation index system of customer satisfaction in human dispatch industry and has completed verification for the index system in order to provide the theory basis for forming the quality specification of the industry service and promoting the healthy and orderly development of the industry.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical Analysis on Determinant Factors for Tianjin's Export in China Based on Method of Impulse Response Function
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Analysis of Yahalom-Paulson Protocol in Strand Spaces
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on strand spaces, this paper formally analyzes an important authentication protocol- the Yahalom-Paulson protocol from the aspects of both secrecy and authentication. The result shows that the session key distributed by the server is secure, but there is a flaw in the protocol, even if the responder and initiator receive keys, they may receive different keys. And then an improvement to this protocol is presented in order to enhance the security of the protocol.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis of Socio-emotional Signaling in Work Excitation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Reciprocity in the workplace makes it possible for employers to motivate their workers to put forward more effort than the minimum requirement. Unfortunately, nor can employers feasibly motivate worker effort in the long term by means of paying more than the market-clearing wage due to the “evaporating” nature of workers' gratitude from a pay rise. The mathematical model in this paper further proves that sufficiently strong and frequent socio-emotional signals would motivate both observable and unobservable worker effort.

articleTitle: Application of Kalman Filtering Method Based on Real-time OD Estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: OD estimation is a critical component of Dynamic Traffic Assignment System in that it determines the frequencies of driver's trips through a network. As OD estimation is intended for use in a real-time setting, computational issues are critical, and the Kalman Filtering method is provided to increase computational efficiency. The basic idea of this applied is to use all the information contained in historical OD data in conjuction with data on traffic counts to generate OD estimated in real-time.
