abstract: In the information age, information technology is the most basic and most common techniques, It is essential that the every area, every aspect of human social life will widely apply to the information technology, the field of public affairs management are no exception. At present, we are in the starting point of information technology-based of public affairs management. It is very meaningful for us to conscious acceptance and application information technology in the field of public affairs management through forecasting a reasonable form brought by information technology in public affairs management. Thus, when the traditional government management faced with such difficulties, it was discovered that e-government is the most important promoter in government management reform and innovation. on the one hand, Popularity of the Internet will foster the government to face greater pressure, on the other hand, it offers more possibilities for management innovation of government. E-government is a rational choice of government reorganization, and inevitable result of advances in information technology. So, e-government can be a model combing technological innovation with the government management innovation, it can bring profound changes for the way of Government management.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection Based on Immune Dynamical Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It applies artificial immune theory to the intrusion detection model and puts forward a new method different from traditional affinity match method. It provides the dynamic equation of the ripe cell and memory cell, and sets up a kind dynamic match algorithm. The experiment simulation result indicates that adopting this algorithm improves the efficiency and accuracy of measurement, makes it more effective to the discernment rate of the antigen. It has offered a kind of effective scheme for the fact that structure a new generation's high-efficient and rational network security system.

articleTitle: Study e-Waste Management Based on EPR System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Aiming at the problem of e-waste management, this paper put forward an introduction of EPR systems into the e-waste management system to reduce Electronics pollutants by means of the establishment of responsibility of the main for e-waste recycling disposal. Simplifications should be made angled at China's electronic product market structure. First, calculate the interests of legitimate businesses and Non-legitimate businesses in the Electronics Recycling Market by game second, study the behavior of each interest subject, and then decide how the government can carry out EPR systems better. Meanwhile, the government should further supervise illegal electronics market and eliminate of electronic products in the Illegal electronics market by market regulation accordingly Standardize electronic product market and carry out EPR systems better.

articleTitle: Financial Distress Prediction of China Listed Companies Based on SD Model and LSSVM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Financial distress prediction has drown a lot of research interests in previous literature, and many studies have shown that artificial intelligence techniques achieve better performance than traditional statistical ones. In this paper, we use Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) to carry through empirical study for financial distress prediction of China listed companies. The independent variables as input to LSSVM classifier are deduced by Higgins's sustainable Development (SD) model. Result shows that the combination of SD model and LSSVM has good classification abilities.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Research to the Construct of Electronic-Business Capability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a conceptual framework to evaluate electronic-business (E-B) capabilities using a latent content analysis. Using the interviews to top managers of firms which applied E-B through different ways as our research contents from some popular websites, the paper identifies three E-B capabilities, namely E-B strategy capability, E-B managerial skills and E-B technology resources, which are further measured by 23 items. At last we conclude with a discussion of the results and the limitations.

articleTitle: Employee Relationship Management of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Harmonious employee relationship(ER) for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) is similar to lubricant for machine, the fast growth of the SMEs will bring a lot of change inevitably, there is an important problems for management department to handle employee conflict and allow employees to express their views. This paper will give clear identification of ER at first, then carry on an appreciation of the specific needs and constraints of SMEs, and finally give some recommendations of improving the employee relationship to the SMEs, in order to improve staff's satisfaction and reach the win-win between enterprise and the staff.

articleTitle: The Study and Application of Gray-Orthogonal Wavelet Network Forecasting Mode on Cementing Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The interrelated characteristics and the complexity of cementation quality affecting factors are cosidered, a new method of forecasting cementing quality based on Gray-Orthogonal wavelet network is set up. The method regards some factors affecting the cementing quality as the input parameters of the model, and regards quantifying cementation quality as the output parameter of the model. Evaluating and forecasting the cementing quality of Bei1 block of 20 wells in Daqing Oilfield. The maximum fractional error between forecasting results and actual results is 2.66%. The associated problem of impacting factors is solved by the new forecasting method,and the prediction accuracy of cementing quality is improved. A reliable theoretical basis of cementing operation parameters design and construction program adjustment for new wells in oil field is provided.

articleTitle: Constructing Performance Management Information System for Academic Staff: A Model for Research-intensive Universities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Academic staff at research-intensive universities have played a strategic role in fostering talents needed by the country and improvement of the core competitiveness of the university. Therefore, it is extremely crucial to build a team of excellent academic staff while continuing to improve their professional capacity and their competiveness in the global market. The construction of a fair and efficient performance appraisal and management system and an incentive teaching and research environment at the universities are of both necessity and practical value. The paper presents the process for performance management via the integration of the sophisticated theories both at home and abroad. An analysis and design model has been proposed for the performance management information system in a digital campus. An example has been presented at the School of Economics and Management, Beihang University to illustrate the implementation of the model. The research findings are of both practical and theoretical value and are expected to be applicable to both research-intensive universities and other universities.

articleTitle: An Improved Particle Swarm Optimization for the Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper proposes a formulation of the multi-depot vehicle routing problem (MDVRP) that is solved by the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. PSO is one of the evolutionary computation technique, motivated by the group organism behavior such as bird flocking or fish schooling. Compared with other search methods, such as genetic algorithm, ant colony optimization and simulated annealing algorithm, PSO has many advantages like only primitive mathematical operators, high precision and fast convergence. However, it may premature and trap into the local optima sometimes. In order to overcome the drawback, this paper introduces a modified PSO algorithm with mutation operator and improved inertia weight. The simulation results shown that this modified method could not only avoid premature automatically according to the convergence level but also get a better optimal solution than the basic one.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Loyalty of B2C E-commerce Based on Structural Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper studied customer loyalty of B2C E-commerce by testing the hypotheses on six latent variables using the structural equation modeling method. Perceived value is discovered which it has no significant effect on the others. After correcting model, online shop image is obviously fundamental basis on online shopping expectations, purchasing experience, customer satisfaction and customer loyalty, and there are seven positive relationships accepted by the AMOS model. The results provide scientific evidence for improvement in customer loyalty of B2C E-commerce.

articleTitle: Design of a Semantic Search Engine System for Apparel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Firstly, based on the needs of supply-chain management in the environment of E-business, this paper analyzed problem existed in present search engine for apparel-goods and proposed a new kind of distributed search engine for apparel goods based on semantic web services, and then discussed its architecture. Secondly, this paper introduced apparel ontology design model and the representation method that based on Ontology Web Language (OWL). Thirdly, this paper analyzed basic functions of apparel search engine and Web Services (WS) synthesizing in distributed environment. At last, through the theoretical Analysis and the designed prototype, it showed that this kind of search engine, based on apparel semantic tree, was more efficient apparently than full-text search engine when searching with multi-keywords.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Application of Internet of Things in Logistics Production Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Because of the bar code's disadvantage, information flow cann't match the physical flow in the logistics production industry this causes the efficiency very slowly. Internet of Things overcomes the shortcomings of the bar code, it will revolutionize logistics production management. This paper describes basic principles and characteristics of Internet of Things, and discusses the application of it in logistics production management briefly.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Delivery Route Optimization Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Research on the problem of delivery route optimization and selecting the appropriate delivery route is an effective way of enhancing the response speed of logistics process, improving service quality, lowering logistics costs and upgrading efficiency. The problem of logistics delivery route optimization is an NP hard problem. Therefore, the use of traditional optimization method is difficult to obtain the optimal solution or satisfactory solution. Through the analysis of delivery route optimization and genetic algorithm, this paper designs the delivery route optimization based on genetic algorithm, applies the powerful numerical computing function of Matlab to solve this NP hard problem.

articleTitle: Knowledge Sharing System of E-business Ecosystem Based on SECI Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: After literature review from both at home and abroad, this paper analyzed the knowledge-sharing mechanism under e-commerce environment, and then, it clarified the drivers of knowledge-sharing under e-commerce eco-system based on the knowledge transfer spiral model (SECI). Finally, it proposed countermeasures and proposals concerning how to build a knowledge-sharing system under e-commerce environment.

articleTitle: The Application of Probabilistic Neural Network Model In the Green Supply Chain Performance Evaluation for Pig Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Pig industry occupies an important position in China's agricultural economy and rural-urban environmental construction, so the development of green supply chain in pig industry would contribute to the maintenance of urban and rural environment, and improve the quality, efficiency and safety level of agricultural products. This article provides an indicator system applied to the green supply chain performance evaluation for pig industry, from four respects including the environmental management, the environmental investment and output, the quality and safety of pigs, and social benefits, as well as the application method of the Probabilistic Neural Network model applied in performance evaluation. Five enterprises for pig slaughtering and processing are selected as the analysis object, and the pro-posed method is used to conduct a case study with 12 evaluation indicators selected. The research results show that the proposed indicator system is scientific, strongly adaptable; it is simple, easy to master, intelligent and can effectively improve the performance evaluation level of science for the green supply chain in pig industry to apply the performance evaluation method based on the Probabilistic Neural Network.

articleTitle: Investor Relations, Information Asymmetry and Corporate Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper investigated the association between investor relations level and corporate performance. We used Nankai IRMI (investor relations management index) to measure investor relations level, which based on amount of interactive communication and organizational guarantee provided in the 2007 self-examination reports. The results showed that higher investor relations were associated with higher corporate performance after controlling β, size and other variables. We fatherly explored the association among investor relations, information asymmetry and corporate performance, and found investor relations influenced corporate performance by reducing information asymmetry, which confirmed the mediator effect of information asymmetry. The evidence of this paper also supported that investor relations was a self-governance activity.

articleTitle: Research on Correlation between Customer Satisfaction and Brand Loyalty of Service with Experience Qualities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The development level of service industry is the important index measuring social economy developing stage. Rapid development of service is the internal requirement of solving human problem and improving social harmony. This article will focus on service with experience qualities. Through the analysis on development of service industry, brand analysis and the influence of loyalty, this article summarizes the importance of customer satisfaction and brand loyalty to organization development. Theoretically, the customer satisfaction, brand loyalty and their measuring are discussed; also include the procedure and the major contents, and specific to quantitative analysis. Through the argument and empirical research, the relationship of customer satisfaction and brand loyalty will be demonstrated to give recommendation to organization on developing customer satisfaction and brand loyalty.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Integrated Management of Supply Chain Dominated by the Third-party Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Logarithmic Backoff Algorithm of MAC Protocol in Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A new backoff algorithm based on logarithmic function is presented by introducing the parameter which can change with the network state, in allusion to the problems of Binary Exponential Backoff algorithm of IEEE 802.11 MAC. This algorithm dynamic changes the initial value of collision window and the increasing extent of backoff by using the logarithmic function which takes the numbers of network nodes as variable and reduces the probability of collision of data transmission. The results of simulation show that the backoff algorithm based on logarithmic function has obvious effects in improving the capability of throughput and fairness of Ad Hoc network, reducing network delay and the ratio of packet loss.

articleTitle: Competitiveness Analysis Method for Logistics Enterprises in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the wide popularity of Internet, E-commerce is the informative outcome of 20's century springing up vigorously. China is a developing country and logistics starts at a late and low level. How to raise logistics level efficiently is the key to the development pace of Chinese E-commerce. This paper just focuses on the competitiveness analysis for logistics enterprises in E-commerce. The author firstly reviewed the Principal Component Analysis method, and then explained how to select the samples and evaluating indicators. Furthermore, the main calculating procedures and analytical method were discussed for the competitiveness analysis. According to the competitiveness analysis method, we can seek these principal constituent factors so as to know how to increase the logistics enterprises' competitiveness. And also know the macro-situation of Chinese logistics from the micro information and data.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Researches for Constructing Responsibility Safeguard System of Enterprise Faces User
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Timing Correlation Dimension Study on Regional Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the relevance of fractal theory, taking Liaoning Province as an example to research the time series of regional economic growth, applied GP algorithm to calculate the correlation dimension and observe whether it has fractal characteristics, correlation dimension is a relatively simple extraction fractal dimension method through experimental data by calculating fractal dimension, has a certain operational, the method lays the foundation for predicting the regional economic growth and judging the economic situation.

articleTitle: A Study on Scene Service Content Management System of Government Portal Website
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The value of the government portal website services is to pursue the tenet of the service-oriented, the experience of focusing on the client interaction and the construction of scene service which is initiative and introductory. According to the characteristics of the scene service, this paper discusses the method of building the scene service system and provides a architecture program for the scene service content management system. Finally, this paper takes the thesis of “apply for residence” of scene service as the example of the basic design process of scene service.

articleTitle: Development Strategies of China's E-business in the Post-crisis Era
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-business is changing the way entrepreneur do business, especially in developing countries and China without exception. E-business develops fast in the past several years, gets dramatic achievements and obtains great benefits in China. But there are also problems in China's e-business. The financial crisis brings enormous harm to world economy. How China's e-business will develop is an important issue. The paper analyzes strategies that China can take in six aspects in order to survive during the post-crisis era.

articleTitle: Third-Party Online Payment System Based on Campus Card
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper discusses the possibility of Third-Party online payment system based on campus card, then analyses the security of online payment based on campus card and finally provides the scheme of realization. In the realization, virtual account is introduced. According to the characteristic of campus commerce, this paper originates the escrow without third party logistics.

articleTitle: Analysis of Applicability of Strategic Trade Policy to China's Electronics and Information Industry: A Perspective from Market Power
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: International market power is the micro basis for carrying out Strategic Trade Policy (STP). Whether STP should be applied to China's electronics and information industry depends on its market power for different industry subdivision in different international markets. The paper develops the Hall model, analyzes the specific market power of industries of HS85, HS90 and HS8471 in the U.S., Japan and overall international market in quantitative. It shows that market power for China's electronics and information products is strong in the U.S. and in the overall international market, but weak in Japan. And market power for HS8471 is strong in Japan but weak in the U.S. and the overall international market. It should be pointed out that the strong market power for China's some subdivision industry in some international market comes mainly from advantages in cheaper labor and capital investment, seldom from technology advancement. On the basis of empirical and quantitative analysis, the paper draws a conclusion that STP is applicable to some subdivision industries of China's electronics and information industry that have a strong market power in some specific international market.

articleTitle: Object Management and Performance Assessment Model Design in University: Taking a University as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This target-oriented management of a university model of performance evaluation has been designed, mainly introduces the overall program management by objective performance evaluation index system for the design and establishment, and performance appraisal feedback. Colleges and universities through the introduction of management by objectives approach to the various colleges and universities to assess the work aimed at the rational use of educational resources improve operating efficiency, improve the assessment mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on the M-Commerce Business Models for China Mobile
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, the existing M-commerce business models for China Mobile are analyzed by SWOT theory and the corresponding evaluation matrix is established. Then the three major factors impacting the development of M-commerce business models for China Mobile is extracted. Finally, the way to construct the effective business model of China Mobile is given.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Debate of Academic Freedom and University Autonomy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Exploring the Status and Improvement on China's Corporate Social Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Standing on the current fulfillment of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), this paper makes an attempt to uncover the existing problems and causes that domestic enterprises are suffering from practicing CSR and bring forward solutions to the harmful condition of CSR among the domestic takers.

articleTitle: Using Monte Carlo Simulation with Crystal Ball to Improve Mergers & Acquisitions Decision
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) is an important way to expand the enterprises' scale and improve their core competitiveness, but M&A decision is a big challenge for the manager, especially in the highly uncertain environment. The main approach to value M&A by traditional financial theory is discounted cash flow (DCF) model. DCF models are used for M&A evaluation by most companies, presumably because they are straightforward to apply and because they are intuitively appealing. However DCF method fails to consider the value of managerial flexibility. Real option analysis (ROA) offers a superior way of capturing the value of flexibility, while ROA can't effectively deal with the volatility of parameters in itself, because there are typically no historical returns for the underlying asset and no current market prices. This paper uses Monte Carlo Simulation with Crystal Ball to settle the parameters volatility problems in ROA. The case study further proves that it can improve M&A decision effectively under highly uncertain circumstances.

articleTitle: A Panel Data Analysis on the Performance's Difference of E-Governments in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The difference of performance among Chinese provincial e-governments is very obvious, but the underlying momentums yet to be analyzed in depth. From the intuitive point of view, the e-government development may be affected by a lot of factors such as the local online demand, regional urbanization, regional economic openness, regional economic development level and the other visible or invisible constraints. Our Panel data model found that the performance of provincial government websites have the very significant individual effect, and most importantly, it reflects the characteristics of random effects. It seems that the performance of provincial government websites may not be due to the unchangeable nature such as the location, the cultural tradition etc., but may arise from other invisible or noncountable potentials such as the openness of local politics, the attitude to e-government from governors and all of which may move stochastically over time and individuals.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Work Safety Capacity for Construction Enterprises Based on Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: From the angle of construction enterprises' work safety capacity, the research center is changed from traditional construction site safety management to work safety capacity management. First, we established evaluation index system of work safety capacity for construction enterprises. Second, we applied rough set theory to conduct index reduction in order to overcome the shortcomings of index redundancy and high computation complexity. Third, we used analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to confirm indexes' weight after reduction. Finally we applied fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to evaluate work safety capacity for construction enterprises.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Discussion about the Risk Avoiding of Enterprise Annuity Investment in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Secure Scheme for Data Statistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Secure Multi-party Computation (SMC) is a hot point concerning with information security and it is widely used in many fields, such as e-voting, e-auction and e-payment systems et al. This paper mainly discusses a special issue, data statistics, of SMC and its practical application background. Based on the oblivious transfer protocol and the homomorphic encryption scheme, a solution scheme is proposed. Furthermore, the security and the computational complexity of this scheme are as well analyzed. The results of analysis show that the proposed scheme is secure and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Innovation of the Incentive Mechanism and Strategies on Knowledge Workers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the coming of the knowledge economy era, knowledge workers have played an important role in modern enterprises. The new knowledge economy brings many and large challenges to the knowledge workers, such as frequently transferring of knowledge workers leads to the instability of companies, more difficult performance appraisal on knowledge workers leads to the distortion of appraisal results, and poor self-management effects of knowledge workers lead to the failure of enterprise cohesion and so on. However, the traditional incentive strategies on knowledge workers can not fully play its role because they could not meet the comprehensive needs of knowledge workers. Therefore, the incentive mechanisms and strategies on knowledge workers should be innovated, which is described in this paper from angles of informal communication and feedback, fair and differences, flexibility and comprehension to change the traditional incentive mechanism, and from angles of people-oriented concept, vocational training, the Total Pay Policy, and autonomous working atmosphere to implement the new incentive strategies.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Management of Bilingual Course Materials
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Now many universities have already set up bilingual courses. How to apply Computer Aided Translation to manage English-Chinese bilingual course materials is discussed. The system developed by translation memory and efficient searching technology can achieve efficient management of parallel texts and improve translation efficiency.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Software Quality Management on Informatization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Attention to informatization has increased, as thousands of organizations have adopted information systems. Meanwhile, the adoption of process-focused programs such as ISO9001 and CMMI (Capability Maturity Model Integration) are increasing in the software industry. Due to the technology coherence of SQM and informatization, we consider whether organizations who have adopted SQM successfully will be more effective in progressing informatization, has not reported so far. Through investigating the enterprises in the Pearl River Delta, this study analyzes the effect of SQM on a company's productivity, product quality, customer satisfaction, volume of business to prove that SQM is beneficial to most companies, and explores whether the adoption of SQM will affect the efficiency and workload resulted from informatization. Finally, it proposes that SQM should be a potential way to improve the effectiveness of informatization.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Shipbuilding Industry Cluster Based on Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper uses the research method about complex network, and constructs the complex network of shipbuilding industry cluster in Shandong, and analyzes the statistical characteristics of network. The result shows that: there exist five cluster areas of important hub node in network, namely, Qingdao, Yantai, Weihai, Rizhao and Jining; node degree obeys power-law distribution; through continuous evolution and development, a more mature shipbuilding industry chain is gradually forming in Shandong, and agglomeration effect is obvious. It also finds that there are still some deep-seated problems and constraints in shipbuilding industry cluster in Shandong.

articleTitle: Research and Design of the Smart Home-Based Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Smart Home is a comprehensive systematic project which compromises computing, networking, automation, sensing and other technologies, and involves ecology, environment, energy and other areas. Intelligent implementation is policy-based automation and information exchange, so smart home system is a network system integrating information flow and control flow. In this network, there are a variety of bus systems or wireless systems in charge of communications; is also a computer network system responsible for the exchange of information. By using the network, telephone, SMS, etc. to receive the remote commands, remote control will be implemented.

articleTitle: Volatility Forecasting Using APARCH with Skewed Conditional Distributions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It is well known that distributions of financial return are fat-tailed and many models have been developed to capture fat-tail. It is not so well known that distributions are skewed. We construct skewed distributions based on symmetric distributions using Fernandez-Steel method and research the prediction of volatility together with APARCH model. Empirical results show that there are significant influences of the skewedness on simulation and prediction of volatility models. More steps ahead of prediction, more significance of influence.

articleTitle: A Dual-subcycles Grant Dynamic Bandwidth Allocation Scheme for EPON
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Dynamic bandwidth allocation (DBA) is an open and hot topic in the Ethernet passive optical network (EPON). In this paper, we propose an efficient DBA scheme for EPONs. Unlike traditional DBA schemes, the proposed DBA scheme adapts the polling cycle time not only to the uplink traffic load but also to the downlink load. Thus it can adapt polling duration to the downstream load, and keep the high throughput of downlink by reducing the protocol overhead (GATE messages) related bandwidth loss. In the uplink, we divide the polling cycle into two subcycles—BG-subcycle and EBR-subcycle, and grant a window size not exceeding the minimum guaranteed bandwidth for each ONU in GB-subcycle, then reallocate the excessive bandwidth to those overloaded ONUs in EBR-subcycle. This scheme can avoid the walk-time bandwidth waste and reduce the packets delay of overloaded ONUs.

articleTitle: The Strategic Alliance Study of the E-Business Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The e-business has played more and more important role in our social and economic activities, but the existing documents about the e-business have the tendency which emphasizes the technique and neglects the business theory. So the development of the e-business enterprise lacks the necessary guidance coming from the management theory. Therefore, this paper mainly studies the strategy problem of the e-business enterprise. We think that the strategic alliance is an effective competitive policy of the e-business enterprise, and we discuss the value of the strategic alliance for the e-business enterprise and the form of the strategic alliance of the e-business enterprise. In the end, we analysis the key issues about the strategic alliance which the e-business enterprise must pay more attention.

articleTitle: The Establishment of Guizhou Tea Association Internet Shopping Mall
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The design for the tea industry in Guizhou Province, the demand is used in ASP.Net (C #), Microsoft SQL Server 2005, Access Marketing Web site developed by professional tea. Web sites which use the whole dynamic pages to achieve a web page to minimize maintenance and use means to achieve a vendor mall free shop, customers shared mall model.

articleTitle: Integrated Distribution Services: An Innovative Mechanism and Case Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the globalization and informationization, outsourcing services has become the new bright spot in the economic globalization. In the meantime, a number of service enterprises which provide high value-added services appear. The main purpose of this paper is to do both theoretical and empirical researches on the innovative mechanisms of integrated services. Firstly, in terms of the theory of supply chain management, the paper puts forward analytical framework of integrated distribution services innovation, which involves five ranges: concept innovation, management innovation, service innovation, technological innovation, and resource allocation innovate ion. Secondly, taking Hong Kong Li & Fung Group for example, the paper analyzes three major businesses which consist of contract manufacturing, marketing, logistics services, and finds that integration distribution service providers are different from traditional distributors in business philosophy, internal and external co-operation mechanism, service content and the application of information systems. Hong Kong's Li & Fung Group's experience is important for Chinese enterprises to learn.

articleTitle: The Disadvantages of Citizen E-Participation in China and Its Strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Citizen e-participation supplies powerful drive and rare opportunity for democracy development, meanwhile, it also confronts with large challenges and risks, which is mainly embodied at: first, “digital gap” problem is obvious, the subject, capability and wish of citizen network political participation are featured by unbalance and may be dissimilated to be “network noble democracy”, due to unbalanced development of China’s economy and society and dual-division of rural and urban areas. Second, individualism, liberalism and citizen globalization concept prevail in network era, which makes the state traditional political authorization lowered and citizen e-participation may confront with the situation of being out of control. Third, the phenomena of information explosion, information crowd and “group polarization” lead to irrationalism, extremeness of citizen’s political participation on Internet, which will do harm to democratization course of Chinese e-participation. Aimed at these problems, first, China’s government should devote itself to eliminating “digital gap” and accelerating construction of information infrastructure and prevalence of computer network knowledge to supply opportunity of equal network political participation to citizens. Second, China’s government should rule Internet with law and strengthen control and management for network information node, purify information network space, perfect the systems of issuance of government information on Internet, direct communication between government officials and public on Internet to strive to form good “appeal-response” mechanism of interaction between officials and citizens. Third, government should further improve citizens’ political quality and network ethic quality to cultivate citizens’ political participation in culture, and perfect network ethic criterion system.

articleTitle: Research on Waste Mobile Recycling Network Model and Application in the Context of E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of electronic technology and the accelerating update speed of the electronic products, the number of waste mobile phones is growing exponentially. Study on the recycling and utilization of waste mobile phones has caused worldwide concern. Based on the Theory of Reverse Logistics, the paper designs a recycling logistics network suitable for waste mobile phones, which consists of collecting points, storage sites, disassembly recycling plants and the final disposition sites, then presents a mixed integer programming model and conducts an empirical study based on the actual situation of 14 prefecture-level cities of Guangxi. The paper gives the thought and method to design the recycling logistics network for waste mobile phones.

articleTitle: Electronic Commerce and Network Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article will complete that discussion by considering how business and organizations around the world are taking advantage of an exiting application of information systems-electronic commerce.

articleTitle: Maximized Deviation-Based Group Decision-Making Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper studies the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation problem through group decision-making, in which the information about factor weights is completely unknown. A model is proposed to determine factor weights based on a maximized deviation. To demonstrate the method proposed in this paper, a case study, i. e. books selecting problem is analyzed by this model, showing that the model is easily applied to group decision-making comprehensive evaluation and that result is of applicability in that factor weights are determined based on a maximized deviation without being influenced by decision-makers.

articleTitle: A Model of Software Project Risk Management Based on Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A new model of software project risk management is presented, which uses the Bayesian networks to infer the probability of risk occurrence and the impact of risk simultaneously. The model can assess risks continuously and take proper measures to respond to risks during software project. Practice proves that by introducing this model into software development process, project risks can be well-managed and project success rate can be improved.

articleTitle: Research on Government Information Resources Planning Architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Government information resources planning is a comprehensive planning of government information resources' collection, processing, storage and transmission which consists of a set of related standards, theories, methods, laws and regulations and application composition. With the focus on government information resource planning architecture, this paper presents standard planning, data planning and security planning as the core content of government information resource planning which further improves the relevant standards, theory and methods of government information resources planning.

articleTitle: System View Software Application in Experimental Teaching Reformation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: System View software has a high accuracy, flexibility and can make up for a lack of hardware in the traditional experimental teaching. According to the situation of electronic information and relevant professions in high school, the practical teaching reformation was proposed. Based on the characteristic of System View software, the application of correlative reformation methods in experimental teaching and scientific research was put forward. The practice shows that reformation can improve students' learning interest and capability of research. This kind of practical teaching reform is widely recognized by some employers.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the application about MA in e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A series of security problems face to e-commerce systems based on Mobile Agent has restricted its development. In this paper, by making a behavior analysis for MA at different stages of e-commerce, minimize the security risks by using different access patterns for MA. Then proposed a model of e-commerce transactions for the session key generation which could authenticate bye each other but no third party involved.

articleTitle: Research on E-government Technical Framework Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The widespread usage of the Web and the Internet-as information and communication technologies (ICTs)-is a recent important public sector innovation. Most e-government systems are web applications based on B/S mode. However, these applications have problems such as poor expansibility and bad interoperability. The article proposes the architecture of e-government system based on SOA, which can improve the openness and efficiency of the e-government.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Necessity Analysis to Speed Up Contract Energy Management in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Function Restriction Analysis of Information Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Defined the functions of information network, the paper analyzes the functions and asthenia-sthenia-duality of networks, puts forward the connotation of cardinality, and deduces the formula of networks' cardinality. Analyzed the asthenia-sthenia-duality of wired networks and ideal networks by dimension-force theory, the paper gets the functional relationship between the asthenia and sthenia of networks, and studies the extreme constraints problems of cardinality function.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of E-government Performance Evaluation between China and Overseas
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Since China implemented "Government Online Project" in 1999, E-government has developed rapidly. How to evaluate the E-government performance has gradually become a brand new and important subject. This paper reviews the development of E-government performance evaluation research in China and overseas. Based on the analysis of domestic and abroad literature, it points out the inadequacy of domestic research and puts forward some concrete suggestion on China's E-government performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Research of Transactions Goods Domain Ontology Building Method Based on Reputation Recommendation Trust Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In reputation recommendation system of E-Commerce, while two recommendation nodes recommended the same node, their transactions goods content similarity could be used to judge the credibility of their recommendation, so concept similarity of transactions goods domain ontology could be used to a computing method of transactions goods content similarity, transactions goods domain ontology need be created firstly in order to obtain similarity between theirs. This paper proposes a hierarchical building method for trade goods domain ontology based on types and key attributes. Through top-down ontology analysis and design as well as bottom-up ontology building and integration, this method can quickly build a prototype of trade goods domain ontology, then ontology is recreated, according to experts' evaluations, and forms a complete trade goods domain ontology ultimately.

articleTitle: The Effect of Audio-visual Teaching on Learning Burnout
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to explore the effect of Audio-visual teaching on learning burnout, this study conducts a survey among 360 middle school students by using questionnaire and experimental method. The result shows that Senior 2 and 3 students' score in terms of behavior improper dimension is significant higher than general level; the scores of 3 dimensions of learning burnout in Audio-visual teaching group are significant lower than in Non-audio-visual teaching group; the girls' scores of dejection and behavior improper dimension are significant lower than the boys' in Audio-visual teaching group. It is concluded that Audio-visual teaching can help middle school students reduce learning burnout; in Audio-visual Teaching group, the girls' scores of dejection and behavior improper dimension are significant lower than the boys'.

articleTitle: Functional Analysis of the Land-use System in Urban Residential Areas
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to Maslow's hierarchy of needs, the Sustainable Development Theory and the Theory of Urban Growth, this article which is based on the theoretical analysis of the function of the land-use system in urban residential areas has sorted out the function of it by using FAST technology and has preliminarily studied the calculation method of the functional level. This article has, therefore, drawn the following conclusion: the analysis of the function of the land-use system and the positioning of the functional level in residential areas, which are located in cities of different type and nature, are the basis for rational use of the residential land.

articleTitle: Simulating the Relation between the Environmental Protection Investment and the Economics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the continuous model, the paper established a discrete model, which is good at showing the impact of environmental protection investment to economic and environment simply. There are three response strategies in the paper: complete elastic response strategy of environmental protection investment, directional elastic response strategy of environmental protection investment and minimum maintain response strategy of environmental protection investment. They were all used for the simulation of the model. And the best strategy is the third one. Through the simulation, it is known that the growth of depreciation rate by environment is conducive to environment quality but not to economic development and the rate of technological progress of environmental protection is good at both sides. The increase in population growth rate is not conducive to the development of both.

articleTitle: Research on IDSS of PDL Station Location Based on GRA Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The scheme selection in passenger dedicated line (PDL) station location, with wide range and lots of factors, is a complex and comprehensive work. Based on the theory of intelligent decision support system (IDSS) and grey relational analysis(GRA), the authors proposed a basic structure pattern of PDL station location IDSS. On the above basis, with the case in literature, this proposed IDSS was verified with its correctness, adaptability and feasibility.

articleTitle: E-Democracy: Issues and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of information and network technology, e-democracy came into being. As a new means and channel of democratic participation, there are two essential perspectives of e-democracy. On the one hand, it plays a kind of positive role; on the other hand, there are some limitations and problems. In this paper, first of all, the author affirmed the positive role of e-democracy, then analyzed its limitations and problems, and proposed the methods and countermeasures to overcome these limitations. The author believed that the main problems in e-democracy lie as follows: e-democracy can only be a kind of means, but not the end; e-democracy over-publicized the instrumental rationality, which would lead to the decline of the value of rationality; e-democracy is also facing the problems of fairness, and furthermore, there is the plight of ethical anomie in e-democracy. Among the above problems, the author believed that we could start from the following aspects: strengthening the construction of infrastructure; distributing the resources equitably; developing and improving education, so as to make all classes of people have access to electronic information and communication technology; strengthening the legal system and creating a favorable legal environment; strengthening the construction of ethical system to form a good environment of public opinion; and enhancing the technical control.

articleTitle: A Multi-Dimensional Measuring Model for E-travel Service in Decentralized Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-travel in decentralized network is becoming a rising and important domain in e-commerce applications on Internet, in which evaluation of service is one of the most fundamental problems. Due to the individuation and complicacy, the evaluating methods for traditional e-commerce cannot support some inherent features of decentralized e-travel applications. In this paper a multi-dimensional measuring model is discussed, which considers 3 dimensions including evaluation for service peer, service quality and service load with different speed of temporal attenuation. Prototype based on the measuring model was implemented and experiments showed that the method could return satisfying services for individual requirements. Although the model is specified for e-travel domain, some minor adjustments can adapt it to the evaluation model for other e-commerce applications in unstructured P2P network.

articleTitle: Analysis of E-business Model Classification Framework Based on Value Proposition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Classification method is a hotspot and difficult issue in the analysis of e-business model. On the basis of analysis and summarization of present classification research of business model, a e-business model classification framework is built based on value proposition in e-business model.

articleTitle: Employment Self-efficacy: Construction and Initial Validation of a Scale for University Students
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article revised the colleges' employment self-efficacy (ESE) scale, and measured 330 undergraduates using the scale. The results are as follows: The structures of students' ESE consists of five dimensions including self-evaluation of personality, labor market, schools reputation, academic achievement and job information and skills. The overall students' ESE reached an average or above; Students from different grades and majors have significant difference, the scores of seniors are higher than that of the juniors, and accounting students have higher efficacy than business management students. The undergraduates of different genders, different native place and those between single child and non-single child don't have significant difference, but male students have higher scores than female students, the scores of students from cities are higher than those from rural areas, and non-single children have higher efficacy than single children. University should carry out different employment instructions for different students.

articleTitle: Geological Information Forecast and 3D Reconstruction Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to represent 3D spatial entity effectively in geological engineering, a new method of geological information forecast and 3D reconstruction is put forward based on support vector machine (SVM). Firstly, for the given geological drill hole data, SVM is adopted to forecast ore grade of information unknown areas within the geological sections and then geological layered data is obtained. Secondly, based on discretization meshwork model, topological relations for control points can be established automatically between adjacent data layers and in this way we can construct surface model of 3D spatial entity. The experiment results show that SVM has a better performance in predictable performance than the traditional BP neural network and the predicted value are close to the actual value which improves precision of 3D modeling greatly.

articleTitle: The Model Analysis of HR Outsourcing Gambling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The information involved in the process of HR outsourcing is non-symmetrical, it is a certain degree of difficulty that Outsourcing Supplier achieves to maximize the interest in the process of cooperation. Based on principal - agent relationship and in view of outsourcing supplier no understanding the effort level of outsourcing service vendor, setting up the non-continuous effort level outsourcing game model monitored and the continuous effort level outsourcing game model that cannot be monitored. Having done analysis for strategy of cooperation in the light of principal-agent theory framework, Nash Equilibrium thought as well as maximization theory.

articleTitle: Research on Persuasion Type Argument-negotiation System Based on Agent and Its State of Arts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Persuasion type argument-negotiation system based on agent can meet needs of cooperation among organization. After introduction of this system, advance in this area has been reviewed from three aspects: protocols, strategies and models, development. Then through our research, relative strategies and models, evaluation system and arithmetic in this system have been put forward, which have been verified by development of relative prototype system. Java and Jade have been used in it. Finally, directions in the future are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on optimal Multiple Sequence Alignment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Multiple Sequence Alignment(MSA) is one of the most fundamental problems in biology information. At present, with the rapid increase in the sequence quantity, there is an urgent need to run the optimized algorithm of MSA, the researchers also made a lot of the problem solution, such as dynamic programming, including the Needleman-Wunsch algorithm and Carrillo-Lipman algorithm, Feng-Doolittle algorithm and algorithm ClustalW of heuristic algorithm step method; the Barton & Sternberg algorithm of Iterative optimization method; HMMs of statistics and probability method and multiple sequence alignment algorithms in genetic algorithm of random optimization method, such as SAGA. In this paper, studied MSA optimization algorithm of genetic algorithm-based, which put forward an improved adaptive genetic algorithm, calibrated fitness value, and realized the community multiplicity in the evolution process, while the use of the most commonly used sigmoid function in structural neuronal activation function, carried on the optimization to overlapping rate and the rate of mutation, has realized misalignment auto-adapted adjustment of overlapping rate and mutation rate, sharpened the algorithm optimization ability and the stability.

articleTitle: Dynamic Game Analysis in Program Emergency Management of Engineering Construction Company
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Along with the trend that emergency events frequently occur in the program management, it becomes significantly important to strengthen the program emergency management, and the scientific and reasonable resource allocation shall exert dual effects on the disposal of unexpected event. The paper proposes the process model of the program emergency management, analyzes the game between the program emergency events and program managers of the engineering construction company under the model framework of the dynamic game, and discusses how to generate the allocation scheme for relief materials with the game model.

articleTitle: Analysis on Incentive Risk in Enterprise Human Capital Investment as Viewed from Investment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The study divides the risks caused by enterprise human capital investment (EHCI) into two types: prediction risk and incentive risk, according to whether the risk reason is related to the subjectivity of the invested object or not. Then the study analyses the characteristics of the incentive risk, and sets forth the means to control the incentive risk as viewed from investment.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-tier EMIS System Based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Aiming at satisfying the urgent requirement of interoperability in education information systems, and based on the research of CELTS_40, this article put forward a new interoperability multi-tier EMIS architecture model, which can implement most of the functions defined in CELTS_40 and some of new unique functions. In addition, it also overcomes the shortcomings of traditional EMIS systems effectively, such as, tightly-couple of the communication and information semantics, therefore it is more open and of interoperability and reusability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study on International Financial Crisis' Impact on Hangzhou's Industrial Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Electronic Document Transmission System Based on Chaotic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper discusses a new algorithm of file encryption based on chaotic systems and advanced AES encryption technology. Based on the study of some existing chaotic encryption algorithms, a new dynamical block cipher was proposed. In the proposed cipher, key generated from chaotic sequence are used as sub-key for AES block ciphers. The problem of “key space shortage" is successfully solved and a new AES algorithm based on chaos map is created. The new model integrates the characteristics of both cipher systems to achieve higher security. The possibility of mixing both the advantages of block and stream ciphers in one encryption scheme is discussed. The essential superiorities on security and efficiency are stated. Such cipher schemes which have both the features of block ciphers and stream ciphers have good properties on anti-attacks. And thus, the schemes will have a good future on the application.

articleTitle: The Environmental and Economic Effects of Trade Liberalization: A Computable General Equilibrium Modeling Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the environmental and economic effects of trade liberalization, we use a Computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to examine the impact of a trade bloc consisting of the US and China. We find some macro-economic variables such as gross domestic product (GDP), disposable income, import, export, production and consumption increases for two members of the trade bloc when tariffs are eliminated. These gains appear to accrue more to China. However, we also find environmental quality will increase in US but decrease in China. The trade liberalization policy thus bring higher economic prosperity but at the cost of environmental degradation to China. This is an issue of major concern for the future of the China.

articleTitle: Estate Club House e-Services and Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Club House Management, as a service component of estate management, is identified as a key factor of quality management. Good access to club house facilities demand efficient and often with the need in providing latest status updates. Software solution has to be cost effective with Internet access to services, and support for future enhancements. A prototype Club House Management System (CHMS) was developed and on-site usage results showed that there were significant improvements in service quality with reduction on labor and operating costs.

articleTitle: Analysis of Optimal Batch Transshipment Policies between Two Retailers of Electronic Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: After investigating and analyzing the Zhongguancun electronic products market, this paper studies the optimal batch transshipment policies between two competing retailers by establishing a model. The model assumes that both retailers hold a certain quantity of initial inventories which are non-replenishable during the selling process, one of the retailers can only ask for transshipment from the other one if it has run out of its inventory, and share profit as agreed scale. In this process, both retails pursue expected profit maximization, they make the optimal batch transshipment policies based on the comprehensive consideration of transshipment profits, inventory costs and transshipment costs. The result shows that one of the retails will grant the request of transshipment only when its actual inventory level is higher than the key value. Moreover, the specialty of this model is that the retail who has run out of the inventory will consider whether to ask for transshipment based on profits.

articleTitle: The Price Strategy and Mobile Internet Supply Chain Coordination Mechanism in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The Price decision and game process is studied between mobile network provider (MP) and service provider (SP) in China mobile internet supply chain. The game results in decentralized decision pattern and centralized pattern are analyzed and compared. The results show that centralized decision can make Pareto improvement, where the consumer payments are lower, but supply chain profits are higher than which under decentralized pattern. The cooperation between MP and SP needs coordination based on the mechanisms of explicit and incentive revenue share contract.

articleTitle: A Review on Establishment of E-democracy in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-democracy is a new form of democracy in the internet age. E-democracy plays active roles in democratic construction in China. However, the information asymmetries, the inadequate of government administration, imperfectness of relevant laws, and the absence of internet ethics, all restrained the building of E-democracy. Therefore, great efforts should be made to strengthen development of information system, strengthen political civilization development and improve government operation mechanism. In addition, it is quite essential to speed up internet legislation and perfect the system of internet ethical codes.

articleTitle: Bid Evaluation System of Construction Project Based on Multi-level Fuzzy Synthetic Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: An evaluation index system for construction project bidding on basis of the current situation analyses on the bid evaluation system is established, and a multi-level fuzzy synthetic evaluation model is proposed to evaluate the comprehensive advantages of the bidding enterprise.

articleTitle: Study of E-commerce Trust Management Formal Model Based on Reputation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Trust plays an important role in the development, implementation and operation of e-commerce systems. This paper Analyzes the current research of e-commerce trust model and research method, proposes a formal model of e-commerce trust management based on reputation, disccusses the various issues involved and their solution ideas, which gives a good foundation for further research.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research on China's Finance Stability under the Shock of Global Finance Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Telecom Family Customer Value Identification Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Customer identification, which is based on the clear definition and classification of customers, is the foundation of market positioning and strategic planning for telecom service providers. The traditional definition of family customers, which use fixed-line telephone, cannot meet the current circumstances under which the telecom companies develop their full-scale business targeted at family users since China telecom were recombined in 2008. The paper clarifies the definition and substance of telecom family customers, establishes an evaluation model of family customer value based on the family customer business practices, and introduces a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model to identify the telecom family customer value accurately. These efforts try to provide theoretical basis to help identify the high-value customers and further develop the family market.

articleTitle: Study on the Factors of Customer Loyalty in B2C E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to a recent study pointed out that online sales are expected to rise from $19 billion in 2008 to $26 billion in 2009 in China. Despite this spectacular annual growth of 7.2%, many web based businesses failed. With the change, the business community are interested in focusing on online customer satisfaction and retention through the creation of e-loyalty. E-businesses realized that by retaining customers, cost can be reduced because it is much cheaper to retain customers than to attract new customers. In this paper, Exist literature on e-loyalty is studied. Based on the literature review in e-business, the thesis first outlined the critical differences between traditional loyalty and e-loyalty, and then delivered a set of critical success factors to develop e-loyalty.

articleTitle: A Quality Testing Management System Architecture for Web-Based Small and Medium-sized Glasses Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The current development situation of glasses production area is analyzed first, and a Web-based small and medium-sized glasses enterprises (SMGE) quality testing management system is established. Several key technologies for implementing the system are introduced. In order to realize transparent data access and dynamic collection, components for data accessing and serial port accessing are designed and explained in detail. A template-based web print method is employed for solving the complex report questions in the glasses testing process. Finally, the system is implemented on vs.net platform.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Selection of Issuing Modules of Catastrophe Bond for China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Learning from the issuing experiences of the international catastrophe bond market, this paper analyzes the existing obstacles we are facing. On the basis of current law, capital markets, we discusses three feasible issuing modules for the issurance of the catastrophe in China as follows: domestic (re)insurance company or government as sponsor to issue catastrophe bond based on foreign insurance company's SPV; domestic finance institute and foreign reinsurance company as sponsors to establish the SPV and issue the catastrophe bond jointly.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Service Innovation about Relational Embedded Configuration and Network Competence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This study conducts three types of relational embedded configuration based on the relational embedded ties between the focal firm and its partners-customer, supplier, competitor and research institution. The effects of configurations on service innovation are contingent on service innovation types. From internal perspective, the network competence of a firm can enhance the performance of service innovation. The study also deals with the effect of the interaction between network competence and relational embedded configurations on service innovation performance. We verify the proposed model based on 182 companies as effective samples in Jiangsu University of Science and Technology Park and high-tech development zone into the conduct of empirical research and analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Shaping the Cohesion of Top Management Team in EPC Project Based on Psychological Contract
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The research on shaping the cohesion of top management team (TMT) in EPC project has great significance for carrying on EPC project in China. The paper firstly defines the cohesion meaning of top management team (TMT) in EPC project. Then, it points out that the cohesion shaping of top management team (TMT) in EPC project mainly lies in the balance of every member's psychological contract, and more, constructs the cohesion shaping model of top management team (TMT) in EPC project based on psychological contract. Finally, based on the model, aming at the top management team (TMT) in EPC project, the paper proposes the countermeasures for the no-balance of psychological contract.

articleTitle: Development of Knowledge Management Based on Task Circumstance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Knowledge Management (KM) plays the key role in upgrading the competitiveness of an organization, one of objectives of KM is to promote the share and reuse of all kind of knowledge. To this end, task circumstance (TC) of knowledge is crucial. Base on task circumstance, this paper proposes a framework of KM to facilitate knowledge reuse. According to the definition of domain ontology, this paper introduces the concept of TC, and then presents a method of TC annotation. Base on the TC MiniTree, we propose a novel method of evaluating TC semantic similarity, and finally introduce a knowledge match algorithm to retrieve appropriate knowledge for application precisely and quickly.

articleTitle: Study on Necessity of Creating Own-Brand and Effect of Promoting Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: OEM production has played an important role in the early development of Chinese enterprises, along with the economic situation changing, enterprise can not avoid the issue of creating their own-brand. In this paper, according to the analysis of the OEM production model, research on the necessity and the importance for businesses of creating their own-brand and the strategy of promoting the competitiveness of enterprises based on own-brand.

articleTitle: Strategies for Promoting Better Interaction between Higher Education and IT Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: For a sustained development of higher education and IT industry, it is essential to have a close collaboration between them. As provider of software talents to IT industry, higher education in software engineering must play immeasurably active role in meeting and adapting to the development needs of IT industry. Higher education institutions need to update advanced educational concepts and explore advanced educational measures to ensure the quality of software graduates. As main consumer of software engineering graduates, IT industry also needs to have positive attitudes toward education, and collaborate closely with education. IT industry needs to be involved in curriculum development and policy making for higher education. The effective interaction between higher education and IT industry needs these two key players to do great effort together. This paper proposes some strategies to strengthen the interaction between them, and give some examples that the authors' school are exploring and implementing now.

articleTitle: An Emprical Study on Optimization Method of Allocation Water Resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The issue of Water Security has increasingly gained the global concern. Henan province is presently confronted with the severe imbalance in water resources distribution and drinking water security, which is extremely detrimental to agricultural production. In the study of regional water resources optimization, with the guide of systmetic theory, based on improved adaptive genetic algorithm, corresponding mathematical model is established in this article to deal with some problems which include precocious or non-global convergence or slow convergence. The result shows that the improved algorithm has good global search ability and rapid convergence rate, which lays a theoretical foundation for global optimization problem of water resources allocation, which has been already adopted by Water Conservancy Bureau of Anyang city, and good effects have beed brought.

articleTitle: Fold Catastrophe Model of Fracture Propagation of Hydraulic Fracturing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to energy conservation from the destruction of rock catastrophe, a new calculation method of the length of fracture propagation in hydraulic fracturing is proposed, and assuming the crack extends to approximate ellipse, the width calculation model of fracture extension is established. By using this new method in Changsheng well of Jilin oilfield, And the maximum error between the productivity that calculated by using the new method and the actual oil production is anastomosing. the method is an innovation in parameter calculation of crack propagation with the destruction of rock catastrophe, and it supposes some new theoretical foundation for the design of fracture parameter optimization.

articleTitle: Study on the Early-warning Management for Pilot's Turnover Based on the Unfolding Model of Voluntary Turnover
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
