abstract: Since the pilot's inefficient and disorderly flow is threatening and damaging Chinese aviation industry, on the basis of the Unfolding Model of Voluntary Turnover this Paper discusses the pilot's possible and major Paths toward turnover through empirical and statistical analysis, concluding that the key to early-warning management should be to strengthen the pilot's loyalty to airlines and to improve the pilot's job satisfaction, on which the early-warning countermeasures are proposed to the different Paths.

Author Keywords: the Unfolding Model of Voluntary Turnover

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Research on Knowledge Management Domestic and Abroad Based on Literature Statistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In Recent years, there is very obvious improvement and development in the domain of knowledge management, both domestic and abroad. To find out inadequacy of domestic research compared to that of abroad and to increase the domestic research level, this paper makes comparison of both Chinese and English literature in aspects of research topic, method, and application field and so on, based on statistics of literature about knowledge management. Besides it concludes both similarities and differences. The result shows that domestic research (1) mainly focuses on models and strategy research while paying less attention on specific implementation; (2) mainly use non-empirical methods; (3) application fields are much less wider than those of foreign countries.

articleTitle: Star-like Model of Database Design for Government Economic Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to solve the difficulty to change and expand the application system and field security in government economic integrated system, a new star-like of database design model is proposed. The new model is proved to be more suitable for the complicated, changeable and field security database systems integration by giving an example of the government economic integrated system.

articleTitle: IP Security Gateway in E-Business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The security of data which is transferred in E-business and E-Government is becoming more and more important. Using of IP security protocol can solve the reality and reliability problem, greatly improves the security of transmitted data. An IP security gateway realization is introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: 3rd Party E-business Architechure and Model in Grid Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: More and more E-business services of enterprises are performed by the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> party E-business platform, which leads to bad system performance. To solve the performance issue, an E-business architecture based on grid computing is proposed. The major architecture is depicted and discussed in detail, and some features of our proposed architecture are outlined. To verify the feasibility of E-business application in grid environment, an E-business model is proposed and discussed.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Economic Effects of Outsourcing of Service - A Case Study in Dalian
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper examines empirically the economic effects of outsourcing of service by using data between 1998 and 2007 of Dalian city, which has witnessed significant outsourcing of service activity rapidly over the last decade. Results show that development of outsourcing has positive effects on labor demand, FDI and productivity, and outsourcing of service not only can be a direct contribution to economic growth in Dalian, but also a indirect contribution on economic growth through employment effect and foreign direct investment attraction effect. At the same time, we conclude that outsourcing of service industry in China is still a labor-intensive industry.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Sources of C2C Sellers' Perceived Risk and Their Corresponding Relationship with Perceived Risk Types
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The C2C market is now occupying the dominant position of online retail market. The problem of its perceived risk is becoming increasingly conspicuous and shows different characters from that of B2C market, of which the existence of sellers' perceived risk is a typical example. In order to find practical measures to reduce the C2C sellers' perceived risk, this study analyzed the sources of which, employing the methodology of content analysis and using the posts of the Answer Center of EBay as the sample. The results suggest that there are 7 kinds of sources of C2C sellers' perceived risk: the sellers' unusual behavior; the buyers' violation of the transactional rules; the instability of transaction system; the buyers' incredibility; the unfair policies in transaction; the instability of the third party payment and the buyers' delayed response. Finally, several managerial implications derived from the results were suggested.

articleTitle: A New Robust Digital Watermarking Based on Complex Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper proposed a new robust method of image watermarking in Complex Wavelet Transform. Through modulating a Logistic chaotic sequence, extract a sub-image from the host image. In Complex Wavelet domain, combine the singular values of the watermark and the singular values of the selected sub-band of the sub-image. As the new method uses the properties of frequency domain and SVD simultaneously, it has better quality in comparison with the pure SVD-based as well as pure CWT-based methods. Experimental results and analysis show that the proposed method has good transparency, as well as better robustness against the most of common attacks.

articleTitle: The Research on Web Testing Methods for Agricultural Information Retrieval System Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Described the basic framework of the agricultural information retrieval system based on ontology and analyzed the factors which affect the system reliability, then proposed many methods and contents of web testing about the functionality testing, performance testing and security testing.

articleTitle: On “Power Man” Hypothesis in Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The hypothesis of human nature is the basic view of human nature. With the time goes, The shortcomings of traditional hypotheses gradually emerged the article proposed power man hypothesis, and based on which some puzzlement in management science is discussed and some enlightenments to improving management method is presented.

articleTitle: The Application of Fuzzy Synthesis Evaluation Method Based on AHP in Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper lets the Fuzzy mathematical methods combined with the AHP, establishment multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method based on AHP, at the same time combined with the characteristics of knowledge management evaluation index system, the Application of Fuzzy Synthesis Evaluation Method t in knowledge management, to make studies more feasible and practical.

articleTitle: A Simple Analysis about the Signal Transmitting between Physicians and Patients on the Condition of Asymmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Health care service is connected tightly with each people. The relationship between the physicians and patients should be paid more attention. The article concentrates on the analysis of the signal transmitting between the physicians and the patients with game theory and information economics so as to find the keys to face the challenge which might destroy the good physician-patient relationship.

articleTitle: Research on Incentive Mechanism of Supply Chain with Knowledge Association between Suppliers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Aimed at the knowledge association relation between suppliers in complex supply chain, the principal-agent models with individual incentive and group incentive under knowledge associations were established respectively. Additionally, the core enterprise' optimal incentive strategies and knowledge sharing between suppliers were researched. The results show that combing individual incentive and group incentive can promote production effort and coordinate knowledge sharing behavior among suppliers effectively. Besides, learning capability of suppliers has a significant impact on group incentive and the knowledge-sharing effort.

articleTitle: The Applications of Web Mining in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid growth of Internet information, the common topic of E-commerce enterprises is how to mine and utilize web information effectively. The paper introduces the categories and major steps of web mining, and discusses the applications of web mining in E-commerce such as marketing on the web, customer relationship management, commodity personalization recommendation, and so on.

articleTitle: Rearch on Bilingual Teaching of Development Economics Graduate Course
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Using bilingual teaching in the graduate course development economics has great significance for training internationally competitive economics professionals. First, the significance of bilingual teaching on graduate course development economics are described, and then the existing problems of bilingual education in development economics graduate courses are analyzed from four aspects including teachers, students, cultural backgrounds and teaching materials differences between Chinese and Western, and then the perfection methods of new teaching materials mode, teaching mode, assessment mode and teacher training mode are proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis about Factors of Brain Drain in Enterprise Based on ISM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: There are many factors effect brain drain in enterprise, these factors are complex, they are multi-level and sides. This paper determined key factors which influence the enterprise's brain drain by Delphi method, research the relations between these key factors through ISM (Interpretive Structural Modeling). We may safely draw a conclusion that these factors has a hierarchical structure, employee self-realization does not meet is internal root, and the convenience of the information age is external causes. This paper proposes enterprise should make strong measure to deal with these internal and external factors.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Classroom Instruction Dealing with Mode and Median: The Chinese and U.S. Different Mathematics Instructional Designs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The article chooses 3 lesson-cases dealing with the same content of “mode and median” from Chinese and American classrooms. The article attempts to investigate whether the cultural differences between China and the U.S. will influence on the implementation of instructional tasks by the means of “an analysis frame of mathematics instructional tasks”. We think that the differences between the two lesson-cases under the different cultural backgrounds are the resources which the two parties can introspect and draw lessons from in common, especially in how to promote the development of the cognitive level of the mathematical tasks.

Author Keywords: Classroom instruction dealing with mode and median

articleTitle: Reseach on Mandatory Access Control in LogicSQL Database System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The secure limitation in the database system only taking discretionary access control is discussed. This paper proposes a mandatory access control model for multilevel secure DBMS and discusses the problems of labeling object in tuples, security label, covert channels and poly-instantiation. The mandatory access control model requires that all users and resources are classified and assigned a security label, which is a combination of a hierarchical security level and non-hierarchical security categories. As mandatory access control plays an important role in highly secured database system, the model is analyzed and implemented in independent copyright database management system LogicSQL. In addition, the model is designed at least with a B1 security level for LogicSQL database.

articleTitle: Audience Analysis and Development Measures of “Zhejiang Online”
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At the time of new media, i.e. the mediamorphosis supported by new technology, such as digital magazine, digital newspaper, digital radio, mobile short message, mobile television, network, digital television, digital movie, tangible media, etc. Comparing with the four traditional media, i.e. newspapers and journals, outdoor media, radio and television, New Media is called “the fifth media”. The transition from the concept of “propagator focus” to “audience focus” at the new media times and the combination of media functions through Internet makes the audience more and more significant in the media market. Under this background, the management of customer relations is becoming a key factor in audience investigation and market development. This paper aims at, basing on the development of Zhejiang Online, through comparing the customer relation managements of between both the old and new media, analyzing the audience characteristics and development resolutions of China's news websites from the perspective of customer relation management (CRM), thus offering constructive advice in the growth of Zhejiang Online.

articleTitle: Analysis of how to use the GEB developing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The beginning of Growth Enterprise Board provides opportunity for China's economic transformation and help China's economy choose the next round heights of economic growth. SMEs which have e-business nature are representatives of many Chinese traditional enterprises in the new economic situation, the success of these enterprises are highly related with many traditional enterprises implementing information and achieve a real e-commerce.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Mixed Model Based on Wavelet Multi-resolution Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The wavelet multi-resolution analysis is combined with time series traffic flow models. The characteristic of traffic flow is decomposed by wavelet multi-resolution analysis. According to the long relativity of smooth component and the short relativity of detail component, corresponding models are set up. The prediction of traffic flow series is implemented by synthesizing all the components. Experiments results indicate that the mixed model can make accurate prediction of traffic flow and the prediction results are better than using FARIMA model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: New Product Development, Strategy Crafting, and the Performance of Entrepreneurial Firms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Mechanism Research of Tacit Knowledge Share in Marketing Innovation of E-Business Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: On the condition of global finance crisis, marketing innovation of E-Business enterprises is particularly important. The thesis extracts 6 factors from 15 factors of affecting tacit knowledge share in marketing innovation and builds a theoretical model of mechanism research of tacit knowledge share in marketing innovation of E-Business enterprises. 230 E-Business enterprises in China were studied as empirical samples to test the model. It turns out relation credit; sustain from leadership; communication intercommunion and reciprocal degree have distinct positive effect on tacit knowledge share, relation credit is most. Meanwhile, insecurity has distinct negative effect on tacit knowledge share, and pressure from task has no distinct positive effect on tacit knowledge share. The thesis brings forward management advice.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Value Flow Accounting Based on Circular Economy for Coal-fired Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper presents the methodology of resource value flow accounting developed for a study which combined material flow analysis (MFA) for the coal-fired power generation plant, in order to shed light on concepts such as resource productivity and dematerialization of the coal-fired power plant. Different from the previous macro-level MFA, this paper analyses the material cycle of coal-fired power plant based on the micro-scale, not only establish material balance model of the boiler combustion quantity center in accordance with the conservation principle of the mass and energy, but also analyses the resource value flow and its components of the combustion quantity center. The findings show that resource value flow accounting information of coal-fired power plant will play an eco-guide role for the cycle of material and energy resources.

articleTitle: Internet Bidding and Procurement in Chinese Military Industry Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Online bidding and procurement, as one of the advanced business models, has been widely used in manufacturing enterprises exhibiting traits of modern enterprise management: speed, cost and variety. The Chinese military-industrial enterprises are still under the influence of planned economy; therefore, it is of utmost importance to use the advanced modern enterprise management theories and tools to improve efficiency and reduce cost while implementing institutional transformation. This article introduces the theories about design and implementation of online bidding and procurement in Chinese military industry enterprises. It also presents an analysis of the advantages and disadvantages in using online bidding and procurement in a manufacture enterprise.

articleTitle: “Culture”, “Workmanship” and “Power Relation”: A Perspective of Value Chain Governance - The Empirical Analysis of Manufacturing Firms of Specialty Products in Guizhou Minority Nationalties
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the literature review of the value chain governance and from the perspective of micro research on enterprise, this paper describes the value chain of the manufacturing firms of specialty products in minority nationalities and the key factors of geographical and cultural characteristics in value chain governance. Through the survey of the manufacturing firms in Guizhou Minority Nationalities, it also proves the hypothesis that the potential for more economic rent can be obtained with the use of ethnic culture and traditional techniques by the manufacturing firms of specialty products in ethnic minority areas. Namely, there might be an economic agent of master control in the manufacturing firms of specialty products in ethnic minority areas, who chases more economic rent in the value creation and benefits distribution during organization, coordination or control. The research results help to further understand the essence of the relationship between the participants in the value chain of minority business, so as to provide the policy reference for the forms of governance and upgrading strategy of specialty industries in minority nationalities.

articleTitle: Study on Model of the Large Merchandise Sales Logistics Base on E-business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The model of large merchandise sales logistics is both traditional and new. Model of Sales logistics does not fully realize the logistics flow and business flow separation. Enterprise are very few overall outsourcing logistics to the third party company and logistics operating costs is higher. Innovative model of logistics Base on E-business is that deliver large merchandise sales to the regional distribution center by the third-party logistics enterprise management and then distribution to customers. Business flow finish in e-business website, retail stores or shops. Capital flow is from customers to the retailer or store then to manufacturers. In the case of online sales, cash flow can be completed through a bank. Innovative model of logistics is better integration model of the large merchandise sales logistics then it achieve must to be co-operation, logistics outsourcing, information management and distribution benefits reasonable.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Empirical Study on the Management of Product Development Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: AHP Application in Objective Management of Coal Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Objective management and performance appraisal complement each other, promoting the innovation and originality of coal enterprises. Directed towards the difficulties in coal enterprises, this article built a multi-objective programming model, which decomposed the monthly targets of production, footage and coal quality into each production team, and obtained the crucial parameters with Analytical Hierarchy Process. This way we combined the qualitative methods and quantitative methods, which decreased the influence of subjective factors, and obtained reasonable decomposition result, providing coal enterprises scientific foundation for the implementation of objective management and performance appraisal.

articleTitle: Collaborative Integration and Management of Community Information in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The cloud computing paradigm has been receiving much attention recently, and data management applications such as e-business are potential candidates for deployment in the cloud. In this paper, we introduce CloudCDI, which is a platform for collaborative integration and management of community information in the cloud. We present the architecture for CloudCDI, which is based on cloud computing framework to facilitate collaborative management and pay-as-you-go integration of data in data centers. Furthermore, a unified data model, Resource Net Model, is put forward to represent unstructured, semi-structured and structured data inside a single model. We design a hierarchical resource view model to enable best-effort cooperation for community members. In order to access data in CloudCDI conveniently and efficiently, a scaleable query model is also proposed to facilitate users to move seamlessly from one query mode to another.

articleTitle: Knowledge Movement in the Knowledge Field of Industrial Integration: A Dynamic Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to study the dynamic mechanism of knowledge movement in industrial integration, the force of knowledge-spillover/transfer and the effect of integration on inter-organizational relation are analyzed in this paper based on both knowledge management theory and field theory. The results shows that the convergence force caused by the integration-effect gives a promotion for inter-organizational cooperation, so it is an useful way to improve the environment of knowledge movement by boosting the effect of integration on reducing the resistance of knowledge flowing and enhancing the impetus.

articleTitle: Study on the Holonic Agent-Based Integrated Electronic Commerce System of the Tourism Destination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Passing through more than 10 years development, many problems and obstacles still exist in China e-tourism, especially overlapping projects and single service of websites. This paper ascribes them to those non-integrated legacy systems, and strengthens the status of tourism destination as main body in the integrated system building. Aiming to the task-driven distributed intelligent attributes lying in the e-tourism task solving, the paper uses the HTN (Hierarchical Task Network) to represent tasks, and holonic agent to solving nodes and their organization. It clarifies the system construction, presents a logic formalism framework of holon from the angle of internal mental state, and exemplifies some details about the relationship between roles and nodes. Results of the study are expected to assist the integrated system building in e-tourism area, and then obtain the benefit of information integration and resource optimization finally.

articleTitle: The Management System of Order and Distribution Working Meals Based on Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The classical management system of working meals cannot satisfy the people's order. The management system of order and distribution working meals based on mass customization is presented, which applies the business intelligence and the electronic commerce technology. On the basis of classical single catering management model, the three layers management model of working meals is proposed, which is from center kitchen to planet kitchen, then to corporation users, last to employee users. The new management model achieves the bidirectional and closed-loop operation of material flow and information flow, guarantees the mass, individualized and standardized production and distribution of working meals. The software test and actual application indicates that the entire system runs well and it is very practical, advanced, and approved by users.

articleTitle: Research on ERP Application from an Integrative Review
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Enterprise resource planning (ERP) system is an enterprise management system, currently in high demand by both manufacturing and service organizations. Recently, ERP systems have been drawn an important amount of attention by researchers and top managers. This paper will summarize the previous research literature about ERP application from an integrative review, and further research issues have been introduced to guide the future direction of research.

articleTitle: Study on Incentive Mechanism Model of Tacit Knowledge Sharing in Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Tacit knowledge exists in knowledge workers in enterprises. To enable full sharing, reasonable knowledge sharing incentive and restraint mechanisms should be designed to accelerate spontaneous behaviors of employees so that it can improve the ability of innovation and competitiveness. According to principal- agency theory, and taking into account incomplete information of knowledge sharing, multi-stages incentive model of knowledge sharing for knowledge worker, and incentive model of knowledge sharing for knowledge team based on team sharing interests are proposed. The results indicate that, in order to acquire maximum rewards in enterprise, special incentive contracts are to be made for different knowledge main-bodies, optimal incentive decisions to meet enterprise own objective are to be made, and knowledge body's knowledge sharing effort is to be improved.

articleTitle: Establishment of Real Estate Appraise and Agence Industrial Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As the unique professional organization of national real estate, China Institute of Real Estate Appraisers and Agents (CIREA) make an important role in the improvement of profession actions and the regulation of enterprises and practitioners. With the rapid development of these two businesses, there are an increasing number enterprises coming up, and the amount of related practitioners is also growing. In another word, the more complex situation, that CIREA has to deal with, is a big challenge. The accumulation of massive information, from not only the enterprises but also the related stuff, demands for an effective and sufficient information management system to be established.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research of Personal Customer Relationship Management for Commercial Banks Based on Multidimensional Model of Customer Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Strategies of Mobile E-Commerce Development in 3G Age
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The article summarized the characteristics of China mobile E-commerce in 3G age. Then it analyzed the problems of law, safety, technology, payment and distribution in current development. At last, it provided corresponding development strategies of accelerating mobile E-commerce development in China.

articleTitle: Hotel Website Performance Evaluation: A Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Previous studies on hotel website performance have relied on frequency counting, content analysis or user behavioral approaches. These studies cannot accurately calculate hotel website performance in terms of user assessments of dimension/ attribute weighting and performance ratings. The aim of this research is to develop a scientific model that integrates a set of website evaluation dimensions for evaluating websites performance. Unlike previous studies, this research proposes a novel framework for evaluating website performance by using Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (Fuzzy AHP). Since human judgments are often uncertain and vague, using fuzzy set theory instead of exact numbers could integrate a decision maker’s uncertainty. This proposed method could rectify this limitation and provide a more accurate overall evaluation result.

articleTitle: Assessing ICT Impact: The Effects of ICT on e-Commerce Migration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this study, we proposed a set of constructs and used it to assess the effects of ICT on e-commerce migration-migrating toward internet-based e-commerce at firm level. We examined the validity of the instrument in terms of the relationships to e-commerce migration with data from 156 firms in China. A series of hypotheses were designed and tested, and the drivers and their contributions to e-commerce migration were determined. Our study found a significant relationship between ICT and e-commerce migration which measure was the extent of business processes implemented electronically in a firm. The result indicates that our measurement instrument have demonstrated value for capturing these ICT effects. The instrument can help managers assessing ICT impact more effectively, and better establishing of the favorable policies and conditions in order to facilitate e-commerce in firms.

articleTitle: Research on the Reengineering of Government Business Processes Based on the Environment of E-government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: By studying the concepts and the relationships of e-government and government business processes, this paper analyzes the necessity and describes the principles and objectives of implementing of government business process reengineering based on the environment of E-Government, analyzes comparatively the two modes of Government Business Process Reengineering. Finally it gives the steps and attentive problems of government business process reengineering based on the e-government environment.

articleTitle: Real Estate Business E-commerce System Research Based on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The complex production and market globalization etc make the supply chain become increasingly large. In this case, supply chain management becomes more complex, if real estate enterprises have not technical basis this management form would be difficult to achieve. As the competition in the real estate market get s more and more severe, it is difficult for real estate enterprises to gain advantages from technologies and products. E-commerce is a new type of enterprise management systems in this environment. We can nail down implemented methods and steps from the value of enterprises gained at different stages of e-commerce system and e-commerce implementation approach. It is helpful to the successful implementation of real estate business e-commerce.

articleTitle: “One Map”-Based Land Information System: Towards E-government for Land Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Land information system is one of the most important components in the construction of E-government. Such system can provide fundamental position and land property for other information, which is urgently required by the local government in China. “One map” is a new project launched by the Ministry of Land and Resources of China towards the construction of E-government for land management. Purpose of this paper is to design such “one map”-based land information system towards e-government. Firstly, the term of “one map” is discussed and defined, and the background of “one map” project is reviewed. Then, the contents of E-government for land management and general framework of land management are proposed. Finally, the design of framework, functions, software architecture, and general technical framework of software of "one map"-based land information system is presented.

articleTitle: Employer Branding Based on Job Pursuit Attraction: Constructure and Measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The study constructed a model and measurement on External Employer Branding based on job pursuit attraction, by an exploratory factor analysis with 110 participants of MBA students and a confirmative factor analysis with 225 participants of MBA students. We constructed 8 dimensions of instrumental attributes with 28 items and 6 symbolic attributes with 25 items. The questionnaire showed good constructive validity and reliability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research into the Crucial Factors of Successful Enterprise CRM - A Case of Haier CRM System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Enterprise Technological Innovation Models and Implementation Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The birth of Internet gave a brand new meaning to Technological Innovation. Information technology, the product of Internet, now is the important base and way to promote the Technological Innovation of enterprises. With the aim of helping enterprises improve the technological innovation ability, this paper discusses how to improve enterprise technological innovation ability based on Internet, proposes three models - User-Enterprise, Enterprise-Enterprise and Regional Technological Innovation Model, and points out the key steps of implementation.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Training Large Scale E-Business SVM Models in a Grid Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The Support Vector Machines (SVM) become popular E-Business data mining tools recently, and the datasets of E-Business are usually large-scale. If Support Vector Machines are trained on large-scale datasets, the training time will be very long and the classifier's accuracy will become lower too. As training a large-scale SVM is equated to solve a large-scale quadratic programming (QP) problem, so Path Following Interior Point Method (IPM) that can efficiently solve large scale QP problem in polynomial time is proposed to construct a new SVM learning algorithm on large-scale datasets. To improve the SVM learning efficiency, the dimensions of IPM direction equations are degraded first, then LDLT parallel decomposition method is used to solve the direction sub-equations efficiently, and the parallel algorithm is implemented in the ProActive grid-computing environment. The experiment results show that the new parallel SVM training algorithm is efficient and the SVM classifying accuracy is higher than libsvm.

articleTitle: Research of Mechanical Arm Real-time Motion Control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The main idea of this article is: enabling operators to directly control the robot hands via operating data glove, by using serial port communication technique and synchronous technology, based on robot hands, data glove and RS-232 serial line. First, the data glove hand and mechanical procedures together, the use of control technology to enable synchronization of data gloves in real time, accurate control of the manipulator; second, developed a prototype system, and a prototype system for testing, analysis, and finally system in accordance with the actual results of the appropriate improvements.

articleTitle: Pricing Strategies for Mobile Service Products with Vertical Differentiation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper introduces the quality of service products and network externalities intensity coefficient into consumer utility function, and analyzes the impact on market share and profits in incomplete market coverage of a duopolistic marketing with the difference of network externalities and quality of products. It's shown that the profits increased neither depend on the network externalities nor quality of products, but depends on the marketing strategy of the service products. Different quality of service products in the market competition has its own advantages.

articleTitle: Data Mining and Student e-Learning Profiles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Data mining techniques have been applied to educational research in various ways. In this paper, I presented the application of sequential data mining algorithms to analyze computer logs to profile learners in terms of their learning tactic use and motivation in a web-based learning environment (gStudy). The data mining algorithms are employed to discover patterns which characterize learners either across session or groups based on their study tactic choice and goal orientation. The use of this method is illustrated through a sequential pattern analysis of gStudy log files generated by university students.

articleTitle: The Operating Mechanisms and Analysis of Fourth Party E-payment Monitoring Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper is proposed to establish a fourth party e-payment monitoring platform, aiming at resolving the vicious competition among third-party e-payment companies, the unstable circulation volume of e-currency instability, the problems of the storage of financing deposition and customer interests and so on. Through the operation of the regular registration examination and approval system, the deposit insurance system, the incentive and restrictive mechanism, the monitoring platform will not only enable third-party e-payment platform to effectively regulate its operation, but also inspire the innovation of third-party e-payment companies.

articleTitle: High-tech Zone Technology Innovation Ability Evaluation with BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: High-tech industry zone play a important role in the global economic system with the continuously new knowledge innovation, it's becoming the main motion of regional economic structure optimization and competition. The technology ability and diffuse effect of High-tech zone influence itself and regional economic development greatly. This paper design High-tech zone technology innovation ability appraisal index system, and take integrated appraisal with BP neural network, a improved method is put forward to identification mode by Euclidean distance, and appraise a true sample with it.

articleTitle: A Method for Identifying the Industry Credit Risk Based on Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper proposes a new method for identifying the industry credit risk based on Markov chain. Firstly, a new credit rating model for enterprises based on Projection Pursuit and optimal partition is constructed, and then a credit state space of enterprises is established. Secondly, through calculating the non-conditional probability, the one-step transfer probability matrix of industry is obtained. Finally, through calculating the k-step transfer probability matrix of industry, the industry credit risk is identified successfully. Taking the high-tech listed companies in China as samples, it is proved that the method proposed by this paper is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Logistic Bottleneck of Taobao.com in C2C Model and Its Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The current status of C2C developing and the difficulties exist in logistics distribution have been discussed in this paper. It made an analysis on the elements which affect the logistics distribution of C2C and then put forward the countermeasures to improve the logistics distribution under C2C.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Public R&D Subsidies, Firm Innovation and Firm Performance - Empirical Evidence from Listed Companies in China's SME Board
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Data “Audit” Research Based on the Accounting Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, after the investigation and study the security situation of the accounting information system at home and abroad, analyzing the current security system of accounting information system with accounting data information security as an entry point, we want to construct a data "audit" model which draw on the experience of relevant principles of the black box in the aircraft, using the knowledge of accounting and auditing as well as relevant technologies about data encryption, digital signatures in computer data processing under the accounting information system. The establishment of this model can be achieved on the review, verification and validation of the source database, which in order to achieve the data in disguise from "audit". Once the source data in the database have been illegally tampered, you can use the data in the data "audit" model to verify and restore the source data in the source database, which can verify the security of the accounting data in source database and realize the source database data protection from another perspective.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Perceived Innovation Attributes and Innovative Adoption Intention: A Mediating Effect of Attitude
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Innovation attributes are not only the most important characteristics of the innovative products, but also have the major impact on the adoption speed. In this study, attitude is taken as the mediating variable, and the innovation attributes of product are defined according to the innovation diffusion theory and technology acceptance model, and the integration model of innovation attributes cognition and adoption intention is built as well. An empirical study takes 3G mobile phones as an example, and the model is tested by using 313 valid samples from six domestic cities. Studies showed that the innovation adoption behaviors are different between the individual consumers and organizational consumers, which will offer new explanations to the research of the individual innovation behaviors.

articleTitle: Research of Image Retrieval Based on Vocabulary Tree in Virtual University
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The demand of virtual database in implementation process of the virtual university were discussed, and further focused on analyzing a large scale image database for the virtual university in the necessity of demand for image retrieval. On this basis, a vocabulary tree image retrieval algorithm is applied to the virtual universities. Vocabulary tree is an efficient search data structure based on visual-keywords. Using vocabulary tree structure can improve the retrieval efficiency, and can meet the large-scale image database demand from the adaptability and scalability requirements, thus realizes the highly effective achieve virtual university.

articleTitle: On the Application of the Fuzzy Synthesize Evaluation to E-Commerce Websites
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The e-commerce websites are developing quickly, so it is necessary to evaluate them in order to find out the best one. In this paper, we use a fuzzy synthesize evaluation method to ecommerce websites, which is an effective multifactor decision-making method on making a comprehensive assessment of things influenced by many factors. Finally, we give an example to show its application.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Domestic Effect of Technological Progress on China's OFDI: Theoretical Analysis and Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: User Experience Based Adaptive Transmission Control in Network Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: UDP is usually used as the mechanism to transmit real-time video data. However, it has no control over the packet it transferred, and unaware of the network condition it is running on, such as packet loss, delay and jitter. As bandwidth is crucial for surveillance system due to its high bit rate and restrict time constraint, we focus on the packet loss problem in this paper which is mainly caused by congestion. We propose a simple and efficient user experience based adaptive transmission control approach according to the network's current available bandwidth, and implement Fast Downgrade Cautiously Upgrade (FDCU) algorithm. We encode video at several different image quality levels, and each level has different bandwidth requirement. Video will always be encoded at a quality level that matches current network condition. The goal is to provide user the best video image quality under the permissive bandwidth.

articleTitle: APT-Structure: Efficient Mining of Frequent Patterns
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Frequent pattern mining is a key step in many data mining applications. In this paper, we propose a simple and novel pattern growth algorithm, which uses a compact data structure named Array-based Prefix Tree (APT). The APT has a distinct feature that the space requirement can be predictable in advance. The memory usage of APT is less than FP-Tree that uses pointer to maintain the link between parent and child nodes, and the traversal cost is lower. The mining algorithm based on APT uses top-down traversal strategy, and unfiltered pseudo-construct conditional database, which can improve computational performance. Further computational experiments show that APT algorithm is more efficient, and performs better than FPGrowth* and AFOPT.

articleTitle: Tourist Perception of Online Hotel Bookings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This study examines the factors that have an impact on tourists' adoption of online channel. A theoretical framework explaining channel adoption behavior was built and empirically tested with a sample of 421 Hong Kong residents. Results of a logistic regression analysis show that the perceptions of channel and socio-demographics have a significant impact on tourist hotel booking choice between off-line and online channels. Tourists who make hotel reservations through online channel perceive significantly higher benefits of online channel and lower service quality of offline channel. The results of this study also suggest that demographics characteristics can impact on tourists' choice to different delivery channels.

articleTitle: The Application of DEA/AHP in Evaluating Comprehensive Benefits of Heating Equipments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To get the sort of the comprehensive benefits of the currently frequently-used heating equipments, this paper constructed a target system of the comprehensive benefits heating equipments. In the paper, with the use of DEA/AHP evaluation model, first of all, calculate the effective coefficient of the heating equipments consisting of input/output system; Then, using comparison matrix consisting of these effective coefficient, calculate the comprehensive benefits evaluation of the heating equipments. Avoiding the subjectivity of artificial to determine the matrix in AHP and DEA can not sort in a full-scale. Making the evaluation findings more objective and reliable.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Impact of Technological Innovation Capability on Business Growth: An Empirical Study for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A New Adaptive Service Provisioning Architecture for NGN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Adaptive and reconfigurable service provisioning is a promising research direction for NGN service technologies. It will lay the foundation of a converged network environment, in which users can feel free to enjoy various advanced services. In this paper we propose a new Adaptive Service Provisioning Architecture(ASPA) applicable to NGN. The architecture is composed of five subsystems enriching the current NGN service provisioning with novel capability of adaptation to user environment, network environment and service environment. Detailed modular structure of each subsystem is presented with emphasis on the description of adaptation capabilities. Finally an application example is provided to illustrate the rational of ASPA.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Model of System Synergy Management Based on Emergence Mechanism - Take the Constuction Project System as Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Studies show that the system thinking is a pattern of thinking following the emergence theory. Emergence theory gives a new perspective to promote the development and to improve the performance of complex systems. The happening of system emergence is a very complex process, but it isn't mysterious. When and where emergent properties would appear and what emergent properties would come forth can be forecasted by setting up conceptual model and framework. The following work has been done in this paper. Firstly, emergence mechanism is introduced. Based on emergence mechanism, emergence comes from component effect, structure effect and environment effect. Secondly, synergy management, especially interface synergy is proved to be one of effective ways to induce emergence by analyzing its emergent properties. Then the emergence process through interface synergy is discussed, the conceptual model of system interface synergy inducing emergence is established and the generalized flow of interface synergy is summarized. Finally, this paper takes the system of construction project as an example to illustrate the application of synergy management.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of Development Level of Principal Sports Industry Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Sports industry plays an important role in economic development and it is a new growth point of national economic development. This paper, based on the principles of scientificity, integrity, systematicness and maneuverability, selects indices from the perspective of mass sports development and athletic sports development, builds up an evaluation index system for the principal sports industry development, and determines the weight of index evaluation system. Also, this paper, has collected on the basis of some raw data, and makes a complete evaluation and analysis on the development level of athletic sports, mass sports and principal sports industry in Beijing, Guangdong, Shaanxi, Hubei, Hunan and the whole nation.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Investment Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper is a study on the identification and prevention of investment projects risks. The author makes a comprehensive discussion of the type of investment projects risks and divided it into business risk, financial risk and systemic risk. The causes of these risks are also discussed. According to the different types and causes of the risks, the author proposes targeted measures to prevent and control investment projects risks. This paper has certain of theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Fluctuation in a Multi-regional Economic Network Model with Community Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The multi-regional economic network model has recently been constructed to describe open economic systems and to study the strength of fluctuation in open economic systems. While our previous studies focused on a completely connected topology, here we address a topology with a community structure. We find that in such a economic network with the community structure, an open system suffers more fluctuations if it has a positive trade balance. In contrast, the open system enjoys less fluctuation, if the open system has a negative trade balance.

articleTitle: Government Intervention, Diversification and Firm Performance: Based on the Endogenous Investigation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Applying Simultaneous Equation Models With the data of publicly listed firms in china from 2001 to 2008, the paper analyses the performance of diversification based on the dual features of the government intervention and the endogeneity of Diversification. the empirical results indicate that diversification discount change into a significant diversification premium. In addition, government-controlled multisegment firms have lower MV/BV in average than non-government-controlled multi- segment firms while government-controlled single- segment firms have higher MV/Bv in average than non-government-controlled multi-segment firms. Overall, government intervention is not always Grabbing-Hand.

articleTitle: Research on Mass Customization under E-commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Mass customization will be as important to business in the twenty-first century as mass production was in the twentieth which has a close relationship with the e-commerce, since e-commerce provides a convenient and fast way for customers to request their personalized product. The aim of this paper is to present the architecture and system model of mass customization based on e-commerce between customer, manufacturer and supply chain. The implementation process of this customer driven mass customization system is described at last.

articleTitle: Component-Based Distributed System Analysis and Design of EDI
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper describes the background and development trends of EDI system, also gives an analysis of the existing EDI system which is summed up by the basic method and main functions, furthermore the existence of not unified operational standards, difficulty of integration, the inflexibility and poor- security of the used system and other outstanding issues are also discussed in the paper. The basic principles and ideas which are based on component technology and distributed processing technology are introduced to develop software. A set of components which are appropriate for distributed EDI System is designed. The components are assembled into a common distributed EDI system through component assembly technology. The paper has discussed the work process of distributed component-based EDI system and described the practical significance of the system and applications and prospects.

articleTitle: Income and Wealth Distributions in Money Exchange Models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The empirical works demonstrate that wealth distribution and income distribution have very similar characteristics. This fact makes some researchers fall into a confusion of the two distributions. As important economic variables, wealth and income are quite different in both concept and measurement. These differences should be recognized and embodied in the process of modeling and simulation. Taking the explicit definitions of wealth and income into account, this paper illustrates that income distribution is different from wealth one based on money exchange models. The numerical simulation results show that random exchanging with different trading rules exhibits different types of wealth distribution, but yields almost the same profiles of income distribution.

articleTitle: “Safe Harbor” Doctrine: A Panacea for Chinese Search Engine's Copyright Infringement Liability or Not
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Thanks to the increasingly progressing of search engines, millions of netizens enjoy free music download without pay. However, for the lack of efficient and effective regulations on this issue, copyright infringements caused by search engines have taken central stage in courtrooms. After “Ordinance on the Protection of the Right to Network Dissemination of Information” promulgated in 2006, “safe harbor” doctrine under US. 1998 Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) was introduced into China and the legal attitude towards copyright protection is going through a great change, which can be clearly seen from the treatment of two significant cases involving Baidu and Yahoo! China. After discussing the copyright infringement of search engines and these two cases, this article explores and analyzes “Safe harbor” doctrine of China and its improvement methods. Finally, this article concludes with some suggestions to the development of search engine industry, hopefully to realize a long time healthy progress and a win-win future.

articleTitle: Research on the Pre-warning Model of Enterprise Financial Crisis Based on the Information Entropy and PSO-ANN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The pre-warning of enterprise financial crisis is a hot studying spot in current theoretical field. This paper firstly overviews the present research conditions of enterprise financial crisis pre-warning, sets up a more perfect pre-warning indicators system. Then accomplishes dynamic pre-warning for the financial risk based on the great nonlinear function approaching capability of artificial nerve network(ANN). To simplify the space dimension of input information and reduce the complexity of network structure, the information entropy reduction theory is brought in. At the same time, aim at the main shortage of ANN (the converging speed is often slow and the network is easily involved in local optimum), this paper introduces the Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO). Thus establishing a pre-warning system to enterprise financial crisis based on the information entropy and the PSO-ANN, making the information reduction, the dynamic study and induction of ANN, the particle swarm optimization, the forecast and evaluation of enterprise financial crisis organically combined. At last, an actual example is given to justify the validity and efficiency of this model. The study can supplies a new means for the dynamic pre-warning of enterprise financial crisis.

articleTitle: The Service Innovation of Ticket Agency Industry Based on 4D Service Innovation Model - An Empirical Case Study on Cococ Ticket Mall
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The ticket agency industry is forced by the increasing worldwide competition due to the development of economic globalization and technology advancements. Competitive advantage undoubtedly can come from innovation in services. So innovation is now regarded as internal requirement for Chinese ticket agency industry to enhance the core competence. Since now many traditional ticket agencies transform into modern travel agencies, it is vital to research on the innovation models that help to clarify the innovation approaches for ticket agency industry. Therefore, this paper summarizes the methodology of service innovation, applying the 4D service innovation model on ticket agency industry. By taking Cococ ticket mall as an example, then this paper presents an empirical case study of the service innovation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Innovative Service Platform of Agricultural Economic Development - A Case Study on New Agricultural Cooperative Economic Organization Development Model of Yunnan Province in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research on Project Manager's Moral Hazard
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Employer-Based Research on the Risk Identification and Assessment for Large-scale Mining Shaft Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Internet Economics and Electronic Commerce Paradigm Revolution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Digitalization and Globalization is two kinds of trends in the world, which indicate a new kind of economic model will be coming. This makes a qualitative revolution in the productive forces and production relations. Human society and economic patterns are changing from the traditional capital economy to a digital economy. Some new economic things can not be explained by the old economic theories. New economic paradigm should be innovated according to Marxism economics. Economics innovation under the condition of the internet economy would be based on it and inevitably a mixture of Eastern and Western economics theories.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Indoor Positioning System Based on UWB
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, Ultra wideband technology and the main features of indoor positioning technology is introduced, focusing on the design and establishment of a UWB-based indoor positioning system model, the transceiver structure of the system is determined, and then location algorithm, the receiver synchronization and channel estimation and other key technologies conducted in-depth study. On this basis, the detailed simulation of the entire system using Matlab/Simulink software platform is carried out. It has been proved by simulation results s that UWB indoor positioning system provides good positioning accuracy and better performance.

articleTitle: A Scheduling Model for Soft Real-time Component System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Component technology is only available for business-oriented quality of service (QoS) management functions, can not satisfy the QoS requirements of soft real-time applications areas such as the multimedia and Web services. For real-time guarantee and improving resource utilization needs, this paper presents a real-time scheduling model for soft real-time component-oriented systems. First, the task model, component QoS specifications, resources container, resources container manager, and scheduler-related factors and their mutual relations are described. Second, the method for adding real-time mechanism to the component system is given. Finally, the scheduling algorithm is extended based on this model, and the resource container management algorithms are given, including access control algorithm, out of control algorithm, and QoS negotiation algorithm. The model meets the real-time requirements of applications and improves the system resource utilization together.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Industrial Competitiveness of Henan Coal Industry Based on the Improved Diamond Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Under the characteristics of the coal industry, this paper made related improvements to Michael Porter's “Diamond model”. Then this paper uses the improved model to analyze various factors of competitiveness of Henan coal industry. The conclusion is that competitiveness of Henan Coal Industry mainly comes from such factors as advantageous transportation, technological innovation. At the same time, this paper puts up relevant recommendations to various factors in order to enhance competitiveness of coal industry.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of College Undergraduate Software Talents Training Mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, there are more and more educational institutions with multi-talented and multi-level talent and the scale expands constantly. However, the problem that the talent structure is irrational and the software professionals cultivated by educational institutions can't meet the needs of enterprises hasn't been solved. This paper tends to deeply analyze the two reasons arising from these two situations and come up with a fundamental solution to solve China's two major problems and meet with our country's education system.

articleTitle: The Establishment on Performance Evaluation Indicator System of Government Financial Resource Integration and the Verification with Reliability and Validity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Firstly this paper elaborates that it is necessary to establish performance evaluation indicator system of government financial resource integration. Secondly, this paper establishes performance evaluation indicator system which can reflect the ability to integrate county government financial resources based on the character and realistic circumstances in Liaoning Province. Finally, reliability and validity analysis are introduced to test the established indicator system, and ultimately this paper determines performance evaluation indicator system of government financial resource integration.

articleTitle: The Study of Time-variable Law of Surfaces Deformation Based on EMD and Phase Space Reconstruction Technique
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Surface deformation of goaf is effected by a series of geological and mining conditions. In order to study the process of dynamic deformation, based on EMD and phase space reconstruction technologies, and the data of surface deformation monitored, this paper puts forward laws of surface analysis method of dynamic time-varying: First, the EMD technology was applied to extract the time-variable deformations of surface, then the phase planes of surface are constructed by using phase space reconstruction technique for studying the evolution of surface deformation. The test shows that by using this method the variation of time-variable deformation of surface deformation can be clearly shown.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Application of CRM in Logistics Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) has become an important business activity during the logistics process. Starting with the content of Customer Relationship Management, this paper introduces the application situation of CRM in logistics enterprises in China, and proposes a number of innovative approaches to CRM.

articleTitle: Analysis of Effect of E-Government on Avoiding Public Policy Failure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Prosperity and development of society depend on reasonable policies. However, some factors such as problem affirmation, information resources, executor of policy and so on can arouse policy failure. Financial policy failure is one of the fundamental causes of the current financial crisis originated in the US. In order to prevent occurring of similar crisis in China, efforts should be devoted to promoting technology innovation by means of financial development on the one hand, and devoted to developing E-government on the other hand. Financial system needs not only to provide financing for technology innovation, but also to promote technology innovation by means of financial services in respects such as information processing, risks management, supervision and incentive. E-Government can not only help officials to make scientific decisions and establish effective supervision system, but also help object of policy to understand policies better. Therefore, we should concentrate our efforts on developing E-Government in order to avoid policy failure.

articleTitle: Internet Media and Democracy Construction of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Internet is a kind of special media whose birth has brought great influences on democratic politics, in which there are both positive and negative influences. As the Internet is more and more popular, the population of net-citizens is increasing, so that the Internet media is used more and more widely in China, and plays an active role and also brings a negative role. Therefore, the Internet media must be guided correctly and controlled properly, and its positive roles should be played, so that democracy is enabled to develop healthily.

articleTitle: The Research of Environment Economy Decision Supportive System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, environment is deteriorating at a rapid pace. Traditional economic system and the environmental system is division. It is harmful to the current environmental protection work. Exploitation of Environmental Economic Decision Support information System (EEDSS) is based on the current environment and economic situation requires, and becomes a keystone. Taking environment economy system as a research object according to system engineering methodology and large-scale system theory, and integrating the computer GIS technology, environmental science, economy, this paper analyzes the structure and mechanism of environment economy system (EES),the logic structure, system structure and function structure were brought out, provides a EEDSS model. EEDSS focus on projection of economic environmental information management and decision-making support. In EEDSS, the information data of society economy and environment are saved, managed, shared and analyzed by the technique of GIS. It provides a scientific management and decision support for the development of environment economy.

Author Keywords: Environmental Economic Decision Support information System (EEDSS)

articleTitle: Joint Inventory Coordination Mechanism of Supply Chain under Fuzzy Demand Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the practical situation, market demand information is always fuzzy and expressed by fuzzy language. The existing inventory decision problems under fuzzy demand information are expanded to inventory coordination of the whole supply chain. And mathematical model of joint inventory coordination mechanism of supply chain under fuzzy demand information is proposed. A kind of transfer payment mechanism is also suggested to coordinate the benefit between supplier and distributor. The internal meaning of the mathematical model is manifested by numerical analysis.

articleTitle: The Credit-hype on Internet Trading and ITS Legal Control: Take the Case of Credit Storm Occurred in Taobao Net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The vigorous development of electronic commerce has resulted in the growing popularity of internet trading, but the wide spread of credit-hype on internet trading restrained its rapid development. it has become a hot topic for the whole world that how to control the credit-hype on internet trading. The harms and its causes has been analyzed that credit-hype would brought in this paper, and then the measures has been put up with that how to control the harms with the way of legislation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Simulation for Hotel Service Industry Based on Continued Fraction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper links dynamic simulation of hotel service industry to continued fraction interpolation theory and genetic algorithm, and derives a dynamic prediction modeling method of structural equation model, which can predict the future causality between system elements with no need of future sample data. All the simulation data of this paper is based on the actual one from Beijing hotel industry. The simulation results reveal that our algorithm has high fitting accuracy and authentic prediction model, and can be used for analysis and prediction of structural equation modeling.

articleTitle: A Study on the Determinants of Consumer's Atittude to IB Adoption: An Extended Research Based on TPB Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the fast development of IT, Internet Banking(IB) has become an important component of our daily life, and the research on IB consumer behavior has also become a hotspot in both theoretical and practical aspect. Based on TPB which analyze consumer behavior from atittude to behavior, subjective norm and perceived behavior control, the paper analyzed consumer's atittude to IB adoption(AIBA)'s determinants from IB service quality(IBSQ), customer perceived value(CPV) and customer perceived risk(CPR). We hoped to provide marketing or management suggestions to commercial bank's IB development and tried to make a new development about TPB.

articleTitle: A Game Analysis on Knowledge Spillover Effect - A Case Study of the Enterprises in the Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Knowledge spillover among the enterprises of a cluster is a profit game. In this paper, the author studies the process of knowledge spillover from the following three aspects: (1) Non-cooperative game: (2) Trust Game in the cooperation; (3)Infinitely repeated games based on complete information. Three conclusions can be obtained from the research: (1) If the game of knowledge spillover occurs for only one time in the short run, the two participants of the game will get into the Prisoner's Dilemma. And there will be no knowledge spillover. (2)The participant who makes knowledge spillover initiatively will be considered to have good sincerity of cooperation in the Trust Game of knowledge spillover, which will lower the minimum standards on expected earnings of the two sides. And it will be in favor of the occurrence of knowledge spillover. (3)If the discount factor in the infinitely repeated games is large enough, the Pareto-optimal strategy combination (spillover, spillover) can be achieved.

articleTitle: Research on the Procurement Issues of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise under the Conditions of Price Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The funds and scales of small and medium-sized enterprise are all smaller, for lowering operation cost, The SME in general is very concerned about their supplies of raw materials. And in the market, the price is volatile. To ensure that in such cases SME can make the best purchasing decision-making, this paper presents the use of dynamic programming ideas to solve this problem, Constructs of the procurement decision-making model.

articleTitle: Application of Value Management to Real Estate Project Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Value Management (VM) has proved to be one of the most effective methodologies to increase benefits as regards a given investment. However, VM is still not successfully applied to construction industry in China. This paper, based on value management approach and relevant theories like customer relationship management and core competence management, introduces a framework for real estate developers to apply value management to their project planning. Through a case study the paper illustrates how VM concept can be adopted in real estate investment. It is believed by the authors that adoption of value management in real estate project planning will bring with more benefits for both the developers and the customers.

articleTitle: A Discuss of the Application of Project Management in the Non-project-involved Organizations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
