abstract: This paper shows that project management exists in all organizations, only the form and degree of which exist varies from the different conditions of organizations. The paper introduces the background of the project management, and conceptions and methods of project management. Linked to the practice of the enterprise management, the paper studies the deficiency of the form and the application of project management in organizations, and proposes the thought, methods and tools as well as key points of resolving the problems about its applications.

articleTitle: Visualization of Potential Function of the Spherical Region Based on the Green Function Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The Green Function Method is one of the basic methods of studying the theory of electromagnetic field. This paper, starting from research ideas of the concept of Green Function and Green Function Method, solves the Green Function inside and outside the static field spherical region, based on solution to the Green Function, obtains potential function expression (mathematical model) of static field's spherical region, then programs the potential function using Matlab, and finally achieves visualization of potential function of the electric charge of the electric field inside and outside the spherical region.

articleTitle: Research on Task Space Model and Contract Mechanism Design of Knowledge Sharing in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Knowledge sharing in supply chain consists of a series of sharing activities. Characteristics of sharing activities are analyzed, then the three-dimension task space model is constructed and the properties of sharing activities are educed. Finally, the influence of task properties on contract mechanism design is discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation System of Basic Research Projects Outputs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy and increasing Capital Input of the Chinese government to basic scientific research, the evaluation of basic research projects outputs will be an important part of performance evaluation. Uncertainty and backwardness of value affirmation are the characteristics of basic research outputs, whose evaluation needs diversified participates, opening of evaluate process and becoming integrated part of normal work. The computer network and its related information technologies enable the development of information system of evaluation of the results of basic research projects. Information system of evaluation of basic research outputs based on internet can not only improve working efficiency, but also make the evaluation process fair, just and open. Based on the analysis of characteristics of basic research and review of existing works of the basic research outputs, we analyze the feasibility and necessity of informationizing of evaluation. The paper proposes the framework of a web-based evaluation system of basic research outputs.

articleTitle: Research on Optimizing Enterprise Knowledge Portal Based on Knowledge Architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Enterprise knowledge portal is a useful tool for facilitating competitive advantage of enterprise itself and whole supply chain. In this article we analyze optimizing mechanism of enterprise knowledge portal based on knowledge architecture. Organization system, navigation system and labeling system as three major optimizing methods are discussed in this paper. IBM/KDS as a practicable tool is introduced. We believe that through best practices of KA can point us to mobilize and optimize knowledge value in supply chain.

articleTitle: Competitiveness Evaluation Model for Supply Chain Systems of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Supply chain management system has become an important basis for competitive advantage. The supply chain system with efficient operation will play a more important role in building core competitiveness of enterprises, establishing cost-competitive advantage and creating customer value and so on. Therefore, it has an important practical significance to establish a competitiveness evaluation model for supply chain systems of enterprises with guide of strategy and combination of operations and practice in supply chain. The competitiveness evaluation model for supply chain systems of enterprises mainly includes the objectives, models, criteria and indicators analysis of the competitiveness evaluation for supply chain management and operational systems, and the direction and measures of supply chain systems to improve.

articleTitle: A Weighted and Combined Super Resolution Reconstruction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The weaknesses between L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> norm minimization estimator and L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> norm minimization estimator in the traditional super resolution reconstruction problem are analyzed. In this paper, L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> norm and L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> norm are weighted and combined to measure the data fidelity term, and based on an approximate total variation regularization method, a robust weighted and combined super resolution reconstruction algorithm is proposed. Simulation experiments show that this method not only enhances the quality of the restoration images and has better edge-preserving capability, but also efficiently removes the visual artifacts and is robust to noise.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Dualistic Antinomy between Innovative Ability and Activity of Entrepreneurs: Phenomenon & Explanation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Archival Utilization Service Based on Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper has analyzed the need for archiving under new knowledge-based economy, and the existing problems in current national archival services. The author has put forward a novel concept of knowledge-based archival service that can meet people’s requirement and can be fulfilled.

articleTitle: Game Analysis and Strategic Research on Watershed Management of Water Resource
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Principles and methods of Game theory were taken to analyze how to avoid conflict of stakeholder in watershed management, so as to attain multilateral cooperations under profit balance. Taking ChanBa watershed for a demonstration analysis, watershed management system and existing problems were expounded, game models between watershed administrative organization and administrative region, among different administrative regions were established, arrived at mixed strategy and dominant strategy equilibrium. The paper proposed coping strategies based on the result of game analysis in the end, i.e. improving management system, making clear of legal status, unified management of watershed and cooperative management of region, public participation in routinely management.

articleTitle: The Personalized Information Exchange Model for Colleges and Universities in Web 2.0
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Colleges and universities, as important knowledge storage bases, supply a platform for students to get knowledge, broaden their horizons, unfold themselves and display their individuality. However the current colleges' information systems are teacher-centered. Students' initiative and creativity are neglected and developed ineffectively. Web 2.0, including Blog, TAG, SNS, RSS, Wiki and so on social softwares, initiatives the ideas of open, sharing, participation, creation and user-centered which could meet the need of colleges' knowledge service. So this paper designs a personalized information exchange model for colleges and universities based on the Web2.0 technologies and furthermore develops the system and makes comment on it.

articleTitle: Analysis of Scientific and Technological Development in Sichuan Province Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The authors used the system dynamics methods, applied the Vensim PLE software to set up the dynamic structure model of technology development system, put up numerical simulation to study the principles of technology development system and the operational process, analyzed the power mechanism of technology development, so as to provide a reference for the future development of technology strategy formulation and effective implementation.

articleTitle: Online Human Resource Management Personnel Performance Evaluation System of B2C E-commerce Businesses Based on Projection Pursuit Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: B2C modern e-commerce businesses are developing rapidly as new modern enterprises, Their human resource management performance is a brand new topic across traditional management and modern information technology,In particular, e-commerce online staff performance management evaluation studies of B2C e-commerce enterprises is particularly important, because the line officer is the first e-commerce B2C business salesman. This paper builds an online human resource management personnel performance evaluation system of B2C e-commerce businesses based on Projection Pursuit Model, in comparison with other models, but also be able to overcome the effects of artificial subjective factors, so that a more objective evaluation results, which provide some useful reference to human resource management of e-commerce enterprises in China.

articleTitle: Effective Mining of Fuzzy Quantitative Weighted Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper presents a new method of mining weighted association rules, which can hold the “weighted downward closed property” by using an improved model of weighted support measurements in the weighted setting. Compared to some generalized weighted association rules mining, it proves that the method can quickly and efficiently mine important association rules.

articleTitle: E-commerce Research with Bass Product Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper applied the Bass product diffusion model to study the accumulative number of a selected electronic product online shopping in the area of electronic commerce. Used the statistic data, estimated the parameters of the model, predicted the accumulative number of online shopping in the coming years, and also examined the factors of the growth of online consumers and tested the fit of goodness of the model.

articleTitle: The Research about the Decision-supporting Based on Incompletely Information Game
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper aims to help the enterprises deciding whether or not go into a new market and analysising the project risks and ecomomic feasibility in this economic market, which information has not openness totally. The paper also explains how to determine based on the fuzzy mathematics research about using the method of circulation on the fuzzy mathematics to make the decision and the situation.

articleTitle: Design for Mobile Information System of Safety Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of safety management and effectively solve the problem in locale decision-making as well as standardize law-enforcing procedures, the mobile information system of safety management is designed. Based on the analyses of the safety management characteristics and information demand, bringing the advantages of portable and secondary development on PDA into full play, eight of function modules such as safety management and supervision of law enforcement were designed which can complete data communication with two editions of back-end supporting platform, such as Enterprise Edition and Management Edition. The experimental data prove that the mobile information system of safety management is an important technical means to realize the safety management informatization and enhance the level of safety management.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Mechanism of Customer-Based Brand Equity of Service Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the review of domestic and international research about brand equity and service marketing, this paper put forward a concept model which focuses on the influencing mechanism for the dimensions of brand equity and service marketing mix affecting customer-based brand equity of service enterprise. On the basis of the hypothesis model, by the samples of customers of china's telecommunication service enterprise, this article investigates the relationships between service marketing mix, the dimensions of brand equity and the entire brand equity. Presented empirical evidences indicate that the entire brand equity is constituted and affected by the dimensions of brand equity, service marketing mix impacts brand equity through impacting dimensions of brand equity. Finally, this paper analyzes the practical significance of the model to service enterprise's brand management and proposes the limits and directions for future research.

articleTitle: Relational Databases Access based on RDF View
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Large amounts of data in legacy system are stored in relational databases, and therefore there are requirements of exposing relational databases into RDF for the Semantic Web. RDF view based approach for accessing to relational databases is proposed in this paper, which provides SPARQL query services for relational databases. The SPARQL query over RDF view is rewritten into an equivalent SQL query executed against databases, and then results sets of SQL query are wrapped in RDF form. The prototype of this approach is feasible.

articleTitle: An Analysis to Critical Points of Making Profit through Investment Transaction Behavior without Transaction Costs and the Theoretical Basis of Stop-loss Point Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The mathematical model of the conditions for making profit through investment products transaction behavior under no transaction costs is developed in the paper, by which the critical points of making profit through the investment products transaction behavior are obtained. They are critical proportion of the times of winning and losing when the winning and losing are at the same scope, the critical proportion of the scopes of winning and losing when the winning and losing times are the same. The model has closed relation to the investor's successful or failing operation, so it is significant to the choosing of reasonable investment strategy. The research results indicate that the stop-loss point method originating from the investors' experience has some theoretical basis in such market as stock market and futures market with fluctuating prices.

articleTitle: Covert Communication for DTD Documents Slicing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this work, a novel covert communication method for DTD documents is introduced. The relationship is found between an arbitrary 0,1 string and DTD documents. According to some slicing criterion, a secret communication is completed. Furthermore, a covert communication model is also proposed and an algorithm is discussed in detail. The method is imperceptibility and anti-extractable.

articleTitle: Novel Method for Fishery Supply Chain Risk Diversity and Insurance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Supply chain management had become part of the senior management agenda in the manufacturing and retailing industries. More recently, interest in supply chain management has also been growing in the fishery industry both in developed and developing countries. Along with the occurrence of several catastrophic events in fishery supply chains, fishery risk diversity and insurance problems become more and more important. For lacking sufficient knowledge about the exact probability of the fishery supply chain contract signatory or insured accidents, in the fishery supply chain risk diversity and insurance process, the fishery supply chain risk insurer usually uses the information supplied by the fishery supply chain contract signatory or fishery supply chain insurants and the behavior performed by the fishery supply chain contract signatory or fishery supply chain insurants to establish the parameters of the fishery supply chain insurance contract. In this paper, the fishery risk diversity and insurance problems in such supply chain risk diversity and insurance cases are studied based on the fishery supply chain insurance contract and the behavior of each participant.

articleTitle: Realization of XML-Based ETL Process of the Regional Health Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Regional Health Information System (RHIS) plays a vital role in health information building in which the crucial and difficult part is how to effectively integrate data from heterogeneous database. XML (eXtensible Markup Language) can solve the problem when it has been put into RHIS because of it has the function to integrate massive data and HL7, the exchange standard of health information field, has syncretized XML in its third version.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Empirical Study of the Weak Efficiency of China's Foreign Exchange Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis of Evaluation Index System of Innovation Situation of Service Enterprise-Analysis Based on the Service Enterprises in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the era of knowledge-based economy, the contribution of innovation of service enterprises to economic development is growing, but the existing theories are focused on technological innovation of manufacturing enterprises mainly. Comparing to manufacturing enterprises, service enterprises pay more attention to the innovation to satisfy customer demand and accumulate knowledge. This paper establishes the services innovation evaluation index system of the service enterprises on the basis of service sector innovation index (SSII), and make an empirical test of the indicator system which is based on service enterprises in Zhejiang Province to prove its scientificity.

articleTitle: Study on the Like-biological Regulation in M&A
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: M & A is similar to the hybrid method of the biology, so it is possible to exist the like-biological regulation in the M & A activity. For studying the corporate biological-like regulation,it has made the series supposition and the corporate biological-like regulation were discovered including gene separation regulation and free combination regulation. It has pointed out the difference between the corporate biological-like regulation and the biology heredity regulation and also has discussed the idealism and the satisfied qualification of the corporate biological-like regulation. The author has used the corporate biological-like regulation to explain the integrated culture models and the combination models of the culture and technology in the M & A activity.

articleTitle: Mobile Commerce Role Chain Model Based on Customer Value Perceived
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Wireless communication and Internet services are converging to provide an unprecedented level of convenience for online shopping. Based on the review of value theory, especially on the newly research on the perceived value, the authors develop a framework that incorporates ten kinds of roles and three layers, as well as value chain. Because of the pervasiveness of perception criticality as an important characteristic of the mobile commerce, they also investigate the influence of consumers' value consciousness. This study focuses on the perceived value of a new service delivery Model, presents the Mobile Commerce Value Chain Role Model. They reveal that the value perceptions, which in turn influence behavioral intentions of customers.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Constituting Factors of Business Process Outsourcing Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With IT development, BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) has become the developing trend for service outsourcing, which has attracted more and more people’s attention. This paper gave a new explanation on the definition of BPO, and analyzed the factors influencing BPO service quality based on BPO characteristic analysis.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of Social Stable State in Industry Shift of Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Mandatory Access Control Based on Security Label
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes scheme and technologies to fulfill the mandatory access control model based on security label, and discusses few aspects of security label, including definition, composition, storage structure, compare algorithm, implementation. Because security label plays an important role in highly secured database system. The scheme for an independent copyright database management system Logic SQL is implemented. The paper designed at least the B1 security level for LogicSQL database.

articleTitle: Educational Blog and Its Impact on Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The Blog and its characters are introduced, together with its developing, classification and functions. Its influences on education are researched, which are the influences on professional development of college teacher, influences on learner's autonomic learning, influences of educational Blog on instruction content and environment. The conclusion is that educational Blog has huge impart on education, and is worth implementing an educational Blog in educational fields, and worth accelerating the process of its application and extension in the educational field in our country.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Performance Evaluation of E-government Based on BSC and Fuzzy Borda Number Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Through a review of status quo of research on evaluation at home and abroad, the paper analyzes in depth BSC and fuzzy Borda number method, makes their respective advantages complementary to each other and establishes a new comprehensive performance evaluation model of e-government combining BSC with fuzzy Borda number method, so as to make up for the disadvantages of BSC which can not give relative weight of each indicator and make more scientific and rational evaluation of those governments which have their own advantages and disadvantages of each dimension. A numerical example is discussed to demonstrate the methods to evaluate e-government performance based on BCS and fuzzy Borda number method.

articleTitle: Application of Association Rules Mining in Marketing Decision-Making Based on Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Appling association rule mining to merchandise marketing decision-making can supply references to optimizing decision-making project. The paper introduces the principle of using rough set in knowledge mining of merchandise marketing. First, consumed market-relevant attributes are simplified by rough set theory. And then, association computation rules based on rough set are constructed to reduce the scale of the decision table. Giving an example, it explains how auto market behavior characters affect result of car sales decision-making.

articleTitle: Imprecise Semantic Web Ontology Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The Semantic Web ontology is a partial ordering set of concept used to make information have semantic markedness. The enclosing type and the educing type are the ways of forming a concept in human brain. They are related to the fuzziness and the roughness respectively. The imprecise concept is actually the fuzzy rough concept, but there is no existence of the imprecise partial ordering relation. The Semantic Web ontology is a fuzzy rough concept partial ordering set, namely, a binary pair composed of a fuzzy rough concept set and a kind of partial ordering relation. It could be represented as two types of practical forms: the fuzzy rough concept list and the fuzzy rough concept lattice, the latter has good properties with compactness and exclusiveness, so could be as a base to code a compact and normative OWL document which helps the Semantic Web to come true.

articleTitle: Platform Engineering in Enterprise Application Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Although component-based software development, model-driven development, software product line engineering, and similar things considerably improve software productivity and software quality, modern web based enterprise application development is still facing great challenges. This paper addresses how to deal with the complexity of enterprise application development via platform engineering (PE). We also propose the lessons learned in PE, challenges we are still facing, and some open issues we need to discuss.

articleTitle: Ambidextrous Capabilities and Innovation Performance - The Moderating Effect of Entrepreneurial Orientation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Do the simultaneous pursuit of exploitative and explorative activities will add to or detract from innovation performance? We develop a model of firms as essentially ambidextrous, i.e. as engaging in both exploitative and explorative behavior. According to dynamic capabilities, we find that firms with ambidextrous capabilities - those that both use exploitative capabilities and build explorative capabilities indeed exhibit better innovation performance. Also, the entrepreneurial orientation (EO) has positive moderating effect of on the relationship between capabilities and innovation performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Trust Management Model for P2P Network with Reputation and Risk Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A novel decentralized trust management model with reputation and risk evaluation is proposed (RFTrust). Trust is an essential ingredient of the transaction process. Trust and risk are two closely related factors to make transaction in an uncertain environment. RFTrust model establish the credibility by calculating current reputation and acquiring the risk evaluation which represents the accumulative assessment of the long-term transaction behavior. Simulation and theoretical system show that RFTrust has advantages in combating various malicious behaviors such as dishonest feedbacks from malicious peer, the collusion and the strategic attacks to the trust model itself, and surpasses the current trust models. This model is more robust on trust security and more predominant in successful transaction rate than other trust mechanisms.

articleTitle: Dynamic Trust Model Based on Perceived Risk
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, more and more people use the Internet to transact. In order to be successful transactions, it is need to establish a certain trust relationship between people In order to manage the trust relationship, trust model have been proposed. Based on the past trust model, a Dynamic Trust Model based on Perceived Risk is given in the paper. The perceived risk is divided into six dimensions under the peer environment according to this trust model. And use perceived risk and other factors to conclude the ultimate trust. The ultimate trust will be the basis to determine whether a transaction is carried out. The simulation which there are malicious users and deceive user in the transaction shows that this model can effectively improve the success rate of e-commerce transactions, thus reducing the loss of users.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent based Model for Resource Oriented Automated Negotiation in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The concepts of automated negotiation and its two kinds of resource are introduced firstly. Secondly is the analysis of the demands for resource oriented automated negotiation. Thirdly is the rough design of framework of the whole environment, the user system, the three kinds of agents and their interaction. At last the detail design of negotiation, the most important one of those three kinds of agents, is provided to implement the learning ability from experience in automated negotiation.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Factors which Affect Consumers' Online Shopping Behavior
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper studies the factors of affecting consumers' online shopping behavior. The factor model of online shopping is constructed on the basis of theoretical research and china's reality. And the model is tested by LISREL8.7. This paper also puts forward the suggestions of promoting the consumers' online shopping.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Competitiveness of Supply Chain Customer Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Trust Model Based on Bayesian Network in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Trust is a key constraining factor in the development of electronic commerce. The parties must establish a certain trust model between each other before the beginning of transaction. This paper analyses the advantages and deficiencies of existing models, and presents a trust model for E-commerce based on Bayesian network. The model is based on Bayesian network and conditional probability formula, introducing conditional probability table, fully considered the impact of major factors which have relationship to formal e-commerce transactions, raising the transaction success rate to a certain extent. Meanwhile, this model introduces the time decay factor and the incentive factor, reducing the generating probability of malicious node.

articleTitle: The Application of Electronic Business in Transnational Operations of Small and Medium Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Compared with traditional business electronic business (e-business) has the advantages of globalization of markets, convenience, low cost and high efficiency. It has changed the business philosophy and modes of operation in traditional business, and the changes have a deeply significant effect on transnational business of small and medium enterprises (SMEs). Compared with large enterprises SMEs are at a disadvantage in strength in transnational operations, but the application of e-business brings new opportunities for SMEs. Therefore, SMEs should take full advantage of the opportunities e-business has brought and e-business's functions of advertising, information and business in order to improve their own international competitiveness and operate internationally.

articleTitle: Research on Relatively Important Indicator Extraction by Means of PCA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper aims at disclosing the process and steps of the relatively important index extraction by means of PCA, on the basis of analyzing the principle and theory of PCA and its application in the establishment of evaluation index system on the contribution of infrastructure construction to the coordinated urban-rural development. And the paper may function as reference source for the establishment of some other index system in practical research.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on the Third Generation Urban Planning E-government Platform - Taking Nanjing as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper takes the third generation urban planning e-government platform of Nanjing as an example, introduces its background and working target, describes its main characteristics and general system framework, discusses the key technologies of platform construction. Simultaneously, the authors illuminate exploration and practice of platform on aspects such as system integration, resources integration, government affairs transparency, then lastly prospects its recent development.

articleTitle: Automatic Information Extraction from E-Commerce Web Sites
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, online transactions has become an important part in people's lives, in order to support the smooth development of e-commerce activities, how to provide users with efficient and practical product information has become an urgent and critical problem. This paper presents a set of novel techniques based on page similarity measure, page clustering and wrapper generation to automatically extract data from E-Commerce web sites. Experiments on real web sources show the effectiveness of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Analyses on the Antecedents to Service Repurchase Intention: A Survey of Hotels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In star-rated hotel services consumer's repurchase intention is affected by many factors. According to the theory of value creation, this study filters out four dimensions of functional, symbolic, experienced and cost value, as the antecedents, and selects expectation disconfirmation as mediating variables. We survey 29 star-rated hotels and 105 service personnel, and analyze the data with exploratory factor analysis and structural equation. As a result, expectation disconfirmation has a significant effect on moderating repurchase intention of star-rated hotel, and functional value and experiential value are more likely to produce service repurchase intention.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Development Stages and Trend of Digital Urban Management in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Digital urban management is an important means to implement E-government. This paper reviews the development stages of digital urban management in Zhejiang province of China, illustrates the significant benefits in the construction, and discusses the development trend of digital urban management. The analysis will provide useful references for promoting the construction of digital urban management in Zhejiang province.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Defense Procurement Entry Right Allocation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper studies the allocation of defense procurement entry right and designs a allocation mechanism of defense procurement entry right. The result shows that the allocation mechanism satisfies strong incentive compatibility, a condition stronger than incentive compatibility. So the allocation mechanism can always get the allocation the military desires, no matter whether the manufacturers' technology levels are complete information between manufacturers or not. Next work is to design an implementation mechanism to implement the allocation mechanism.

articleTitle: Knowledge Transfer in the Framework of Triple Helix Model: A Case of Sweden
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As one of the main bodies of research and development, Swedish universities, who rank top worldwide in getting public funding, should highlight their responsibility in transferring knowledge into productivity in the construction of national innovation system within the new organizational field ``knowledge-based economy''. Based on the framework of Triple Helix Model, the paper describes and evaluates the dynamic mechanism of knowledge transfer from academia to industry. Conclusion draws here is : the model of knowledge transfer in Sweden is mainly state-pulled, corporate-pushed and university-coordinated.

articleTitle: The Application Research of Web 2.0 in Customer Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Web 2.0 is the general designation of a kind of interactive Internet application, the main characteristic of Web 2.0 relative to Web 1.0 is that more attention paid to the interaction with the customer. The important content of Customer Relationship Management is the interaction between the corporation and the customer, so most technology and application of Web 2.0 can be used in Customer Relationship Management. This paper discussed how to apply the popular Web 2.0 applications in the process of Customer Relationship Management to improve the function and the efficiency of Customer Relationship Management.

articleTitle: Study on the Third Party Logistics Development under the Condition of Electronic Business Rapid Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, e-commerce which has taken information technology, business technology and management techniques together is at an alarming rate getting into the people's production and life, promoting the pace of economic globalization, trade liberalization and information modernization. However, when the network security technology and certification system have been increasingly sophisticated, the lag of third-party logistics development has been becoming a major obstacle to the development of e-commerce. To solve this problem, writer of this paper first examines the relationship between e-commerce and third-party logistics, through the SWOT analysis of third party logistics development, and then presents the countermeasures of third-party logistics development.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Inter-regional Electricity Trade Cooperative Based on Shapley Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Inner Mongolia, northern China's resource-based regions, is a large province of power output. State Grid Corporation plans to construct special high-voltage transmission channels for the Autonomous Region Electric Power Delivery in Inner Mongolia. As the monopoly of power industry, the output cross-power energy trading in Inner Mongolia mainly have two ways: Point on the network and the network of networks. This paper studied Decision-Making Optimization in Inter-regional power grid, established person cooperation game model between interconnected power system by using Game Theory, discussed the effectiveness of the distribution between various network members based on Shapley Model, and optimized and improved solving measures. Through analysis and research, the paper proposed feasible suggestions for inter-regional energy trade cooperation in Inner Mongolia Power Grid.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Industrial Transfer and Economic Development in Less Developed Regions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Application of Web GIS in E-Government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we utilized the ActiveX component and XML technology, developed a small and simple component of Web GIS at the bottom level which has been applied in the e-government system. The advantages of this study include three aspects, adopted XML files to store the GIS information which make the information be more suitable for network transmission; developed a applicable and powerful system through integrating the Web GIS with E-Government.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Performance Evaluation of Universities Governmental S&T Investment Based on DEA Super
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm of Ordinated Management Control for Complex Systems in Urban Public Transport Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A well-operating urban public transportation system has a wide range of requirements in many aspects such as route design, station density, scheduling management, demands analysis, service level, and so on. In order to analyze and research such complex system, a method is to use a computer simulation which simulates the behavior of individuals in complex systems, so that a group of such individuals in virtual environments created by computer interact and evolve; thereby the behavior complexity of the whole system "emerged" out. Another method is similar to the human brain with limited rationality and some uncertain information to make rational decisions when faced with complex system. We make a reasonable description of the operating state of system; constitute the rules of system operation with the accumulated experience, so we can control the system in according to above rules. This is a top-down "control" approach. For the existence of limitations in model designing and algorithms for urban public transportation systems in the practical application, this paper serves the problem of coordinated management control in urban public transport system as the research object. Dividing this system into seven interrelated subsystem, namely the line subsystem, station site subsystem, the vehicle subsystem, the driver and conductor subsystems, service management subsystem, the public traffic information subsystem, bus-taking demand subsystems of the residents, this paper analyses the state vector and control vector of each subsystem, constructs a dynamic system model and make parameters identification and forecasting. A more simplified coordinated management control algorithm is presented.

articleTitle: Application of a Combination Forecasting Model in Logistics Parks' Demand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Logistics parks' demand is an important basis of establishing the development policy of logistics industry and logistics infrastructure for planning. In order to improve the forecast accuracy of logistics parks' demand, a combination forecasting model is proposed in this paper. Firstly, we use grey forecast model and exponential smoothing method to predict the demand respectively, then we combine the two results by using simulated annealing algorithm (SSA) to select appropriate weight. Experimental results show that the combination forecast model obtain lower total absolute error and average absolute error.

articleTitle: The Application of MATLAB Platform in the Teaching of Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Aiming at the course characteristics of Digital Signal Processing (DSP), the powerful data-processing and visualization software MATLAB is introduced into the course teaching. To this end, the MATLAB is seamlessly linked with the powerful word-processing software WORD with the help of MATLAB notebook, and then the teaching content combined with text and diagram, static and dynamic are realized in the teaching, which overcomes the cumbersome processes in the traditional multi-media teaching, in which the switches from one application program to another one is needed in order to present the results. Meanwhile, along with the course teaching, a course experimental system of DSP is designed based on the MATLAB platform. Through the computer simulation of the experimental system, the students can further apprehend and master the basic concepts, relevant theories and analysis methods of DSP. These will help improve the course teaching progress and effectiveness of DSP.

articleTitle: Customer Relationship Evaluation System Based on BP Neural Network in Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Customer relationship management is one of the most concerned marketing and managing strategies in management and research fields. Effective evaluation of customer relationship is the precondition and indemnification to achieve the objective of customer relationship management. The BP neural network is applied in this paper to research the models of customer relationship evaluation, which has great advantages and feasibility. A customer relationship evaluation criteria system based on customer loyalty and customer satisfaction is discussed. This paper also describes analysis of a customer relationship evaluation system based on neural network technology that is implemented using ASP.NET 2.0, SQL Server 2005 and MATLAB, conceptual design of the system, and implementation of the system. The functions of this system include customer evaluation, query, sample data maintenance etc. The better practicability of the customer relationship evaluating method based on the BP neural network is showed by the final results of evaluation.

articleTitle: Study on Enterprise Informationization Models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to the present situation of the Chinese enterprise informationization, the Chinese enterprise informationization models are analyzed. Compare the deficiency of traditional enterprise application integration, it is deeply discussed that are the technology standard, loose coupling and high efficacy of Web Service in modern enterprise application integration. Based on these characteristics, the Web Service technology-based enterprise application integration framework is proposed.

articleTitle: Logistics Distribution Center Location Decision-making Model Based on Simulation Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A reasonable layout of the logistics distribution system can significantly reduce business operating costs and improve logistics system operating efficiency. The operation characteristics and physical resources of third-party logistics and distribution system focused in this article, the key parameters of the distribution system operation efficiently and stably get summarized. Through simulation and optimization method, a optimization model is built. To minimize customer churn rates and operating costs is taken as the optimization objective, meanwhile the system configuration parameters as decision-making variables. Ultimately a logistics company is taken as a research example to verify the scientific decision-making model and effectiveness.

articleTitle: The Risk Assessment of E-commerce Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to effectively evaluate the risk of e-commerce, this paper applies BP neural network to establish risk assessment model, and then use the MATLAB neural network toolbox to process the learning, training and simulation of the model, at last the model is applied to the practice to make the sensitivity analysis of e-commerce risk factor. The result shows that: the method provides an effective method for e-commerce risk assessment, and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Research on Inspiration Mechanism of Knowledge Sharing Based Motivations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Knowledge sharing as a key factor in knowledge management, its importance has long been valued by entrepreneurs, scholars also have made a great deal of research towards this issues. However, how to overcome obstacles of knowledge sharing and stimulate the sharing behavior of employees have not formed a clear context until now. This paper attempts to make employee motivation as entry point, classified employees accordance with motivational orientation of behaviors, and design targeted inspiration measures of knowledge sharing. From a psychological point of view, promote knowledge sharing acting and build an incentive mechanism for helping enterprises maximize shared resources have important practical significance.

articleTitle: A System Dynamics Approach for Corporate Waste Recycling Capacity and Income
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The simulation model of corporate waste recycling capacity and income was established by system dynamics approach and the results showed the recycling capacity and income were increased in long-term. On the condition of changing systemic parameters, the simulation results showed governmental subsidy has a littlie effect on recycling capacity and income, while market risk has a great effect on recycling capacity and income. And then, suggestions were put forward after analyzing the reasons.

articleTitle: An Approach for Constructing Knowledge Map Embedded in the Social Relationship Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Implicit knowledge has been always the difficulty for enterprise knowledge management, and expert map or knowledge map may help enterprises manage implicit knowledge. This paper materializes implicit knowledge sharing system by management of experts and their social relations, puts forward the way of constructing the knowledge map in line with business process and experts' social relations, portrays the general framework of the system, illustrates the data storage model, introduces major processes of the system, designs the social relationship-based approaches recommended by experts and implements the system.

articleTitle: Federation Access Control Model Based on Web-Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Single Sign-On is one of the more popular enterprise business integrated solution currently. For the complex self-domains across different application requirements, the article researches the traditional single-point sign-on system, and presents a combined access control model. The main form of the model is implemented on Web-service. It extends RBAC access control model, proposes R-R role mapping concept and makes use of extensible policy language SAML and XCAML. At last implement of the application the model is verified on the existing system and we propose the problems to solve next step.

articleTitle: An Exploration of the Case-teaching Model Based on Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As the increasingly competition in the society, it is more difficult for the traditional teaching model to meet the teaching requirements, and more difficult to meet the demand of the community for high-quality engineering and technical personnel. It is urgent to reform the current teaching model to improve the quality of teaching and classroom, to enhance students' comprehensive analysis ability and mastery of knowledge. A new case teaching model based on engineering is put forward in this paper, it's defined as follows: students play the main body to the information excavation; they choose engineering cases, independently analyses, and lecture, discuss the engineering case, with the purpose of knowledge application in technology and to improve the overall quality of the students.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the Influence of Job Pressure on Staff's Performance in Service Industry - Taking Emotional Labor and Job Burnout as Intermediaries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Risks of Enterprises Logistics Outsourcing under Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Logistics outsourcing has become a new management mode due to the advantages such as reducing logistic cost, strengthening the core competitiveness, accelerating cash flow and so on. Logistics outsourcing brings a number of benefits to enterprises, as well a large number of potential risks. From the process of logistics outsourcing the paper deeply analyzes many risks that enterprises must face in the process of logistics outsourcing, and on this basis provides corresponding risks control strategies to provide a theoretical basis for the successful implementation of logistics outsourcing.

articleTitle: Organization Strategies Research of Teachers Forum from the Perspective of Collaboration Knowledge Construction - Take Teachers BBS of Teachers Forum Network as a Research Case
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The interactive behavior of teachers based on forum is studied from the perspective of collaboration knowledge construction in this paper. By selecting teachers BBS of Teacher Forums Network as a case, the purpose is to obtain the quality and the problems existed in interaction of teacher forum, as well as to present organizational strategies of teacher forum which can promote collaboration knowledge construction, including Promote the Peripheral Participation strategy, the Information Attribute Classification strategy and the View Convergence strategy.

articleTitle: OPES: An On-line Practice and Examination System Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: On-line practice and examination is a new trend of interactive remote teaching and learning. By providing practice and examination content, OPES realizes another distributed and asynchronous learning atmosphere for students. OPES is carried out under the B/S design model with student, teacher, system administrator three functional roles. During the practice procedure, the practice content is focused on the users' weakness of knowledge by dynamic adjusting questions. After each time of practicing, OPES will summarize and export the weakness and blind spots of user as guidelines. Students can capture detailed knowledge under the instruction of guidelines. The exam questions are generated randomly under the testing thematic with scientific counting distribution. To reduce the burden of clients, all the operations are executed on the server side and the clients only received execution results by JSP technique.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Coupling about Water and Land Resources in the Process of Urbanization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the background of the current supply and demand of land and water resources has become increasingly acute contradictions, this paper conducted a study of coupling effects of land and water resources, making the region of the use for system land and water resources to optimize the rational allocation. The paper established the coupling effect model, and discussed the process of the genetic algorithm to solve multi-objective in detail, calculated the model which established on the papers, maximize mining the inherent potential of the resources systems, achieved the development goals of the sustainable utilization of resources. Finally, take Xi'an Chanba ecological zone for example to make empirical solving, obtained the optimal results of the water and land resources coupling, provided the basis for land and water resource allocation research of system coupling.

articleTitle: Intelligently Predict Project Effort by Reduced Models Based on Multiple Regressions and Genetic Algorithms with Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Estimating the amount of effort required for developing a software system is one of the most important project management concerns. This study successfully produces an optimal reduced linear model for software cost estimation by employing a series of methods of multiple regressions to identify the most significant explanatory variables of the fifteen COCOMO cost drivers. The results yielded by the linear models are then compared with their counterparts obtained from the simulation using genetic algorithms with feed-forward neural networks (NN) with back-propagation learning algorithms. The performance of the resulted optimal reduced linear model is very close to that of the full regression and neural network models, and is also comparable to that of the COCOMO'81 intermediate in terms of MMRE and Pred (25). As both linear and nonlinear reduction methods described in this paper are applied and the most significant nine explanatory variables selected among the fifteen COCOMO cost drivers in these reduced models are the identical and their effort estimation accuracy is highly acceptable, the reduced models can be concluded as accurate and robust.

articleTitle: On the Public Participation in Environmental Management in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Public participation in the environmental protection has been increasingly valued. This thesis firstly makes a brief literature review. Then, from the perspective of the investigation result of automobile industry chain and Chinese corporate social responsibility in 2006, it discusses the significance, present status and limitation of Chinese public participation in environmental protection. As for the characteristic of Chinese public “attention without participation”, the trinity of the Rational Ecological Man is put forward as the solution finally.

articleTitle: A Uniform Utility Function for Delay and Disruption Tolerant Mobile Internet Access Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Utility function recently has been adopted in network studies to describe quality of service. However, the existing utility functions focus only on the effect of power or throughput, so are not suitable to delay and disruption tolerant networking (DTN), where delay and disruption have major impacts on the utility and cannot be ignored. This paper proposes a corresponding sigmoid utility function, which takes into account of the delay and disruption factors. The analytics of the utility function on different services shows that the new function is effective in the context of DTN. Moreover, there does still not exist a uniform general utility function for diversified network services in form. After analyzed current utility functions on constant bit rate service, variable bit rate service and asynchronous and synchronization services, amendments or deformations were made to put forward a uniform general utility function of all of the above as a conclusion.

articleTitle: Study on Business Models Transformation of Online Travel Services Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Though online travel services industry has been going through rapid growth, the business models were ambiguous and immature. Even the leader CTrip.com learns by trial and error. Therefore, study on business models transformation of companies in this industry is significant, especially on those medium-and-small ones because they are in the majority. In this work, we evaluate the business model of a new online travel services provider which has been evolved from a large ticket agent. The evaluation is based on in-depth investigation of the company, and a classical theory of business models is applied.

articleTitle: Inter-organization Collaboration Management in Dynamic Virtual Alliances
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The agility to collaborate in business networks has become essential for the success of both individual organizations and business value networks. The dynamic nature of alliances environment, the complexity of collaboration supporting in heterogeneous systems, and the autonomy of organizations all create new challenges for the operational computing environment. This paper describes a form of virtual alliance and proposes an integrated collaboration framework solution for inter-organization coordination management, including the using of ontologies-context pairing to support semantic level interoperability, and intelligent agent infrastructure to provide alliance life-cycle organizational autonomy.

articleTitle: A Study on Energy Management Contracting Pattern in Existing Building Energy Conservation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The chief object of the present study is to demonstrate and the characters and functions of Energy Management Contracting (EMC) in existing building energy conservation. According to the top topics of energy conservation and sustainable development, the patterns of EMC in building energy conservation were analyzed. The main technical measures for building facilities energy conservation were introduced, and a case in air-conditioning system was discussed. The results show that EMC is a win-win choice to both customers and energy service company (ESCo), and EMC will be widely applied in building energy conservation in the next future.

articleTitle: Model-Based Methods for Test Equating Under Item Response Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: There are some popular criteria for computing equating coefficients based on Item Response Theory (IRT), such as Stocking_Lord method (SLcrit), Haebara method (Hcrit). In this paper some new equating criteria are driven, such as Logistic regression method (LRcrit) and symmetric relative entropy method (SREcrit). Some of these criteria may be specifically suitable for a corresponding IRT model. LRcrit could be used for the divided-by-total and difference polytomous models and may have simpler form than that of Hcrit and SLcrit. Especially, the series of LRcrit could not include the iteration algorithm in the computing procedure without losing the accuracy. And SREcrit could almost be applied to all of the models under IRT. The results of Monte Carlo study demonstrate that the new criteria have some advantages in test equating procedure, such as providing more accurate value of equating coefficients A,B or the initial value in the situations of using iteration algorithm. Moreover, they may be simpler in the form and in the computing procedure.

articleTitle: The Interaction of Community and Tourism: Dual Structure and Kuznets Hypothesis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: By adopting the research method of documentary research and combining the related theory of development economics, and starting with the concept of community tourism, this paper brings forward the “dual structure” and the Kuznets Hypothesis of community tourism, defining “the game of chess” between the residents of community and tourists, the increasing relationship between the per capita tourism income of community and the Geordie Modulus of community. Conclusively putting forward the way of developing the tourism and community harmoniously, namely taking the human as the dominant factor and being joined by the community.

articleTitle: The Mediation Data Services Application Model Based on Web Resource Ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The application of Web service technology used in the semantic web, which provides available methods for defining, getting and sharing Web resources. This paper presents to build a mediation data service application model by using the service management agent, to use the web resource ontology model to mark web resources in the semantic web, and to implement the mediation web resource data services in the application model by using web service, so that it can make users get and share web resources data effectively in the multiform and great deal of web resources environment.

articleTitle: Adaptive Bandwidth Measurement and Monitoring for Multimedia Transmission in Home Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, digital home networking is popular in academic and industrial areas. It provides a variety of multimedia services for home customers. Among these services, the video services are the most attractive. But video services are sensitive and easy to be influenced by the fluctuation of available bandwidth. This paper proposes a bandwidth measurement and monitoring mechanism which can be adopted in home gateways for adaptive multimedia transmission in digital home environment. Experiments are carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Incentive Mechanism of Knowledge Sharing among Teams in Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In modern enterprise, project team has become a much more effective form for its flexible, problem-oriented and task-oriented. Knowledge sharing among teams plays a significant role in knowledge management of enterprise. Based on principal-agent theory, this paper explores the benefit game between enterprise and project team under information asymmetry condition, introduces both knowledge value and excess reward into knowledge sharing incentive model framework, and analyzes the impact of diverse parameters (e.g. knowledge value coefficient, standard knowledge value coefficient of enterprise, effort cost coefficient, absolute risk aversion coefficient et al.) on incentive intensity, expected revenue of enterprise and agent cost of project team. Mathematical analysis results show that the optimal incentive contract is determined when both sides reach the stable equilibrium state. If the parameters change, enterprise will simultaneously adjust the incentive strategy, and the optimal action of project team will accordingly vary to maximize bilateral benefits.

articleTitle: The Measurement of the CSI of e-learning Courseware
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the past few years, with the information technology development and the application of streaming media technology, teaching forms break the restriction of time and space. Internet plays an important role in e-learning. The e-learning courseware will influence the quality of study, even in the future development of distance education. Therefore, how to measure the quality of e-learning courseware becomes increasingly important. Based on the theory of customer relationship management, the paper analyzed quantitatively the customer satisfaction of the e-learning courseware.

articleTitle: Study on Analyzing Questionnaire Survey by Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Traditional questionnaire usually takes likert scale and treats the data as discrete and controllable. It overlooks the different opinions chosen in the same scale, moreover does not consider the possibility distribution trend. Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) is used to explore into the possible trend based on the distribution from the questionnaire. The difference of the results based on original questionnaire and MCS show the trying is beneficial and interesting. However, for this method, the questionnaire survey should be scientifically random. Moreover, foundational research should be conducted to test the validity.

articleTitle: China's Emergency Management Mechanisms for Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Emergency management mechanisms for disaster prevention and mitigation mainly include three parts: disaster prevention mechanism, disaster guarantee mechanism, and post-disaster relief, rehabilitation, and reconstruction mechanisms. Prevention mechanism includes disaster warning mechanism, disaster emergency counterplan mechanism, disaster prevention and mitigation education mechanism. Guarantee mechanism includes organization guarantee, legal guarantee, rescue teams guarantee, rescue equipments support, disaster relief materials guarantee, relief funds guarantee, technical guarantee, international cooperation mechanism, social mobilization mechanism and the development of disaster supplies industry. Post-disaster relief, rehabilitation and reconstruction mechanisms include disaster rescue, repair and restoration, secondary disasters prevention in disaster areas, resettlement of victims and post-disaster assessment.

articleTitle: Learning Curve: Principle, Application and Limitation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The article introduces the background that learning curve was established and sets up its model. The basic principles and methods of estimating and improving learning rate are put forward. The author elaborates the concrete application of learning curve in enterprise management, and analyzes its applied conditions and limitations to provide suggestions for enterprises making reasonable application.

articleTitle: Solving the Employment Problems in China Construction Industry: Localization, IT Service, Minimum Wage Limit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Chinese construction industry has faced many dilemma, to some degree, this dilemma has been a stumbling block under the certain time background of China. This paper pays attention to the inner-produced mechanism of employment problems in China construction industry. Simply summarized, there are three main difficulties. Firstly, construction labor localization is required by characteristics of economic activities of construction and organization mode of productivity. Second, the construction services localization is the only way to reduce the ineffective production cost caused by mobility, and it is also an important way to benefit local society and economy. Thirdly, under the conditions of the imbalances of supply and demand relationship in the labor market and asymmetric information, it is the construction industry that is the most prone to employ cheap labors. Correspondingly, it provides some opinions and strategies to solve the above issues, for examples, by taking the connotation of localization of construction labor, Using Commuter Services, providing the employees in the construction industry particularly the construction services with the minimum wage standards and the treatment.

articleTitle: Research on Collaboration Software Based on JBPM and Lightweight J2EE Framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper studies a widely used workflow management technology and lightweight J2EE platforms during collaborative software development, and the efficient and rapid development framework for collaborative systems based on both. This article firstly introduces the definition and composition of collaboration software, and explains the features and benefits of open-source JBPM workflow engine based on the definition of workflow and workflow management system. Then the paper discusses the construction of lightweight J2EE platform, and proposes a solution of collaboration software based on JBPM and J2EE framework. Finally the article analyzes the advantages of this solution from the features of the collaboration software, which can help enterprises improve efficiency and win competition.

articleTitle: Combined Technologies in Analysis of Overlapping Cells
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Time-lapse microscopy imaging serves as an important method to measure the cycle progression of individual cells in a large population. The lacking of automatic systems that can deal with large volume of time-lapse optical microscopy imaging is a bottleneck of modern bio-imaging research. In this paper we present an effective computerized method for overlapping cell nuclei detection in time-lapse image sequences. We design a two-stage detection scheme for such cells in each image of the image sequence. Features of the skeleton and the contour of the cell model are extracted in the two stages, and overlapped cells are detected by the similarity of the features with the training samples. Experimental results shows the proposed method is very effective and the work shows great assistance for the cell nuclei segmentation afterward.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Architecture Based on Web3D, Web2.0 & SSH
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To address the serious problems in e-commerce based on traditional 2D image-word, the author introduced Web3D, Flex and SSH technologies into e-commerce, presented “3D Virtual Reality & Flex” Web architecture for e-commerce, researched mechanisms of their architectures, and implemented their integration and communication & interaction: Flex and Struts2 via XML, Flex and Spring & Hibernate via BlazeDS, Flex and Web3D via JavaScript. The practice has shown that the integrated Web architecture based on Web3D, Flex and SSH is effective and valuable for e-commerce.

articleTitle: Construction of a Course Video Resource System Based on Students' Visual Attention
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A course video resource system based on non-classroom students' visual attention can present the course video resources to non-classroom students and provide them with the teaching information they require in their studies, thereby effectively promoting learning. This paper analyzes the focal points of the visual attention of classroom and non-classroom students, examines the various ways used by teachers of different instructional styles to guide students' visual attention, and presents concepts for effectively manipulating the camera lens to guide students' visual attention. Moreover, the paper suggests the use of phonetic recognition, board-writing recognition, and light-spot information overlapping methods to control of the application of the camera lens and the channel switch of video material flows, so that the course video resources presented to non-classroom students fit their visual attention, thereby enhancing the efficiency of the utilization of course video resources and boosting the efficiency of student learning. At present, no device for building such a course video resource system exists; thus, IT enterprises may develop such devices using this idea to satisfy the learning needs of non-classroom students.

articleTitle: Study on Water Resources Economic Value of a Particular Basin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A Water resource is the critical basement and insurance for rapid social and economic development. Quantitively study about the effective use of water resources towards three major department of civil economic development and its water use efficiency has great significance on how to make high-efficient water price and water resources management policy as well as to adjust water resources allocation reasonably so as to keep a sustainable development for the whole society. This paper chooses benefit sharing coefficient method among large amount of methods for quantitively analysis. It takes the 9 provinces along the Yellow River basin as study area, calculating water economic value and its use efficiency of its three major department of economy. Then it analyzes its characteristics and problems of current water use structure and puts forward some measures and advice for improving water use and allocates water resources eventually.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on SME's Innovative Efficiency - A Case of SMEs in Guangdong Cluster of Materials Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper uses a DEA model to do an empirical analysis on the innovative efficiency of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in the cluster based on inputs and outputs, and provides an effective way to identify existing issues and the causes of SMEs in Guangdong cluster of materials industry, puts forword the direction to improve SMEs' innovative efficiency in the cluster for the decision makers.

articleTitle: Reviews on Service Quality Studies in Internet Environment and Further Researches
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper firstly summarizes present service quality in internet environment based on the review on traditional service quality researches and expounds service features in internet environment: service in internet environment is much more intangible, the seperability of service is promenience, while perishablity and heterogeneous are weaken; perceived service quality is more stable and services of variety coperate websites are similar. After that, this paper points the limitations of existing researches and believes we ought to define service quality characteristics in internet environment, explore the service quality expectation, perception path and mechanism in terms of 3 phases of e-transaction in B2C market, and then construct a new perceived service quality model and evaluation system based on corporate website.

articleTitle: Grey Evaluation of Cultural Creative Industry's Competitive Ability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
