abstract: The role of cultural creative industry in current economy has been widely acknowledged. In Henan province cultural creative industry has become a strong engine for economic development. It is important to acknowledge the comparative ability of regional cultural creative industry objectively to further make relevant policies. Currently the evaluation is limited and qualitative method often be adopted. On considering the characteristics of cultural creative industry development, such as complexity and many variables can't be easily quantified, thus we regards the evaluation of cultural creative industry's competitive ability as a special grey system, adopting the method of multi-level grey comprehensive evaluation to fulfill the target. Based on the theory of grey system, this paper builds up the grey comprehensive evaluation of cultural creative industry's competitive ability. Then we make implementation of the model combining empirical research. The results show the fitness of multi-level grey method in cultural creative industry's competitive ability, which have active meanings for improving the quantitative research of cultural creative industry research, also can aid the relevant directors to acknowledge the role of cultural creative industry's role in the whole economy and make more objective decisions.

articleTitle: Emergency Supply Chain Integration Based on Petri Net Thoery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Emergency management, as a major work system, includes all aspects, among which an important one is supply of emergency materials. Whether the emergency materials can meet the emergency needs in time is vertical to the success of emergency response. By the impact of the past planned economy, the emergency supplies Management exists a lot of problems. The integration of emergency supply chain is vertical to establish an effectively emergency system. In this paper, we studied the integration of emergency supply chain and propose an integration mole based on Petri net theory. The detailed description of integrated emergency supply chain provided a way to operate the chain efficiently.

articleTitle: The Impact of Sales Promotion on the C2C Online Purchasing Behavior: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper tries to construct sales promotion and Technology Acceptance Model as an integrated theoretical framework of C2C online consumer behavior. We use empirical method to test hypothesis about the relationship between online sales promotion, TAM and C2C online shopping behavior. The study shows that online sales promotion direct impaction on the customer's attitude and purchase intention is not significant, but by the perception of consumers ease of use and perceived risks induce an indirect impaction. The conclusions of this study would provide helpful suggestions on the online marketing operation.

articleTitle: Post-evaluation of Project Management for Fengcheng PowerPlant Phase II Expansion Project in JiangXi Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Combining with the actual situation of project management for Fengcheng Power Plant Phase II Expansion Project in Jiangxi Province, this paper used Logical Framework Approach for partial evaluation of the project management, and used Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method for comprehensive evaluation of the project management. In the process of partial evaluation, the indicator systems of post-evaluation was established, which according to the management objectives of investment, quality, progress, safety and environmental. The five indicator systems laid the foundation for comprehensive evaluation. The results of the comprehensive post-evaluation can measure the overall level of project management, and can be used as performance standards or reference.

articleTitle: Field Programmable Gate Array Design and Implementation for Fast Fourior Transform Processor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Design and implementation of Fast Fourior Transform (FFT) processor is one of the most important problems for multimedia, communication, networking and security (key enabling technologies supporting E-Business and E-Government). The problems of design and implementation of complex numbers FFT processor based on field programmable gate array (FPGA) are studied for the application in the fields of multimedia, communication, networking and security in this paper. In this paper, the FPGA design and implementation, the simulation and synthesis, the correctness verification of the complex numbers FFT processor, are based on the algorithm of radix-2 Demation-In-Time (DIT), the hardware platform of XC2V40 that is one of the FPGA chips, the software platform of ISE9.1 provided by Xilinx Inc, VHSIC hardware description language (VHDL).

articleTitle: Application Research on Manufacter E-commerce and ERP Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper studies the history of ERP and E-commerce, analysis the importance of integration and possible facing problems, and then presents the principle of integration, which is "unified strategy, process optimization, application integration and data synchronization". Finally, a complete and feasible solution is given for manufacter E-commerce and ERP integration.

articleTitle: Knowledge Requirements Modeling for Personalized E-learning on Business Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper tries to provide a personalized knowledge requirements model (KRM) according to the learners' knowledge structure and their roles in the process of enterprise business, on the basis of the concept map and knowledge-flow ontology approaches, in order to fulfill company's knowledge needs through effective and efficient training.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Fiscal Support Policy on Farmer's Income in Major Grain Producing Areas Using Jiangsu as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Government financial support for agriculture plays an important role in both agricultural economic development and farmers' income growth. However, China's public finance investment in the agricultural sector has being insufficient and inefficient for a quite long time. Based on the empirical analysis between government expenditure in agricultural sector and from 1985 to 2006 in Jiangsu province, we found the financial support for agriculture is Granger cause of per capita annual net income of rural households, while the contrary is not established. And the short-term elasticity of expenditure on financial support for agriculture for per capita annual net income of rural households is about 0.328, indicating growth in financial expenditure has a strong impact on farmer's income.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Agricultural Government Website in Western China by Using TAM Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the Technology Acceptance Model, this paper aims to take an empirical study on agricultural government website in Western China. Firstly, this paper puts forward the research model and makes hypotheses, then examines the hypotheses by means of the questionnaire and deliberate data analysis through structural equation. After explain the results in detail, this paper gives some advices on Western China agricultural E-government construction.

articleTitle: The Condition and Normal Mode of Net Financial Consultation Based on XBRL
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Adopt XBRL in Net Finance consultation criteria will provide major benefits in some aspects: the convenience and reliability of finance information search, transmission and exchange cross-platform financial information data, mining and tracing data. The network and associated infrastructure and a huge database system support are essential to achieve a net financial consultation supported by XBRL. The information and network application skills of Consultants and the security of network data are also in demand. In the mode of network financial consultation based on XBRL, different types of financial statements saved in the form of electronic documents, and then the XBRL converter will change it into XBRL format-document automatically. The stage of analysis and consultation also operates in XBRL environment, Consultants will obtain and trace the relevant information and data, according to the tag of financial data and non-financial data, achieve a highly-efficient and accurate consultation objective. To meet a higher consultation requirement, can add some functions like data mining and strengthen the consultation to the consulting mode.

articleTitle: Some Study about China's C2C e-Commerce Credit Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: China's C2C e-commerce encounters many problems, in which credit problem is always a knotty problem, and it is also the bottle-neck to the development of Chinese C2C e-commerce. In such circumstances, this paper exams the status quo of China's C2C e-commerce credit management, takes a case study, and put forward a mended evaluation model.

articleTitle: A Study on Inter-governmental Documents Security Transfer under E-government Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The electronic of government documents transmission and processing has greatly improved working efficiency. However, because the network has openness, connectivity and other features, resulting the network vulnerable to be attacked by hacker and viruses, and also resulting in information of electronic documents disclosure, counterfeiting, tampering, repudiation and many other issues. This paper firstly points out the status of secure transfer of electronic documents under e-government environment and security needs, on this basis, the authors propose the solution to the problem on the secure transfer of documents under e-government environment, building computer and network systems security and hybrid encryption technology, combining an integrated encryption system to ensure the security delivery of electronic document.

articleTitle: Interactivity Design of Network Courseware for Engineering Fluid Mechanics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to achieve the network-based teaching of Engineering Fluid Mechanics, the network teaching courseware for Engineering Fluid Mechanics is developed, using the platform provided by campus network, making full use of the network teaching with timeliness and multimedia advantage, the network of textbook, lecture notes and demonstration experiment content is achieved. At the same time, the online test and Q & A are achieved through using the interactivity of the network courseware, the studying enthusiasm of students is lightened, and a better teaching effect is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Improved PERT Model in Analysis of Schedule Risk of Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: PERT (program evaluation and review technique) is one of the most popular means in Project Time Management, however, it exists some shortcomings. Based on the assumptions of PERT, this paper illustrates the disadvantages of the normal three times estimation method and gives countermeasures to solve these problems. Firstly, it adopts the Monroe method to improve the normal ß distribution. Secondly, it improves the accuracy of the normal method of three times estimation by adopting the restrictive probability to estimate the three times and the minimal deviation model. Thirdly, it considers the effects of the secondarily crucial line. Consequently, the paper applies a new model to analyze schedule risk of project and divides it into five different grades.

Author Keywords: the restrictive probability of three times estimation

articleTitle: The Analysis about Economic Effects of Coal Safety Regulations on the Basis of Cost and Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The coal safety regulations play an important role during Chinese coal production, which greatly effects the progress of Chinese mining technology. Furthermore, in the market-oriented condition, safety input is an important factor that increases the production cost of the mine companies. By constructing profit-maximizing model, the article discusses how do the safety regulations impact Chinese coal industry both on the basis of cost and technology, giving some advices for the problems.

articleTitle: E-Campus in Xiamen University: The Past, Present and the Hopeful Future
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: E-Campus has greater and greater roles in universities around the world. This paper discusses the E-Campus development in Xiamen University in the past, the present and the future. By analyzing its functionalities, some insufficiencies such as organizational insufficiency, ineffective information management, lack of maintenance planning, lack of a sustainable investment mechanism, insufficient involvement of university project team, lack of management process readjustment are pointed out. Future improvement and investment should be based on the management of these insufficiencies. To offer solutions to informatization, some suggestions which could be a way forward to the improvement of E-campus planning and development in universities are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analysis of Response Surface Designs to Outlier
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Response surface designs investigating the effects of several factors have widely application and make the researcher or analyst to control the factors or model the effects of the input variables on the response of the process. Outliers among the measurements can almost be inevitable and will frequently have a highly confusing effect on response surface design, consequently leading to a wrong interpretation of the data. Various designs are studied for the influence of the outlier in different experimental regions.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of E-Portfolio Based Performance Assessment System in E-learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The existing web-based learning evaluation systems more focused on learner's quantitative assessment, they could not be competent for the performance assessment of learner's complex, high-level learning behavior, abilities or skills. E-Portfolio gives us a new idea and method to the performance assessment in e-learning. In this article, on the base of studying performance assessment and E-Portfolio, the author discussed the design, implementation and application effect of E-Portfolio based performance assessment system in e-learning.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Vehicle Routing Problem for Responding to Large-Scale Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, we propose a mathematical model for a dynamic vehicle routing problem (VRP) to minimize unmet demand with stochastic demands and real-time vehicle control in large-scale emergencies. In this context, we consider that one depot may not supply all demand nodes with sufficient medicine that they need in limited time. The problem involves multiple vehicles with various capacities and instantaneous variations of service requests in demand nodes. Both dispatched (serving on a route) and undispatched (at the depot) vehicles are considered in the problem. And the route adjustments arising from new or reduced demand nodes and various service requests are also considered. Then, we propose a hybrid solution algorithm based on C-W saving and tabu search algorithms to solve the proposed model. Finally, experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Innovation Service Platform Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Traditional innovation service platforms simply search in one sub-platform and the search results can not assist the user's innovation behavior effectively. This paper proposes the design of a novel innovation service platform based on Bayesian network. This platform makes use of Bayesian network to describe the sub-platforms, and borrowing ideas from multi modularly modeling it integrate all the sub-platforms together as a whole by taking advantage of sharing nodes. By means of the inference function of Bayesian network, this platform can take various factors into consideration so as to provide more accurate and effective search results for user. Additionally this platform uses all the sub-platforms rather than one to serve users so that it can provide comprehensive results to assist user's innovation behavior better.

articleTitle: Research on Diagnosis Method for Analyzing Implementation Status in Engineering Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Two prerequisites to diagnose implement status of engineering project are pointed out, where, one is a reference standard of diagnosis index, another is a judgment standard of diagnosis result. All diagnosis indexes are divided into three kinds during the analysis of diagnosis index standards, and their corresponding index standards can be determined by such methods as citation, reference and evaluation relatively. Then, the method to transform all indexes' values into a uniform standard is proposed, and a model to integrate all indexes values is set up too. Based on which, in order to enable diagnosis results to be judged, a judgment standard to identify the implement status is established according to some suggestions from project managers. At last, a real engineering example is presented for explaining how to use the engineering diagnosis method and proving the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Job Analysis for the Central Enterprises' Executive Position
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: China is furthering its reform of state-owned enterprises and establishing a modern enterprise system. Human resource as a important part of the modern enterprise system. Job analysis sits at the heart of all human resource practices, making it a critically important in every organization. However, the central enterprises’ special role in national economy determined the job analysis for the central enterprises’ executive position must follow certain rules. In this paper, we discussed Job analysis model and implementation strategy for the central enterprises’ executive position.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation System Based on Web Mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: More and more E-commerce Websites provide the products with different price which made it hard for consumers to find the products and services they wanted. In order to overcome the information overload, personalized recommendation systems were proposed to suggest products and to provide consumers with information to help them decide which products to purchase. Personalized recommendation systems can enhance E-Commerce sales by converting browsers into buyers, increasing cross-sell and building loyalty to prevent customers losing. In this paper the definition of web mining is analyzed, two key personalized recommendation technologies are introduced, a framework of personalized recommendation system based on web mining has been established. In the last part of the paper the author researches on an example system: Amazon.com.

Author Keywords: Web Mining Personalized Recommendation Recommendation System Framework

articleTitle: On Skipping Classes of College Students in E-Education - A Perspective of Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper aims to study the fundamental reasons why more and more college students in China in E-education Times prefer to skip classes, especially English classes applying Game Theory which is a brand new field of study. Different game theory models under the condition of asymmetric information are put forward and analyzed by comparing the costs and pay-offs of both players, teachers and students at college in China. The equilibrium is arrived at to help the teachers and the university with the optimal strategies to improve the situation by studying the two players' behaviors.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Framework of Fourth Party Payment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article proposed the model of the fourth party payment and its integral theoretical framework and aimed to solve the existing problem of payment, such as the incompatible problems of various payment modes caused by the existing diversity of payment modes and protocols in the electronic business system, the cross-authorization problems in the third party payment system, the problem of lacking unified electronic money, as well as the problems of supervising E-payment and E-commerce. The research method of this paper is to analyse the existing problems in the development of E-commerce system at first, then based on these problems, the second step is to put forward to the conceptions of the fourth party payment platform.

articleTitle: Research on Growth Mechanism of Industrial Cluster of Logistics in Coopetition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The coopetition among the enterprises in the cluster of logistics is an important power mechanism to push the growth of the cluster of logistics. By analyzing the coopetition among the enterprises in the cluster of logistics, this paper investigates the growth mechanism of the cluster and proposes the conceptual model of the cluster's growth mechanism, and tries to provide the corresponding theoretical support for the sustainable development of the cluster of logistics.

articleTitle: Technical Framework Model of Continuous Online Assurance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The spectacular growth of the Internet in general and the World Wide Web (WWW) in particular, has created a new set of opportunities and challenges confronting corporate management and reporting. These developments emphasize the need for continuous online monitoring of transactions. Continuous online assurance will achieve this need. Continuous online assurance is viewed here as a type of assurance that producing assurance results on a subject matter can be provided simultaneously with, or a short period of time after, the occurrence of relevant events. This article focuses on the emerging field of continuous online assurance. First, the background of continuous online assurance is briefly presented. Thereafter, Continuous online assurance and continuous online audit are separately presented. Finally, technical foundation and framework model are researched. A framework model of continuous assurance based on four important technological advances of XML, XBRL, XARL and Web service is designed.

articleTitle: “Google Library”: Some Copyright Infringement Concerns in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Digital reading brings more conveniences to our life, but at the same time, it brings more worries to the copyright owners about copyright infringement. Digital reading or sharing the files has to be legal and fair use according to the copyright laws in many jurisdictions including China. Google is a private owned corporation. This article discusses Google's plan- Google Book Service (including Google Book Search and Google Library) and analyze what the Google Book and Google Library are and their legal controversy in the copyright area, and the difference between “Google Book Search” and “Google Library” as well. This article assumes “Google Book Search” and “Google Library” are parts in the entire “Google Book”. In addition to using “the Google Book Settlement” and China's Copyright Law to solve the controversy, we hope that we can find a better way to balance the right and benefit between users and copyright owners.

articleTitle: Learners' Emotion Cultivation in E-learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the increasing popularity of the internet,the large using crowd has be expanding. Nowadays,the crowds of E-learning are explosively growing,education resources on the network has becoming richer. In the network learning environment,the majority of network resources only concern about teaching students the knowledge. Some educators believe that emotion is the basis of behavior,behavioral Patterns are based on emotional factors as motivation. Emotional education based on network environment is an organized combination of education,Psychology,aesthetics,computer science and etc. Strengthening the learners' emotional education has great positive significance in regulating network activity and constructing correct moral sentiments.

articleTitle: Study on the Calculation of Text Similarity Based on Key-sentence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: To solve the problems of the slow speed and a great deal of memory demand appearing in text categorization, this paper explains Sentences Vector Space Model (SVSM), puts forward the method to calculate text similarity based on key sentences. Experiments show the better result.

articleTitle: Research on Data Exchange Platform of Provincial Credit System: A Perspective of Data Processing Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A large amount of information is on the hand of government, but most of which is not shared or poorly shared. Data exchange platform is used to support collaborative work among government, which is achieved by sharing data stored in different agencies. The background and necessity of developing data exchange platform is analyzed in this paper. A framework of data exchange platform is proposed from the perspective of data processing process. The framework could effectively promote information sharing and opening among government agencies, enterprises, and citizens.

articleTitle: Plotting out Relationship Stage between Online Stores and their Customers: Based on Behavioral, Psychological and Combined Criterion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It's necessary for an on-line firm developing relationship to identify the relationship stage where a customer is and take different tactics depend on the stage. Most existing researches describe the characters of different stage qualitatively. Quantitative criterions are seldom explored. So, it's hard for firm to practice and for researchers to conduct empirical research depend on different stage. This paper plots out and compares relationship stage through K-means Cluster analysis, ANOVA and discriminate analysis. It shows that the mix of behavioral variables (including times and length) and psychological variables (commitment and loyalty) could plot out relationship stage well. This is meaningful for practice and research in relationship marketing.

articleTitle: An Equitable DEA-Based Approach of Allocating Fixed Costs or Resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The problem of how to allocate a fixed cost or resource among a set of competing entities in an equitable way is a considerably important issue. Based on data envelopment analysis (DEA), the current paper proposes a new method for allocating fixed costs and resources to all decision making units (DMUs) respectively, in such a way that the relative efficiencies of DMUs remain unchanged and the distribution should reflect the individual DMUs' performances and scales of inputs consumption and outputs production. To illustrate the method, numerical results for an example are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: General Gaussian Watermarking Model Research and Application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Watermarking has been suggested in the literature as the most effective means for copyright protection and authentication. The main focus of this thesis is the establishment of the non-stationary Gaussian watermarking models, to the case where watermarked images are quantized before distribution. The hidden message carries R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">W</sub> bits per image dimension. Our main result is the determination of the region of allowable rates (R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Q</sub>, R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">W</sub>).

articleTitle: The Analysis of Mortgage under the Subprime Crisis Based on the Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: By applying the Evolutionary Game Theory, this paper analyzes the credit behavior of banks and the lender under the condition of dynamic model of incomplete information. And it also discusses the process of the dynamic evolution and the stable equilibrium strategy under two different economic environments. Finally, this paper expounds the cause of the subprime crisis based on the evolutionary game theory. Through the parametric analysis of the evolutionary stable equilibrium, the controlling factors in the game model and possible methods are discussed.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of the New Rural Cooperative Medical Care System of the Factors Affecting Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on a five-point Likert scale Questionnaire investigation through factor analysis, we withdraw five common factors which the cumulative variance contribution rate has reached 58.657%, through rotation and Factor score coefficient matrix, we find that the satisfaction is "F = 2.8447”. Finally, we put forward some sugesstions in order to improve the satisfaction unceasingly.

articleTitle: Data Security Analysis of the Mass Producing Process of Smart Cards
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As a secret data storage location and a platform of security computing, the data security mechanism of the smart card has some distinctive features in mass produced process. This paper analyses the personalization system of smart cards and the secret key hierarchy of smart cards system, contrasts the data privacy mechanisms of two steps of personalization stages, and analyses a representative process of financial card issuance by demonstration analysis method.

articleTitle: Solve Job-shop Scheduling Problem Based on Cooperative Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Coping with such disadvantages of particle swarm optimization algorithm and GA as being easy to run into local optima, the method of cooperative optimization is proposed to solve the job shop scheduling problem by combing the quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization and GA. The algorithm applied the parallel hybrid architecture of collaborative quantum particle swarm and GA, in which a kind migration operator was designed to associate all population, and the result shows that this algorithm has better answers and more rapid convergence.

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Model of Buffer Inventory for the Automobile Supply Chain Based on TOC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to improve the timely of part distribution and the stability of automobile assembly line, based on the theory of constraints, according to the analysis of inventory cost and failure cost, an optimal model of buffer inventory for the automobile supply chain is put forward. This model can solve the conflict between lowering logistics cost and ensuring logistics continuity, thus reduce the operating cost and enhance the overall efficiency of the automobile supply chain. At last, the validity of this model is proved by an implementation case.

articleTitle: The Founder's Choice between Democracy and Autocracy in Corporate Governance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper presents a new model of founder's choice between democracy and autocracy in corporate governance and point out that there is a life-cycle effect on the choice of governance mode. At the start-up period, the autocracy mode is more efficiency. However, autocracy requires the founder being as the CEO to have sufficient own capitals. If external finance is needed, the founder would respond for higher capital cost as compensation for the manager's control benefit rents behavior and the control power loss of minority shareholders. Therefore, the capability of entrepreneur should be greater than the average managerial level in the professional manager market and the expected return of the “project” should be higher than the average level of the market as well. It is concluded that own funds and the founder's capability are substitutes.

articleTitle: A Survey of Researches on Uncertain Project Scheduling Problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper summarizes the recent researches on uncertain project scheduling problems. The literatures of the proactive project scheduling problems are presented firstly. Then we review the achievements of the reactive project scheduling problems. According to the methods of dealing with uncertain information, the developments of the stochastic project scheduling problems and the fuzzy project scheduling problems are described respectively. Ultimately, the paper is sumed up and the directions for further research in this field are indicated.

articleTitle: Based on RBAC Security Design of University Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of internet and the network applications' increasing popular in each field of universities, web application security issue becomes one of the main factors that constraint the development of the internet. Access control is an important part of security service. It integrates closely with identity authentication, encryption and other factors. This paper expatiate the design concept of roll based access control and discusses core object-oriented design model of rights management system and other key techniques of authority access and control.

articleTitle: Liquidity Risk and Asset Pricing: The Multivariate GARCH-in-Mean Application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, the concept of liquidity risk in the sense of asset pricing is discussed firstly, and then all the liquidity risks are analyzed from two different aspects. From the whole market, there are two liquidity risks, namely, market returns sensitivity to aggregate liquidity level and volatility of aggregate liquidity level, while from the point of portfolio or individual security, there are four liquidity risks, namely, systematic liquidity risk, portfolio return sensitivity to market liquidity, portfolio liquidity sensitivity to market returns and volatility of portfolio liquidity level. Finally, a uniform model-the multivariate GARCH-in-mean is defined to investigate the relationship between all liquidity risks of two aspects and asset pricing. And the model also includes the impact of market risk, systematic risk and idiosyncratic risk on asset pricing.

articleTitle: The Research of CR-based WSNs Architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In recent years, we have seen tremendous growth in the applications of wireless sensor networks (WSN) operating in unlicensed spectrum bands. However, there is evidence that existing unlicensed spectrum is becoming overcrowded. On the other hand, with recent advances in Cognitive Radio (CR) technology, it is possible to apply the Dynamic Spectrum Access (DSA) model in WSN to get access to less congested spectrum, possibly with better propagation characteristics. In this paper we investigate the structure of traditional WSN, cognitive radio and dynamic spectrum access technique etc. We present a concept of CR-based WSN, and proposed the new network topology and cross-layer architecture for CR-based WSN. At last, we discuss advantages and limitations of CR-based WSN. Clearly, there are many significant challenges in the realization of CR-based WSN.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research of Knowledge Management Based on the Enterprise's Core Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Antecedent Factors of Knowledge Sharing in Project Teams: Evidence from Chinese Construction Sector
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: While it is well known that knowledge sharing is essential for organization to maintain competitive advantage. This study is to examine the impact of several key factors that may affect knowledge sharing within project teams in China. By surveying managerial employees from different project teams in the construction sector, this study shows that both intrinsically and extrinsically motivated individuals tend to share more knowledge with their team members. Individuals with high altruism are also more likely to share knowledge with others. Moreover, explicit knowledge facilitates knowledge sharing while tacit knowledge creates barriers to knowledge sharing. The implications to knowledge management research and practice are also considered in this study.

articleTitle: The Formation Mechanism of Implicit Human Capital of High-skilled Talents Based on Learning Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article analyzes the formation mechanism of implicit human capital of high-skilled talents on the basis of the analysis on formation features and influencing factors of implicit human capital. This article discusses the formation mechanism of implicit human capital of high-skilled talents from perspectives of individual learning and organizational learning, explorative learning and exploitative learning and “Learning by Doing” respectively, mainly expanded from different perspectives and patterns of group learning.

articleTitle: Effects of Interorganizational Systems: Issues Affecting Coordination Cost
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It is believed that the adoption of Interorganizational systems (IOS) can enable organization to use the information processing capabilities to reduce interorganizational coordination costs and improve performance. However, the past researches have shown mixed results about the impact of IOS on coordination costs. While drawing on transaction cost analysis and resource-dependence theory, this paper suggests that analyzing the relationship between IOS use and coordination costs should consider different levels of asset specificity and interdependence of participating organizations. This article presents an analyzing method and suggests that, when asset specificity or interdependence is high, IOS use can reduce coordination costs for monitoring or cooperative purpose. While under a condition of low asset specificity or low interdependence, the association between IOS use and coordination costs reducing is negative.

articleTitle: An Integrated Practice Lab Course for Service Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper begins with an overview of the curriculum design for service engineering at school of software and microelectronics, Peking University, and then presents the integrated practice lab course design. The proposed lab is meant to span one academic year in order that all the relevant knowledge modules in the curriculum. This curriculum, including this integrated lab course, provides a best practice example of how to build a curriculum for the students trained for the modern service industry.

articleTitle: Research on the Condition of Paying Tax for Individual Commercial Households without Setting up an Account: A Case Study in X District, X City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Individual commercial households have always been the toughest group for taxation since they have not normative account, and some of them even without any record. So the local tax authorities have to determine a fixed taxation standard periodically for them in accordance with approved procedures. Although this method is comparatively scientific, many questions do exist. One of the questions is that the tax authorities have not a clear basis for determining the fixed taxing amount because of the over-principled procedures, and another question is that some leak of management emerges in the process of implementing those procedures. These questions caused troubles in two areas: first, a part of individual commercial households without setting up an account will have a private bargain with the authorities to cut down their standards of fixed tax amount, causing great loss of state revenue; second, the subjective intention of authorities on determining the standards will repress the enthusiasm of individual commercial households as well as their development, which is unfavorable to establishment of social order for fair competition. It is one of the issues concerning the source of taxation and economic development of the country that how to standardize the verifying procedures of tax authorities strictly according to certain regulations and laws.

articleTitle: The Strategy and Demonstration Study on the Interactive Development between Port and City of Huaian
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The port city has promoted the development and optimization of the regional industrial structure with its unique basic resources through agglomeration effect, synergistic effect and the self-increasing effect of the city. And accordingly, the port city has become the mainstay of the regional economic development. Firstly, the paper has illustrated the research background. Then it has carried out macroscopic analysis on the interactive relationships between the port and city. It also has made concrete analysis on the relation between the port and economy of Huaian by correlation degree modal. Finally, it has put forward some policy suggestions for promoting the interactive development between the port and city of Huaian.

articleTitle: The Study on the Pricing of the Government Information: Case of the Statistical Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the literature reviews on the pricing of the government information, this paper established a comprehensive pricing model for the government information in view of the current situation of the information sharing among the governments in Mainland China. And it took the governmental statistical information for example to utilize and validate the model. The conclusions had a practical meaning for promoting the share and exchange of the government information.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on Evaluation Techniques of Credit Based on E-commerce Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology, e-commerce has become an irresistible trend of the world. At the same time, network transaction is facing a growing number of opportunities and challenges. Many researchers from different angles, using different research methods and technical means, research on credit evaluation techniques in e-commerce transaction, which makes a great many of relevant research results and documents. Based on this, a number of credit evaluation techniques are summarized, classified and compared, and the development trend of evaluation techniques are discussed.

articleTitle: Study of Compressed Organization Structure by Means of Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper is based on the formula put forward by Shannon, which is used to measure the information flow generated from discrete variables, and also the maximum entropy rule put forward by Jaynes, which is used to describe the distribution of maximum entropy. Through analysing the characters of entropy function, we draw a conclusion of the relationship between the value of entropy function and the possibility of variables. At the end, compressed organization structure is proved to be superior to hierarchical structure.

articleTitle: The Research on Enterprise Manufacture Integrated and Collaborative Commerce System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Optimization and fast response ability in market cannot be simply achieved by computer automation without considering systematic application integration. The manufacturing enterprises need integrated platform and the coordinated commercial support platform to improve its whole productivity, flexibility, competitiveness and the ability in emergency management. This paper presents an e-commerce project at Xuzhou Cigarettes Factory with Jiangsu cigarette industrial group. We introduced the current information-based situation of the Xuzhou Cigarettes Factory with Jiangsu cigarette industrial group, identified the key problems and bottlenecks in the enterprise's management, and proposed the solution for enterprises' manufacturing integration and collaborative commerce. Our solution could be referred and used for information construction in manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Improved Fuzzy Integrating Assessment Application in Construction Project Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the impproved fuzzy integrating assessment, all assessment factors are divided into two categories,the quantitative factors and the qualitative factors. For the former detailed evaluation criteria can be easily draw up and its accuracy and uniformity can be maintained. For the latter fuzzy integrating assessment is introduced so that the qualitative factors can be evaluated with quantitative results. With the improved fuzzy integrating assessment effective combination of qualitative assessment and quantitative assessment is obtained and the evaluation is more scientific and reasonable.

articleTitle: Study on Decision Method of Project Selection for Core Product Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Key factors of project selection for core product development were analyzed from qualitative angle and decision process of project selection for core product development was constructed in this paper. Returns and risks of core product development were analyzed from quantitative angle. On that basis, two dimensional model of project selection for core product development was proposed. Core product development project could be selected by manufacturing enterprise correctly under the direction of this method, which has a higher operational ability.

articleTitle: Development of Effective Quality Management Driven by Visualization and Automation Support
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Visualization and Automation decision support is significant to the quality management. This paper discusses the ever increasingly important role of Visualization and Automation decision support in the development of quality management and points out that in the process intelligence is dominant in its way to help fulfill some necessary key tasks, and both Visualization and Automation decision and data mining are chosen as core technologies.

articleTitle: Analysis of Bank Performance Appraisal Based on the Contingency Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Presently, performance appraisal is one of the most active areas under discussion in theory and practice of bank management, from which various methods and theories have been put forward one after another. Face the complicated internal and external bank environment, how to make performance appraisal fair and impartial, meanwhile to avoid the unilateral pursuits for indexes and ignorance of total benefit, become a key to succeed in competition. In this paper, contingency theory is adopted in analyzing the performance appraisal system, and bank performance appraisal process is proposed based on environment analysis,and think that only in this way could structural differences in competitiveness be constructed accordingly.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Digital Shadow Play Communication Model Based on Flash
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Digital shadow play is one attempt to combine the traditional shadowgraph and modern computer science technology. By the requirement of shadowgraph in the real world, the digital shadow play is required to be highly real-time, easily handle and strong interaction. Besides, because of the requirement of multi-personal interaction, the design and implement of communication model also should be considered in the digital shadow play system. In this paper, it proposes one flash-based digital shadow play communication module, which utilizes socket to achieve the requirement of fluent communication between multiple digital shadow play clients. Then the communication model will be used in the digital shadow play system.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Listed Company's Financial Crisis Based on SVM Classification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: SVM based model is constructed for predicting performances of Chinese listed companies. The paper firstly uses factor analysis, equal value difference test and correlation test to sieve the financial indicators and corporate governance variables separately for representative variables, and then uses the method of support vector machine for an empirical analysis. The research shows the model of SVM is superior. And through the comparison with the model based on financial indicators, we find that the model incorporating corporate governance variables has a more excellent prediction performance.

articleTitle: Method of Curriculum Development for Enterprise University - University of UFIDA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The current international economic operating environment demands the enterprise to enhance its competitiveness continually, so how to enhance the competitiveness has become the focus of Chinese enterprises. Human being is the most valuable resource, and only by providing a wide range of training opportunities can these limited resources release the largest energy. This article is to design customized courses according to the characteristics of the position and personal development of staff on the basis of company strategy, goals and objectives. The courses target to enhance the comprehensive ability of staff, helping managers get a clear understanding of corporate resources to enhance the competitiveness of the enterprise.

articleTitle: The Attempt of Instructional Reform to Solve the Employment Problem for Electronical Commerce Graduates
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It has been questioned at the very beginning about the Electronical Commerce major. The low employment rate of Electronical Commerce graduates exposes some problems on the cultivation of qualified personnel at the stage of university. This paper begins with the employment problems for the Electronical Commercial Business students and proposes some specified methods like the system of assessment for teachers, teaching methods and contents as well as practice based on the college teaching. It puts forward several approaches: establishing annual assessment system in terms of further study and exploration in companies, cultivation of teachers' skills, construction of multi-level practical teaching system and on-line shop to enlarge the possiblity of employment, etc.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Commerce Application Decision-making in China SMEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: More and more Small and Middle Sized Enterprises (SMEs)have started the development of Electronic Commerce (EC) recently. It is important and valuable to study the EC application decision-making in SMEs according to its peculiarity. The present project, first establishes the decision-making index systems about the EC application decision-making of SMEs based on Theory of Planned Behavior, obtains the weight of every index by Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and entropy of information theory. Then it uses the EWAA/LHA arithmetic operators and Grey Relativity analysis to study the EC application decision-making in SMEs. A simple example of EC decision-making on a small enterprise shows the specific steps of this method and proves the scientificity of the decision-making index systems and the validity of the decision-making method.

articleTitle: Construction of Flexible Management of Human Resource: Study on HR Management Model in Growth Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Enterprise life cycle is generally divided into four stages: establishment, growth, maturity and decline, the primary target of the enterprise during the period of establishment should be the enlargement of enterprise scale, and with which the enterprise's human resource management will be faced up with unprecedented stress: more arrangement of recruitment and training, challenge on the formal post setting and job analysis, and the new problems to implementing of corporate culture, compensation incentive system and the traditional performance appraisal system. In the present paper, a practicable model is proposed in order to deal with these problems, which is based on performance management system and takes human resource flexible management into consideration.

articleTitle: Reduced Analysis of Theoretical Solution to Conflict Events Based on ISM Principle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The co-adaptability theoretical solution to conflict events in construction engineering projects has three problems. First, the transformation of constraint conditions of theoretical solution is very difficult in practical engineering applications; second, some coefficients are difficult to be determined; third, there are overfull circular arithmetic operations in it. To resolve these problems, a new method to reduce the theoretical solution complications is proposed. By analyzing the operating mechanism of theoretical solution model, redundancies in the theoretical solution can be eliminated, and the ISM mapping with the co-adaptability solution can be set up. Based on this approach, an new procedure to solve conflict events in engineering projects is established by replacing characteristic variables with mathematic variables. The research results show that the procedure can replace the co-adaptability theoretical solution and solve practical problems of conflict events in engineering projects effectively.

articleTitle: On the Web-Based Tracking Survey of Educational Quality of Applied and Practical Majors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Different from theoretical ones, applied and practical majors (APM) demand more frequent update of knowledge. Universities need to be timely acquainted with enterprises’ latest demands and feedback, as well as their graduates’, to adjust their curriculums and knowledge given in class to cultivate competent students. Through analysis of the characteristics of APM, the fundament and feasibility of web-based tracking survey (TS) of educational quality is expatiated. In virtue of material analysis and comparison, active browsing, supplemented by e-mail and web meeting, can be employed as the most suitable method to carry out the foresaid survey, the promotion of which will benefit universities, graduates, enterprises and even the whole country’s sustainable development.

articleTitle: Application Study on Collaborative Mobile Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As the mobile electronic commerce constantly develops in our country, there emerge problems like the imperfect payment system, poor transaction security and incomplete credit system, etc. Collaborative mobile electronic commerce, proposed in this paper, has incomparable advantages over traditional mobile e-commerce in terms of the added value of the collaborative business groups, the secure mobile payment, the establishment of credit system, personnel training and employing.

articleTitle: Research on Diagnosis Indexes for Analyzing Implementation Status in Engineering Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The actuality of constructions management in China is investigated. All main problem phenomena in engineering projects could be divided into 20 categories and 261 sub-categories. On the help of diagnosis thoughts in other science subjects, the characteristics of problem phenomena and their parameters are refined and determined by means of information reduction in rough set. 113 diagnosis indexes are educed by the mapping principle of set theory from these parameters. The weights of 113 indexes are determined according to the judgment of 65 project management specialists; and the diagnosis index system of engineering projects is set up. The research result proves that the idea of diagnosis can be used to identify and analyze problems in engineering project management efficiently.

articleTitle: A Data Mapping Strategy of Parallel Data Mining in Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to achieve data load balancing of mining nodes in parallel data mining based on grid, this paper proposes a data mapping strategy based on minimum time cost: MapND. Firstly, MapND strategy divided data sets referenced in the data mining into data blocks; Then, the strategy respectively estimated the sum of transmission time and data mining time between each mining node and each data block, and mapped each data block to corresponding mining node according to the minimum time sum. Experimental results show that the proposed MapND strategy can solve the problem of data load balancing for data mining nodes, and improve the performance of parallel data mining in grid.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Study on Application Value of EVA in Enterprise Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Dynamical Extension Framework Supporting for Personalized Information Portal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: A kind of personalization extension of Portal framework is studied. Based on the establishment of user pattern which can describe the characteristics of users' behaviors at runtime, a dynamical mechanism for Portiet composition driven by user pattern is presented, which is helpful for improving user experience. The prototypical experiments on the open-source Liferay framework verify the feasibility of the mechanism, which can be applied in E-government and E-Business.

articleTitle: Analysis of Prerequisite for Experts Acquiring and Reporting Informatively
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of strategic information acquisition and information transmission. In our model, a decision maker delegates multiple experts to acquire information concerning a binary decision under uncertainty. The decision maker and experts have different utility functions with respect to the decision problem, which are their private information. We derive the optimal number of experts which the decision maker should delegate providing that all experts acquire information and report sincerely. Then we identify the prerequisite for all experts gathering and reporting informatively. We show that every expert's strategy for information acquisition and transmission when he is one of multiple information senders is generally different from that when he is the only one. And every expert's pivotal probability for the final decision, which is evaluated based on the probability distribution of the decision maker's threshold of doubt, is not equal to his pivotal probability under the majoritarian decision rule with a quota being the expected threshold of doubt of the decision maker.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Technology Used in Transformer's Condition Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Currently the main direction of wireless sensor technology is ZigBee technique, which was built on 802.15.4 Protocol. This paper focused the researching Transformer's Condition Monitoring System which was composed of the design of hardware and software based on ZigBee protocol.

articleTitle: A Research on Inter-enterprise Knowledge Exchange of the Producer Service Cluster (PSC) Based on Knowledge Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Knowledge exchange is the foundation of producer service cluster (PSC), and it is the strong security of PSC to enhance competence. Based on the literature review on industrial cluster, producer service cluster, knowledge network and knowledge exchange, the paper proposes the knowledge network structure of PSC, build the knowledge exchange model of PSC and the three modes of knowledge exchange based on knowledge network, then analyze the significances in the management fields.

articleTitle: Innovative Modes of E-commerce in the Tangible Commodity Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper aims to innovate the e-commerce modes in the tangible commodity market by relating features of tangible goods to the application of e-commerce. It expounds on the creation of shopping-guiding websites that enhance consumers' knowledge about the tangible commodities. It also explores the opening of on-line communities for the building of experiential on-line brand paradigm. Meanwhile, it digs into the on-line/off-line paralled catalogue mode-the most effective way to e-commerce paradigm in the tangible goods market. This paralled catalogue mode will reinforce the judgeability of product quality concerning tangible commodities on line, making it easier to enter into the e-business market.

articleTitle: Research on Water & Soil Conservation and Eco-restoration Management in West-East Natural Gas Pipeline Project of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The West-East Natural Gas Pipeline Project traverses from the west, on through the various types of Eco-fragile regions (belts) in Xinjiang, Gansu, and Ningxia in Northwest China, to the east, along the pipeline with the complicated and variable geomorphology in China. The natural gas pipeline project construction is liable to cause water and soil erosion and intensify the desertification by human beings themselves. Also, the already fragile Eco-environs along the pipeline will be further worsened so that the safety of regional ecosystem will be affected so as to further threaten the safety of the natural gas pipeline. Accordingly, taking the West-East Natural Gas Pipeline Project in Ningxia Section for Example, this paper analyzes Eco-environments in the natural gas pipeline construction regions,studies the Eco-recovery measures of combination of water and soil conservation engineering interfered by human behaviors with bio-vegetation recovery, and carries out Eco-restoration and reconstruction in the construction interference regions, which being very necessity in guaranteeing the safety of both natural gas pipeline and regional Eco-environs.

articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation for Trade Virtual Community Based on Trust Phases
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Virtual community, as a kind of new application of Internet, has greatly changed the way of life, communication and trade. However, lack of trust is often cited as a great barrier of the success of virtual community. This paper takes the trade virtual community for example, analyzes trust phases and models the trust phase of the virtual community, discusses the key point of personalized recommendation of trust phases.

articleTitle: The Current Situation and Countermeasures of Digital Library's Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper mainly analyses the current situation of building the digital library, explains the theory of knowledge management in the digital library, and probes into the strategies of the digital library that applying knowledge management. Following four aspects are the key contents in the paper. At last, the application of knowledge management techniques can be concluded in the digital library.

articleTitle: The Discussion on Virtual B2C Collaboration of Online Shopping
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With online shopping in China's rapid development, several problems rises. This paper proposes the establishment of a virtual B2C E-business Collaboration that intends to provide quality services to buyers, improve customer satisfaction, membership revenue and platform influence, and ultimately, promote the online shopping market's healthy to flourish.

articleTitle: The Analysis Research on Team Performance - Team Competitiveness Based on HM Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The high-performance team is gradually becoming an important resource for enterprises to compete in the market. Scholars have done some related studies on the factors affecting team performance, but they have not distincted the factors from the nature, nor done research on the relationship between the factors and team competitiveness. This article classifies the factors which affect team performance from a new perspective - it introduces two-factor theory, and analyses team competitiveness with the chain of factors affecting team performance. Finally it reaches conclusion that the coexistence of H factor and M factor is the characteristic of a high-Performance team.

articleTitle: Study on Electronic Business of Model Based on VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The application of electronic business is developing very fast. Because of the limitations of HTML, the business information on the Internet is presented by way of 2D, lacking a sense of reality. With the developing of computer network technology and broad band technology, the 3D space information based on visual reality technology comes true. The paper advances modeling of E-commerce based on VR (virtual reality) technology. The application of E-commerce system based on the construction of internet virtual commerce is discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: The Research of Conduct Security Management Based on Evolutionary Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper establishes the evolutionary game model of conduct security management, and analysis its strategies' choice about the interaction between the government and the construction enterprises. In order to enhance the construction security management, the paper also analyzes the evolution of the relevant parties to the dynamic process of the game, and finally gives the optimal strategy of both sides.

articleTitle: Policy Based Wireless Remote Control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The remote control system that supports Wireless handheld devices can manage and control users' computer at home or the office remotely in the world. While current work did not focus on the ability of self-adapting open and dynamic environment, we propose the method of adaptive wireless remote control. The proposed policy is based on the Separation of Concerns principle, thus it can provide a flexible self-adaptation solution of wireless remote control. To demonstrate the feasibility of flexibility and adaptability and generalized applicability of the proposed method, video surveillance scenario is examined and testified.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Science and Technology Policy of Establishing Water-saving and Pollutant-reducing Green Industrial Structure in Guangzhou
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Alliance of Tourism Based on Industry Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Nowadays, gaining standing competitive advantage and enhancing sustainable development ability through knowledge alliance is a brand new idea that tourism enterprise should have. This article first has carried on the limits to the concept of knowledge alliance, and then has carried on the analysis to tourism industry value chain, according to the status and role tourism-related enterprises have in tourism industry value chain, this article has constructed knowledge alliance model based on industry value chain, and puts forward several proposals to safeguard knowledge alliance stable.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Modeling and Simulation of Multi-stage Supply Chain under Random Demand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The paper starts with the Casual Loop Diagram (CLD) of each supply chain node. The system dynamics model of supply chain node is given. Based on this, the model of multi-stage supply chain consisting of manufacturer, distributor, wholesaler and retailer is given as well. The simulation results under the random demand show that remarkable bullwhip effect is exist. The sensitivity analysis indicate that the lead time has the greatest impact on the supply chain compare to the safety inventory and period of forecast.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Constituents of Dynamic Capabilities from Evolution Perspective and its Empirical Evidence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Two-stage Personalized Recommendation in CTS Using Graph-Based Clustering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Collaborative tagging systems (CTS) enable Internet users to annotate for resources using custom tags, and the tags reflect the user interest and thus form a user profile. However, the flexibility of tagging brings large number of synonymous and polysemous tags which make the use of these profile information to personalize resource recommendation difficult. We propose to use graph-based clustering to form groups of semantically-related tags in the offline stage. Then in the online stage the tag clusters act as an intermediary between users and resource and are utilized to personalize the query results in CTS. 5-fold cross-validation is performed on two data sets, the results are compared with two other algorithms. Results show that the algorithm proposed demonstrate much better personalization measured by the F-value, whilst the effect is more miraculous in a multi-topic than in a single-topic CTS. This observation suggests that in a multi-topic CTS tag clustering such as proposed in this paper is an important strategy.

articleTitle: An On-line Approach for Emergency Relief Scheduling Problem under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In order to reduce losses, Relief Transfer Center needs to make a trade-off between the urgency degree and the size of demands. Assuming the losses of unsatisfied relief demands have a positive relationship with delayed time, this paper first get an optimal offline strategy under the known demand sequences and point out that the time complexity is ; secondly, under the unknown demand sequences, we use a on-line approach to get the competitive ratio of strategy FIFO and MQF; at last, aim to the characteristics of this problem, we give a on-line strategy with competitive ratio.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model of Customer Satisfaction Degree
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper takes attention to the customer satisfaction evaluation, and puts fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method into use. Firstly, the paper establishes the evaluation index system of customer satisfaction degree by combining with the influences of customer satisfaction. Secondly, it establishes the evaluation model. Finally, it has been realized comprehensive evaluation of customer satisfaction through the example.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Advertising Expenditure Decision-making of Chinese Enterprises Based on Grey System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Taking the advertising laboratory trial findings made by Hill and Mackerel as the theoretical support, the relationship between advertising expenditure and product sales before and after the financial crisis in Chinese enterprises is analyzed empirically by utilizing Grey System on the basis of the specific data got from questionnaire survey. The hypothesis is verified after constructing the model and utilizing the data, and then proposals are given to guide Chinese enterprises to take corresponding measures to overcome the financial crisis.

articleTitle: Study on Application of Long-distance Education Resource Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Because of the importance effect of visualization in science computation, grid-based visualization has become a new research field, visualization application has visibility and high efficiency, which extends the range of service and the ability of remote access. Based on the campus grid platform, we integrate some multi-subjects parallel software, make a breakthrough on the techniques of web-based three-dimensional graphic display, and achieve job run workflow and visualization of computation resource use status and computation results.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Model Selection and Realization Approaches for the Tourism Development and Environmental Protection of the National Geopark in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Accounting Affairs of Provision for Impairment of Fixed Assets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: According to the Accounting System of Enterprises Business, enterprises should make provision for the recoverable amount of fixed asset is lower than its carrying amount and reverse the loss of the impairment of fixes assets in time. The accountant should master the accounting principles scientifically in practice and handle well the business related to provisions for impairment of fixed assets, and reflect the amount of fixed assets in the end of period in order to reduce the financial risks of enterprises.

Author Keywords: provision for impairment of fixed assets

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: To Cancel the Enforced Supervision Policy is Imperative
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on the Method of Ranking Scientific Papers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: How to estimate the value of a scientific paper is a common requirement, when we facing so many retrieved scientific papers. This paper provides a method named PaperRank for ranking scientific papers based on Google's PageRank, which considers those factors reflecting the reading value of the papers such as content, journal, author, published time etc. The method of ranking papers also can be seen as recommendations of the papers, and related knowledge, such as important authors and important journals in the field.

articleTitle: An Improved Frame Interpolation Algorithm for Side Information in Wyner-Ziv Decoder
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper proposes an improved frame interpolation algorithm. The forward motion vectors between the previous and the next key frame is gained at first by traditional block matching algorithm. Then we get the backward motion vectors by using the dynamic search range based on the already known forward motion vector. After smoothing the bidirectional motion vectors, we can get more accurate motion vectors which are closer to the true object motion. By bidirectional motion compensation, we can obtain the side information at last. According to the simulation results, the proposed algorithm works better than the conventional one in subjective quality as well as in objective quality, and it is very simple to be implemented on DVC system.

articleTitle: Improvement of Time Parameter Calculation Models for the Multi-Dependency Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
