abstract: The complexity of the existing time parameter calculation methods limits its wide-spread use for the multi-dependency network. Aimed at the above shortcoming, this paper develops a new conception which is overlap time difference on the basis of the study on the relationship between two activities, and then the multi-dependency network is transformed into activity-on-network in broad sense. Forwardly, the paper also presents corresponding time parameter calculation steps and formulas which reduce calculation works greatly. Finally, the effectiveness of the new methods is tested and verified by an example.

articleTitle: Research on the Synergetic Management Mechanism of R&D Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper analyzes the necessity of the Synergetic management of R&D projects, revealing their effectiveness and productiveness and then establishing a structural equation model which demonstrates the relations between the supporting factors, knowledge-learning factors, organizing ability factors and the effectiveness and productiveness in the Synergetic management of R&D projects. On the basis of exploratory factor analysis, confirmatory factor analysis and full structure equation model analysis, the essay concludes: (1) the supporting factors and productive factors are directly correlated to the feasibility of synergetic management in R & D projects; (2) in the process, knowledge-learning and organizing ability factors, which are of a positive correlation with the productiveness of Synergetic management in R&D projects, have indirect influences on the feasibility of Synergetic management in R& D projects.

articleTitle: Nonstandard Employing Worker's Job Satisfaction: A Comparative Research between Intelligent and Traditional Workers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Recent years, nonstandard employment has been coming an important method for organization to increase its flexible ability. The new employment relationship has lead to new employee working attitude. The job satisfaction is one of basic and vital index. However nonstandard employing workers is a huge extension group, different nonstandard employing workers have different feature, and have different job satisfaction. This research divides nonstandard employing workers into intelligent and traditional workers based on their knowledge, skill, and experience, and compares the difference of job satisfaction between two types by empirical research. The results show the intelligent workers' job satisfaction is higher than traditional worker's on most components, however they is less satisfied than traditional workers on one component, and is similar with traditional workers on one component.

articleTitle: Practice and Theory of Research-Oriented Teaching in Advanced Mathematics Based on E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: With the development of educational informatization and educational resources networked, concepts and methods of advanced mathematics teaching has undergone significant changes. People paid more attention to E-Learning which increasingly has been applied in practice. This paper analyzes the connotations of E-Learning and research-oriented teaching, points out that research-oriented teaching in advanced mathematics based on E-Learning is a new teaching mode which suit to innovative education. On these bases, this paper researches how to carry out the teaching mode of research-oriented teaching in advanced mathematics based on E-Learning combined with practical teaching. This paper provides a new paradigm for the integration of education of traditional subjects and the modern technology.

articleTitle: Research on the Information Integration Standard of Multi-interchange Based on the Life Cycle Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the theory cycle, the information research of Multi-interchange mainly focuses on the information integration system, the information integration technique and its platform. There are few researches on the information integration target. This thesis applied the life cycle theory and stakeholder theory to the information integration system. And By applying the method for Attributes Reduction from the Rough Sets Theory, this paper selected the index subsets which are strongly related to the standard of project success as the project information integration standard. Through research, this paper settled the problems of the information deficiency and ambiguous information integration target of the Multi-interchange and then promoted the development of the Multi-interchange project.

articleTitle: The Application of the Optimal Stopping Theory in E-supply Chain Basic data proofreading
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Based on the electronic supply chain partners selection and evaluation process, according to the theory of optimal stopping theory, this paper constructed a mathematical model which was based on the data proofreading optimal problem of supply chain partner and also generalized this decision problem. The two kinds of typical models are discussed in this paper. The optimal solution and condition are brought forward. The calculation steps are also prompted based on cutting tails method.

articleTitle: Construction of Threshold Concept-Based Programming Courses Ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: There have been many studies showing that learning to program is really challenging for most students,while a lot of works have been done to improve the effective and efficiency of programming teaching and learning. This paper first reviewed the literature on studies of threshold concepts of computer science, Ontology construction of programming domain, and construction of university course Ontology, then based on these research outcomes, provided a programming course ontology based on threshold concepts of computer science. This research will provide a foundation for the development of Ontology based personalized learning system.

articleTitle: Online Advertising Regulatory Resources Integration: A Framework Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Through in-depth analysis of the current situation of online advertising regulation in China, the practical problems and difficulties in supervision and administration over the online advertising are pointed out. The effectiveness of regulation is seriously affected by lack of unified regulatory approaches, advanced technologies and coordination among different authorities. Some solutions are proposed to regulate the online advertising. In this paper, an integrated framework of online advertising regulatory based on SOA is proposed, in order to break the barriers and boundaries between departments, promote the extent of information resources sharing, and finally improve the regulatory efficiency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on Manpower Resource Management for Civilian-run Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Graph-Based Square Grids Generating Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Graph grammar has been employed as a tool to express formal logic of graph structures. Among different mechanisms, pullback categorical grammars have been proved to be intrinsically context-free. We will show in this paper that this kind of graph grammar can be used for modeling a mechanism which generates square grids and only square grids. With semantics this mechanism will be a good candidate for studying semantic web, or semantic grid.

articleTitle: Research on Commercial Credit Guarantee Model Based on Guarantee Premium
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The role of guarantee companies is to provide guarantee, take the form of liquid collateral offered to support for and facilitate corporate financing. This paper firstly studies and establishes model of guarantee-default using only information specific to borrower whose corresponding probability schedule of default reflects strategic information. Secondly, the paper expounds that credit is rationed by quantity, causing its equilibrium price to be higher than what comes from the equilibrium of supply and demand. Thirdly, this paper shows a model of estimating a guarantee rate to implement guarantee agreements. Fourthly, through an emperical case, this paper verifies that the default mode to measure the credit loss is appropriate.

articleTitle: Patent Evaluation of Universities in Shanghai by Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In this paper, patent indicators are selected to build patent evaluation index system of universities in Shanghai. The method of principle component analysis is used to conduct comprehensive evaluation. The patent indicators are carefully weighed in specific by their influences. As a result, the system is validated by a practical evaluation of 10 universities in Shanghai. It can be a useful guidance for both academia and industries.

articleTitle: A Concept Modeling Approach for Connected Transaction between the Listed Company and Their Parent Company
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Connected transaction is prevalent between the listed firms and their parent company at the expense of the minority shareholders, which violate the order of market. In this paper, social ontology and BDI model are presented to analyze the connected transaction. This approach is expected to understand the domain problems comprehensive and provide an innovative method to detect connected transaction.

articleTitle: Quantity Competition under Demand Slope Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Consider a model where firms own the same technology in linear Cournot duopolies with differentiated products and the slope of the demand curve facing the firm is unknown, especially which contains own-price effect and cross-effect. We discuss as follows: whether there is an incentive to share information when firms are symmetrically informed about the random demand. In a two-stage game, on the one hand, it is a Nash equilibrium for the competitors to share their information for relatively perfect substitutes, and sufficiently large variation in the demand slope, or for relatively poor substitutes, not depending on the precision of the information and the variation of the demand slope.

articleTitle: Optimal Supply of Manufacturer under Electronic Secondary Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The advance of business-to-business commerce has result in the establishment of many types of electronic marketplace. This paper focuses on a market exchange as the "secondary market" for the perishable goods-that is, for the resellers to disposal and acquisition of excess perishable goods inventory. Follow the method of Lee and Whang(2002), we develop a model of secondary market in the case of given supply price P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> to clear the market. In this model, one manufacturer and n resellers compose a two-stage supply chain for perishable goods. The sale season is divided into two periods. At the beginning of first period, resellers order directly from the manufacturer, and at the beginning of second period, electronic secondary market opens, resellers can trade inventory among themselves in it. We endogenously derive the optimal decisions for the resellers, along with the equilibrium market price of the secondary market and supply price. And based on the analysis of resellers' decisions, we deduce the optimal supply for the maximization of manufacturer's profit.

Author Keywords: perishable goods electronic secondary market optimal supply

articleTitle: The Design of Improved Motion Estimation Algorithm for H.264 Based on GA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: An improved algorithm of motion estimation is proposed based on H.264 coding standard in this paper. The basic principle of motion estimated is analyzed at first. Then the improved algorithm is designed. This algorithm makes improvements in selection of muti-reference frames, initial point of searching and process of searching. Especially an improved genetic algorithm is adopted in process of searching, and it is of important role in speeding up the motion estimation procedure. The experimental results show that compared with other fast search approaches, such as the full searching and the three steps searching, this algorithm improves coding efficiency and keeps excellent image quality. Moreover, it also has good stability. As a consequence, this improved algorithm has great practical utility.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Economic Cycle, Economic Shocks and Small-Firm Effect: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on Linkage Mechanism between Manufacturing and Logistics Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Practical and Multi-layer Net for Supplier Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Service Model and NGN's New Service Deployment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The guiding principle of next generation network is separating service application layer and traffic transmission layer to build a network with characteristics of controllable, QoS guaranteed and service deployment open. But, what factors should be mainly thought about before new network service exploitation and deployment? This paper firstly proposed a service model including the characteristics of traffic generation and commerce revenue, named as Traffic-Charge Integrated Service Model (TCISM). Then, joining TCISM and three NGN's key parameters (network bound, resource price and QoS level), a basic methodology on NGNs service deployment process is given out to primarily answer the above question.

articleTitle: The Research of Remote-Monitoring System of the Gas Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article discusses the development of monitoring system about the security situation in coal production and coal mining. In order to solve the problem of coal mine monitoring systems and self-management of coal enterprises, Adopt the Socket communication mechanism based on TCP protocol, design the Real-time monitoring and development of a WEB-based remote coal mine gas monitoring system. The test result of this system indicates that it works normally and reaches the design goals, and it has been successfully applied in a coal mine in Shanxi province.

articleTitle: Interpolation Model for Threat Evaluation of Targets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Threat evaluation of targets, an important part in warship's C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>ISR, was the judgment of threat levels. A Shepard interpolation model for threat evaluation of the air targets is presented. It can be helpful to estimate the threat levels of air targets in the anti-air combat of single ship. Using standard threat levels based on standard battle-field situations, threat levels can be generated from the interpolation model according to attribute values of the new target. The case study at the end shows the effectiveness and simplicity of the model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Comprehensive Evaluation of the Listed Power Energy Companies' Growth Ability Based on Improved Seasonal Dynamics and Multi-index
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Strategic Analysis of New-type Industrialization Which is Under the Background of Information-Based Business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on the Necessity of College Teachers to Establish the Information System Education Concept
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: This paper argues that the education of Information system is a kind of modern ideological emancipation movement with scientific thinking as its subject, a natural extension and a higher stage of the computer education, and at the same time, a concrete manifestation of information quality education. We describe the origin, definition and the education pattern of information system literacy, and suggest that information system literacy is one of the college teacher's basic qualities. It is necessary and urgent to establish the concept of information system literacy education, for college teachers are entrusted with the responsibility of information system education, and they should put themselves at the forward position of the ideological emancipation movement.

articleTitle: The Studies of Harmonious Relationship between FDI and China's Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: As the world's second largest FDI inflow country, and the world's largest developing country, China faced with the increasingly serious environmental problems. The FDI inflow is a two-edge sword, along with the great effect in host country's economic development, they also bring in the pollution industries which badly influence the environment. In this way, the studies on the coordination between the FDI and the environment issues have great significance. In this paper, after the exploration of the relationship between FDI and environment, it will figure out the big negative impact on the fragile environment. In order to solve this problem, this paper will offer corresponding countermeasures and suggestions to solve China's deteriorate environment.

articleTitle: Regional S&T Database Share and Information Platform: A Case Study of Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Scientific data are the important strategic resources for national scientific innovation, economic growth, social progress and national security. However, due to the low level of data share, these data can hardly be used effectively. The constantly repetitive collection of basic data results in the great waste in labor and capital. Therefore, how to solve the data share has become an exigent problem. In this paper, we analyze the theory of constructing S&T statistic database and information platform, and then, we introduce the practical implement of this system in Hebei province, and draws some conclusions.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Study about Entry Modes Choice of Multinational Corporate Based on Knowledge Transfer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: It is an important reason of international expansion of multinational corporation to hold distinctive knowledge. Based on knowledge transfer theory, the text uses means of comparing cost and comparing net benefit to analyze overseas entry modes of multinationals. First, the text discusses how knowledge tacitness affects four entry modes (licensing, joint venture, wholly owned entry, export) of multinational corporations; and then the text discusses how knowledge transmission capacity of source corporation moderate the relationship between knowledge tacitness and the choice of entry strategies; finally, the text analyzes how knowledge absorptive capacity of objective corporation moderate the relationship between knowledge tacitness and the choice of entry strategies. The text confirms optimum entry modes under impact of several factors of knowledge transfer. The study enriches theoretical perspectives on entry strategy of multinational in some ways.

articleTitle: A Study on Manage Mechanism of College Internet Public Opinion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: College internet public opinion has characteristics of sudden, emotional, extensive and controllable, the current control and guide pattern have shortcomings such as slow response, too many directions and little investment. Currently, colleges and universities have gradually established the team for college internet public opinion. The organization construction of the teams should include four aspects with a normal, tolerant and responsible mind.

articleTitle: The Learning Effectiveness of an Online Inquiry-based Course in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In Taiwan, since WebQuest has been used as an inquiry-based learning and creative teaching strategy in primary and secondary schools, it has been rarely used for general education in universities. The purpose of this study was to examine the impact of WebQuest learning activities on students' learning behavior and cognitive changes between two music appreciation courses in a university by applying the t-test. Participants included a control group of 36 students and an experimental group of 35 from a university in central Taiwan. In a quasi-experimental design, all students were assigned to be the experts in the final task, with and without WebQuest. The results showed that there was a significant difference between the two common factors: team integration and independent thinking. And there was a significant difference in learning effectiveness scores for students in either group under the accommodated condition. This has proved that WebQuest can be used in music appreciation as a creative educational tool. It can promote the learning effectiveness in music appreciation course. In addition, it can improve the creative higher order thinking ability after the WebQuest task was assigned.

articleTitle: An Appraisal on Business Efficiency of Insurance Industry of China - An Empirical Study Based on DEA Non-parameter Estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The Competitiveness is a key of the continuous development of insurance companies, while the efficiency embodies the competitiveness. Applying Data envelopment analysis (DEA) method, this essay worked out the figures of technical efficiency, pure technical efficiency and scale efficiency. After the analysis, it is found that the insurance industry has a fatal problem on wasting resources due to both low scale efficiency and pure technical efficiency which usually exist in the domestic insurance industry. After China entered WTO, the daily management standard of the whole insurance industry did not improve markedly, although the international market changes.

articleTitle: Impact of Personal Relationship of Inventors on the Partner Selection of Cooperative Technological Innovation - Based on an Analysis of Enterprises in Xi'an High-tech Zone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: QAP regression is used to analyse the relations between personal relationship of inventors (i.e. scientists, engineers and other staff who are responsible for the patent) and firm's relationship of cooperative technological innovation. With different conclusions drawn by previous studies, the paper did not find the persistence of relationship of cooperative technological innovation, i.e. companies are not inclined to cooperate with the previous partners (i.e. the embeddedness is not obvious), but will choose the enterprises where the inventors work who have the personal relationship with the inventors of companies in the current period.

articleTitle: The Development Strategies of Human Resource Management of Chinese Enterprises in the Context of Financial Crisis - Based on Enlightenment of Alibaba Group
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Financial crisis has brought about serious challenges for human resource management of enterprises in China. Based on analyzing the new problems faced by human resource management of Chinese enterprises in the context of financial crisis, and combining with the human resource strategies of China's largest e-commerce enterprises - Alibaba Group response to the financial crisis, the paper pointed out that Chinese enterprises should adjust the relevant management strategies, enhance the loyalty and trust of employees according to changes of internal and external environment from aspects of the dynamic allocation of human resources, salary structure, employee training, labor relations and others, eventually enhance the performance management and achieve long-term development of enterprises.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Algorithm Introduced Factor of Authority and Trust
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The traditional collaborative filtering algorithm is too much emphasizing on the role of similarity of the predicted value that there have a higher Sparse Data and poor result of Recommendation. In addition to similarity, the user's trust and authority are also an important factor that will affect the result of recommendation in the algorithm by analyzing. Proposing a new filtering method by introducing factor of authority and trust, by which the users have a more reasonable and reasonable assessment of the resources. Experiments show the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: China's E-Government Research and the Conception of its Disciplinization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Since the launch of “Government Online Project”, China has been taking shape in its e-government field, while the e-government study, as well, manifests itself in features of multidisciplinary interaction, extensive range of study, profound scientific achievements and the like. Theoretical research of e-government could be traced back to the exploration of practical area and serves as the part-and-parcel guidance for its further expansion. Therefore, from the angle of interdisciplinary science development, the author aims to draw a measure of oriented analysis with reference to scientific documents, graduation papers of colleges and universities, academic conferences etc. in the field of e-government research and devote efforts to the its growth in our nation through raising a scientifically systematic conception in terms of the establishment of e-government.

articleTitle: Firm Entry, Exit and Industrial Dynamic Revisited: The Perspective of Dynamical System Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: An industrial endogenous model in long - term equilibrium shows that the entry and exit of enterprise is the motivity for industrial evolution. In the case of monopolistic competition structure, there should exists market power in some degree. However, the number of monopolistic firms could not be so large that ensured the stimulant by innovative rent. In the viewpoints of long - term market dynamics, dynamic system model shows the interaction coefficient, intrinsic growth rate, self-inhibition rate, competitive inhibition rate and delays have a major impact on long-term development, and the enterprises with different size and capability may coexist under certain conditions.

articleTitle: Study on the Dynamic Mechanism of the Universities' Independent Innovation Based on Industry-University-Research Institute Alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The drive of universities' Independent Innovation is the key and decisive factor during the whole process of the university's Innovation. This paper, analyzing the relationship between industry-university-research institute alliance and universities' Independent Innovation, mainly focuses on the perspective of industry-university-research institute alliance including the interests drive the mechanism, the organization coordination mechanism, the cooperative R&D mechanism, the interaction and communication mechanism, and the outer guarantee mechanism. What's more, this thesis, taking Central South University as the analytical example, further proves how the above-mentioned dynamic mechanisms promote the improvement of the university's Independent Innovation ability.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Family Enterprises need to employ professional managers in order to carry out sustainable development strategy. During the process, there are various challenges as well as opportunities. By means of selecting, examining and cultivating the professional managers, ecological relationships of mutualistic symbiosis and synergy evolution can be established between them.

articleTitle: Building of Competency-Based Human Resource Strategic Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Because of great change of business environment and diversity of employees, traditional strategic planning of human resources faces more and more challenges. On the one hand, according to enterprise strategy, deductive method-based human resource strategic planning will fix the requirements of employees' behaviors. On the other hand, competency-based human resource strategic planning will bring employees' behavior management into the modules of human resource management. Therefore, human resource management will become one part of enterprise strategic planning.

articleTitle: Implementation of Far Query Based on Texture of Image in Web
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Because of the features of image information itself, the results of query by text in many cases are not useful. How to query by texture of image have been studied especially in this paper. A solution of using ISAPI for image database based on B/S is provided. A method developing query image texture in image database based on Web is alse provided.

articleTitle: CDIO and Teaching Reform of Document Retrieval Courses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: CDIO is a new education model, which cultures students' specialized technical knowledge, individual ability, professional ability and ability of working and communicating in team towards systemic product design. We obtain practical experience using organic combination between document retrieval and analog electronic technology, and try out a teaching model of document retrieval combined with specialized courses which is lectured by professional teachers. The model is formed by the following three stages. First, methods and theories developed by social scientists and mathematical logicians were adopted to conceive the course content structures and the formation rules for project teams. Second, internet based information sharing tools developed by systems engineers were utilized to encourage organized interactions among students and teachers. Then, it leveraged the lecture hours as a“marketing”platform for students to share their findings and exhibit their creativity based on flexibly designed assignments. Practice shows that the organic combination between document retrieval and specialized courses is an ideal education model of document retrieval under CDIO.

articleTitle: Application and Study on Test Data Analysis in Software Reliability Evaluation Model Selection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In the software reliability evaluation, selection of model directly affect the reliability evaluation and accuracy of the forecast result. So testing data input to any models, impact of its quality and completeness on the reliability of measurement results is much larger than impact of suppose the quality and evaluation ability of the model. For example, such as actual data set, study on selection and processing of testing data and kinds of data analysis techniques in selection process of reliability model, is useful to help select more effective and rational evaluating models and improve accuracy of the forecast in software reliability evaluation.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: The importance of suited business process and information flow to supply chain was set forth, then, this paper analyzed the impacts of tightly coupled business process on the whole performance of supply chain through a simple example about a supplier and a vendor, two as-is models of original business processes were improved a new and integrated to-be model was provided, and the effect of improvement was also descripted. Next, business process reengineering on the basis of improvement of information controlling flow was discussed.

articleTitle: Marketing Functions and Features of Exhibition in “e” Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Exhibition is an important enterprise marketing platform to explore the market. It has not only these capabilities of gathering information, promotion and expanding place, but also features of low-cost and distinctive-effect. In “e” environment, the marketing function of exhibition is better. Network exhibition, which has more promotion and interactive features, makes it possible to never end. A successful exhibition also needs to integrate with other supporting industries, such as restaurants, hotels, tourism, advertising, commerce, telecommunications, transportation, etc.

articleTitle: The 4R Theory and Empirical Study Based on Relationship Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: At present, people's focus has shifted from the demand purchase to the value investments. The value becomes soul of marketing, which makes marketing research to be launched around the value. Through the introducing important intermediary of the relationship levels and related-party fit, discussing interaction among 4R, the relationship levels and related-party fit, so as to upgrade relationship value--4R and the relationship value have been dovetailed--this paper proposes the 4R theoretical models based on the relationship value. In order to more powerful prove the 4R to relationship value's upgrading, the paper selects mobile communications companies to build structural equation, and validates 4R theoretical models, which provides theoretical basis and decision-making guidance for marketing activities of enterprises, especially mobile communications companies at this stage.

articleTitle: Note on EOQ Model with Stock-Dependent Demand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: In 1988, Baker and Urban presented an inventory model with stock dependent selling rate. First, this paper develops the existence and uniqueness of the solution to the problem. Second, this paper explains that it is appropriate to use the Newton method to find the optimal solutions of the profit function per unit time.

abstract: The paper briefly generalizes the subject system and basic issues of the evolvement of e-government, mightily characterizes the variance and innovation mechanism of the system, and in virtue of such tools, analyzes the evolvement of e-government.

articleTitle: Analysis on IT's ROI in Businesses Based on REJ Framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on E-Business and E-Government
abstract: Traditional result oriented IT's appreciation model satisfied businesses requirement seldom. Instead, process oriented one - REJ framework gave rise to attention. So far, this framework considered much less disbenefits from changing environment, systematic reliability risks, and utilization risks. This paper conducted four process factors and constructed a framework to analyze above problems qualitatively by introducing three risk variable factors, and discussed it further.
